   351: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL String8 c_declaration_link_name(Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CDeclaration declaration)
   352: {
   353:     u32 end = declaration.body_start ? declaration.body_start - 1 : declaration.token_start + declaration.token_count;
   354:     for (u32 index = declaration.token_start; index + 3 < end; index += 1)
   355:     {
   356:         CToken token = preprocess.tokens[index];
   357:         if (token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER ||
   358:             !c_token_in_well_known_set(preprocess.spelling_base, token,
   359:                                        C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_BIT(ASM) | C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_BIT(ASM_GNU) | C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_BIT(ASM_GNU_ALT)) ||
   360:             !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) ||
   361:             preprocess.tokens[index + 2].kind != C_TOKEN_STRING_LITERAL ||
   362:             !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index + 3], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
   363:         {
   364:             continue;
   365:         }
   366:         ByteSlice decoded = {0};
   367:         if (c_ir_decode_quoted(arena, c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index + 2]), '"', &decoded) && decoded.length)
   368:         {
   369:             return (String8){
   370:                 .pointer = (char8*)decoded.pointer,
   371:                 .length = decoded.length,
   372:             };
   373:         }
   374:     }
   375:     return declaration.name;
   376: }

   390: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL String8 c_ir_scalar_type_name(CTypeKind kind)
   391: {
   392:     switch (kind)
   393:     {
   394:     case C_TYPE_VOID:
   395:         return S8("void");
   396:     case C_TYPE_BOOL:
   397:         return S8("_Bool");
   398:     case C_TYPE_CHAR:
   399:         return S8("char");
   400:     case C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR:
   401:         return S8("signed char");
   402:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR:
   403:         return S8("unsigned char");
   404:     case C_TYPE_SHORT:
   405:         return S8("short");
   406:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT:
   407:         return S8("unsigned short");
   408:     case C_TYPE_INT:
   409:         return S8("int");
   410:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT:
   411:         return S8("unsigned int");
   412:     case C_TYPE_LONG:
   413:         return S8("long");
   414:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG:
   415:         return S8("unsigned long");
   416:     case C_TYPE_LONG_LONG:
   417:         return S8("long long");
   418:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG:
   419:         return S8("unsigned long long");
   420:     case C_TYPE_INT128:
   421:         return S8("__int128");
   422:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128:
   423:         return S8("unsigned __int128");
   424:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16:
   425:     case C_TYPE_BFLOAT16:
   426:         return kind == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16 ? S8("__bf16") : S8("_Float16");
   427:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT:
   428:         return S8("float");
   429:     case C_TYPE_DOUBLE:
   430:         return S8("double");
   431:     case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE:
   432:         return S8("long double");
   433:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX:
   434:         return S8("_Float16 _Complex");
   435:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX:
   436:         return S8("float _Complex");
   437:     case C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
   438:         return S8("double _Complex");
   439:     case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
   440:         return S8("long double _Complex");
   441:     case C_TYPE_VA_LIST:
   442:         return S8("va_list");
   443:     case C_TYPE_NULLPTR:
   444:         return S8("nullptr_t");
   445:     case C_TYPE_INVALID:
   446:     case C_TYPE_POINTER:
   447:     case C_TYPE_ARRAY:
   448:     case C_TYPE_VECTOR:
   449:     case C_TYPE_FUNCTION:
   450:     case C_TYPE_STRUCT:
   451:     case C_TYPE_UNION:
   452:     case C_TYPE_ENUM:
   453:     case C_TYPE_COUNT:
   454:         return (String8){0};
   455:     }
   456:     return (String8){0};
   457: }

  4605: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_type_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end);
  4606: 
  4607: // May the parenthesized group opening at `open` spell a type name?  False
  4608: // only when the token after the `(` proves it cannot, without entering the
  4609: // query machine.  c_ir_type_name_prefix accepts a type name that begins with
  4610: // a type, qualifier, tag, typeof or _Atomic keyword, a decoration
  4611: // c_ir_primitive_type_kind steps over (an attribute, an asm label, a `[[`
  4612: // attribute) or an identifier naming a typedef, and nothing else, so:
  4613: // - a number, a string, a character and every punctuator but `[` is refused
  4614: //   outright;
  4615: // - an identifier the parser bound to a local, object, parameter,
  4616: //   enumerator or function is refused too: the prefix reads that binding
  4617: //   before any scope lookup, and none of them is a typedef.  Its spelling
  4618: //   must not be one of the keywords above, which
  4619: //   c_parse_type_name_start_word_token answers from the word bits (an
  4620: //   interned spelling outside the predefined range is no keyword; symbol 0
  4621: //   is unclassified and stays a candidate).
  4622: // An unbound identifier keeps the scope-chain lookup the probe does for it,
  4623: // and a typedef is the candidate the probe exists for.
  4624: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_group_may_be_type_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open)
  4625: {
  4626:     bool result = true;
  4627:     if (open + 1 < builder->preprocess.token_count)
  4628:     {
  4629:         CToken first = builder->preprocess.tokens[open + 1];
  4630:         if (first.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
  4631:         {
  4632:             result = first.punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET;
  4633:         }
  4634:         else if (first.symbol && !c_parse_type_name_start_word_token(builder->preprocess, first))
  4635:         {
  4636:             CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, open + 1);
  4637:             if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count)
  4638:             {
  4639:                 CEntityKind kind = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].kind;
  4640:                 result = kind != C_ENTITY_LOCAL && kind != C_ENTITY_OBJECT && kind != C_ENTITY_PARAMETER && kind != C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR &&
  4641:                          kind != C_ENTITY_FUNCTION;
  4642:             }
  4643:         }
  4644:     }
  4645:     return result;
  4646: }
  4647: 
  4648: // The memo slot for the group opening at `open`, in the body-token array
  4649: // prepared_call_indices also spans: a `(` outside the body -- a parameter
  4650: // bound's declarator, a global initializer -- has none and is probed each
  4651: // time.
  4652: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32* c_ir_group_type_name_slot(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open)
  4653: {
  4654:     u32* slot = 0;
  4655:     if (builder->group_type_names && open >= builder->body_token_start && open - builder->body_token_start < builder->body_token_count)
  4656:     {
  4657:         slot = builder->group_type_names + (open - builder->body_token_start);
  4658:     }
  4659:     return slot;
  4660: }
  4661: 
  4662: // Whether a probe's answer for the group `open .. close` may be stored.  A
  4663: // group headed by typeof/__typeof__/__typeof/typeof_unqual reads the locals
  4664: // declared so far, so its answer can change between two probes; a lone
  4665: // identifier the parser left unbound is looked up at file scope by
  4666: // c_ir_type_name and at the declaration's scope by the query, so the two
  4667: // probe paths may not share one answer for it.  Everything else is a
  4668: // function of the tokens and the parse alone.
  4669: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_group_type_name_memoizable(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open, u32 close)
  4670: {
  4671:     bool result = true;
  4672:     CToken first = builder->preprocess.tokens[open + 1];
  4673:     if (first.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
  4674:     {
  4675:         String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, first);
  4676:         if (string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__typeof__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__typeof")) ||
  4677:             string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof_unqual")))
  4678:         {
  4679:             result = false;
  4680:         }
  4681:         else if (close == open + 2 && c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, open + 1).value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  4682:         {
  4683:             result = false;
  4684:         }
  4685:     }
  4686:     return result;
  4687: }
  4688: 
  4689: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_group_type_name_encode(IrTypeId type)
  4690: {
  4691:     return type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? 1 : type.value + 2;
  4692: }
  4693: 
  4694: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_group_type_name_decode(u32 encoded)
  4695: {
  4696:     IrTypeId result;
  4697:     if (encoded == 1)
  4698:     {
  4699:         result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  4700:     }
  4701:     else
  4702:     {
  4703:         result = (IrTypeId){.value = encoded - 2};
  4704:     }
  4705:     return result;
  4706: }

  4708: // The type name the group `open .. close` (a `(` and its matching `)`)
  4709: // spells, or invalid: c_ir_type_name over the interior, asked once per
  4710: // opener.  The gate refuses the groups that cannot be one before the query
  4711: // machine runs, and the memo answers the second and third probe of one `(`
  4712: // -- the expression steps, the unary-end scan and the call preparer each ask
  4713: // -- so the probe itself, unchanged, stays the reference for both.
  4714: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_group_type_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open, u32 close)
  4715: {
  4716:     IrTypeId result;
  4717:     u32* slot = c_ir_group_type_name_slot(builder, open);
  4718:     if (slot && *slot)
  4719:     {
  4720:         result = c_ir_group_type_name_decode(*slot);
  4721:     }
  4722:     else if (!c_ir_group_may_be_type_name(builder, open))
  4723:     {
  4724:         result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  4725:         if (slot)
  4726:         {
  4727:             *slot = 1;
  4728:         }
  4729:     }
  4730:     else
  4731:     {
  4732:         result = c_ir_type_name(builder, open + 1, close);
  4733:         if (slot && c_ir_group_type_name_memoizable(builder, open, close))
  4734:         {
  4735:             *slot = c_ir_group_type_name_encode(result);
  4736:         }
  4737:     }
  4738:     return result;
  4739: }
  4740: 
  4741: // c_ir_query_type_name over the same group, for callers that run inside the
  4742: // query machine: the gate and the memo answer without raising a request, and
  4743: // a request the probe raises passes through unanswered -- has_request set,
  4744: // type_out untouched -- exactly as before.
  4745: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_query_group_type_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open, u32 close, IrTypeId* type_out)
  4746: {
  4747:     bool resolved;
  4748:     u32* slot = c_ir_group_type_name_slot(builder, open);
  4749:     if (slot && *slot)
  4750:     {
  4751:         *type_out = c_ir_group_type_name_decode(*slot);
  4752:         resolved = type_out->value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
  4753:     }
  4754:     else if (!c_ir_group_may_be_type_name(builder, open))
  4755:     {
  4756:         *type_out = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  4757:         resolved = false;
  4758:         if (slot)
  4759:         {
  4760:             *slot = 1;
  4761:         }
  4762:     }
  4763:     else
  4764:     {
  4765:         resolved = c_ir_query_type_name(builder, open + 1, close, true, type_out);
  4766:         if (!builder->queries->has_request && slot && c_ir_group_type_name_memoizable(builder, open, close))
  4767:         {
  4768:             *slot = c_ir_group_type_name_encode(*type_out);
  4769:         }
  4770:     }

  6315: 
  6316: /* Whether every atomic access the lowered body kept has a canonical IR
  6317:    representation the backend can inspect.
  6318: 
  6319:    Asked here, over the finished body, rather than where the access is built:
  6320:    an operand is lowered as a value first, and an expression that only wanted
  6321:    its address then recovers the place and drops the load again, so refusing at
  6322:    the emit site rejects `&object.atomic_member` -- which performs no atomic
  6323:    access at all, and is exactly the shape tests/basic_c_packed_layout.c writes
  6324:    over a seventeen-byte atomic member.  This walks the block chains, which is
  6325:    what code generation walks, so an unlinked instruction is never blamed.
  6326: 
  6327:    The blame is the function rather than a token: an instruction carries a
  6328:    source range and not the token index the failure funnel wants, and two
  6329:    tokens sharing a spelling offset would make a search for one answer with the
  6330:    wrong occurrence. */
  6331: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_atomic_aggregate_accesses_lowerable(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
  6332: {
  6333:     IrFunction* function = builder->function;
  6334:     bool supported = true;
  6335:     // The walk exists for the six functions in a self-compile that hold an
  6336:     // atomic access; the opcode summary the builder maintained while
  6337:     // appending answers "none here" for every other one without touching a
  6338:     // row, and a summary it never established reads as "maybe", which keeps
  6339:     // the walk for hand-built IR.  Measured on the stage-1 self-host: the
  6340:     // unconditional walk was 0,5% of the compile's instructions.
  6341:     bool may_hold_atomic =
  6342:         ir_function_may_contain_opcodes(function, IR_OPCODE_BIT(IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD) | IR_OPCODE_BIT(IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_STORE));
  6343:     for (u32 block_index = 0; may_hold_atomic && block_index < function->block_count && supported; block_index += 1)
  6344:     {
  6345:         IrInstructionId instruction_id = function->blocks[block_index].first_instruction;
  6346:         while (instruction_id.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && supported)
  6347:         {
  6348:             IrInstruction* instruction = function->instructions + instruction_id.value;
  6349:             bool atomic_access = instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_STORE;
  6350:             if (atomic_access && instruction->operand_count && instruction->operands[0].value < function->value_count)
  6351:             {
  6352:                 IrTypeId place_type = function->values[instruction->operands[0].value].canonical_type;
  6353:                 if (!c_ir_atomic_aggregate_access_representable(builder, place_type))
  6354:                 {
  6355:                     IrType* qualified = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, place_type);
  6356:                     builder->failure_message = string_format(
  6357:                         builder->arena, S8("C IR lowering does not support an atomic {S8} of a {u64}-byte aggregate: this target has no lock-free access that wide"),
  6358:                         instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD ? S8("load") : S8("store"),
  6359:                         qualified && qualified->layout.resolved ? qualified->layout.size : 0);
  6360:                     builder->failure_token_index = UINT32_MAX;
  6361:                     supported = false;
  6362:                 }
  6363:             }
  6364:             instruction_id = instruction->next;
  6365:         }
  6366:     }
  6367: 
  6368:     return supported;
  6369: }
  6370:

  6375: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_address_of_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId element_type, IrSourceRange source);
  6376: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId target_type,
  6377:                                                         IrConversionOperation operation, IrSourceRange source);
  6378: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_cast(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId target_type, IrSourceRange source);
  6379: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u64 magnitude, bool is_negative, CToken token, IrTypeId type);
  6380: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_runtime_call_source(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrSourceRange source, String8 link_name, IrTypeId return_type,
  6381:                                                       IrTypeId* parameter_types, IrValueId* arguments, u32 argument_count,
  6382:                                                       IrValueId* result_out);
  6383: 
  6384: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_required(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId atomic_type)
  6385: {
  6386:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, atomic_type);
  6387:     return type && type->is_atomic && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size == 16 &&
  6388:            builder->target.cpu_arch == CPU_ARCH_X86_64 &&
  6389:            !target_cpu_feature_has(builder->target, TARGET_CPU_FEATURE_X86_CX16);
  6390: }
  6391: 
  6392: // The type-specific libatomic entry points erase the C object's signedness,
  6393: // atomic/volatile qualifiers and aggregate spelling at their ABI boundary.
  6394: // Use one unsigned bit representation and one plain pointer type so every
  6395: // source spelling in a translation unit reuses exactly one imported symbol.
  6396: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_arguments(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId atomic_type,
  6397:                                                            IrSourceRange source, IrTypeId* bits_type_out, IrTypeId* pointer_type_out,
  6398:                                                            IrValueId* address_out)
  6399: {
  6400:     IrTypeId bits_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128);
  6401:     IrValueId bits_place = bits_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
  6402:                                ? c_ir_atomic_aggregate_bits_place(builder, place, atomic_type, bits_type, source)
  6403:                                : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6404:     IrTypeId bits_place_type = bits_place.value < builder->function->value_count
  6405:                                    ? builder->function->values[bits_place.value].canonical_type
  6406:                                    : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6407:     IrValueId qualified_address = bits_place_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
  6408:                                       ? c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, bits_place, bits_place_type, source)
  6409:                                       : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6410:     IrTypeId pointer_type = bits_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
  6411:                                 ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, bits_type)
  6412:                                 : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6413:     IrValueId address = qualified_address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
  6414:                             ? c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(builder, qualified_address, pointer_type,
  6415:                                                          IR_CONVERSION_POINTER_REINTERPRET, source)
  6416:                             : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6417:     bool valid = bits_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
  6418:                  address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
  6419:     if (!valid && !builder->failure_message.length)
  6420:     {
  6421:         builder->failure_message = S8("could not form a canonical address for a 16-byte atomic runtime call");
  6422:     }
  6423:     if (valid)
  6424:     {
  6425:         *bits_type_out = bits_type;
  6426:         *pointer_type_out = pointer_type;
  6427:         *address_out = address;
  6428:     }
  6429:     return valid;
  6430: }
  6431: 
  6432: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_wide_atomic_runtime_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId atomic_type,
  6433:                                                                 IrSourceRange source, IrMemoryOrder order)
  6434: {
  6435:     IrType* atomic = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, atomic_type);
  6436:     IrTypeId value_type = atomic ? atomic->unqualified_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6437:     IrType* value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
  6438:     bool aggregate = value && (value->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || value->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION);
  6439:     IrTypeId bits_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6440:     IrTypeId pointer_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6441:     IrValueId address = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6442:     IrValueId order_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, (u64)order, false, (CToken){0}, builder->s32_type);
  6443:     IrTypeId parameter_types[2] = {IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID, builder->s32_type};
  6444:     IrValueId arguments[2] = {IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID, order_value};
  6445:     IrValueId loaded = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6446:     bool emitted = c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_arguments(builder, place, atomic_type, source, &bits_type, &pointer_type, &address);
  6447:     parameter_types[0] = pointer_type;
  6448:     arguments[0] = address;
  6449:     emitted = emitted && order_value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
  6450:               c_ir_emit_runtime_call_source(builder, source, S8("__atomic_load_16"), bits_type,
  6451:                                             parameter_types, arguments, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(arguments), &loaded);
  6452:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6453:     if (emitted)
  6454:     {
  6455:         result = aggregate ? c_ir_atomic_aggregate_bits_value(builder, loaded, value_type, bits_type, false, source)
  6456:                            : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, loaded, value_type, source);
  6457:     }
  6458:     else
  6459:     {
  6460:         if (!builder->failure_message.length)
  6461:         {
  6462:             builder->failure_message = S8("could not emit a 16-byte atomic runtime load");
  6463:         }
  6464:     }
  6465:     if (result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && !builder->failure_message.length)
  6466:     {
  6467:         builder->failure_message = S8("could not convert a 16-byte atomic runtime load result");
  6468:     }
  6469:     return result;
  6470: }
  6471: 
  6472: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_wide_atomic_runtime_store(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId atomic_type,
  6473:                                                             IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source, IrMemoryOrder order)
  6474: {
  6475:     IrType* atomic = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, atomic_type);
  6476:     IrTypeId value_type = atomic ? atomic->unqualified_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6477:     IrType* unqualified = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
  6478:     bool aggregate = unqualified && (unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION);
  6479:     IrTypeId bits_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6480:     IrTypeId pointer_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6481:     IrValueId address = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6482:     bool emitted = c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_arguments(builder, place, atomic_type, source, &bits_type, &pointer_type, &address);
  6483:     IrValueId bits_value = aggregate ? c_ir_atomic_aggregate_bits_value(builder, value, value_type, bits_type, true, source)
  6484:                                      : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, bits_type, source);
  6485:     IrValueId order_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, (u64)order, false, (CToken){0}, builder->s32_type);
  6486:     IrTypeId parameter_types[3] = {pointer_type, bits_type, builder->s32_type};
  6487:     IrValueId arguments[3] = {address, bits_value, order_value};
  6488:     emitted = emitted && bits_value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && order_value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
  6489:               c_ir_emit_runtime_call_source(builder, source, S8("__atomic_store_16"), builder->void_type,
  6490:                                             parameter_types, arguments, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(arguments), 0);
  6491:     if (!emitted && !builder->failure_message.length)
  6492:     {
  6493:         builder->failure_message = S8("could not emit a 16-byte atomic runtime store");
  6494:     }
  6495:     return emitted;
  6496: }
  6497: 
  6498: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_memory_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIntegerIrLocal* local, CToken token)
  6499: {
  6500:     IrType* place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, local->type);
  6501:     bool atomic = place_type && place_type->is_atomic;
  6502:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6503:     if (atomic && !builder->preparing_calls && c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_required(builder, local->type))
  6504:     {
  6505:         result = c_ir_emit_wide_atomic_runtime_load(builder, local->place, local->type, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token),
  6506:                                                     IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL);
  6507:     }
  6508:     else
  6509:     {
  6510:         // The named-local load reads a qualified place at its unqualified type the
  6511:         // same way c_ir_emit_load_place_raw does; the two must agree or the same
  6512:         // object read through the two paths produces two different value types.
  6513:         IrTypeId result_type = place_type && (atomic || place_type->is_volatile) ? place_type->unqualified_type : local->type;
  6514:         result = c_ir_add_result(builder, result_type);
  6515:         if (local->place.value < builder->function->value_count)
  6516:         {
  6517:             c_ir_label_metadata_copy_for_place(builder, local->place);
  6518:             builder->function->values[result.value].points_to_read_only = builder->function->values[local->place.value].points_to_read_only;
  6519:             if (builder->label_metadata_enabled)
  6520:             {
  6521:                 ir_label_provenance_load(builder->arena, builder->function, result, local->place);
  6522:             }
  6523:         }
  6524:         IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
  6525:         operands[0] = local->place;
  6526:         IrSourceRange instruction_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
  6527:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(atomic ? IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD : IR_OPCODE_LOAD, result_type);
  6528:         instruction.operands = operands;
  6529:         instruction.operand_count = 1;
  6530:         instruction.canonical_local = local->id;
  6531:         instruction.result = result;
  6532:         instruction.memory_order = atomic ? IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL : IR_MEMORY_ORDER_COUNT;
  6533:         instruction.volatile_access = local->place.value < builder->function->value_count && builder->function->values[local->place.value].is_volatile;
  6534:         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
  6535:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
  6536:     }
  6537:     return result;
  6538: }
  6539: 
  6540: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIntegerIrLocal* local, CToken token)
  6541: {
  6542:     CIrSsaLocal* direct = local->direct_ssa ? c_ir_ssa_place_local(builder, local->place) : 0;
  6543:     IrValueId result = direct ? c_ir_ssa_read(builder, direct, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token), true)
  6544:                              : c_ir_emit_memory_load(builder, local, token);
  6545:     c_ir_vla_loaded_shape(builder, result, local->place);
  6546:     return result;
  6547: }

  6549: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u64 magnitude, bool is_negative, CToken token, IrTypeId type);
  6550: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, String8 link_name, IrTypeId return_type, IrValueId argument,

  6553: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type_id)
  6554: {
  6555:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
  6556:     return type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && type->bit_width == 16 && type->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_IEEE;
  6557: }
  6558: 
  6559: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_binary_value_raw(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId left, IrValueId right, IrTypeId type,
  6560:                                                          IrBinaryOperation operation, IrSourceRange source)
  6561: {
  6562:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
  6563:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 2);
  6564:     operands[0] = left;
  6565:     operands[1] = right;
  6566:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
  6567:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_BINARY, type);
  6568:     instruction.operands = operands;
  6569:     instruction.operand_count = 2;
  6570:     instruction.binary_operation = (u8)operation;
  6571:     instruction.result = result;
  6572:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
  6573:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
  6574:     return result;
  6575: }
  6576: 
  6577: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_binary_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId left, IrValueId right, IrTypeId type, IrBinaryOperation operation,
  6578:                                                      IrSourceRange source)
  6579: {
  6580:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6581:     IrTypeId left_type = left.value < builder->function->value_count ? builder->function->values[left.value].canonical_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6582:     IrTypeId right_type = right.value < builder->function->value_count ? builder->function->values[right.value].canonical_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6583:     bool binary16_operands = c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, left_type) && c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, right_type);
  6584:     bool arithmetic = operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_ADD || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_SUBTRACT || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_MULTIPLY ||
  6585:                       operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_DIVIDE;
  6586:     bool comparison = operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_EQUAL || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS ||
  6587:                       operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS_EQUAL || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL;
  6588:     if (binary16_operands && (arithmetic || comparison))
  6589:     {
  6590:         IrValueId left_wide = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__extendhfsf2"), builder->f32_type, left, left_type, source);
  6591:         IrValueId right_wide = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__extendhfsf2"), builder->f32_type, right, right_type, source);
  6592:         if (left_wide.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && right_wide.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6593:         {
  6594:             IrValueId wide_result = c_ir_emit_binary_value_raw(builder, left_wide, right_wide, comparison ? type : builder->f32_type, operation, source);
  6595:             if (comparison)
  6596:             {
  6597:                 result = wide_result;
  6598:             }
  6599:             else if (wide_result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6600:             {
  6601:                 result = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__truncsfhf2"), type, wide_result, builder->f32_type, source);
  6602:             }
  6603:         }
  6604:     }
  6605:     else
  6606:     {
  6607:         result = c_ir_emit_binary_value_raw(builder, left, right, type, operation, source);
  6608:     }
  6609:     return result;
  6610: }
  6611: 
  6612: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrField* c_ir_bit_field_from_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place)
  6613: {
  6614:     if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
  6615:     {
  6616:         return 0;
  6617:     }
  6618:     IrInstructionId definition = builder->function->values[place.value].definition;
  6619:     if (definition.value >= builder->function->instruction_count)
  6620:     {
  6621:         return 0;
  6622:     }
  6623:     IrInstruction* field_instruction = builder->function->instructions + definition.value;
  6624:     if (field_instruction->opcode != IR_OPCODE_FIELD || field_instruction->operand_count != 1 || field_instruction->immediate_count != 1 ||
  6625:         field_instruction->operands[0].value >= builder->function->value_count)
  6626:     {
  6627:         return 0;
  6628:     }
  6629:     IrType* aggregate = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[field_instruction->operands[0].value].canonical_type);
  6630:     u64 field_index = field_instruction->immediates[0];
  6631:     IrField* result;
  6632:     if (!aggregate || field_index >= aggregate->field_count || !aggregate->fields[field_index].is_bit_field)
  6633:     {
  6634:         result = 0;
  6635:     }
  6636:     else
  6637:     {
  6638:         result = aggregate->fields + field_index;
  6639:     }
  6640: 
  6641:     return result;
  6642: }
  6643: 
  6644: // The unsigned scalar type spanning `size` bytes, which is the type a narrowed
  6645: // packed bit-field's storage unit is read and written through: unsigned so the
  6646: // raw load zero-extends and the other members' bits in the unit cannot reach
  6647: // the extracted value's sign.
  6648: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u64 size)
  6649: {
  6650:     CTypeKind kinds[] = {C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG};
  6651:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  6652:     for (u32 index = 0; result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && index < BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(kinds); index += 1)
  6653:     {
  6654:         IrTypeId candidate = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, kinds[index]);
  6655:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, candidate);
  6656:         if (type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size == size)
  6657:         {
  6658:             result = candidate;
  6659:         }
  6660:     }
  6661: 
  6662:     return result;
  6663: }

  6665: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_memory_load_place_raw(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrSourceRange source)
  6666: {
  6667:     IrType* place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
  6668:     bool atomic = place_type && place_type->is_atomic;
  6669:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;

  6671:     {
  6672:         result = c_ir_emit_wide_atomic_runtime_load(builder, place, type, source, IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL);
  6673:     }
  6674:     else if (atomic && c_ir_type_contains_wide_float(builder->program, builder->wide_float_cache, type))
  6675:     {
  6676:         builder->failure_message = S8("C IR lowering does not yet support atomic wide floating-point loads");
  6677:     }
  6678:     else
  6679:     {

  6703:         instruction.operands = operands;
  6704:         instruction.operand_count = 1;
  6705:         instruction.result = result;
  6706:         instruction.memory_order = atomic ? IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL : IR_MEMORY_ORDER_COUNT;
  6707:         instruction.volatile_access = place.value < builder->function->value_count && builder->function->values[place.value].is_volatile;
  6708:         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
  6709:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
  6710:     }

  6714: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrSourceRange source)
  6715: {
  6716:     CIrSsaLocal* local = c_ir_ssa_place_local(builder, place);
  6717:     IrValueId result = local && local->type.value == type.value ? c_ir_ssa_read(builder, local, source, false)
  6718:                                                             : c_ir_emit_memory_load_place_raw(builder, place, type, source);
  6719:     c_ir_vla_loaded_shape(builder, result, place);
  6720:     return result;
  6721: }

  6723: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_address_of_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId element_type, IrSourceRange source);
  6724: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_cast(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId target_type, IrSourceRange source);

  6733: 
  6734: // The address of the bytes a bit-field occupies, as `unsigned char*`.
  6735: // `c_ir_emit_address_of_place` refuses a bit-field place because C does --
  6736: // `&s.b` is not an expression -- but a field with no single storage unit is
  6737: // read and written one piece at a time, and the pieces past the first are
  6738: // bytes the member place cannot name. The place still starts at
  6739: // `field->offset`, which is the first byte of the span.
  6740: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_bit_field_storage_address(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrSourceRange source)
  6741: {
  6742:     IrTypeId place_type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
  6743:     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, place_type);
  6744:     IrTypeId byte_pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR));
  6745:     if (pointer_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || byte_pointer_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6746:     {
  6747:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6748:     }
  6749:     IrValueId address = c_ir_add_result(builder, pointer_type);
  6750:     if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6751:     {
  6752:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6753:     }
  6754:     builder->function->values[address.value].points_to_read_only = builder->function->values[place.value].is_read_only;
  6755:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ADDRESS_OF, pointer_type);
  6756:     instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
  6757:     instruction.operands[0] = place;
  6758:     instruction.operand_count = 1;
  6759:     instruction.result = address;
  6760:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
  6761:     builder->function->values[address.value].definition = id;
  6762:     return c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, byte_pointer_type, source);
  6763: }
  6764: 
  6765: // One piece of that span as a place of its own width, at `offset` bytes in.
  6766: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_bit_field_piece_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId byte_address, u32 offset, IrTypeId piece_type,
  6767:                                                             IrSourceRange source)
  6768: {
  6769:     IrTypeId byte_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR);
  6770:     IrValueId address = byte_address;
  6771:     if (offset)
  6772:     {
  6773:         IrValueId index = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, offset, false, (CToken){0}, builder->s32_type);
  6774:         IrValueId element = index.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, byte_address, index, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6775:         address = element.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, element, byte_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6776:     }
  6777:     IrTypeId piece_pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, piece_type);
  6778:     IrValueId cast = address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && piece_pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
  6779:                          ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, piece_pointer_type, source)
  6780:                          : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6781:     return cast.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, cast, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6782: }
  6783: 
  6784: // The bits of `field` that lie in one piece of its span, as the half-open
  6785: // range [`low`, `high`) of span bit positions. Empty when the piece holds none
  6786: // of them, which no piece of a span that is exactly the field's bytes does,
  6787: // but a caller that walks pieces should not have to know that.
  6788: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_bit_field_piece_bits(IrField const* field, IrFieldAccessPiece piece, u32* low, u32* high)
  6789: {
  6790:     u32 piece_low = (u32)piece.offset * 8;
  6791:     u32 piece_high = piece_low + (u32)piece.size * 8;
  6792:     u32 field_high = field->bit_offset + field->bit_width;
  6793:     *low = BUSTER_MAX(piece_low, field->bit_offset);
  6794:     *high = BUSTER_MIN(piece_high, field_high);
  6795: }
  6796: 
  6797: // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no single storage unit for is read one
  6798: // piece at a time and reassembled: each piece contributes the bits of its own
  6799: // byte range that belong to the field, shifted down to the field's low bit.
  6800: // The assembly runs at sixty-four bits, which covers every bit-field there is,
  6801: // and the result narrows to the declared type on the way out -- the same shape
  6802: // the single-unit extraction has, with the load replaced by a sum of loads.
  6803: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrField* field, IrTypeId type, u64 access_size,
  6804:                                                            IrSourceRange source)
  6805: {
  6806:     IrFieldAccessPiece pieces[IR_FIELD_ACCESS_PIECE_CAPACITY];
  6807:     u32 piece_count = ir_field_access_pieces(access_size, pieces);
  6808:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
  6809:     IrTypeId wide_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, 8);
  6810:     IrValueId address = piece_count && value_type && wide_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
  6811:                             ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_storage_address(builder, place, source)
  6812:                             : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6813:     if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6814:     {
  6815:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6816:     }
  6817:     CToken token = {0};
  6818:     IrValueId assembled = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6819:     for (u32 index = 0; index < piece_count; index += 1)
  6820:     {
  6821:         u32 low = 0;
  6822:         u32 high = 0;
  6823:         c_ir_bit_field_piece_bits(field, pieces[index], &low, &high);
  6824:         if (low >= high)
  6825:         {
  6826:             continue;
  6827:         }
  6828:         IrTypeId piece_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, pieces[index].size);
  6829:         IrValueId piece_place =
  6830:             piece_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_piece_place(builder, address, pieces[index].offset, piece_type, source)
  6831:                                                          : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6832:         IrValueId loaded = piece_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, piece_place, piece_type, source)
  6833:                                                                         : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6834:         IrValueId part = loaded.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, loaded, wide_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6835:         if (part.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6836:         {
  6837:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6838:         }
  6839:         if (low > (u32)pieces[index].offset * 8)
  6840:         {
  6841:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - (u32)pieces[index].offset * 8, false, token, wide_type);
  6842:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
  6843:         }
  6844:         u64 mask = high - low == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << (high - low)) - 1;
  6845:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, mask, false, token, wide_type);
  6846:         part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, mask_value, wide_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
  6847:         if (low > field->bit_offset)
  6848:         {
  6849:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - field->bit_offset, false, token, wide_type);
  6850:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
  6851:         }
  6852:         assembled = assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
  6853:                         ? part
  6854:                         : c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, part, wide_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR, source);
  6855:         if (assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6856:         {
  6857:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6858:         }
  6859:     }
  6860:     if (assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6861:     {
  6862:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6863:     }
  6864:     // The sign lives at the field's own top bit, so it is stretched from
  6865:     // there rather than from the assembly width; an unsigned field already
  6866:     // has zeroes above it from the masks.
  6867:     if (value_type->is_signed && field->bit_width < 64)
  6868:     {
  6869:         IrTypeId signed_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_LONG_LONG);
  6870:         IrType* signed_value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, signed_type);
  6871:         if (!signed_value_type || signed_value_type->bit_width != 64)
  6872:         {
  6873:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6874:         }
  6875:         IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 64 - field->bit_width, false, token, signed_type);
  6876:         assembled = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, assembled, signed_type, source);
  6877:         assembled = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, shift, signed_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
  6878:         assembled = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, shift, signed_type, IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
  6879:     }
  6880:     IrValueId result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, assembled, type, source);
  6881:     c_ir_mark_unsigned_bit_field_value(builder, result, field);
  6882:     return result;
  6883: }
  6884: 
  6885: // The write half of the same split: every piece keeps the bits that are not
  6886: // the field's and takes the field's from the value. A piece the field fills
  6887: // completely needs no read at all.
  6888: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_store(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrField* field, IrValueId value, u64 access_size,
  6889:                                                        IrSourceRange source)
  6890: {
  6891:     IrFieldAccessPiece pieces[IR_FIELD_ACCESS_PIECE_CAPACITY];
  6892:     u32 piece_count = ir_field_access_pieces(access_size, pieces);
  6893:     IrTypeId wide_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, 8);
  6894:     IrValueId wide = piece_count && wide_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, wide_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6895:     IrValueId address = wide.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_storage_address(builder, place, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6896:     if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6897:     {
  6898:         return false;
  6899:     }
  6900:     CToken token = {0};
  6901:     for (u32 index = 0; index < piece_count; index += 1)
  6902:     {
  6903:         u32 low = 0;
  6904:         u32 high = 0;
  6905:         c_ir_bit_field_piece_bits(field, pieces[index], &low, &high);
  6906:         if (low >= high)
  6907:         {
  6908:             continue;
  6909:         }
  6910:         u32 piece_low = (u32)pieces[index].offset * 8;
  6911:         u32 piece_bits = (u32)pieces[index].size * 8;
  6912:         IrTypeId piece_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, pieces[index].size);
  6913:         IrValueId piece_place =
  6914:             piece_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_piece_place(builder, address, pieces[index].offset, piece_type, source)
  6915:                                                          : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6916:         if (piece_place.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6917:         {
  6918:             return false;
  6919:         }
  6920:         IrValueId part = wide;
  6921:         if (low > field->bit_offset)
  6922:         {
  6923:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - field->bit_offset, false, token, wide_type);
  6924:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
  6925:         }
  6926:         u64 value_mask = high - low == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << (high - low)) - 1;
  6927:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, value_mask, false, token, wide_type);
  6928:         part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, mask_value, wide_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
  6929:         if (low > piece_low)
  6930:         {
  6931:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - piece_low, false, token, wide_type);
  6932:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
  6933:         }
  6934:         part = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, part, piece_type, source);
  6935:         if (part.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6936:         {
  6937:             return false;
  6938:         }
  6939:         if (high - low != piece_bits)
  6940:         {
  6941:             u64 storage_mask = ((high - low == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << (high - low)) - 1) << (low - piece_low));
  6942:             IrValueId clear = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, ~storage_mask, false, token, piece_type);
  6943:             IrValueId current = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, piece_place, piece_type, source);
  6944:             current = current.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
  6945:                           ? c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, current, clear, piece_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source)
  6946:                           : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6947:             part = current.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, current, part, piece_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR, source)
  6948:                                                              : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  6949:             if (part.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6950:             {
  6951:                 return false;
  6952:             }
  6953:         }
  6954:         if (!c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, piece_place, piece_type, part, source))
  6955:         {
  6956:             return false;
  6957:         }
  6958:     }
  6959:     return true;
  6960: }
  6961: 
  6962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrSourceRange source)
  6963: {
  6964:     // C 6.3.2.1p4: a function designator is converted to a pointer to the
  6965:     // function; there is nothing to load out of one. The place reaches here
  6966:     // when the name resolves to an entity rather than to a call — a
  6967:     // block-scope `extern void sighandler(int);` declares such a name, and
  6968:     // sbase's make then stores it in a `struct sigaction`.
  6969:     IrType* designated_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
  6970:     if (designated_type && designated_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION)
  6971:     {
  6972:         return c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type, source);
  6973:     }
  6974:     IrField* field = c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place);
  6975:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
  6976:     // A `_Bool` bit-field's bits are extracted like any other's. Its declared
  6977:     // type is not an integer, so the extraction used to be skipped and the
  6978:     // whole `_Bool` unit came back -- every neighbouring field's bits with it,
  6979:     // normalized to one, which is why a `_Bool` that happened to be the only
  6980:     // set bit still read correctly. The unit it is read through has to be an
  6981:     // integer of the same width for the shift to see the raw byte.
  6982:     bool boolean = value_type && value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
  6983:     bool extract =
  6984:         field && value_type && (value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || boolean) && field->bit_width && field->bit_width <= value_type->bit_width;
  6985:     // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no room for a declared-type unit
  6986:     // of is read through the narrower one its layout recorded; every other
  6987:     // field reads its own type. A span that is no integer's width -- five
  6988:     // bytes for `long long b : 40` -- has no such unit and takes several
  6989:     // accesses instead.
  6990:     IrTypeId access_type = type;
  6991:     if (extract && (field->access_size || boolean))
  6992:     {
  6993:         access_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, ir_field_access_size(&builder->program->types, field));
  6994:         if (access_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  6995:         {
  6996:             return c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_load(builder, place, field, type, field->access_size, source);
  6997:         }
  6998:     }
  6999:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, place, access_type, source);
  7000:     if (extract)
  7001:     {
  7002:         CToken token = {0};
  7003:         // The extraction runs in the promoted type, never in a narrower one:
  7004:         // the machine backends model shifts at 32 and 64 bits only, so a
  7005:         // 16-bit `shl`/`sar` pair executes at 32 bits and the sign bit of a
  7006:         // `short a : 9` never reaches the top. Promoting here is also what C
  7007:         // does with the value, and the result narrows back on the way out.
  7008:         // The memory load removes object qualifiers. Extraction and its
  7009:         // constants must use that same value type, including volatile fields.
  7010:         IrTypeId result_type = value_type->is_atomic || value_type->is_volatile ? value_type->unqualified_type : type;
  7011:         IrTypeId extract_type = result_type;
  7012:         IrType* extract_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, extract_type);
  7013:         if (value_type->bit_width < 32)
  7014:         {
  7015:             extract_type = value_type->is_signed ? builder->s32_type : builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT];
  7016:             extract_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, extract_type);
  7017:         }
  7018:         if (extract_type_value && extract_type.value != access_type.value)
  7019:         {
  7020:             value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, extract_type, source);
  7021:         }
  7022:         if (!extract_type_value || value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  7023:         {
  7024:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  7025:         }
  7026:         IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, field->bit_offset, false, token, extract_type);
  7027:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shift, extract_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
  7028:         u64 mask = field->bit_width == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << field->bit_width) - 1;
  7029:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, mask, false, token, extract_type);
  7030:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, mask_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
  7031:         if (value_type->is_signed && field->bit_width < extract_type_value->bit_width)
  7032:         {
  7033:             u32 sign_shift = extract_type_value->bit_width - field->bit_width;
  7034:             IrValueId sign_shift_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, sign_shift, false, token, extract_type);
  7035:             value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, sign_shift_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
  7036:             value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, sign_shift_value, extract_type, IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
  7037:         }
  7038:         if (extract_type.value != result_type.value)
  7039:         {
  7040:             value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, result_type, source);
  7041:         }
  7042:         c_ir_mark_unsigned_bit_field_value(builder, value, field);
  7043:     }
  7044: 
  7045:     return value;
  7046: }
  7047: 
  7048: // An assignment expression names the stored field value. Keep its promotion
  7049: // fact without rereading memory (in particular, without a second volatile load).
  7050: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_bit_field_assignment_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
  7051: {
  7052:     IrField* field = c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place);
  7053:     IrValueId result = value;
  7054:     if (c_ir_unsigned_bit_field_promotes_to_int(builder, field))
  7055:     {
  7056:         result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, field->type, source);
  7057:         if (result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  7058:         {
  7059:             IrValueId mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, ((u64)1 << field->bit_width) - 1, false, (CToken){0}, field->type);
  7060:             result = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, result, mask, field->type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
  7061:             c_ir_mark_unsigned_bit_field_value(builder, result, field);
  7062:         }
  7063:     }
  7064:     return result;
  7065: }
  7066: 
  7067: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_place_may_have_static_storage(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place)
  7068: {
  7069:     u32 value = place.value;
  7070:     u32 steps = builder->function->value_count + 1;
  7071:     while (value < builder->function->value_count && steps)
  7072:     {
  7073:         steps -= 1;
  7074:         IrValue* current = builder->function->values + value;
  7075:         IrInstructionId definition = current->definition;
  7076:         if (definition.value >= builder->function->instruction_count)
  7077:         {
  7078:             return true;
  7079:         }
  7080:         IrInstruction* instruction = builder->function->instructions + definition.value;
  7081:         if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_GLOBAL)
  7082:         {
  7083:             return true;
  7084:         }
  7085:         if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_LOCAL)
  7086:         {
  7087:             return false;
  7088:         }
  7089:         if ((instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_FIELD || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_INDEX || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_DEREFERENCE ||
  7090:              instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ADDRESS_OF || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_CAST) &&
  7091:             instruction->operand_count >= 1 && instruction->operands)
  7092:         {
  7093:             value = instruction->operands[0].value;
  7094:             continue;
  7095:         }
  7096:         return true;
  7097:     }
  7098:     return true;
  7099: }
  7100: 
  7101: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_truth_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source);
  7102: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_decay_array_value_if_needed(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source);
  7103: 
  7104: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId target_type, IrConversionOperation operation,
  7105:                                                          IrSourceRange source)
  7106: {
  7107:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count && c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, value))
  7108:     {
  7109:         IrType* source_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type);
  7110:         IrType* destination_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, target_type);
  7111:         bool original_void_pointer = source_value && destination_value && source_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && destination_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER &&
  7112:                                      source_value->element_type.value == destination_value->element_type.value &&
  7113:                                      source_value->element_type.value < builder->program->types.count &&
  7114:                                      ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, source_value->element_type)->kind == IR_TYPE_VOID &&
  7115:                                      source_value->id.value == destination_value->id.value;
  7116:         if (!original_void_pointer)
  7117:         {
  7118:             builder->failure_message = S8("a label-provenance value may only be used with its original void pointer type");
  7119:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  7120:         }
  7121:     }
  7122:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, target_type);
  7123:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
  7124:     {
  7125:         // A pointer reinterpretation takes the target type's own
  7126:         // qualification, and IR types carry no const: the flag clears, so
  7127:         // `((char *)formatted)[size-1] = '\0'` -- CPython casting away the
  7128:         // const its own accessor returned -- stores where the reference
  7129:         // compilers store.  The cost is one diagnostic, not a miscompile: a
  7130:         // cast that *adds* const is no longer refused as a store target,
  7131:         // which is the same laxity the reference compilers only warn about
  7132:         // under -Wcast-qual.  Stores through const lvalues keep their
  7133:         // refusal -- those places read their entity's own C type.
  7134:         builder->function->values[result.value].points_to_read_only =
  7135:             operation != IR_CONVERSION_POINTER_REINTERPRET && builder->function->values[value.value].points_to_read_only;
  7136:         c_ir_copy_label_provenance(builder, result, value);
  7137:     }
  7138:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
  7139:     operands[0] = value;
  7140:     IrSourceRange cast_source = source;
  7141:     IrInstruction cast = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CAST, target_type);
  7142:     cast.operands = operands;
  7143:     cast.operand_count = 1;
  7144:     cast.conversion_operation = (u8)operation;
  7145:     cast.result = result;
  7146:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, cast, cast_source);
  7147:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
  7148:     return result;
  7149: }

  7172: 
  7173: // An integer converted to a pointer (6.3.2.3p5, and the null pointer constant
  7174: // with it) reaches pointer width first, sign-extending when the operand is
  7175: // signed: `(void *)-1` is the all-ones pointer, not the low half of one. Every
  7176: // backend lowers INTEGER_TO_POINTER as a plain register copy -- and so does
  7177: // LLVM's inttoptr, which zero-extends -- so the widening is its own
  7178: // instruction here rather than a rule each of the five has to repeat.
  7179: // ir_canonical_conversion_valid holds every producer to it.
  7180: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_integer_to_pointer(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId target_type, IrSourceRange source)
  7181: {
  7182:     if (value.value >= builder->function->value_count)
  7183:     {
  7184:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  7185:     }
  7186:     IrType* source_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type);
  7187:     if (!source_value || source_value->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
  7188:     {
  7189:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
--- lines 7668-8069 ---
  7668:         operation = IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_ZERO_EXTEND;
  7669:     }
  7670:     else if (source_value->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && target_value->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
  7671:     {
  7672:         if (source_value->bit_width == target_value->bit_width && source_value->float_format != target_value->float_format)
  7673:         {
  7674:             IrValueId widened = c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(builder, value, builder->f32_type, IR_CONVERSION_FLOAT_EXTEND, source);
  7675:             if (widened.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  7676:             {
  7677:                 value = widened;
  7678:                 operation = IR_CONVERSION_FLOAT_TRUNCATE;
  7679:             }
  7680:         }
  7681:         else
  7682:         {
  7683:             operation = source_value->bit_width < target_value->bit_width   ? IR_CONVERSION_FLOAT_EXTEND
  7684:                         : source_value->bit_width > target_value->bit_width ? IR_CONVERSION_FLOAT_TRUNCATE
  7685:                                                                             : IR_CONVERSION_IDENTITY;
  7686:         }
  7687:     }
  7688:     else if (source_value->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && target_value->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
  7689:     {
  7690:         operation = source_value->is_signed ? IR_CONVERSION_SIGNED_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT : IR_CONVERSION_UNSIGNED_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT;
  7691:     }
  7692:     else if (source_value->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN && target_value->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
  7693:     {
  7694:         value = c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(builder, value, builder->s32_type, IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_ZERO_EXTEND, source);
  7695:         if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  7696:         {
  7697:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  7698:         }
  7699:         operation = IR_CONVERSION_SIGNED_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT;
  7700:     }
  7701:     else if (source_value->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && target_value->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
  7702:     {
  7703:         operation = target_value->is_signed ? IR_CONVERSION_FLOAT_TO_SIGNED_INTEGER : IR_CONVERSION_FLOAT_TO_UNSIGNED_INTEGER;
  7704:     }
  7705:     else if (source_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && target_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
  7706:     {
  7707:         operation = IR_CONVERSION_POINTER_REINTERPRET;
  7708:     }
  7709:     else if (source_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && target_value->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
  7710:     {
  7711:         operation = IR_CONVERSION_POINTER_TO_INTEGER;
  7712:     }
  7713:     else if (source_value->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && target_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
  7714:     {
  7715:         return c_ir_emit_integer_to_pointer(builder, value, target_type, source);
  7716:     }
  7717:     if (operation == IR_CONVERSION_COUNT)
  7718:     {
  7719:         builder->failure_message = string_format(builder->arena, S8("cannot convert IR type {u32} (kind {u32}) to IR type {u32} (kind {u32})"),
  7720:                                                  source_type.value, (u32)source_value->kind, target_type.value, (u32)target_value->kind);
  7721:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  7722:     }
  7723:     return c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(builder, value, target_type, operation, source);
  7724: }

  7726: // The initializer lowering below is intentionally defined much earlier than
  7727: // the shape-inference helpers.  Keep this declaration beside the value-cast
  7728: // API so brace-elision can ask whether a non-braced expression already has an
  7729: // aggregate type before descending into its first member.
  7730: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_initializer_type_is_aggregate(IrType* type);
  7731: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_initializer_value_is_aggregate_expression(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CScopeId scope, u32 start, u32 end);
  7732: 
  7733: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_nullptr(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token)
  7734: {
  7735:     // Built at pointer width rather than as an `int`, so the conversion below
  7736:     // is the bare INTEGER_TO_POINTER a null pointer constant deserves and not
  7737:     // a widening ahead of it: this runs on every `p == 0` and every `if (p)`.
  7738:     IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, builder->size_type);
  7739:     IrValueId result;
  7740:     if (zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  7741:     {
  7742:         result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  7743:     }
  7744:     else
  7745:     {
  7746:         result = c_ir_emit_integer_to_pointer(builder, zero, builder->nullptr_type, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token));
  7747:     }
  7748: 
  7749:     return result;
  7750: }
