  7763: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrSourceRange source);
  7764: 
  7765: // Do two types agree closely enough that a function prototype built from them
  7766: // is the same prototype? Identical ids always do. Beyond that only the coarse
  7767: // shape is compared -- the kind, and for the scalar kinds the width and
  7768: // signedness -- because two spellings of one aggregate can reach here as two
  7769: // ids and refusing them would reject valid code. This is the deliberate
  7770: // conservatism c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible documents.
  7771: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_scalar_shapes_agree(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId left, IrTypeId right)
  7772: {
  7773:     IrType* left_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left);
  7774:     IrType* right_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right);
  7775:     bool result = left.value == right.value;
  7776:     if (!result && left_type && right_type && left_type->kind == right_type->kind)
  7777:     {
  7778:         result = left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER && left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT && left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
  7779:         result = result || (left_type->bit_width == right_type->bit_width && left_type->is_signed == right_type->is_signed &&
  7780:                             (left_type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT || left_type->float_format == right_type->float_format));
  7781:     }
  7782: 
  7783:     return result;
  7784: }
  7785: 
  7786: // Whether a value may cross into an object of `target` without a cast, for the
  7787: // one class C makes an error of that this frontend used to accept in silence:
  7788: // two pointers to functions whose prototypes disagree (#830). Clang has made it
  7789: // an error by default since Clang 16 and GCC diagnoses it too, and the silence
  7790: // flipped autoconf probes that read the diagnostic as their answer -- CPython's
  7791: // readline check assigns `int(const char*, int)` to an `int(*)(void)` and
  7792: // concludes from the refusal that the hook takes no arguments.
  7793: //
  7794: // Only a mismatch both reference compilers reject is reported, and only when
  7795: // both sides are function pointers: a `void*` on either side is the idiom every
  7796: // dispatch table is built from, and an unprototyped `()` is compatible with a
  7797: // non-variadic prototype by C11 6.2.7p3 -- musl's `long __syscall_cp_asm();`
  7798: // beside its eight-parameter prototype is one function, not two. Within that,
  7799: // the parameter count, the variadic-ness, and the kind (and scalar width) of
  7800: // the return and of each parameter have to agree. Anything subtler is accepted:
  7801: // a false refusal would reject a translation unit clang compiles, which is a
  7802: // worse failure than the silence this replaces.
  7803: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId left, IrTypeId right)
  7804: {
  7805:     IrType* left_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left);
  7806:     IrType* right_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right);
  7807:     bool result = true;
  7808:     if (left.value != right.value && left_type && right_type && left_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION && right_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION &&
  7809:         !left_type->is_unprototyped && !right_type->is_unprototyped)
  7810:     {
  7811:         result = left_type->parameter_count == right_type->parameter_count && left_type->is_variadic == right_type->is_variadic &&
  7812:                  c_ir_scalar_shapes_agree(builder, left_type->return_type, right_type->return_type);
  7813:         for (u32 index = 0; result && index < left_type->parameter_count; index += 1)
  7814:         {
  7815:             result = c_ir_scalar_shapes_agree(builder, left_type->parameter_types[index], right_type->parameter_types[index]);
  7816:         }
  7817:     }
  7818: 
  7819:     return result;
  7820: }
  7821: 
  7822: // The pointer wrapper around c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible: an
  7823: // assignment crosses two *pointers*, and only when both point at functions is
  7824: // there a prototype to compare.
  7825: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_pointer_assignment_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId target, IrTypeId source)
  7826: {
  7827:     IrType* target_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, target);
  7828:     IrType* source_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, source);
  7829:     bool result = true;
  7830:     if (target_type && source_type && target_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && source_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
  7831:     {
  7832:         result = c_ir_function_prototypes_compatible(builder, target_type->element_type, source_type->element_type);
  7833:     }
  7834: 
  7835:     return result;
  7836: }
  7837: 
  7838: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_store_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
  7839: {
  7840:     if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count || builder->function->values[place.value].category != IR_VALUE_PLACE)
  7841:     {
  7842:         return false;
  7843:     }
  7844:     if (builder->function->values[place.value].is_read_only)
  7845:     {
  7846:         builder->failure_message = S8("assignment operand is not a modifiable place");
  7847:         return false;
  7848:     }
  7849:     IrType* qualified_place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
  7850:     bool atomic = qualified_place_type && qualified_place_type->is_atomic;
  7851:     if (atomic && c_ir_type_contains_wide_float(builder->program, builder->wide_float_cache, type))
  7852:     {
  7853:         builder->failure_message = S8("C IR lowering does not yet support atomic wide floating-point stores");
  7854:         return false;
  7855:     }
  7856:     // The stored value is converted to the unqualified type of the place, the
  7857:     // conversion C gives an assignment, which is also the type the loads above
  7858:     // produce. See c_ir_emit_load_place_raw for why `volatile` joins `_Atomic`
  7859:     // here.
  7860:     IrTypeId stored_type = qualified_place_type && (atomic || qualified_place_type->is_volatile) ? qualified_place_type->unqualified_type : type;
  7861:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
  7862:     {
  7863:         IrType* source_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type);
  7864:         IrType* target_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, stored_type);
  7865:         if (source_type && source_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY && target_type && target_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
  7866:         {
  7867:             value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, stored_type, source);
  7868:         }
  7869:     }
  7870:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count &&
  7871:         !c_ir_pointer_assignment_compatible(builder, stored_type, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type))
  7872:     {
  7873:         builder->failure_message = S8("assignment from an incompatible function pointer type");
  7874:         builder->failure_kind_plus_one = C_DIAGNOSTIC_CONFLICTING_DECLARATION + 1;
  7875:         return false;
  7876:     }
  7877:     value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, stored_type, source);
  7878:     if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  7879:     {
  7880:         return false;
  7881:     }
  7882:     if (atomic && !builder->preparing_calls && c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_required(builder, type))
  7883:     {
  7884:         return c_ir_emit_wide_atomic_runtime_store(builder, place, type, value, source, IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL);
  7885:     }
  7886:     IrValueLabelMetadata stored_metadata =
  7887:         value.value < builder->function->value_count ? ir_value_label_metadata(builder->function, value) : (IrValueLabelMetadata){0};
  7888:     bool label_value = stored_metadata.is_label_value;
  7889:     bool aggregate_label_value = stored_metadata.has_label_provenance;
  7890:     if ((label_value || aggregate_label_value) && c_ir_place_may_have_static_storage(builder, place))
  7891:     {
  7892:         builder->failure_message = S8("a label address may not be stored in static storage");
  7893:         return false;
  7894:     }
  7895:     if (!c_ir_label_metadata_store_for_place(builder, place, value))
  7896:     {
  7897:         return false;
  7898:     }
  7899:     IrField* bit_field = c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place);
  7900:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, stored_type);
  7901:     // The read-modify-write runs in the unit the field is accessed through,
  7902:     // which is the declared type unless packing narrowed it; the value
  7903:     // truncates into that unit first, and the mask keeps only the field's own
  7904:     // bits either way. A span no integer is the width of takes one
  7905:     // read-modify-write per piece instead.
  7906:     // A `_Bool` bit-field reaches the read-modify-write like any other, through
  7907:     // the integer its unit is: writing the whole `_Bool` unit instead used to
  7908:     // clear every field sharing it.
  7909:     bool stored_boolean = value_type && value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
  7910:     bool narrowed_access = bit_field && (bit_field->access_size || stored_boolean);
  7911:     IrTypeId access_type =
  7912:         narrowed_access ? c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, ir_field_access_size(&builder->program->types, bit_field)) : stored_type;
  7913:     if (narrowed_access && access_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && value_type && value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && bit_field->bit_width &&
  7914:         bit_field->bit_width <= value_type->bit_width)
  7915:     {
  7916:         return c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_store(builder, place, bit_field, value, bit_field->access_size, source);
  7917:     }
  7918:     IrType* access_value_type = access_type.value == stored_type.value ? value_type : ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, access_type);
  7919:     if (narrowed_access && !access_value_type)
  7920:     {
  7921:         return false;
  7922:     }
  7923:     if (bit_field && value_type && access_value_type && (value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || stored_boolean) && bit_field->bit_width &&
  7924:         bit_field->bit_width <= value_type->bit_width && bit_field->bit_offset + bit_field->bit_width <= access_value_type->bit_width)
  7925:     {
  7926:         CToken token = {0};
  7927:         u64 value_mask = bit_field->bit_width == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << bit_field->bit_width) - 1;
  7928:         u64 storage_mask = value_mask << bit_field->bit_offset;
  7929:         IrValueId narrowed = access_type.value == stored_type.value ? value : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, access_type, source);
  7930:         if (narrowed.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  7931:         {
  7932:             return false;
  7933:         }
  7934:         IrValueId mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, value_mask, false, token, access_type);
  7935:         IrValueId packed = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, narrowed, mask, access_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
  7936:         IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, bit_field->bit_offset, false, token, access_type);
  7937:         packed = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, packed, shift, access_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
  7938:         IrValueId current = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, place, access_type, source);
  7939:         IrValueId clear_mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, ~storage_mask, false, token, access_type);
  7940:         current = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, current, clear_mask, access_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
  7941:         value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, current, packed, access_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR, source);
  7942:     }
  7943:     CIrSsaLocal* local = c_ir_ssa_place_local(builder, place);
  7944:     if (local && !atomic && stored_type.value == local->type.value &&
  7945:         builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type.value == local->type.value &&
  7946:         builder->function->values[value.value].category == IR_VALUE_VALUE)
  7947:     {
  7948:         c_ir_ssa_slot(builder, builder->current_block.value, (u32)(local - builder->direct_ssa->locals))->value = value;
  7949:         c_ir_ssa_event(builder, (u32)(local - builder->direct_ssa->locals), IR_OPCODE_STORE, value, source);
  7950:         builder->direct_ssa->statistics.writes += 1;
  7951:     }
  7952:     else
  7953:     {
  7954:         IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 2);
  7955:         operands[0] = place;
  7956:         operands[1] = value;
  7957:         IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
  7958:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(atomic ? IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_STORE : IR_OPCODE_STORE, builder->void_type);
  7959:         instruction.operands = operands;
  7960:         instruction.operand_count = 2;
  7961:         instruction.memory_order = atomic ? IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL : IR_MEMORY_ORDER_COUNT;
  7962:         instruction.volatile_access = builder->function->values[place.value].is_volatile;
  7963:         c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
  7964:     }
  7965:     return true;
  7966: }

  7968: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_store(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIntegerIrLocal* local, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
  7969: {

  7972: 
  7973: // Whether a promoted-member search has already queued `type`.
  7974: //
  7975: // The two searches below (this one and c_ir_promoted_member_path) walk the
  7976: // anonymous nested aggregates of one struct or union, so their work lists hold
  7977: // a handful of entries and almost always exactly one. Both used to answer this
  7978: // question with a `bool` array indexed by type id, allocated and memset per
  7979: // call over the whole program type table: 72.167 calls at a mean capacity of
  7980: // 17.432 types, 1,26 GB of zeroing per self-host compile, 6,74% of every
  7981: // stage-1 L1d miss for a set that never held more than a few members (audit
  7982: // 2026-08-22T084855Z). The work list is the visited set; scanning it costs
  7983: // less than clearing the table did.
  7984: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_type_queued(const IrTypeId* queued, u32 count, IrTypeId type)
  7985: {
  7986:     bool found = false;
  7987:     for (u32 index = 0; index < count; index += 1)
  7988:     {
  7989:         if (queued[index].value == type.value)
  7990:         {
  7991:             found = true;
  7992:             break;
  7993:         }
  7994:     }
  7995:     return found;
  7996: }

  8000: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_field_place_from_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId operand, CToken access, CToken member)
  8001: {

  8003:     {
  8004:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8005:     }
  8006:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&access, C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW) && c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, operand))
  8007:     {
  8008:         builder->failure_message = S8("a label-provenance value may not be used as an addressable place");
  8009:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8010:     }
  8011:     IrValueId base = operand;
  8012:     IrTypeId aggregate_type_id = builder->function->values[operand.value].canonical_type;
  8013:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&access, C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW))
  8014:     {
  8015:         operand = c_ir_decay_array_value_if_needed(builder, operand, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, access));
  8016:         if (operand.value >= builder->function->value_count)
  8017:         {
  8018:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8019:         }
  8020:         aggregate_type_id = builder->function->values[operand.value].canonical_type;
  8021:         IrType* pointer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, aggregate_type_id);
  8022:         if (!pointer_type || pointer_type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
  8023:         {
  8024:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8025:         }

  8030:                                          .definition = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID,
  8031:                                          .category = IR_VALUE_PLACE,
  8032:                                          .is_read_only = builder->function->values[operand.value].points_to_read_only,
  8033:                                          .is_volatile = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, aggregate_type_id)->is_volatile,
  8034:                                      });
  8035:         IrSourceRange dereference_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, access);
  8036:         IrInstruction dereference = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_DEREFERENCE, aggregate_type_id);
  8037:         dereference.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
  8038:         dereference.operands[0] = operand;
  8039:         dereference.operand_count = 1;
  8040:         dereference.result = base;
  8041:         IrInstructionId dereference_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, dereference, dereference_source);
  8042:         builder->function->values[base.value].definition = dereference_id;
  8043:     }
  8044:     else if (!c_token_is_punctuator(&access, C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT))
  8045:     {
  8046:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8047:     }
  8048:     else if (builder->function->values[operand.value].category != IR_VALUE_PLACE)
  8049:     {
  8050:         IrInstructionId definition = builder->function->values[operand.value].definition;
  8051:         if (definition.value >= builder->function->instruction_count)
  8052:         {
  8053:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8054:         }
  8055:         IrInstruction* instruction = &builder->function->instructions[definition.value];
  8056:         if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_LOAD && instruction->operand_count == 1)
  8057:         {
  8058:             // The load only materialized the aggregate for the expression
  8059:             // walk; `E.m` designates a member of the object E names and never
  8060:             // reads the whole of it. Drop it when it is still the last
  8061:             // instruction emitted, the way the address-of arm of
  8062:             // c_ir_apply_operation drops the load behind `&E`. The token peek
  8063:             // in the member arm keeps the place before the load exists, but it
  8064:             // only sees the token that follows the member identifier, so a
  8065:             // group between the two accesses hides the `.` from it:
  8066:             // `(*o).in.x` and `&(((T *)0)->in).v[3]` arrive here with the copy
  8067:             // already emitted (#741). The recovery falls back to the load's own
  8068:             // operand when something was emitted after it -- the same address
  8069:             // either way, with the copy left where it stands.

  8357: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_address_of_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId element_type, IrSourceRange source)
  8358: {
  8359:     if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count || builder->function->values[place.value].category != IR_VALUE_PLACE ||
  8360:         builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type.value != element_type.value || c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place))
  8361:     {
  8362:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8363:     }
  8364:     if (c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, place))
  8365:     {
  8366:         IrValueId root = place;
  8367:         u64 offset = 0;
  8368:         u64 size = 0;
  8369:         bool exact = false;
  8370:         if (!c_ir_label_place_location(builder, place, &root, &offset, &size, &exact))
  8371:         {
  8372:             builder->failure_message = S8("a label-containing object may not escape through an address-taking expression");
  8373:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8374:         }
  8375:         IrType* root_type = root.value < builder->function->value_count ? c_ir_value_type(builder, builder->function->values + root.value) : 0;
  8376:         if (root_type && (root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION))
  8377:         {
  8378:             builder->failure_message = S8("a label-containing aggregate may not escape through an address-taking expression");
  8379:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8380:         }
  8381:         // A scalar label pointer may be passed by address as an ordinary C
  8382:         // object, but the frontend cannot prove mutations through an escaped
  8383:         // alias.  Forget the label identity before publishing the address so
  8384:         // any later computed goto is rejected instead of dispatching through
  8385:         // stale metadata.
  8386:         c_ir_label_metadata_clear(builder, root);
  8387:         IrValueLabelMetadata* root_entry = ir_value_label_metadata_ensure(builder->arena, builder->function, root);
  8388:         if (root_entry)
  8389:         {
  8390:             root_entry->has_non_label_provenance = true;
  8391:         }
  8392:     }
  8393:     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, element_type);
  8394:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, pointer_type);
  8395:     builder->function->values[result.value].points_to_read_only = builder->function->values[place.value].is_read_only;
  8396:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
  8397:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ADDRESS_OF, pointer_type);
  8398:     instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
  8399:     instruction.operands[0] = place;
  8400:     instruction.operand_count = 1;
  8401:     instruction.result = result;
  8402:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
  8403:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
  8404:     return result;
  8405: }

  8407: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_vla_flat_pointer(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
  8408: {
  8409:     CIrVlaValue shape = c_ir_vla_value(builder, value);
  8410:     IrValueId result = value;
  8411:     if (shape.counts && !shape.slot)
  8412:     {
  8413:         // Unevaluated type prediction may retain a pointer/array shell which
  8414:         // concrete VLA lowering flattens. Normalize that shell at a consumer;
  8415:         // the saved shape remains the authority for element size and stride.
  8416:         IrTypeId pointer = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, shape.element_type);
  8417:         result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, pointer, source);
  8418:         if (result.value != value.value)
  8419:         {
  8420:             c_ir_vla_value_set(builder, result, shape);
  8421:         }
  8422:     }
  8423:     return result;
  8424: }

  8426: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_index_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId base, IrValueId index, IrSourceRange source)
  8427: {
  8428:     CIrVlaValue shape = c_ir_vla_value(builder, base);
  8429:     CIrVlaValue reversed = c_ir_vla_value(builder, index);
  8430:     if (!shape.counts && reversed.counts && !reversed.slot)
  8431:     {
  8432:         IrValueId swap = base;
  8433:         base = index;
  8434:         index = swap;
  8435:         shape = reversed;
  8436:     }
  8437:     bool dynamic = shape.counts && !shape.slot;
  8438:     u32 dimension = shape.dimension + (u32)shape.array_lvalue;
  8439:     base = dynamic ? c_ir_vla_flat_pointer(builder, base, source) : base;
  8440:     if (dynamic && index.value < builder->function->value_count)
  8441:     {
  8442:         IrType* index_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[index.value].canonical_type);
  8443:         if (index_type && (index_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || index_type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN))
  8444:         {
  8445:             index = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, index, builder->ptrdiff_type, source);
  8446:             for (u32 suffix = dimension; suffix < shape.dimension_count; suffix += 1)
  8447:             {
  8448:                 IrValueId count = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, shape.counts[suffix], builder->ptrdiff_type, source);
  8449:                 index = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, index, count, builder->ptrdiff_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
  8450:             }
  8451:         }
  8452:     }
  8453:     IrValueId result = c_ir_emit_index_place_raw(builder, base, index, source);
  8454:     if (dynamic && dimension < shape.dimension_count && result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
  8455:     {
  8456:         IrTypeId type = builder->function->values[result.value].canonical_type;
  8457:         result = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, result, type, source);
  8458:         shape.dimension = dimension;
  8459:         shape.array_lvalue = true;
  8460:         shape.rvalue = false;
  8461:         c_ir_vla_value_set(builder, result, shape);
  8462:     }
  8463:     return result;
  8464: }

  8548: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_dereference_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId pointer, IrSourceRange source)
  8549: {
  8550:     if (pointer.value >= builder->function->value_count)
  8551:     {
  8552:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8553:     }
  8554:     if (c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, pointer))
  8555:     {
  8556:         builder->failure_message = S8("a label-provenance value may not be used as an addressable place");
  8557:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8558:     }
  8559:     IrType* pointer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[pointer.value].canonical_type);
  8560:     if (!pointer_type || pointer_type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
  8561:     {
  8562:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8563:     }
  8564:     IrTypeId element = pointer_type->element_type;
  8565:     IrValueId place = ir_function_add_value(builder->arena, builder->function,
  8566:                                             (IrValue){
  8567:                                                 .canonical_type = element,
  8568:                                                 .definition = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID,
  8569:                                                 .category = IR_VALUE_PLACE,
  8570:                                                 .is_read_only = builder->function->values[pointer.value].points_to_read_only,
  8571:                                                 .is_volatile = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element)->is_volatile,
  8572:                                             });
  8573:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
  8574:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_DEREFERENCE, element);
  8575:     instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
  8576:     instruction.operands[0] = pointer;
  8577:     instruction.operand_count = 1;
  8578:     instruction.result = place;
  8579:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
  8580:     builder->function->values[place.value].definition = id;
  8581:     return place;
  8582: }

  8584: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_decay_array(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId target_type, IrSourceRange source)
  8585: {
  8586:     if (value.value >= builder->function->value_count)
  8587:     {
  8588:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8589:     }
  8590:     IrType* array_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type);
  8591:     IrType* pointer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, target_type);
  8592:     if (!array_type || array_type->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY || !pointer_type || pointer_type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
  8593:     {
  8594:         return value;
  8595:     }
  8596:     IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0});
  8597:     IrValueId first = c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, value, zero, source);
  8598:     IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, first, array_type->element_type, source);
  8599:     return c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, target_type, source);
  8600: }
  8601: 
  8602: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_decay_array_value_if_needed(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
  8603: {
  8604:     if (value.value >= builder->function->value_count)
  8605:     {
  8606:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8607:     }
  8608:     IrType* array_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type);
  8609:     if (!array_type || array_type->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
  8610:     {
  8611:         return value;
  8612:     }
  8613:     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, array_type->element_type);
  8614:     return c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, pointer_type, source);
  8615: }

  8617: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_arrow_operand_from_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type,
  8618:                                                                 IrSourceRange source)
  8619: {
  8620:     if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
  8621:     {
  8622:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8623:     }
  8624:     IrType* place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
  8625:     if (place_type && place_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
  8626:     {
  8627:         IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, place_type->element_type);
  8628:         return c_ir_decay_array(builder, place, pointer_type, source);
  8629:     }
  8630:     return c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, place, type, source);
  8631: }
  8632: 
  8633: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_parameter(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken name, u32 argument_index, IrTypeId type, IrTypeId object_type, CEntityId entity)
  8634: {
  8635:     // A by-value parameter is a local object, not the caller's ABI slot.
  8636:     // Carry its type alignment just as an ordinary declaration does: native
  8637:     // lowering uses the place's alignment to reserve and materialize storage
  8638:     // beyond the frame pointer's guaranteed alignment.
  8639:     IrType* parameter_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, object_type);
  8640:     u32 alignment = parameter_type ? parameter_type->layout.alignment : 0;
  8641:     IrValueId place = c_ir_emit_local(builder, name, object_type, entity, alignment);
  8642:     CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
  8643:     if (place.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !local)
  8644:     {
  8645:         return false;
  8646:     }
  8647:     local->is_parameter = true;
  8648:     // The pointer an array parameter was adjusted to points at the element
  8649:     // type, qualifiers included: `const struct timespec times[2]` yields a
  8650:     // modifiable pointer to constant elements, so the read-only answer moves
  8651:     // from the object to what it points to.
  8652:     if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count)
  8653:     {
  8654:         CTypeId declared = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].type;
  8655:         if (declared.value < builder->parse.type_count && builder->parse.types[declared.value].kind == C_TYPE_ARRAY &&
  8656:             c_ir_c_type_is_read_only(builder, builder->parse.types[declared.value].element_type))
  8657:         {
  8658:             builder->function->values[place.value].points_to_read_only = true;
  8659:         }
  8660:     }
  8661:     IrValueId value = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
  8662:     u64* immediate = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, 1);
  8663:     immediate[0] = argument_index;
  8664:     IrSourceRange argument_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, name);
  8665:     IrInstruction argument = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ARGUMENT, type);
  8666:     argument.immediates = immediate;
  8667:     argument.immediate_count = 1;
  8668:     argument.result = value;
  8669:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, argument, argument_source);
  8670:     builder->function->values[value.value].definition = id;
  8671:     bool stored = c_ir_emit_store(builder, local, value, argument_source);
  8672:     if (stored)
  8673:     {
  8674:         c_ir_mark_local_read_only(builder, local);
  8675:     }
  8676:     return stored;
  8677: }

  8679: // The constant rows every integer literal becomes, taking the source range
  8680: // directly: the fall-off of `main` has no token of its own to name, only the
  8681: // declaration's range.
  8682: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_integer_value_at(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u64 value, bool is_negative, IrSourceRange instruction_source,
  8683:                                                        IrTypeId type)

  8689:     instruction.immediates = immediate;
  8690:     instruction.immediate_count = 1;
  8691:     instruction.immediate_is_negative = is_negative;
  8692:     instruction.result = result;
  8693:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
  8694:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;

  8696: }

  8708: typedef struct CIrVlaLayout CIrVlaLayout;

  8718: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CArrayBound c_ir_vla_bound_expression(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CArrayBound bound)
  8719: {
  8720:     u32 end = bound.token_start + bound.token_count;
  8721:     while (bound.token_start < end)
  8722:     {
  8723:         CToken token = preprocess.tokens[bound.token_start];
  8724:         bool qualifier = token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && (string_equal(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("static")) || string_equal(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("const")) ||
  8725:                                                               string_equal(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("volatile")) || string_equal(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("restrict")));
  8726:         if (!qualifier)
  8727:         {
  8728:             break;
  8729:         }
  8730:         bound.token_start += 1;
  8731:     }
  8732:     bound.token_count = end - bound.token_start;
  8733:     return bound;
  8734: }

  8736: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_prepare_vla_layout(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CTypeId array_type, CToken token, bool parameter, bool pointer,
  8737:                                                 CIrVlaLayout* result);
  8738: 
  8739: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_integer_literal_fits(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CTypeKind kind, u64 value)
  8740: {
  8741:     u64 limit = builder->literal_limits[kind];
  8742:     if (limit)
  8743:     {
  8744:         return value <= limit;
  8745:     }
  8746:     IrTypeId type = builder->scalar_types[kind];
  8747:     IrType* integer = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
  8748:     bool result;
  8749:     if (!integer || integer->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
  8750:     {
  8751:         result = false;
  8752:     }
  8753:     else if (integer->bit_width >= 64)
  8754:     {
  8755:         result = !integer->is_signed || value <= INT64_MAX;
  8756:     }
  8757:     else if (!integer->is_signed)
  8758:     {
  8759:         result = value <= (((u64)1 << integer->bit_width) - 1);
  8760:     }
  8761:     else
  8762:     {
  8763:         result = value <= (((u64)1 << (integer->bit_width - 1)) - 1);
  8764:     }
  8765: 
  8766:     return result;
  8767: }
  8768: 
  8769: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_integer_literal_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, String8 spelling, u64 value)
  8770: {
  8771:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  8772:     bool suffix_valid = true;
  8773:     bool decimal = !spelling.length || spelling.pointer[0] != '0';
  8774:     bool is_unsigned = false;
  8775:     u32 long_count = 0;
  8776:     u64 suffix_start = spelling.length;
  8777:     u32 msvc_width = c_integer_msvc_literal_width(spelling, &is_unsigned);
  8778:     if (msvc_width)
  8779:     {
  8780:         long_count = 2;
  8781:     }
  8782:     while (!msvc_width && suffix_start)
  8783:     {
  8784:         u8 byte = spelling.pointer[suffix_start - 1];
  8785:         if (byte != 'u' && byte != 'U' && byte != 'l' && byte != 'L')
  8786:         {
  8787:             break;
  8788:         }
  8789:         suffix_start -= 1;
  8790:     }
  8791:     for (u64 index = suffix_start; suffix_valid && !msvc_width && index < spelling.length;)
  8792:     {
  8793:         u8 byte = spelling.pointer[index];
  8794:         if (byte == 'u' || byte == 'U')
  8795:         {
  8796:             if (is_unsigned)
  8797:             {
  8798:                 suffix_valid = false;
  8799:             }
  8800:             is_unsigned = true;
  8801:             index += 1;
  8802:         }
  8803:         else
  8804:         {
  8805:             u32 count = index + 1 < spelling.length && (spelling.pointer[index + 1] == 'l' || spelling.pointer[index + 1] == 'L') ? 2 : 1;
  8806:             if (long_count || count > 2)
  8807:             {
  8808:                 suffix_valid = false;
  8809:             }
  8810:             long_count = count;
  8811:             index += count;
  8812:         }
  8813:     }
  8814:     CTypeKind candidates[6] = {0};
  8815:     u32 candidate_count = 0;
  8816: #define C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(kind) candidates[candidate_count++] = (kind)
  8817:     if (suffix_valid)
  8818:     {
  8819:         if (msvc_width && msvc_width < 64)
  8820:         {
  8821:             CTypeKind signed_kind = msvc_width == 8 ? C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR : msvc_width == 16 ? C_TYPE_SHORT : C_TYPE_INT;
  8822:             CTypeKind unsigned_kind = msvc_width == 8 ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR : msvc_width == 16 ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT : C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT;
  8823:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(is_unsigned ? unsigned_kind : signed_kind);
  8824:         }
  8825:         else if (!long_count && !is_unsigned)
  8826:         {
  8827:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_INT);
  8828:             if (!decimal)
  8829:             {
  8830:                 C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT);
  8831:             }
  8832:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_LONG);
  8833:             if (!decimal)
  8834:             {
  8835:                 C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG);
  8836:             }
  8837:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_LONG_LONG);
  8838:             if (!decimal)
  8839:             {
  8840:                 C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG);
  8841:             }
  8842:         }
  8843:         else if (!long_count)
  8844:         {
  8845:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT);
  8846:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG);
  8847:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG);
  8848:         }
  8849:         else if (long_count == 1 && !is_unsigned)
  8850:         {
  8851:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_LONG);
  8852:             if (!decimal)
  8853:             {
  8854:                 C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG);
  8855:             }
  8856:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_LONG_LONG);
  8857:             if (!decimal)
  8858:             {
  8859:                 C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG);
  8860:             }
  8861:         }
  8862:         else if (long_count == 1)
  8863:         {
  8864:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG);
  8865:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG);
  8866:         }
  8867:         else if (!is_unsigned)
  8868:         {
  8869:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_LONG_LONG);
  8870:             if (!decimal)
  8871:             {
  8872:                 C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG);
  8873:             }
  8874:         }
  8875:         else
  8876:         {
  8877:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG);
  8878:         }
  8879:     }
  8880: #undef C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE
  8881:     for (u32 index = 0; result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && index < candidate_count; index += 1)
  8882:     {
  8883:         if (c_ir_integer_literal_fits(builder, candidates[index], value))
  8884:         {
  8885:             result = builder->scalar_types[candidates[index]];
  8886:         }
  8887:     }
  8888:     return result;
  8889: }
  8890: 
  8891: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_integer(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token)
  8892: {
  8893:     u64 value = 0;
  8894:     if (!c_conditional_number(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), &value))
  8895:     {
  8896:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8897:     }
  8898:     IrTypeId type = c_ir_integer_literal_type(builder, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), value);
  8899:     IrValueId result;
  8900:     if (type.value == IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID.value)
  8901:     {
  8902:         result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
  8903:     }
  8904:     else
  8905:     {
  8906:         result = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, value, false, token, type);
  8907:     }
  8908: 
  8909:     return result;
  8910: }
  8911: 
  8912: // The imaginary suffix of a floating literal. C's suffixes are `f`/`l` and
  8913: // GNU adds `i`/`j` for an imaginary constant, in either order and either
  8914: // case, so the run of trailing letters is scanned rather than just the last
  8915: // one. Reports the spelling with the imaginary letter removed, which is an
  8916: // ordinary real literal the parser below already understands; `arena` is only
  8917: // touched when that letter is not the last one.
  8918: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_number_imaginary_spelling(Arena* arena, String8 spelling, String8* real_out)
  8919: {
  8920:     u64 suffix_start = spelling.length;
  8921:     u64 imaginary_index = spelling.length;
  8922:     while (suffix_start)
  8923:     {
  8924:         u8 byte = (u8)spelling.pointer[suffix_start - 1];
  8925:         if (byte == 'i' || byte == 'I' || byte == 'j' || byte == 'J')
  8926:         {
  8927:             // Two imaginary letters is not a literal any compiler accepts;
  8928:             // leave it alone and let the real parser refuse the spelling.
  8929:             if (imaginary_index != spelling.length)
  8930:             {
  8931:                 return false;
  8932:             }
  8933:             imaginary_index = suffix_start - 1;
  8934:         }
  8935:         else if (byte != 'f' && byte != 'F' && byte != 'l' && byte != 'L')
  8936:         {
  8937:             break;
  8938:         }
  8939:         suffix_start -= 1;
  8940:     }
  8941:     if (imaginary_index == spelling.length || !suffix_start)
  8942:     {
  8943:         return false;
  8944:     }
  8945:     if (imaginary_index == spelling.length - 1)
  8946:     {
  8947:         *real_out = (String8){.pointer = spelling.pointer, .length = spelling.length - 1};
  8948:         return true;
  8949:     }
  8950:     char8* copy = arena_allocate(arena, char8, spelling.length - 1);
  8951:     memcpy(copy, spelling.pointer, imaginary_index);
  8952:     memcpy(copy + imaginary_index, spelling.pointer + imaginary_index + 1, spelling.length - imaginary_index - 1);
  8953:     *real_out = (String8){.pointer = copy, .length = spelling.length - 1};
  8954:     return true;
  8955: }
  8956: 
  8957: // The suffix of a floating constant: how many trailing bytes it occupies and
  8958: // which type it names, reported as one code. C's suffixes are `f`/`F` for
  8959: // float and `l`/`L` for long double, and C23 adds `f16`/`F16` for `_Float16`
  8960: // -- the only one longer than a letter, so reading the last byte alone cannot
  8961: // recognize it. The half suffix reports as 'h', a letter C does not use as a
  8962: // suffix, so a caller comparing against 'f' or 'l' cannot confuse the two.
  8963: // Every spelling-to-value path shares this so that the type a literal is
  8964: // given and the digits that are parsed for it cannot disagree.
  8965: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_float_suffix(String8 spelling, char8* code_out)
  8966: {
  8967:     // In a hexadecimal spelling `f` and `F` are digits, and only a `p`
  8968:     // exponent makes such a spelling a floating constant at all: `0x2f16` is
  8969:     // the integer 12054 and `0x2f` the integer 47, where `0x1p4f` really does
  8970:     // carry the float suffix. Asking for the exponent is what keeps a
  8971:     // float-typed initializer written with a hexadecimal integer from losing
  8972:     // its last digits to a suffix that is not there.
  8973:     bool hexadecimal = spelling.length >= 2 && spelling.pointer[0] == '0' && (spelling.pointer[1] == 'x' || spelling.pointer[1] == 'X');
  8974:     bool suffixable = !hexadecimal;
  8975:     for (u64 index = 2; !suffixable && index < spelling.length; index += 1)
  8976:     {
  8977:         suffixable = spelling.pointer[index] == 'p' || spelling.pointer[index] == 'P';
  8978:     }
  8979:     char8 code = 0;
  8980:     u32 length = 0;
  8981:     if (suffixable && spelling.length >= 3 && (spelling.pointer[spelling.length - 3] == 'f' || spelling.pointer[spelling.length - 3] == 'F') &&
  8982:         spelling.pointer[spelling.length - 2] == '1' && spelling.pointer[spelling.length - 1] == '6')
  8983:     {
  8984:         code = 'h';
  8985:         length = 3;
  8986:     }
  8987:     else if (suffixable && spelling.length)
  8988:     {
  8989:         char8 last = spelling.pointer[spelling.length - 1];
  8990:         if (last == 'f' || last == 'F' || last == 'l' || last == 'L')
  8991:         {
  8992:             code = last;
  8993:             length = 1;
  8994:         }
  8995:     }
  8996:     *code_out = code;
  8997: 
  8998:     return length;
  8999: }
  9000: 
  9001: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_float_parse(String8 spelling, f64* value_out, char8* suffix_out)
  9002: {
  9003:     spelling.length -= c_ir_float_suffix(spelling, suffix_out);
  9004:     bool hexadecimal = spelling.length >= 2 && spelling.pointer[0] == '0' && (spelling.pointer[1] == 'x' || spelling.pointer[1] == 'X');
  9005:     u32 base = hexadecimal ? 16 : 10;
  9006:     u64 index = hexadecimal ? 2 : 0;
  9007:     f64 value = 0.0;
  9008:     f64 fraction_scale = 1.0;
  9009:     bool fraction = false;
  9010:     bool saw_digit = false;
  9011:     // The integer view of a decimal literal: every digit absorbed into a u64
  9012:     // mantissa plus a power of ten. When the whole spelling fits — mantissa
  9013:     // under 2^53, scale within the exactly representable 1e22 — one multiply
  9014:     // or divide of two exact doubles is correctly rounded (Clinger's fast
  9015:     // path), where the digit-by-digit accumulation below drifts by an ulp
  9016:     // (its running fraction scales 0.1, 0.01, ... are themselves rounded).
  9017:     u64 mantissa = 0;
  9018:     s64 mantissa_scale = 0;
  9019:     s64 fraction_digits = 0;
  9020:     bool mantissa_exact = true;
  9021:     while (index < spelling.length)
  9022:     {
  9023:         u8 byte = spelling.pointer[index];
  9024:         if (byte == '.')
  9025:         {
  9026:             if (fraction)
  9027:             {
  9028:                 return false;
  9029:             }
  9030:             fraction = true;
  9031:             index += 1;
  9032:             continue;
  9033:         }
  9034:         if ((!hexadecimal && (byte == 'e' || byte == 'E')) || (hexadecimal && (byte == 'p' || byte == 'P')))
  9035:         {
  9036:             break;
--- lines 10333-10533 ---
 10333:     };
 10334: }
 10335: 
 10336: // Round an exact rational into the format an operation's rank names and carry
 10337: // the answer back as the encoded pair.  A float or double result rounds in its
 10338: // own format first and widens exactly, which is what leaves `1.0f/3.0f`
 10339: // holding the float quotient rather than the long double one.  Overflow and
 10340: // underflow are values here, not failures: C says the result becomes the
 10341: // infinity or the signed zero, and Clang folds them that way.
 10342: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_ext80_value_round(CIrExt80Big const* numerator, CIrExt80Big const* denominator, s32 binary_exponent,
 10343:                                                 bool negative, u8 rank, CIrExt80Value* result_out)
 10344: {
 10345:     u64 significand = 0;
 10346:     u16 exponent_sign = 0;
 10347:     u8 status;
 10348:     if (rank == C_IR_EXT80_RANK_LONG_DOUBLE)
 10349:     {
 10350:         status = c_ir_ext80_from_rational(numerator, denominator, binary_exponent, negative, &significand, &exponent_sign);
 10351:     }
 10352:     else if (rank == C_IR_EXT80_RANK_HALF)
 10353:     {
 10354:         // binary16 rounds in its own format and then widens through binary64,
 10355:         // which is exact for every value it can hold, so the x87 encoding it
 10356:         // reaches is the one the half result denotes.
 10357:         u64 bits = 0;
 10358:         status = c_ir_ieee_from_rational(numerator, denominator, binary_exponent, negative, 10, -14, 15, 5, &bits);
 10359:         if (status == C_IR_ROUND_OK)
 10360:         {
 10361:             f64 widened = c_ir_float16_to_f64(bits);
 10362:             u64 widened_bits = 0;
 10363:             memcpy(&widened_bits, &widened, sizeof(widened_bits));
 10364:             if (!c_ir_ext80_from_ieee64(widened_bits, false, &significand, &exponent_sign))
 10365:             {
 10366:                 status = C_IR_ROUND_FAILED;
 10367:             }
 10368:         }
 10369:     }
 10370:     else
 10371:     {
 10372:         bool single = rank == C_IR_EXT80_RANK_FLOAT;
 10373:         u64 bits = 0;
 10374:         status = c_ir_ieee_from_rational(numerator, denominator, binary_exponent, negative, single ? 23 : 52, single ? -126 : -1022,
 10375:                                          single ? 127 : 1023, single ? 8 : 11, &bits);
 10376:         if (status == C_IR_ROUND_OK && !(single ? c_ir_ext80_from_ieee32((u32)bits, false, &significand, &exponent_sign)
 10377:                                                 : c_ir_ext80_from_ieee64(bits, false, &significand, &exponent_sign)))
 10378:         {
 10379:             status = C_IR_ROUND_FAILED;
 10380:         }
 10381:     }
 10382:     bool result = true;
 10383:     if (status == C_IR_ROUND_OK)
 10384:     {
 10385:         *result_out = (CIrExt80Value){.significand = significand, .exponent_sign = exponent_sign, .rank = rank};
 10386:     }
 10387:     else if (status == C_IR_ROUND_OVERFLOW)
 10388:     {
 10389:         *result_out = c_ir_ext80_value_infinity(negative, rank);
 10390:     }
 10391:     else if (status == C_IR_ROUND_UNDERFLOW)
 10392:     {
 10393:         *result_out = c_ir_ext80_value_zero(negative, rank);
 10394:     }
 10395:     else
 10396:     {
 10397:         result = false;
 10398:     }
 10399: 
 10400:     return result;
 10401: }
 10402: 
 10403: // One operand in the common real type the usual arithmetic conversions pick.
 10404: // Only an integer operand can lose anything here -- a float widens into a
 10405: // double exactly and every encoded value is already exact in the x87 format --
 10406: // but that loss is real: `16777217 * 1.0f` holds 2^24 because the integer
 10407: // rounds to float before the multiply, not after it.
 10408: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_ext80_value_convert(CIrExt80Value* value, u8 rank)
 10409: {
 10410:     bool result = true;
 10411:     if (value->rank != rank && rank != C_IR_EXT80_RANK_LONG_DOUBLE && !c_ir_ext80_value_is_special(*value) && value->significand)
 10412:     {
 10413:         CIrExt80Big numerator;
 10414:         CIrExt80Big denominator;
 10415:         s32 binary_exponent = 0;
 10416:         bool negative = false;
 10417:         c_ir_ext80_big_set_u64(&denominator, 1);
 10418:         result = c_ir_ext80_value_rational(*value, &numerator, &binary_exponent, &negative) &&
 10419:                  c_ir_ext80_value_round(&numerator, &denominator, binary_exponent, negative, rank, value);
 10420:     }
 10421:     value->rank = rank;
 10422: 
 10423:     return result;
 10424: }
 10425: 
 10426: // The IEEE special cases, which answer before the rational core sees anything.
 10427: // The invalid combinations among them -- inf minus inf, inf times zero, inf
 10428: // over inf, zero over zero -- have to give the same answer as
 10429: // c_ir_fold_float_invalid_operation gives an in-function constant, because
 10430: // the sign IEEE-754 leaves unspecified is a compatibility choice and the two
 10431: // paths would otherwise print `nan` and `-nan` for one spelling.  They also
 10432: // do not care where the operation would round: the NaN is the same value at
 10433: // every precision and widens exactly.
 10434: //
 10435: // A NaN operand wins outright and keeps its own sign, the left one first; the
 10436: // sign flip a subtraction applies to its right operand happens only after
 10437: // that, which is why `1.0L - -nan` is still negative.  Everything else is the
 10438: // ordinary infinity and division-by-zero algebra, with the invalid
 10439: // combinations -- inf minus inf, inf times zero, inf over inf, zero over zero
 10440: // -- becoming the default NaN.  A finite operation returns false and the
 10441: // caller folds it as a rational instead.
 10442: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_ext80_value_special(CPunctuator op, CIrExt80Value left, CIrExt80Value right, u8 rank, CIrExt80Value* result_out)
 10443: {
 10444:     bool handled = true;
 10445:     if (c_ir_ext80_value_is_nan(left) || c_ir_ext80_value_is_nan(right))
 10446:     {
 10447:         *result_out = c_ir_ext80_value_is_nan(left) ? left : right;
 10448:         result_out->rank = rank;
 10449:     }
 10450:     else
 10451:     {
 10452:         bool left_negative = (left.exponent_sign & C_IR_EXT80_SIGN) != 0;
 10453:         bool right_negative = (right.exponent_sign & C_IR_EXT80_SIGN) != 0;
 10454:         if (op == C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS)
 10455:         {
 10456:             right_negative = !right_negative;
 10457:         }
 10458:         bool left_infinite = c_ir_ext80_value_is_infinite(left);
 10459:         bool right_infinite = c_ir_ext80_value_is_infinite(right);
 10460:         bool combined_negative = left_negative != right_negative;
 10461:         if (op == C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS || op == C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS)
 10462:         {
 10463:             if (left_infinite && right_infinite)
 10464:             {
 10465:                 *result_out = combined_negative ? c_ir_ext80_value_default_nan(rank) : c_ir_ext80_value_infinity(left_negative, rank);
 10466:             }
 10467:             else if (left_infinite || right_infinite)
 10468:             {
 10469:                 *result_out = c_ir_ext80_value_infinity(left_infinite ? left_negative : right_negative, rank);
 10470:             }
 10471:             else
 10472:             {
 10473:                 handled = false;
 10474:             }
 10475:         }
 10476:         else if (op == C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR)
 10477:         {
 10478:             if (left_infinite || right_infinite)
 10479:             {
 10480:                 bool other_zero = c_ir_ext80_value_is_zero(left_infinite ? right : left);
 10481:                 *result_out = other_zero ? c_ir_ext80_value_default_nan(rank) : c_ir_ext80_value_infinity(combined_negative, rank);
 10482:             }
 10483:             else
 10484:             {
 10485:                 handled = false;
 10486:             }
 10487:         }
 10488:         else if (left_infinite && right_infinite)
 10489:         {
 10490:             *result_out = c_ir_ext80_value_default_nan(rank);
 10491:         }
 10492:         else if (left_infinite)
 10493:         {
 10494:             *result_out = c_ir_ext80_value_infinity(combined_negative, rank);
 10495:         }
 10496:         else if (right_infinite)
 10497:         {
 10498:             *result_out = c_ir_ext80_value_zero(combined_negative, rank);
 10499:         }
 10500:         else if (c_ir_ext80_value_is_zero(right))
 10501:         {
 10502:             *result_out = c_ir_ext80_value_is_zero(left) ? c_ir_ext80_value_default_nan(rank)
 10503:                                                          : c_ir_ext80_value_infinity(combined_negative, rank);
 10504:         }
 10505:         else
 10506:         {
 10507:             handled = false;
 10508:         }
 10509:     }
 10510: 
 10511:     return handled;
 10512: }
 10513: 
 10514: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_ext80_value_binary(CPunctuator op, CIrExt80Value left, CIrExt80Value right, u8 rank, CIrExt80Value* result_out)
 10515: {
 10516:     CIrExt80Big left_numerator;
 10517:     CIrExt80Big right_numerator;
 10518:     s32 left_exponent = 0;
 10519:     s32 right_exponent = 0;
 10520:     bool left_negative = false;
 10521:     bool right_negative = false;
 10522:     if (!c_ir_ext80_value_rational(left, &left_numerator, &left_exponent, &left_negative) ||
 10523:         !c_ir_ext80_value_rational(right, &right_numerator, &right_exponent, &right_negative))
 10524:     {
 10525:         return false;
 10526:     }
 10527:     CIrExt80Big denominator;
 10528:     c_ir_ext80_big_set_u64(&denominator, 1);
 10529:     bool negative = false;
 10530:     bool valid = false;
 10531:     s64 exponent = 0;
 10532:     if (op == C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR)
 10533:     {
--- lines 10553-10849 ---
 10553:     {
 10554:         right_negative = op == C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS ? !right_negative : right_negative;
 10555:         s32 common = left_exponent < right_exponent ? left_exponent : right_exponent;
 10556:         if (!left_numerator.count || !right_numerator.count)
 10557:         {
 10558:             // A zero operand is the exact identity and is taken before the
 10559:             // alignment below rather than through it.  A zero's exponent is
 10560:             // the minimum subnormal's, not its own, so lining it up against a
 10561:             // near-maximum operand spans the entire 32.828-bit dynamic range,
 10562:             // which is wider than C_IR_EXT80_BIG_LIMBS reaches; an addition
 10563:             // that changes nothing would come back as a refusal.
 10564:             valid = true;
 10565:             if (!left_numerator.count && !right_numerator.count)
 10566:             {
 10567:                 // Two zeros keep a sign they agree on and cancel to positive
 10568:                 // otherwise, which is what round-to-nearest gives.
 10569:                 negative = left_negative && right_negative;
 10570:                 exponent = left_exponent;
 10571:             }
 10572:             else if (!left_numerator.count)
 10573:             {
 10574:                 c_ir_ext80_big_copy(&left_numerator, &right_numerator);
 10575:                 negative = right_negative;
 10576:                 exponent = right_exponent;
 10577:             }
 10578:             else
 10579:             {
 10580:                 negative = left_negative;
 10581:                 exponent = left_exponent;
 10582:             }
 10583:         }
 10584:         else if (!c_ir_ext80_big_shift_left(&left_numerator, (u32)(left_exponent - common)) ||
 10585:                  !c_ir_ext80_big_shift_left(&right_numerator, (u32)(right_exponent - common)))
 10586:         {
 10587:             return false;
 10588:         }
 10589:         else if (left_negative == right_negative)
 10590:         {
 10591:             exponent = common;
 10592:             valid = c_ir_ext80_big_add(&left_numerator, &right_numerator);
 10593:             negative = left_negative;
 10594:         }
 10595:         else
 10596:         {
 10597:             // Opposite signs subtract the smaller magnitude from the larger and
 10598:             // keep that operand's sign.  Operands that cancel exactly give
 10599:             // positive zero under round-to-nearest, which is why the sign only
 10600:             // survives while a difference remains.
 10601:             exponent = common;
 10602:             s32 comparison = c_ir_ext80_big_compare(&left_numerator, &right_numerator);
 10603:             if (comparison >= 0)
 10604:             {
 10605:                 negative = left_negative && comparison > 0;
 10606:                 valid = c_ir_ext80_big_subtract_shifted(&left_numerator, &right_numerator, 0);
 10607:             }
 10608:             else
 10609:             {
 10610:                 valid = c_ir_ext80_big_subtract_shifted(&right_numerator, &left_numerator, 0);
 10611:                 c_ir_ext80_big_copy(&left_numerator, &right_numerator);
 10612:                 negative = right_negative;
 10613:             }
 10614:         }
 10615:     }
 10616:     if (!valid || exponent > INT32_MAX || exponent < INT32_MIN)
 10617:     {
 10618:         return false;
 10619:     }
 10620:     return c_ir_ext80_value_round(&left_numerator, &denominator, (s32)exponent, negative, rank, result_out);
 10621: }
 10622: 
 10623: // The usual arithmetic conversions decide where an operation rounds: both
 10624: // operands convert to the common real type first and the result rounds there.
 10625: // Integer arithmetic is still refused, because it does not round at all --
 10626: // `1/3` would need its own truncating semantics, and a fold that answered 0.5
 10627: // for it would be silently wrong rather than merely absent.
 10628: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_ext80_fold_apply(CPunctuator op, CIrExt80Value left, CIrExt80Value right, CIrExt80Value* result_out)
 10629: {
 10630:     u8 rank = left.rank > right.rank ? left.rank : right.rank;
 10631:     bool result;
 10632:     if (rank == C_IR_EXT80_RANK_INTEGER || !c_ir_ext80_value_convert(&left, rank) || !c_ir_ext80_value_convert(&right, rank))
 10633:     {
 10634:         result = false;
 10635:     }
 10636:     else if (c_ir_ext80_value_special(op, left, right, rank, result_out))
 10637:     {
 10638:         result = true;
 10639:     }
 10640:     else
 10641:     {
 10642:         result = c_ir_ext80_value_binary(op, left, right, rank, result_out);
 10643:     }
 10644: 
 10645:     return result;
 10646: }
 10647: 
 10648: // One numeric token as the long double value it converts to.  The three cases
 10649: // are the literal's own type: an L-suffixed spelling is already this format, a
 10650: // plain or f-suffixed spelling rounds to double or float first and widens
 10651: // exactly, and an integer spelling converts from its own integer type, where a
 10652: // leading minus on an unsigned literal wraps before the widening.
 10653: //
 10654: // A spelling whose magnitude does not fit its own type is not a refusal: C
 10655: // gives it the infinity or the signed zero, and musl spells `INFINITY` as
 10656: // `1e5000f` whenever the compiler does not offer the GNU builtins, which is
 10657: // how an overflowing literal reaches a static initializer in the first place.
 10658: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_ext80_fold_number(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 token_index, bool negative, CIrExt80Value* value_out)
 10659: {
 10660:     String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[token_index]);
 10661:     u64 significand = 0;
 10662:     u16 exponent_sign = 0;
 10663:     bool floating = c_number_is_float(spelling);
 10664:     char8 suffix = 0;
 10665:     c_ir_float_suffix(spelling, &suffix);
 10666:     bool long_suffix = suffix == 'l' || suffix == 'L';
 10667:     u8 status = C_IR_ROUND_FAILED;
 10668:     u8 rank = C_IR_EXT80_RANK_INTEGER;
 10669:     if (floating && long_suffix)
 10670:     {
 10671:         rank = C_IR_EXT80_RANK_LONG_DOUBLE;
 10672:         status = c_ir_ext80_parse_long_literal(spelling, negative, &significand, &exponent_sign);
 10673:     }
 10674:     else if (floating)
 10675:     {
 10676:         bool single = suffix == 'f' || suffix == 'F';
 10677:         bool half = suffix == 'h';
 10678:         rank = half ? C_IR_EXT80_RANK_HALF : single ? C_IR_EXT80_RANK_FLOAT : C_IR_EXT80_RANK_DOUBLE;
 10679:         CIrExt80Big numerator;
 10680:         CIrExt80Big denominator;
 10681:         s32 binary_exponent = 0;
 10682:         if (c_ir_ext80_parse_rational_literal(spelling, &numerator, &denominator, &binary_exponent))
 10683:         {
 10684:             u64 ieee_bits = 0;
 10685:             bool source_nonzero = c_ir_ext80_spelling_nonzero(spelling);
 10686:             status = c_ir_ieee_from_rational(&numerator, &denominator, binary_exponent, negative, half ? 10u : single ? 23u : 52u,
 10687:                                              half ? -14 : single ? -126 : -1022, half ? 15 : single ? 127 : 1023, half ? 5u : single ? 8u : 11u,
 10688:                                              &ieee_bits);
 10689:             if (status == C_IR_ROUND_OK)
 10690:             {
 10691:                 // A nonzero spelling that rounded to zero without reporting an
 10692:                 // underflow would be a bug in the core above, not a value.
 10693:                 u64 magnitude = half     ? (ieee_bits & UINT64_C(0x7fff))
 10694:                                 : single ? (ieee_bits & UINT32_C(0x7fffffff))
 10695:                                          : (ieee_bits & UINT64_C(0x7fffffffffffffff));
 10696:                 // A half value widens into binary64 exactly, so the x87
 10697:                 // encoding reached through it is the one the half literal
 10698:                 // denotes.
 10699:                 u64 widened_bits = ieee_bits;
 10700:                 if (half)
 10701:                 {
 10702:                     f64 widened = c_ir_float16_to_f64(ieee_bits);
 10703:                     memcpy(&widened_bits, &widened, sizeof(widened_bits));
 10704:                 }
 10705:                 if ((source_nonzero && !magnitude) ||
 10706:                     !(single ? c_ir_ext80_from_ieee32((u32)ieee_bits, false, &significand, &exponent_sign)
 10707:                              : c_ir_ext80_from_ieee64(widened_bits, false, &significand, &exponent_sign)))
 10708:                 {
 10709:                     status = C_IR_ROUND_FAILED;
 10710:                 }
 10711:             }
 10712:         }
 10713:     }
 10714:     else
 10715:     {
 10716:         u64 integer = 0;
 10717:         if (c_conditional_number(spelling, &integer))
 10718:         {
 10719:             IrTypeId integer_type_id = c_ir_integer_literal_type(builder, spelling, integer);
 10720:             IrType* integer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, integer_type_id);
 10721:             if (!integer_type || !c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(integer_type))
 10722:             {
 10723:                 return false;
 10724:             }
 10725:             if (negative)
 10726:             {
 10727:                 if (integer_type->is_signed)
 10728:                 {
 10729:                     negative = integer != 0;
 10730:                 }
 10731:                 else
 10732:                 {
 10733:                     integer = 0 - integer;
 10734:                     if (integer_type->bit_width < 64)
 10735:                     {
 10736:                         integer &= ((u64)1 << integer_type->bit_width) - 1;
 10737:                     }
 10738:                     // Unary minus on an unsigned integer wraps in that
 10739:                     // integer type before the conversion to long double.
 10740:                     negative = false;
 10741:                 }
 10742:             }
 10743:             CIrExt80Big numerator;
 10744:             CIrExt80Big denominator;
 10745:             c_ir_ext80_big_set_u64(&numerator, integer);
 10746:             c_ir_ext80_big_set_u64(&denominator, 1);
 10747:             // Every u64 is exact in a 64-bit significand, so an integer
 10748:             // spelling can only come back as C_IR_ROUND_OK or a failure.
 10749:             status = c_ir_ext80_from_rational(&numerator, &denominator, 0, negative, &significand, &exponent_sign);
 10750:         }
 10751:     }
 10752:     bool result = true;
 10753:     if (status == C_IR_ROUND_OK)
 10754:     {
 10755:         *value_out = (CIrExt80Value){
 10756:             .significand = significand,
 10757:             .exponent_sign = exponent_sign,
 10758:             .rank = rank,
 10759:         };
 10760:     }
 10761:     else if (status == C_IR_ROUND_OVERFLOW)
 10762:     {
 10763:         *value_out = c_ir_ext80_value_infinity(negative, rank);
 10764:     }
 10765:     else if (status == C_IR_ROUND_UNDERFLOW)
 10766:     {
 10767:         *value_out = c_ir_ext80_value_zero(negative, rank);
 10768:     }
 10769:     else
 10770:     {
 10771:         result = false;
 10772:     }
 10773: 
 10774:     return result;
 10775: }

 10777: // The initializer expression itself, as a recursive descent over the token
 10778: // range with the two ordinary precedence levels.  Values are ten bytes, so the
 10779: // recursion carries no bignum; the bounded ones live inside a single operation.
 10780: typedef struct CIrExt80Fold CIrExt80Fold;

 10796: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_ext80_fold_primary(CIrExt80Fold* fold, CIrExt80Value* value_out)
 10797: {
 10798:     if (fold->cursor >= fold->limit || fold->depth >= C_IR_EXT80_FOLD_DEPTH_LIMIT)
 10799:     {
 10800:         fold->blame = fold->cursor < fold->limit ? fold->cursor : (fold->limit ? fold->limit - 1 : 0);
 10801:         return false;
 10802:     }

 10804:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(token, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS))
 10805:     {
 10806:         bool negative = c_token_is_punctuator(token, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
 10807:         fold->cursor += 1;
 10808:         if (fold->cursor < fold->limit && fold->builder->preprocess.tokens[fold->cursor].kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
 10809:         {
 10810:             // A sign directly on a literal converts in that literal's own
 10811:             // type, which is where the unsigned wrap has to happen.
 10812:             u32 number = fold->cursor;
 10813:             fold->cursor += 1;
 10814:             if (!c_ir_ext80_fold_number(fold->builder, number, negative, value_out))
 10815:             {
 10816:                 fold->blame = number;
 10817:                 return false;
 10818:             }
 10819:             return true;
 10820:         }
 10821:         fold->depth += 1;
 10822:         bool folded = c_ir_ext80_fold_primary(fold, value_out);
 10823:         fold->depth -= 1;
 10824:         if (!folded)
 10825:         {

 10827:         }
 10828:         value_out->exponent_sign ^= negative ? UINT16_C(0x8000) : 0;
 10829:         return true;

 10832:     {
 10833:         u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter(fold->builder->preprocess, fold->cursor, fold->limit, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS,
 10834:                                             C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);

 10836:         {
 10837:             fold->blame = fold->cursor;
 10838:             return false;
 10839:         }
 10840:         CIrExt80Fold inner = *fold;
 10841:         inner.cursor = fold->cursor + 1;
 10842:         inner.limit = close;
 10843:         inner.depth = fold->depth + 1;
 10844:         bool folded = c_ir_ext80_fold_sum(&inner, value_out);
 10845:         if (!folded || inner.cursor != close)
 10846:         {
 10847:             fold->blame = folded ? inner.cursor : inner.blame;
 10848:             return false;
 10849:         }

 12274:         width = target_uses_16_bit_wchar(target) ? 2 : 4;
 12275:         kind = target_uses_16_bit_wchar(target) ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT :
 12276:                target_uses_unsigned_wchar(target) ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT : C_TYPE_INT;
 12277:         break;
 12278:     default:
 12279:         return false;
 12280:     }
 12281:     ByteSlice bytes = {0};
 12282:     u64 element_count = 0;
 12283:     if (!c_ir_decode_wide_quoted(arena, token_spelling, '\'', width, &bytes, &element_count) || element_count != 1 || bytes.length != width)
 12284:     {
 12285:         return false;
 12286:     }
 12287:     u64 value = 0;
 12288:     for (u32 index = 0; index < width; index += 1)
 12289:     {
 12290:         value |= (u64)bytes.pointer[index] << (index * 8);
 12291:     }
 12292:     *value_out = value;
 12293:     *kind_out = kind;
 12294:     return true;
 12295: }
 12296: 
 12297: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_character(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token)
 12298: {
 12299:     u64 value = 0;
 12300:     CTypeKind kind = C_TYPE_INVALID;
 12301:     IrValueId result;
 12302:     if (!c_ir_decode_character_value(builder->arena, builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token, builder->target, &value, &kind))
 12303:     {
 12304:         result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 12305:     }
 12306:     else
 12307:     {
 12308:         result = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, value, false, token, builder->scalar_types[kind]);
 12309:     }
 12310: 
 12311:     return result;
 12312: }
