 12314: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_string_contents_typed(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token, CIrDecodedString decoded, IrTypeId requested_type)
 12315: {
 12316:     if (!builder->module || decoded.element_count == UINT64_MAX || !decoded.element_width)
 12317:     {
 12318:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 12319:     }
 12320:     u64 element_count = decoded.element_count + 1;
 12321:     if (element_count > UINT64_MAX / decoded.element_width)
 12322:     {
 12323:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 12324:     }
 12325:     u64 byte_length = element_count * decoded.element_width;
 12326:     IrTypeId element_type = builder->scalar_types[decoded.element_kind];
 12327:     IrType* literal_element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element_type);
 12328:     if (!literal_element || literal_element->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER || literal_element->bit_width != decoded.element_width * 8)
 12329:     {
 12330:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 12331:     }
 12332:     IrTypeId array_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 12333:     IrType* requested = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, requested_type);
 12334:     if (requested && requested->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
 12335:     {
 12336:         IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, requested->element_type);
 12337:         if (!element || element->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER || element->bit_width != decoded.element_width * 8 || decoded.element_count > requested->element_count)
 12338:         {
 12339:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 12340:         }
 12341:         element_count = requested->element_count;
 12342:         if (element_count > UINT64_MAX / decoded.element_width)
 12343:         {
 12344:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 12345:         }
 12346:         byte_length = element_count * decoded.element_width;
 12347:         array_type = requested_type;
 12348:     }
 12349:     u8* bytes = arena_allocate_zeroed(builder->arena, u8, byte_length);
 12350:     if (decoded.bytes.length)
 12351:     {
 12352:         memcpy(bytes, decoded.bytes.pointer, decoded.bytes.length);
 12353:     }
 12354:     if (array_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 12355:     {
 12356:         array_type = ir_program_add_type(builder->program, (IrType){
 12357:                                                                .name = S8("C string literal"),
 12358:                                                                .element_type = element_type,
 12359:                                                                .return_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
 12360:                                                                .layout =
 12361:                                                                    {
 12362:                                                                        .size = byte_length,
 12363:                                                                        .alignment = literal_element->layout.alignment,
 12364:                                                                        .resolved = true,
 12365:                                                                    },
 12366:                                                                .kind = IR_TYPE_ARRAY,
 12367:                                                                .element_count = element_count,
 12368:                                                            });
 12369:     }
 12370:     String8 name = string_format(builder->arena, S8(".L.cstr.{u32}"), builder->program->symbols.count);
 12371:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 12372:     IrSymbolId symbol = ir_program_add_symbol(builder->program, (IrSymbol){
 12373:                                                                     .name = name,
 12374:                                                                     .link_name = name,
 12375:                                                                     .source = source,
 12376:                                                                     .type = array_type,
 12377:                                                                     .kind = IR_SYMBOL_DATA,
 12378:                                                                     .linkage = IR_LINKAGE_INTERNAL,
 12379:                                                                     .is_definition = true,
 12380:                                                                 });
 12381:     ir_module_add_global(builder->arena, builder->module,
 12382:                          (IrGlobal){
 12383:                              .bytes =
 12384:                                  {
 12385:                                      .pointer = bytes,
 12386:                                      .length = byte_length,
 12387:                                  },
 12388:                              .symbol = symbol,
 12389:                              .initializer_symbol = IR_SYMBOL_ID_INVALID,
 12390:                              .type = array_type,
 12391:                              .source = source,
 12392:                              .initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_BYTES,
 12393:                              .is_read_only = true,
 12394:                          });
 12395:     IrValueId place = ir_function_add_value(builder->arena, builder->function,
 12396:                                             (IrValue){
 12397:                                                 .canonical_type = array_type,
 12398:                                                 .definition = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID,
 12399:                                                 .category = IR_VALUE_PLACE,
 12400:                                             });
 12401:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
 12402:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_GLOBAL, array_type);
 12403:     instruction.symbol = symbol;
 12404:     instruction.result = place;
 12405:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
 12406:     builder->function->values[place.value].definition = id;
 12407:     if (requested && requested->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
 12408:     {
 12409:         return c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, place, array_type, source);
 12410:     }
 12411:     return place;
 12412: }

 12430: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_function_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token)
 12431: {
 12432:     // The quoted name lives outside the spelling space, so decode it through
 12433:     // a detached one-token view; the original token keeps carrying the
 12434:     // source range.
 12435:     String8 quoted = string_format(builder->arena, S8("\"{S8}\""), builder->function->name);
 12436:     CToken quoted_token = {
 12437:         .length = c_token_length_field(quoted.length),
 12438:         .kind = C_TOKEN_STRING_LITERAL,
 12439:     };
 12440:     CPreprocessResult quoted_preprocess = {
 12441:         .tokens = &quoted_token,
 12442:         .spelling_base = quoted.pointer,
 12443:         .token_count = 1,
 12444:         .dialect = builder->preprocess.dialect,
 12445:     };
 12446:     CIrDecodedString decoded = {0};
 12447:     IrValueId result;
 12448:     if (!c_ir_decode_string_literal_range_for_target(builder->arena, quoted_preprocess, builder->target, 0, 1, &decoded))
 12449:     {
 12450:         result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 12451:     }
 12452:     else
 12453:     {
 12454:         result = c_ir_emit_string_contents_typed(builder, token, decoded, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID);
 12455:     }
 12456: 
 12457:     return result;
 12458: }

 12464: // An empty String8 legitimately carries a null pointer, which buster_hash_64

 12466: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u64 c_ir_function_name_hash(String8 name)

 12471: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrFunctionNameResolution* c_ir_function_name_resolution(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, String8 name)
 12472: {
 12473:     CIrFunctionNameIndex* index = builder->function_names;
 12474:     if (index && index->bucket_count)
 12475:     {
 12476:         u32 bucket = (u32)(c_ir_function_name_hash(name) % index->bucket_count);
 12477:         for (u32 group_index = index->buckets[bucket]; group_index != UINT32_MAX; group_index = index->groups[group_index].next_in_bucket)
 12478:         {
 12479:             CIrFunctionNameResolution* group = index->groups + group_index;
 12480:             if (string_equal(group->name, name))
 12481:             {
 12482:                 return group;
 12483:             }
 12484:         }
 12485:     }
 12486: 
 12487:     return 0;
 12488: }

 12490: // The symbol-keyed form of the lookup above: an interned callee token resolves
 12491: // through one load, an uninterned one through the spelling.
 12492: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrFunctionNameResolution* c_ir_function_name_resolution_symbol(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 symbol, String8 name)
 12493: {
 12494:     CIrFunctionNameIndex* index = builder->function_names;
 12495:     CIrFunctionNameResolution* result;
 12496:     if (index && symbol && symbol < index->symbol_limit)
 12497:     {
 12498:         u32 group_index = index->symbol_groups[symbol];
 12499:         result = group_index != UINT32_MAX ? index->groups + group_index : 0;
 12500:     }
 12501:     else
 12502:     {
 12503:         result = c_ir_function_name_resolution(builder, name);
 12504:     }
 12505: 
 12506:     return result;
 12507: }

 12509: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_build_function_name_index(Arena* arena, CParseResult* parse, CIrFunctionNameIndex* index)
 12510: {
 12511:     if (!arena || !parse || !index)
 12512:     {
 12513:         return false;
 12514:     }
 12515:     u32 capacity = parse->declaration_count ? parse->declaration_count : 1;
 12516:     *index = (CIrFunctionNameIndex){
 12517:         .groups = arena_allocate(arena, CIrFunctionNameResolution, capacity),
 12518:         .candidates = arena_allocate(arena, CIrFunctionNameCandidate, capacity),
 12519:         .buckets = arena_allocate(arena, u32, capacity),
 12520:         .capacity = capacity,
 12521:         .bucket_count = capacity,
 12522:     };
 12523:     for (u32 bucket = 0; bucket < index->bucket_count; bucket += 1)
 12524:     {
 12525:         index->buckets[bucket] = UINT32_MAX;
 12526:     }
 12527:     // Sized to the table as it stands: every declaration name below was
 12528:     // interned by the preprocessor's token pass, so the interning at each
 12529:     // one is an identity hit and never grows the table past this limit.
 12530:     u32 symbol_limit = parse->symbols ? parse->symbols->count : 0;
 12531:     index->symbol_groups = arena_allocate(arena, u32, symbol_limit ? symbol_limit : 1);
 12532:     index->symbol_limit = symbol_limit;
 12533:     for (u32 symbol = 0; symbol < symbol_limit; symbol += 1)
 12534:     {
 12535:         index->symbol_groups[symbol] = UINT32_MAX;
 12536:     }
 12537:     for (u32 declaration_index = 0; declaration_index < parse->declaration_count; declaration_index += 1)
 12538:     {
 12539:         CDeclaration declaration = parse->declarations[declaration_index];
 12540:         if (declaration.kind != C_DECLARATION_FUNCTION)
 12541:         {
 12542:             continue;
 12543:         }
 12544:         u32 bucket = (u32)(c_ir_function_name_hash(declaration.name) % index->bucket_count);
 12545:         u32 group_index = index->buckets[bucket];
 12546:         while (group_index != UINT32_MAX && !string_equal(index->groups[group_index].name, declaration.name))
 12547:         {
 12548:             group_index = index->groups[group_index].next_in_bucket;
 12549:         }
 12550:         if (group_index == UINT32_MAX)
 12551:         {
 12552:             if (index->group_count >= index->capacity)
 12553:             {
 12554:                 return false;
 12555:             }
 12556:             group_index = index->group_count++;
 12557:             index->groups[group_index] = (CIrFunctionNameResolution){
 12558:                 .name = declaration.name,
 12559:                 .declaration_index = declaration_index,
 12560:                 .first_candidate = UINT32_MAX,
 12561:                 .last_candidate = UINT32_MAX,
 12562:                 .next_in_bucket = index->buckets[bucket],
 12563:                 .found = true,
 12564:                 .unique = true,
 12565:             };
 12566:             index->buckets[bucket] = group_index;
 12567:         }
 12568:         CIrFunctionNameResolution* group = index->groups + group_index;
 12569:         u32 name_symbol = c_parse_name_symbol(parse, declaration.name);
 12570:         if (name_symbol && name_symbol < index->symbol_limit)
 12571:         {
 12572:             index->symbol_groups[name_symbol] = group_index;
 12573:         }
 12574:         bool duplicate_entity = false;
 12575:         bool declaration_prototyped =
 12576:             declaration.type.value < parse->type_count && !parse->types[declaration.type.value].is_unprototyped;
 12577:         for (u32 candidate_index = group->first_candidate; candidate_index != UINT32_MAX; candidate_index = index->candidates[candidate_index].next)
 12578:         {
 12579:             u32 candidate_declaration = index->candidates[candidate_index].declaration_index;
 12580:             CDeclaration candidate = parse->declarations[candidate_declaration];
 12581:             if (candidate.entity.value != declaration.entity.value)
 12582:             {
 12583:                 continue;
 12584:             }
 12585:             duplicate_entity = true;
 12586:             // One entity keeps one candidate, and the first declaration is
 12587:             // the one it took.  When that first declaration was the
 12588:             // unprototyped `long __cancel();` and a later one spells the
 12589:             // parameters, the call site needs the spelled signature: the
 12590:             // arity check below reads the candidate's declaration.  Both
 12591:             // declarations share the entity's IrFunction, so moving the
 12592:             // candidate changes which signature is consulted and nothing else.
--- lines 14377-14577 ---
 14377: // storage and must not put an undefined symbol in the object file: DoomGeneric's
 14378: // i_sound.c declares `use_libsamplerate` at the top of I_BindSoundVariables and
 14379: // only binds it under #ifdef FEATURE_SOUND, so in a build without sound the
 14380: // declaration stands alone -- and an undefined symbol emitted for it fails at
 14381: // link or load time against a definition that only the SDL backend has.
 14382: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_body_mentions_name_outside(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, String8 name, u32 declaration_start, u32 declaration_end)
 14383: {
 14384:     u32 body_end = builder->body_token_start + builder->body_token_count;
 14385:     for (u32 index = builder->body_token_start; index < body_end; index += 1)
 14386:     {
 14387:         if (index >= declaration_start && index < declaration_end)
 14388:         {
 14389:             continue;
 14390:         }
 14391:         CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];
 14392:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), name))
 14393:         {
 14394:             return true;
 14395:         }
 14396:     }
 14397:     return false;
 14398: }

 14400: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_lower_compound_literal_frame_push(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type, u32 open, u32 close)
 14401: {
 14402:     return c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
 14403:                                               .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_COMPOUND_LITERAL,
 14404:                                               .as.compound_literal_machine =
 14405:                                                   {
 14406:                                                       .type = type,
 14407:                                                       .open = open,
 14408:                                                       .close = close,
 14409:                                                   },
 14410:                                           });
 14411: }

 14413: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_statement_expression_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
 14414: {
 14415:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 14416:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
 14417:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = &machine->frames[machine->frame_count - 1];
 14418:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_STATEMENT_EXPRESSION);
 14419:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD)
 14420:     {
 14421:         if (!machine->child_result.success)
 14422:         {
 14423:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 14424:             return;
 14425:         }
 14426:         frame->as.statement_expression.value = machine->child_result.value;
 14427:         if (frame->as.statement_expression.tail_index)
 14428:         {
 14429:             frame->as.statement_expression.tail_index -= 1;
 14430:             u32 tail_index = frame->as.statement_expression.tail_index;
 14431:             CDeclaration declaration = {
 14432:                 .name = S8("statement expression"),
 14433:                 .location = c_ir_token_location(builder, builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->as.statement_expression.tail_opens[tail_index]]),
 14434:                 .body_start = frame->as.statement_expression.tail_starts[tail_index],
 14435:                 .body_token_count = frame->as.statement_expression.tail_ends[tail_index] - frame->as.statement_expression.tail_starts[tail_index],
 14436:                 .kind = C_DECLARATION_FUNCTION,
 14437:             };
 14438:             if (!c_ir_lower_body_frame_push(builder, declaration, true))
 14439:             {
 14440:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 14441:             }
 14442:             return;
 14443:         }
 14444:         IrValueId value = frame->as.statement_expression.value;
 14445:         if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 14446:         {
 14447:             value = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->as.statement_expression.leaf_open]);
 14448:         }
 14449:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID, value);
 14450:         return;
 14451:     }
 14452:     u32 open = frame->as.statement_expression.open;
 14453:     u32 close = frame->as.statement_expression.close;
 14454:     if (open >= close || !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[open], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE) ||
 14455:         !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[close], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE))
 14456:     {
 14457:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 14458:         return;
 14459:     }
 14460:     // Empty statement-expression wrappers do not introduce declarations or
 14461:     // control-flow state. Descend through them iteratively so generated GNU C
 14462:     // with deeply nested `({ ({ ... }); })` expressions cannot consume the C
 14463:     // call stack merely to re-enter body lowering.
 14464:     while (open + 4 < close)
 14465:     {
 14466:         u32 nested_start = open + 1;
 14467:         u32 nested_end = close;
 14468:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[nested_end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_SEMICOLON))
 14469:         {
 14470:             nested_end -= 1;
 14471:         }
 14472:         if (nested_start + 3 >= nested_end || !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[nested_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) ||
 14473:             !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[nested_start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE) ||
 14474:             !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[nested_end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) ||
 14475:             c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, nested_start, nested_end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) != nested_end - 1)
 14476:         {
 14477:             break;
 14478:         }
 14479:         u32 nested_close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, nested_start + 1, nested_end - 1, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE);
 14480:         if (nested_close != nested_end - 2)
 14481:         {
 14482:             break;
 14483:         }
 14484:         open = nested_start + 1;
 14485:         close = nested_close;
 14486:     }
 14487:     u32 tail_capacity = (close - open) / 4 + 1;
 14488:     frame->as.statement_expression.tail_starts = arena_allocate(builder->scratch_arena, u32, tail_capacity);
 14489:     frame->as.statement_expression.tail_ends = arena_allocate(builder->scratch_arena, u32, tail_capacity);
 14490:     frame->as.statement_expression.tail_opens = arena_allocate(builder->scratch_arena, u32, tail_capacity);
 14491:     frame->as.statement_expression.tail_count = 0;
 14492:     while (open + 4 < close && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[open + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
 14493:            c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[open + 2], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
 14494:     {
 14495:         u32 nested_close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, open + 2, close, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE);
 14496:         if (nested_close == UINT32_MAX || nested_close + 1 >= close ||
 14497:             !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[nested_close + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) ||
 14498:             c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, open + 1, close, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) != nested_close + 1)
 14499:         {
 14500:             break;
 14501:         }
 14502:         u32 tail_start = nested_close + 2;
 14503:         if (tail_start < close && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[tail_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_SEMICOLON))
 14504:         {
 14505:             tail_start += 1;
 14506:         }
 14507:         if (tail_start >= close)
 14508:         {
 14509:             break;
 14510:         }
 14511:         if (frame->as.statement_expression.tail_count >= tail_capacity)
 14512:         {
 14513:             builder->failure_message = S8("C statement-expression nesting exceeds the lowering frame capacity");
 14514:             builder->failure_token_index = open;
 14515:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 14516:             return;
 14517:         }
 14518:         u32 tail_index = frame->as.statement_expression.tail_count++;
 14519:         frame->as.statement_expression.tail_starts[tail_index] = tail_start;
 14520:         frame->as.statement_expression.tail_ends[tail_index] = close;
 14521:         frame->as.statement_expression.tail_opens[tail_index] = open;
 14522:         open += 2;
 14523:         close = nested_close;
 14524:     }
 14525:     frame->as.statement_expression.tail_index = frame->as.statement_expression.tail_count;
 14526:     frame->as.statement_expression.leaf_open = open;
 14527:     CDeclaration declaration = {
 14528:         .name = S8("statement expression"),
 14529:         .location = c_ir_token_location(builder, builder->preprocess.tokens[open]),
 14530:         .body_start = open + 1,
 14531:         .body_token_count = close - open - 1,
 14532:         .kind = C_DECLARATION_FUNCTION,
 14533:     };
 14534:     frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
 14535:     if (!c_ir_lower_body_frame_push(builder, declaration, true))
 14536:     {
 14537:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 14538:     }
 14539: }

 14552: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constexpr_initializer_valid(IrType* type, IrGlobal* initializer)
 14553: {
 14554:     if (!type || !initializer)
 14555:     {
 14556:         return false;
 14557:     }
 14558:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 14559:     {
 14560:         return initializer->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO;
 14561:     }
 14562:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR || type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION)
 14563:     {
 14564:         return initializer->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_BYTES && initializer->relocation_count == 0;
 14565:     }
 14566:     return initializer->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO || initializer->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_INTEGER ||
 14567:            initializer->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_FLOAT;
 14568: }

 14572:     if (!name.length)
 14573:     {
 14574:         name = S8("<function pointer>");
 14575:     }
 14576:     if (!builder->failure_message.length)
 14577:     {

 14725:                                                      .layout =
 14726:                                                          {
 14727:                                                              .size = builder->program->data_layout.pointer.size,
 14728:                                                              .alignment = builder->program->data_layout.pointer.alignment,
 14729:                                                              .resolved = true,
 14730:                                                          },
 14731:                                                      .kind = IR_TYPE_FUNCTION,
 14732:                                                      .parameter_types = parameter_types,
 14733:                                                      .parameter_count = argument_count,
 14734:                                                      .calling_convention = IR_CALLING_CONVENTION_C,
 14735:                                                      .is_variadic = true,
 14736:                                                  });

 14739: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_call_target(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token, IrFunction* target, CIrSignature signature,
 14740:                                                      IrValueId* arguments, u32 argument_count)
 14741: {
 14742:     if (!target)
 14743:     {
 14744:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 14745:     }
 14746:     if (!c_ir_signature_call_supported(builder, signature, target->name))
 14747:     {
 14748:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 14749:     }
 14750:     if (!c_ir_signature_accepts_arity(signature, argument_count))
 14751:     {
 14752:         if (!builder->failure_message.length)
 14753:         {
 14754:             builder->failure_message = c_ir_call_arity_message(builder, target->name, signature, argument_count);
 14755:         }
 14756:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 14757:     }
 14758:     for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
 14759:     {
 14760:         if (c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, arguments[argument_index]))
 14761:         {
 14762:             builder->failure_message = S8("a label address may not escape through a function call");
 14763:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 14764:         }
 14765:     }
 14766:     // A call that supplies its own parameters carries them on the reference:
 14767:     // the symbol's `()` type describes no call, and the backends read the
 14768:     // argument placement off the type the reference names.
 14769:     IrTypeId callee_type = target->canonical_type;
 14770:     if (signature.is_unprototyped && argument_count > signature.parameter_count)
 14771:     {
 14772:         callee_type = c_ir_unprototyped_call_type(builder, signature.return_type, arguments, argument_count);
 14773:         if (callee_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 14774:         {
 14775:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 14776:         }
 14777:     }
 14778:     IrValueId reference_result = c_ir_add_result(builder, callee_type);
 14779:     IrSourceRange reference_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 14780:     IrInstruction reference = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_FUNCTION, callee_type);
 14781:     reference.symbol = target->symbol;
 14782:     reference.result = reference_result;
 14783:     IrInstructionId reference_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, reference, reference_source);
 14784:     builder->function->values[reference_result.value].definition = reference_id;
 14785: 
 14786:     // The declaration's attribute is the general answer -- glibc marks exit,
 14787:     // abort and longjmp with it -- and the three names remain because a
 14788:     // platform's headers may declare the assertion helpers without one.
 14789:     bool noreturn = signature.is_noreturn || string_equal(target->name, S8("abort")) || string_equal(target->name, S8("__assert_fail")) ||
 14790:                     string_equal(target->name, S8("__assert_perror_fail"));
 14791:     bool terminates = noreturn && !c_ir_lowering_resumes_after_call(builder);
 14792:     // A void call still needs an expression-machine placeholder. Emit it
 14793:     // before a terminating call so UNREACHABLE follows the call immediately;
 14794:     // ordinary and expression-nested calls materialize it afterwards.
 14795:     IrValueId result = signature.returns_void ? (terminates ? c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID)
 14796:                                               : c_ir_add_result(builder, signature.return_type);
 14797:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, argument_count + 1);
 14798:     operands[0] = reference_result;
 14799:     for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
 14800:     {
 14801:         operands[argument_index + 1] = arguments[argument_index];
 14802:     }
 14803:     IrSourceRange call_source = reference_source;
 14804:     IrInstruction call = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CALL, signature.return_type);
 14805:     call.operands = operands;
 14806:     call.operand_count = argument_count + 1;
 14807:     call.symbol = target->symbol;
 14808:     call.result = signature.returns_void ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : result;
 14809:     IrInstructionId call_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, call, call_source);
 14810:     if (!signature.returns_void)
 14811:     {
 14812:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = call_id;
 14813:     }
 14814:     else if (!terminates)
 14815:     {
 14816:         result = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token);
 14817:     }
 14818:     c_ir_end_control_flow_after_call(builder, noreturn, call_source);
 14819:     return result;
 14820: }

 14822: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_call_values(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token, u32 declaration_index, IrValueId* arguments, u32 argument_count)
 14823: {
 14824:     if (declaration_index == UINT32_MAX || !builder->declaration_functions[declaration_index])
 14825:     {
 14826:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 14827:     }
 14828:     return c_ir_emit_call_target(builder, token, builder->declaration_functions[declaration_index], builder->signatures[declaration_index], arguments,
 14829:                                  argument_count);
 14830: }
 14831: 
 14832: // Emit one compiler-runtime call whose ABI is fixed by the compiler rather
 14833: // than by a source declaration. These imports are used only when the target
 14834: // cannot implement an admitted operation inline; the canonical IR still owns
 14835: // the call, its arguments and the external symbol identity.
 14836: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_runtime_call_source(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrSourceRange source, String8 link_name, IrTypeId return_type,
 14837:                                                       IrTypeId* parameter_types, IrValueId* arguments, u32 argument_count,
 14838:                                                       IrValueId* result_out)
 14839: {
 14840:     IrTypeId function_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 14841:     IrSymbolId symbol = IR_SYMBOL_ID_INVALID;
 14842:     bool emitted = true;
 14843:     for (u32 argument_index = 0; emitted && argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
 14844:     {
 14845:         if (arguments[argument_index].value >= builder->function->value_count ||
 14846:             builder->function->values[arguments[argument_index].value].canonical_type.value != parameter_types[argument_index].value)
 14847:         {
 14848:             builder->failure_message = S8("a compiler runtime call argument has an incompatible canonical type");
 14849:             emitted = false;
 14850:         }
 14851:     }
 14852:     for (u32 symbol_index = 0; emitted && symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && symbol_index < builder->program->symbols.count; symbol_index += 1)
 14853:     {
 14854:         IrSymbol* candidate = builder->program->symbols.symbols + symbol_index;
 14855:         if (string_equal(candidate->link_name, link_name))
 14856:         {
 14857:             if (candidate->kind != IR_SYMBOL_FUNCTION)
 14858:             {
 14859:                 builder->failure_message = S8("a compiler runtime symbol conflicts with a non-function declaration");
 14860:                 emitted = false;
 14861:             }
 14862:             else
 14863:             {
 14864:                 symbol = candidate->id;
 14865:                 function_type = candidate->type;
 14866:             }
 14867:         }
 14868:     }
 14869:     if (emitted && symbol.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 14870:     {
 14871:         IrType* existing = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, function_type);
 14872:         bool matches = existing && existing->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION && existing->calling_convention == IR_CALLING_CONVENTION_C &&
 14873:                        !existing->is_variadic && !existing->is_unprototyped && existing->return_type.value == return_type.value &&
 14874:                        existing->parameter_count == argument_count;
 14875:         for (u32 parameter_index = 0; matches && parameter_index < argument_count; parameter_index += 1)
 14876:         {
 14877:             matches = existing->parameter_types[parameter_index].value == parameter_types[parameter_index].value;
 14878:         }
 14879:         if (!matches)
 14880:         {
 14881:             builder->failure_message = S8("a compiler runtime symbol has an incompatible declaration");
 14882:             emitted = false;
 14883:         }
 14884:     }
 14885:     if (emitted && symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 14886:     {
 14887:         IrTypeId* imported_parameters = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrTypeId, argument_count ? argument_count : 1);
 14888:         for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
 14889:         {
 14890:             imported_parameters[argument_index] = parameter_types[argument_index];
 14891:         }
 14892:         function_type = ir_program_add_type(builder->program, (IrType){
 14893:             .name = S8("C compiler runtime function"),
 14894:             .parameter_types = imported_parameters,
 14895:             .element_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
 14896:             .return_type = return_type,
 14897:             .layout = {
 14898:                 .size = builder->program->data_layout.pointer.size,
 14899:                 .alignment = builder->program->data_layout.pointer.alignment,
 14900:                 .resolved = true,
 14901:             },
 14902:             .kind = IR_TYPE_FUNCTION,
 14903:             .calling_convention = IR_CALLING_CONVENTION_C,
 14904:             .parameter_count = argument_count,
 14905:         });
 14906:         symbol = ir_program_add_symbol(builder->program, (IrSymbol){
 14907:             .name = link_name,
 14908:             .link_name = link_name,
 14909:             .source = source,
 14910:             .type = function_type,
 14911:             .kind = IR_SYMBOL_FUNCTION,
 14912:             .linkage = IR_LINKAGE_IMPORT,
 14913:         });
 14914:     }
 14915:     emitted = emitted && symbol.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && function_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 14916:     IrValueId reference_result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 14917:     IrInstructionId reference_id = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID;
 14918:     if (emitted)
 14919:     {
 14920:         reference_result = c_ir_add_result(builder, function_type);
 14921:         IrInstruction reference = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_FUNCTION, function_type);
 14922:         reference.symbol = symbol;
 14923:         reference.result = reference_result;
 14924:         reference_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, reference, source);
 14925:         emitted = reference_result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && reference_id.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 14926:     }
 14927:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 14928:     bool returns_void = false;
 14929:     IrInstructionId call_id = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID;
 14930:     if (emitted)
 14931:     {
 14932:         builder->function->values[reference_result.value].definition = reference_id;
 14933:         IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, argument_count + 1);
 14934:         operands[0] = reference_result;
 14935:         for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
 14936:         {
 14937:             operands[argument_index + 1] = arguments[argument_index];
 14938:         }
 14939:         IrType* returned = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, return_type);
 14940:         returns_void = returned && returned->kind == IR_TYPE_VOID;
 14941:         result = returns_void ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_add_result(builder, return_type);
 14942:         IrInstruction call = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CALL, return_type);
 14943:         call.operands = operands;
 14944:         call.operand_count = argument_count + 1;
 14945:         call.symbol = symbol;
 14946:         call.result = result;
--- lines 15265-15792 ---

 15266:                                                                                   {

 15269:                                                                                       .resolved = true,

 15271:                                                                               .kind = IR_TYPE_FUNCTION,
 15272:                                                                               .calling_convention = IR_CALLING_CONVENTION_C,
 15273:                                                                               .parameter_count = argument_count,
 15274:                                                                           });
 15275:             IrSymbolId symbol = IR_SYMBOL_ID_INVALID;
 15276:             for (u32 symbol_index = 0; symbol_index < builder->program->symbols.count && symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID; symbol_index += 1)
 15277:             {
 15278:                 IrSymbol* candidate = &builder->program->symbols.symbols[symbol_index];
 15279:                 if (candidate->kind == IR_SYMBOL_FUNCTION && string_equal(candidate->link_name, link_name))
 15280:                 {
 15281:                     symbol = candidate->id;
 15282:                     function_type = candidate->type;
 15283:                 }
 15284:             }
 15285:             if (symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15286:             {
 15287:                 symbol = ir_program_add_symbol(builder->program, (IrSymbol){
 15288:                                                                      .name = link_name,
 15289:                                                                      .link_name = link_name,
 15290:                                                                      .source = source,
 15291:                                                                      .type = function_type,
 15292:                                                                      .kind = IR_SYMBOL_FUNCTION,
 15293:                                                                      .linkage = IR_LINKAGE_IMPORT,
 15294:                                                                  });
 15295:             }
 15296:             if (symbol.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && function_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15297:             {
 15298:                 IrValueId reference_result = c_ir_add_result(builder, function_type);
 15299:                 IrInstruction reference = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_FUNCTION, function_type);
 15300:                 reference.symbol = symbol;
 15301:                 reference.result = reference_result;
 15302:                 IrSourceRange reference_source = source;
 15303:                 IrInstructionId reference_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, reference, reference_source);
 15304:                 builder->function->values[reference_result.value].definition = reference_id;
 15305:                 IrValueId call_result = c_ir_add_result(builder, return_type);
 15306:                 IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, argument_count + 1);
 15307:                 operands[0] = reference_result;
 15308:                 for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
 15309:                 {
 15310:                     operands[argument_index + 1] = arguments[argument_index];
 15311:                 }
 15312:                 IrInstruction call = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CALL, return_type);
 15313:                 call.operands = operands;
 15314:                 call.operand_count = argument_count + 1;
 15315:                 call.symbol = symbol;
 15316:                 call.result = call_result;
 15317:                 IrSourceRange call_source = source;
 15318:                 IrInstructionId call_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, call, call_source);
 15319:                 builder->function->values[call_result.value].definition = call_id;
 15320:                 result = call_result;
 15321:             }
 15322:         }
 15323:     }
 15324: 
 15325:     return result;
 15326: }

 15328: // Read the sign in the original format: a floating conversion can quiet a
 15329: // signaling NaN or raise overflow/underflow, neither of which signbit permits.
 15330: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_signbit_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token, IrValueId value)
 15331: {
 15332:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15333:     IrTypeId value_type = value.value < builder->function->value_count ? builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 15334:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
 15335:     if (type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && (type->bit_width == 32 || type->bit_width == 64 || type->bit_width == 80 || type->bit_width == 128))
 15336:     {
 15337:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 15338:         u32 width = type->bit_width;
 15339:         CTypeKind bits_kind = width == 32 ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT : width == 80 ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT : C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG;
 15340:         IrTypeId bits_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, bits_kind);
 15341:         IrValueId slot = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, value_type, source);
 15342:         if (bits_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && slot.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 15343:             c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, slot, value_type, value, source))
 15344:         {
 15345:             IrTypeId bits_pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, bits_type);
 15346:             IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, slot, value_type, source);
 15347:             IrValueId bits_address = address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && bits_pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 15348:                                          ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, bits_pointer_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15349:             IrValueId bits_place = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15350:             if (bits_address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15351:             {
 15352:                 // The supported formats are little-endian. The wide sign field
 15353:                 // starts at byte eight: the x87 sign/exponent or binary128 high limb.
 15354:                 if (width > 64)
 15355:                 {
 15356:                     IrValueId index = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width == 80 ? 4u : 1u, false, token, builder->s32_type);
 15357:                     if (index.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15358:                     {
 15359:                         bits_place = c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, bits_address, index, source);
 15360:                     }
 15361:                 }
 15362:                 else
 15363:                 {
 15364:                     bits_place = c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, bits_address, source);
 15365:                 }
 15366:             }
 15367:             IrValueId bits = bits_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, bits_place, bits_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15368:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width == 32 ? 31u : width == 80 ? 15u : 63u, false, token, bits_type);
 15369:             if (bits.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && shift.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15370:             {
 15371:                 IrValueId sign = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, bits, shift, bits_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
 15372:                 if (sign.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15373:                 {
 15374:                     result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, sign, builder->s32_type, source);
 15375:                 }
 15376:             }
 15377:         }
 15378:     }
 15379:     return result;
 15380: }
 15381: 
 15382: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_math_call(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token, String8 link_name, IrValueId* arguments, u32 argument_count)
 15383: {
 15384:     // `__builtin_huge_val()` is a constant-valued compiler intrinsic.  Keep
 15385:     // it in the math-builtin path so hosted headers can use the spelling
 15386:     // without declaring a runtime symbol, but emit the IEEE positive
 15387:     // infinity directly in canonical IR.
 15388:     if (string_equal(link_name, S8("huge_val")))
 15389:     {
 15390:         if (argument_count != 0)
 15391:         {
 15392:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15393:         }
 15394:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 15395:         return c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, builder->f64_type, UINT64_C(0x7ff0000000000000), source, S8("HUGE_VAL"));
 15396:     }
 15397:     // `__builtin_inff()` is the single-precision counterpart used by the
 15398:     // hosted <math.h> INFINITY macro.  It is a constant-valued intrinsic, so
 15399:     // do not require a runtime `inff` declaration or linker symbol.
 15400:     if (string_equal(link_name, S8("inff")))
 15401:     {
 15402:         if (argument_count != 0)
 15403:         {
 15404:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15405:         }
 15406:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 15407:         return c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, builder->f32_type, UINT64_C(0x7f800000), source, S8("INFF"));
 15408:     }
 15409:     // The builtin NaN constructors are compile-time values.  Do not create
 15410:     // an imported `nan*` symbol: hosted headers use these names before a
 15411:     // runtime library declaration exists, and the quiet IEEE payload is
 15412:     // target-independent for the f32/f64 types represented by canonical IR.
 15413:     if (string_equal(link_name, S8("nanf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("nan")))
 15414:     {
 15415:         if (argument_count != 1)
 15416:         {
 15417:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15418:         }
 15419:         IrTypeId value_type = string_equal(link_name, S8("nanf")) ? builder->f32_type : builder->f64_type;
 15420:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
 15421:         if (!type || type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 15422:         {
 15423:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15424:         }
 15425:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 15426:         return c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, value_type, type->bit_width == 32 ? UINT64_C(0x7fc00000)
 15427:                                                                                        : UINT64_C(0x7ff8000000000000),
 15428:                                             source, S8("NAN"));
 15429:     }
 15430:     if (string_equal(link_name, S8("signbit")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("signbitf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("signbitl")))
 15431:     {
 15432:         return argument_count == 1 ? c_ir_emit_signbit_value(builder, token, arguments[0]) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15433:     }
 15434:     bool isnan_builtin = string_equal(link_name, S8("isnanf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("isnan"));
 15435:     bool isinf_builtin = string_equal(link_name, S8("isinf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("isinff"));
 15436:     bool isinf_sign_builtin = string_equal(link_name, S8("isinf_sign"));
 15437:     bool isfinite_builtin = string_equal(link_name, S8("isfinite"));
 15438:     if (isnan_builtin || isinf_builtin || isinf_sign_builtin || isfinite_builtin)
 15439:     {
 15440:         if (argument_count != 1)
 15441:         {
 15442:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15443:         }
 15444:         if (isfinite_builtin)
 15445:         {
 15446:             // `isfinite` accepts any real scalar and returns an int.  Compare
 15447:             // in binary64 against both signed infinities; NaN is unordered,
 15448:             // so it fails both comparisons as required.  This avoids a libc
 15449:             // dependency and keeps the result identical for Buster/Clang.
 15450:             IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 15451:             IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, arguments[0], builder->f64_type, source);
 15452:             if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15453:             {
 15454:                 return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15455:             }
 15456:             IrValueId positive_infinity = c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, builder->f64_type, UINT64_C(0x7ff0000000000000), source, S8("INF"));
 15457:             IrValueId negative_infinity = c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, builder->f64_type, UINT64_C(0xfff0000000000000), source, S8("-INF"));
 15458:             if (positive_infinity.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || negative_infinity.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15459:             {
 15460:                 return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15461:             }
 15462:             IrValueId below_positive = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, positive_infinity, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS, source);
 15463:             IrValueId above_negative = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, negative_infinity, value, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS, source);
 15464:             if (below_positive.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || above_negative.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15465:             {
 15466:                 return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15467:             }
 15468:             IrValueId finite = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, below_positive, above_negative, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_BOOLEAN_AND, source);
 15469:             return finite.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, finite, builder->s32_type, source);
 15470:         }
 15471:         bool single = string_equal(link_name, S8("isnanf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("isinff"));
 15472:         IrTypeId value_type = single ? builder->f32_type : builder->f64_type;
 15473:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
 15474:         if (!type || type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT || type->bit_width > 64)
 15475:         {
 15476:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15477:         }
 15478:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 15479:         IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, arguments[0], value_type, source);
 15480:         if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15481:         {
 15482:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15483:         }
 15484:         if (isnan_builtin)
 15485:         {
 15486:             IrValueId result = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, value, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL, source);
 15487:             return result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, result, builder->s32_type, source);
 15488:         }
 15489:         u64 positive_bits = type->bit_width == 32 ? UINT64_C(0x7f800000) : UINT64_C(0x7ff0000000000000);
 15490:         u64 negative_bits = type->bit_width == 32 ? UINT64_C(0xff800000) : UINT64_C(0xfff0000000000000);
 15491:         IrValueId positive_infinity = c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, value_type, positive_bits, source, S8("INF"));
 15492:         IrValueId negative_infinity = c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, value_type, negative_bits, source, S8("-INF"));
 15493:         if (positive_infinity.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || negative_infinity.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15494:         {
 15495:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15496:         }
 15497:         IrValueId positive = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, positive_infinity, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_EQUAL, source);
 15498:         IrValueId negative = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, negative_infinity, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_EQUAL, source);
 15499:         if (positive.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || negative.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15500:         {
 15501:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15502:         }
 15503:         if (isinf_builtin)
 15504:         {
 15505:             IrValueId result = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, positive, negative, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_BOOLEAN_OR, source);
 15506:             return result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, result, builder->s32_type, source);
 15507:         }
 15508:         IrValueId positive_s32 = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, positive, builder->s32_type, source);
 15509:         IrValueId negative_s32 = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, negative, builder->s32_type, source);
 15510:         IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, builder->s32_type);
 15511:         if (positive_s32.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || negative_s32.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15512:         {
 15513:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15514:         }
 15515:         IrValueId signed_negative = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, zero, negative_s32, builder->s32_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT, source);
 15516:         return signed_negative.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 15517:                    ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID
 15518:                    : c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, positive_s32, signed_negative, builder->s32_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
 15519:     }
 15520:     u32 expected_count =
 15521:         string_equal(link_name, S8("pow")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("powf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("fmod")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("fmodf"))
 15522:             ? 2
 15523:             : 1;
 15524:     if (argument_count != expected_count)
 15525:     {
 15526:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15527:     }
 15528:     IrTypeId value_type = string_ends_with_sequence(link_name, S8("f")) ? builder->f32_type : builder->f64_type;
 15529:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 15530:     IrTypeId* parameter_types = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrTypeId, argument_count);
 15531:     for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
 15532:     {
 15533:         arguments[argument_index] = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, arguments[argument_index], value_type, source);
 15534:         if (arguments[argument_index].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15535:         {
 15536:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15537:         }
 15538:         parameter_types[argument_index] = value_type;
 15539:     }
 15540:     IrSymbolId symbol = IR_SYMBOL_ID_INVALID;
 15541:     IrTypeId function_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 15542:     for (u32 symbol_index = 0; symbol_index < builder->program->symbols.count; symbol_index += 1)
 15543:     {
 15544:         IrSymbol* candidate = &builder->program->symbols.symbols[symbol_index];
 15545:         if (candidate->kind == IR_SYMBOL_FUNCTION && string_equal(candidate->link_name, link_name))
 15546:         {
 15547:             symbol = candidate->id;
 15548:             function_type = candidate->type;
 15549:             break;
 15550:         }
 15551:     }
 15552:     if (symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15553:     {
 15554:         function_type = ir_program_add_type(builder->program, (IrType){
 15555:                                                                   .name = S8("C math function"),
 15556:                                                                   .parameter_types = parameter_types,
 15557:                                                                   .element_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
 15558:                                                                   .return_type = value_type,
 15559:                                                                       .layout =
 15560:                                                                       {
 15561:                                                                           .size = builder->program->data_layout.pointer.size,
 15562:                                                                           .alignment = builder->program->data_layout.pointer.alignment,
 15563:                                                                           .resolved = true,
 15564:                                                                       },
 15565:                                                                   .kind = IR_TYPE_FUNCTION,
 15566:                                                                   .calling_convention = IR_CALLING_CONVENTION_C,
 15567:                                                                   .parameter_count = argument_count,
 15568:                                                               });
 15569:         symbol = ir_program_add_symbol(builder->program, (IrSymbol){
 15570:                                                              .name = link_name,
 15571:                                                              .link_name = link_name,
 15572:                                                              .source = source,
 15573:                                                              .type = function_type,
 15574:                                                              .kind = IR_SYMBOL_FUNCTION,
 15575:                                                              .linkage = IR_LINKAGE_IMPORT,
 15576:                                                          });
 15577:     }
 15578:     if (symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || function_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15579:     {
 15580:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15581:     }
 15582:     IrValueId reference_result = c_ir_add_result(builder, function_type);
 15583:     IrSourceRange reference_source = source;
 15584:     IrInstruction reference = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_FUNCTION, function_type);
 15585:     reference.symbol = symbol;
 15586:     reference.result = reference_result;
 15587:     IrInstructionId reference_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, reference, reference_source);
 15588:     builder->function->values[reference_result.value].definition = reference_id;
 15589:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, value_type);
 15590:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, argument_count + 1);
 15591:     operands[0] = reference_result;
 15592:     for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
 15593:     {
 15594:         operands[argument_index + 1] = arguments[argument_index];
 15595:     }
 15596:     IrSourceRange call_source = source;
 15597:     IrInstruction call = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CALL, value_type);
 15598:     call.operands = operands;
 15599:     call.operand_count = argument_count + 1;
 15600:     call.symbol = symbol;
 15601:     call.result = result;
 15602:     IrInstructionId call_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, call, call_source);
 15603:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = call_id;
 15604:     return result;
 15605: }
 15606: 
 15607: // --- Complex values -------------------------------------------------------
 15608: //
 15609: // A complex value is an ordinary two-field aggregate by the time it reaches
 15610: // the IR (see c_ir_complex_type). Arithmetic uses scalar float opcodes and
 15611: // constructs its result with the existing immutable AGGREGATE operation.
 15612: // Known constructors expose their scalar operands directly; memory objects
 15613: // and non-constructor values retain explicit field loads. Complex lvalues
 15614: // keep their object identity. There is no separate complex opcode or cleanup
 15615: // pass, and native backends keep the existing aggregate representation.
 15616: //
 15617: // Which arithmetic each operator gets is Clang's, checked against
 15618: // `clang -O0 -S -emit-llvm` for every combination rather than derived:
 15619: //   * `+` and `-` are componentwise, and a real operand touches only the real
 15620: //     half (the imaginary half of the promoted real operand is a positive
 15621: //     zero, and Clang carries the other operand's imaginary part through
 15622: //     unchanged rather than adding it).
 15623: //   * `*` and `/` with a real operand scale or divide both halves.
 15624: //   * `*` and `/` with two complex operands call the compiler runtime --
 15625: //     __mulsc3/__muldc3/__multc3 and __divsc3/__divdc3/__divtc3 -- which is
 15626: //     what Clang emits without -ffast-math or -fcx-limited-range. Those
 15627: //     helpers implement the overflow- and NaN-recovering forms from C11
 15628: //     Annex G, and calling them rather than inlining Smith's algorithm is the
 15629: //     choice made here: it is bit-for-bit what a Clang-built object does, and
 15630: //     the alternative would be a second, subtly different implementation of
 15631: //     the same numerics living in this file.
 15632: //   * `real / complex` also goes to the runtime, with the numerator's
 15633: //     imaginary part passed as a positive zero, again matching Clang.
 15634: //   * `==` and `!=` compare both halves.
 15635: //
 15636: // System V x86-64 returns a `long double _Complex` in ST(0)/ST(1) (the psABI's
 15637: // COMPLEX_X87 class) where the equivalent struct is returned in memory. That
 15638: // is the one place the aggregate model is not the ABI, and it is the only
 15639: // thing the backends had to learn about complex: the classifier gives that
 15640: // result four X87/X87_UP eightbyte parts, the canonical x86-64 emitter pushes
 15641: // the imaginary half and then the real one before its RET and pops them in
 15642: // that order after a call, and every other position -- the argument, the
 15643: // loads, the stores, the copies -- is the two-field aggregate unchanged.
 15644: 
 15645: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_float16_negate(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId type_id, IrSourceRange source)
 15646: {
 15647:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15648:     IrTypeId bits_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT);
 15649:     IrValueId slot = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, type_id, source);
 15650:     if (c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, type_id) && bits_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 15651:         slot.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, slot, type_id, value, source))
 15652:     {
 15653:         IrTypeId bits_pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, bits_type);
 15654:         IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, slot, type_id, source);
 15655:         IrValueId bits_address = address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && bits_pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 15656:                                      ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, bits_pointer_type, source)
 15657:                                      : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15658:         IrValueId bits_place = bits_address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, bits_address, source)
 15659:                                                                               : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15660:         IrValueId bits = bits_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, bits_place, bits_type, source)
 15661:                                                                       : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15662:         IrValueId sign_mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x8000), false, (CToken){0}, bits_type);
 15663:         IrValueId flipped = bits.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && sign_mask.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 15664:                                 ? c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, bits, sign_mask, bits_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_XOR, source)
 15665:                                 : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15666:         if (flipped.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, bits_place, bits_type, flipped, source))
 15667:         {
 15668:             result = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, slot, type_id, source);
 15669:         }
 15670:     }
 15671:     return result;
 15672: }
 15673: 
 15674: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_unary_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId operand, IrTypeId type, IrUnaryOperation operation,
 15675:                                                     IrSourceRange source)
 15676: {
 15677:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15678:     if (operand.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 15679:         operation == IR_UNARY_FLOAT_NEGATE && c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, type))
 15680:     {
 15681:         result = c_ir_emit_float16_negate(builder, operand, type, source);
 15682:     }
 15683:     else if (operand.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15684:     {
 15685:         result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
 15686:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_UNARY, type);
 15687:         instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
 15688:         instruction.operands[0] = operand;
 15689:         instruction.operand_count = 1;
 15690:         instruction.unary_operation = (u8)operation;
 15691:         instruction.result = result;
 15692:         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
 15693:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
 15694:     }
 15695:     return result;
 15696: }
 15697: 
 15698: // GNU's `__real__`/`__imag__` and their unsuffixed spellings, as the unary
 15699: // operator each names. The expression walker asks this of every identifier it
 15700: // meets where an operand is expected, so the length test carries the common
 15701: // answer before any comparison runs.
 15702: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_complex_part_operator(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token, CConditionalOperator* operation)
 15703: {
 15704:     if (token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 15705:     {
 15706:         return false;
 15707:     }
 15708:     String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token);
 15709:     if (spelling.length != 6 && spelling.length != 8)
 15710:     {
 15711:         return false;
 15712:     }
 15713:     if (string_equal(spelling, S8("__real__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__real")))
 15714:     {
 15715:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_REAL_PART;
 15716:         return true;
 15717:     }
 15718:     if (string_equal(spelling, S8("__imag__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__imag")))
 15719:     {
 15720:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_IMAGINARY_PART;
 15721:         return true;
 15722:     }
 15723:     return false;
 15724: }
 15725: 
 15726: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrType* c_ir_complex_type_of(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type_id)
 15727: {
 15728:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
 15729:     return type && type->is_complex ? type : 0;
 15730: }
 15731: 
 15732: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrType* c_ir_value_complex_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value)
 15733: {
 15734:     if (value.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 15735:     {
 15736:         return 0;
 15737:     }
 15738:     return c_ir_complex_type_of(builder, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type);
 15739: }
 15740: 
 15741: // The complex type whose halves are `element`, or invalid when `element` is
 15742: // not one of the three real floating types a complex type can be built over.
 15743: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_complex_type_for_element(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId element)
 15744: {
 15745:     CTypeKind kind = element.value == builder->f32_type.value            ? C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX
 15746:                      : element.value == builder->f64_type.value          ? C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX
 15747:                      : element.value == builder->long_double_type.value  ? C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX
 15748:                                                                          : C_TYPE_INVALID;
 15749:     return kind == C_TYPE_INVALID ? IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, kind);
 15750: }
 15751: 
 15752: // A field whose index is already known. Complex halves and anonymous aggregate
 15753: // members have no C name to turn into a source token or look up again.
 15754: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_field_index_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, u32 field_index, IrSourceRange source)
 15755: {
 15756:     IrValueId next = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15757:     if (place.value < builder->function->value_count)
 15758:     {
 15759:         IrTypeId owner_type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
 15760:         IrType* owner = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, owner_type);
 15761:         if (owner && field_index < owner->field_count)
 15762:         {
 15763:             IrTypeId field_type = owner->fields[field_index].type;
 15764:             IrType* field_value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, field_type);
 15765:             next = ir_function_add_value(
 15766:                 builder->arena, builder->function,
 15767:                 (IrValue){
 15768:                     .canonical_type = field_type,
 15769:                     .definition = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID,
 15770:                     .category = IR_VALUE_PLACE,
 15771:                     .is_read_only = builder->function->values[place.value].is_read_only,
 15772:                     .is_volatile = builder->function->values[place.value].is_volatile || (field_value_type && field_value_type->is_volatile),
 15773:                 });
 15774:             IrInstruction field = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_FIELD, field_type);
 15775:             field.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
 15776:             field.operands[0] = place;
 15777:             field.operand_count = 1;
 15778:             field.immediates = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, 1);
 15779:             field.immediates[0] = field_index;
 15780:             field.immediate_count = 1;
 15781:             field.result = next;
 15782:             IrInstructionId field_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, field, source);
 15783:             builder->function->values[next.value].definition = field_id;
 15784:         }
 15785:     }
 15786:     return next;
 15787: }
 15788: 
 15789: // An addressable place holding `value`. An aggregate lvalue is already one, a
 15790: // value that a load produced can reuse the place that load read (the same
 15791: // recovery c_ir_emit_field_place_from_value performs for `x.member`), and
 15792: // anything else -- a call result, a freshly composed value -- is spilled.
--- lines 15907-16317 ---
 15907:         if (real.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && imaginary.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15908:         {
 15909:             // Complex construction is the same immutable aggregate operation
 15910:             // as a struct initializer. Do not introduce a mutable LOCAL plus
 15911:             // two FIELD/STORE pairs and then LOAD it back into a value.
 15912:             result = c_ir_add_result(builder, complex_type);
 15913:             IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_AGGREGATE, complex_type);
 15914:             instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 2);
 15915:             instruction.operands[0] = real;
 15916:             instruction.operands[1] = imaginary;
 15917:             instruction.operand_count = 2;
 15918:             instruction.immediates = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, 2);
 15919:             instruction.immediates[0] = 0;
 15920:             instruction.immediates[1] = 1;
 15921:             instruction.immediate_count = 2;
 15922:             instruction.result = result;
 15923:             IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
 15924:             builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
 15925:         }
 15926:     }
 15927:     return result;
 15928: }
 15929: 
 15930: // Whether a complex value of this type can be computed with here.  Every
 15931: // float element this frontend has is admitted; the 80-bit x87 one reaches the
 15932: // magnitude below through its sign/exponent halfword rather than through a
 15933: // whole-value integer, which is the same view musl's `union ldshape` takes.
 15934: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_complex_element_supported(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType* complex_type)
 15935: {
 15936:     IrType* element = complex_type ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, complex_type->element_type) : 0;
 15937:     return element && element->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && (element->bit_width == 32 || element->bit_width == 64 || element->bit_width == 80);
 15938: }
 15939: 
 15940: // |x|, branchless: clear the sign bit through the same stack-slot punning the
 15941: // signbit builtin uses, because there is no absolute-value opcode and calling
 15942: // libm would make complex division depend on a library.
 15943: //
 15944: // The 80-bit x87 spelling has no integer of its own width, so it is punned
 15945: // one halfword at a time: the sign bit is bit 15 of the sixteen-bit
 15946: // sign/exponent field at byte eight, which is exactly the `se` member of
 15947: // musl's `union ldshape`, and the ten-byte significand below it is left
 15948: // alone.
 15949: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_float_magnitude(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId type_id, IrSourceRange source)
 15950: {
 15951:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
 15952:     if (!type || type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT || (type->bit_width != 32 && type->bit_width != 64 && type->bit_width != 80))
 15953:     {
 15954:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15955:     }
 15956:     u32 bit_width = type->bit_width;
 15957:     CTypeKind bits_kind = bit_width == 32 ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT : bit_width == 64 ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG : C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT;
 15958:     IrTypeId bits_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, bits_kind);
 15959:     IrValueId slot = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, type_id, source);
 15960:     if (bits_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || slot.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
 15961:         !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, slot, type_id, value, source))
 15962:     {
 15963:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15964:     }
 15965:     IrTypeId bits_pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, bits_type);
 15966:     IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, slot, type_id, source);
 15967:     IrValueId bits_address = address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && bits_pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 15968:                                  ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, bits_pointer_type, source)
 15969:                                  : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15970:     IrValueId bits_place = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15971:     if (bits_address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15972:     {
 15973:         if (bit_width == 80)
 15974:         {
 15975:             // The fifth halfword of the sixteen-byte slot: byte eight, where
 15976:             // the x87 format keeps the sign and the exponent.
 15977:             IrValueId halfword_index = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 4, false, (CToken){0}, builder->s32_type);
 15978:             bits_place = halfword_index.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, bits_address, halfword_index, source)
 15979:                                                                          : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15980:         }
 15981:         else
 15982:         {
 15983:             bits_place = c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, bits_address, source);
 15984:         }
 15985:     }
 15986:     IrValueId bits = bits_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, bits_place, bits_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15987:     IrValueId mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder,
 15988:                                                    bit_width == 32   ? UINT64_C(0x7fffffff)
 15989:                                                    : bit_width == 64 ? UINT64_C(0x7fffffffffffffff)
 15990:                                                                      : UINT64_C(0x7fff),
 15991:                                                    false, (CToken){0}, bits_type);
 15992:     if (bits.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || mask.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 15993:     {
 15994:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 15995:     }
 15996:     IrValueId cleared = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, bits, mask, bits_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
 15997:     if (cleared.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, bits_place, bits_type, cleared, source))
 15998:     {
 15999:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16000:     }
 16001:     return c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, slot, type_id, source);
 16002: }
 16003: 
 16004: // One arm of Smith's algorithm, with `dominant` the denominator half of
 16005: // larger magnitude and `lesser` the other one. The obvious names for that pair
 16006: // are the two the Windows SDK still defines as empty segment-model macros, so
 16007: // a parameter called either of them vanishes and the definition stops being
