 16008: // one; these two are deliberately not those.
 16009: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_complex_smith_arm(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId complex_type, IrTypeId element, IrValueId result_place,
 16010:                                                      IrValueId a, IrValueId b, IrValueId dominant, IrValueId lesser, bool dominant_is_real, IrSourceRange source)
 16011: {
 16012:     IrValueId ratio = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, lesser, dominant, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_DIVIDE, source);
 16013:     IrValueId scaled = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, ratio, lesser, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_MULTIPLY, source);
 16014:     IrValueId denominator = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, dominant, scaled, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_ADD, source);
 16015:     IrValueId real_numerator;
 16016:     IrValueId imaginary_numerator;
 16017:     if (dominant_is_real)
 16018:     {
 16019:         // |c| >= |d|: r = d/c, den = c + r*d, (a + b*r)/den and (b - a*r)/den.
 16020:         IrValueId b_ratio = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, b, ratio, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_MULTIPLY, source);
 16021:         IrValueId a_ratio = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, a, ratio, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_MULTIPLY, source);
 16022:         real_numerator = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, a, b_ratio, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_ADD, source);
 16023:         imaginary_numerator = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, b, a_ratio, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_SUBTRACT, source);
 16024:     }
 16025:     else
 16026:     {
 16027:         // |d| > |c|: r = c/d, den = d + r*c, (a*r + b)/den and (b*r - a)/den.
 16028:         IrValueId a_ratio = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, a, ratio, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_MULTIPLY, source);
 16029:         IrValueId b_ratio = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, b, ratio, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_MULTIPLY, source);
 16030:         real_numerator = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, a_ratio, b, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_ADD, source);
 16031:         imaginary_numerator = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, b_ratio, a, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_SUBTRACT, source);
 16032:     }
 16033:     IrValueId real = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, real_numerator, denominator, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_DIVIDE, source);
 16034:     IrValueId imaginary = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, imaginary_numerator, denominator, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_DIVIDE, source);
 16035:     IrValueId real_place = c_ir_emit_field_index_place(builder, result_place, 0, source);
 16036:     IrValueId imaginary_place = c_ir_emit_field_index_place(builder, result_place, 1, source);
 16037:     BUSTER_UNUSED(complex_type);
 16038:     return real.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && imaginary.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 16039:            real_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && imaginary_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 16040:            c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, real_place, element, real, source) &&
 16041:            c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, imaginary_place, element, imaginary, source);
 16042: }
 16043: 
 16044: // (a + bi) / (c + di) by Smith's algorithm, which is what Clang emits inline
 16045: // for `-fcomplex-arithmetic=improved`: divide through by whichever denominator
 16046: // half has the larger magnitude so the intermediate `c*c + d*d` of the naive
 16047: // form -- which overflows for operands whose squares do not fit -- never
 16048: // appears.
 16049: //
 16050: // Clang's default for C is neither this nor the naive form: it calls
 16051: // __divdc3 (and __muldc3 for the product), the compiler-runtime helpers that
 16052: // add C11 Annex G's infinity recovery, and for division an ilogb rescaling,
 16053: // on top of the same arithmetic. Those helpers live in libgcc or compiler-rt,
 16054: // and this toolchain ships neither and links neither, so calling them would
 16055: // turn every complex multiply into an unresolved symbol at link time.
 16056: //
 16057: // The inline forms below were differenced against Clang over an operand
 16058: // matrix covering the signed zeroes, the subnormal and overflow edges and the
 16059: // infinities. Against `-fcomplex-arithmetic=improved` every answer in that
 16060: // matrix is bit-identical, on System V x86-64, AAPCS64 and Win64 alike.
 16061: // Against the default they part company in two places, both inside the
 16062: // library helpers: Annex G's recovery, where the helper turns a NaN into a
 16063: // signed infinity, and a quotient whose operands straddle the format's
 16064: // exponent range, where the helper's rescaling rounds one unit in the last
 16065: // place differently.
 16066: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_complex_divide(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId complex_type, IrTypeId element, IrValueId a, IrValueId b,
 16067:                                                        IrValueId c, IrValueId d, IrSourceRange source)
 16068: {
 16069:     IrValueId result_place = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, complex_type, source);
 16070:     IrValueId magnitude_c = c_ir_emit_float_magnitude(builder, c, element, source);
 16071:     IrValueId magnitude_d = c_ir_emit_float_magnitude(builder, d, element, source);
 16072:     if (result_place.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || magnitude_c.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
 16073:         magnitude_d.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 16074:     {
 16075:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16076:     }
 16077:     IrValueId condition = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, magnitude_c, magnitude_d, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL, source);
 16078:     IrBlockId near_real = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 16079:     IrBlockId near_imaginary = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 16080:     IrBlockId merge = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 16081:     if (condition.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || near_real.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
 16082:         near_imaginary.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || merge.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 16083:     {
 16084:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16085:     }
 16086:     IrBlockId targets[2] = {near_real, near_imaginary};
 16087:     if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &condition, 1, targets, 2, source))
 16088:     {
 16089:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16090:     }
 16091:     IrBlockId merge_target[1] = {merge};
 16092:     if (!c_ir_switch_block(builder, near_real) ||
 16093:         !c_ir_emit_complex_smith_arm(builder, complex_type, element, result_place, a, b, c, d, true, source) ||
 16094:         !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, merge_target, 1, source))
 16095:     {
 16096:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16097:     }
 16098:     if (!c_ir_switch_block(builder, near_imaginary) ||
 16099:         !c_ir_emit_complex_smith_arm(builder, complex_type, element, result_place, a, b, d, c, false, source) ||
 16100:         !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, merge_target, 1, source))
 16101:     {
 16102:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16103:     }
 16104:     if (!c_ir_switch_block(builder, merge))
 16105:     {
 16106:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16107:     }
 16108:     return c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, result_place, complex_type, source);
 16109: }
 16110: 
 16111: // Complex <-> real and complex <-> complex conversions (C11 6.3.1.6-7): the
 16112: // halves convert independently, a real value gains a positive-zero imaginary
 16113: // part, and a complex value converted to a real type keeps its real half.
 16114: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_complex_conversion(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId target_type, IrSourceRange source)
 16115: {
 16116:     IrType* source_complex = c_ir_value_complex_type(builder, value);
 16117:     IrType* target_complex = c_ir_complex_type_of(builder, target_type);
 16118:     if (source_complex)
 16119:     {
 16120:         IrValueId real = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16121:         IrValueId imaginary = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16122:         if (!c_ir_complex_split(builder, value, &real, &imaginary, source))
 16123:         {
 16124:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16125:         }
 16126:         if (!target_complex)
 16127:         {
 16128:             return c_ir_emit_cast(builder, real, target_type, source);
 16129:         }
 16130:         IrTypeId target_element = target_complex->element_type;
 16131:         real = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, real, target_element, source);
 16132:         imaginary = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, imaginary, target_element, source);
 16133:         return c_ir_complex_compose(builder, target_type, real, imaginary, source);
 16134:     }
 16135:     if (!target_complex)
 16136:     {
 16137:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16138:     }
 16139:     IrTypeId target_element = target_complex->element_type;
 16140:     IrValueId real = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, target_element, source);
 16141:     IrValueId imaginary = c_ir_complex_zero(builder, target_element, source);
 16142:     return c_ir_complex_compose(builder, target_type, real, imaginary, source);
 16143: }
 16144: 
 16145: // The result type of an arithmetic operation with at least one complex
 16146: // operand: complex, over the usual arithmetic type of the two corresponding
 16147: // real types (C11 6.3.1.8p1).
 16148: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_complex_result_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId left_type, IrTypeId right_type)
 16149: {
 16150:     IrType* left = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left_type);
 16151:     IrType* right = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right_type);
 16152:     if (!left || !right || (!left->is_complex && !right->is_complex))
 16153:     {
 16154:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 16155:     }
 16156:     IrTypeId left_real = left->is_complex ? left->element_type : left_type;
 16157:     IrTypeId right_real = right->is_complex ? right->element_type : right_type;
 16158:     IrTypeId element = c_ir_usual_arithmetic_type(builder, left_real, right_real);
 16159:     return c_ir_complex_type_for_element(builder, element);
 16160: }
 16161: 
 16162: // `__real__ E` and `__imag__ E` as values. GNU allows either on a real
 16163: // operand too: `__real__ x` is `x` and `__imag__ x` is a positive zero of
 16164: // x's type, which is what Clang emits, and it is what makes the operators
 16165: // usable in code that is generic over real and complex.
 16166: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_complex_part_operator(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, bool imaginary, IrSourceRange source)
 16167: {
 16168:     IrType* complex_type = c_ir_value_complex_type(builder, value);
 16169:     if (!complex_type)
 16170:     {
 16171:         if (value.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 16172:         {
 16173:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16174:         }
 16175:         IrTypeId type_id = builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type;
 16176:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
 16177:         if (!type || (type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT && type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->kind != IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN))
 16178:         {
 16179:             builder->failure_message = S8("__real__ and __imag__ require an arithmetic operand");
 16180:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16181:         }
 16182:         if (!imaginary)
 16183:         {
 16184:             return value;
 16185:         }
 16186:         return type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT ? c_ir_complex_zero(builder, type_id, source)
 16187:                                            : c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0}, type_id);
 16188:     }
 16189:     IrTypeId element = complex_type->element_type;
 16190:     IrValueId place = c_ir_complex_operand_place(builder, value, source);
 16191:     if (place.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 16192:     {
 16193:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16194:     }
 16195:     return c_ir_complex_part(builder, place, element, imaginary ? 1u : 0u, source);
 16196: }
 16197: 
 16198: // `+ - * /`, unary `-`, GNU unary `~` (conjugation) and `== !=` where at
 16199: // least one operand is complex. Everything else -- the remaining bitwise and
 16200: // the relational operators, `%` -- has no complex form in C and is refused
 16201: // here rather than silently applied to the real half.
 16202: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_apply_complex_operation(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CConditionalOperator operation, IrValueId* values, u32* value_count,
 16203:                                                       u32 first, u32 operand_count, IrSourceRange source)
 16204: {
 16205:     IrTypeId left_type = builder->function->values[values[first].value].canonical_type;
 16206:     IrTypeId right_type = operand_count == 2 ? builder->function->values[values[first + 1].value].canonical_type : left_type;
 16207:     IrTypeId result_type = c_ir_complex_result_type(builder, left_type, right_type);
 16208:     IrType* result_complex = c_ir_complex_type_of(builder, result_type);
 16209:     if (!result_complex)
 16210:     {
 16211:         builder->failure_message = S8("unsupported complex operand type");
 16212:         return false;
 16213:     }
 16214:     IrTypeId element = result_complex->element_type;
 16215:     bool left_complex = c_ir_complex_type_of(builder, left_type) != 0;
 16216:     bool right_complex = operand_count == 2 && c_ir_complex_type_of(builder, right_type) != 0;
 16217:     IrValueId real = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16218:     IrValueId imaginary = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16219:     if (operand_count == 1)
 16220:     {
 16221:         // GNU spells complex conjugation `~` -- C99 Annex G's `conj` -- so the
 16222:         // one bitwise operator that has no complex form on a real operand does
 16223:         // have one here. It negates the imaginary half alone; unary `-`
 16224:         // negates both.
 16225:         if (operation != C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS && operation != C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT)
 16226:         {
 16227:             builder->failure_message = S8("this unary operator has no complex form");
 16228:             return false;
 16229:         }
 16230:         IrValueId converted = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, values[first], result_type, source);
 16231:         if (converted.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_complex_split(builder, converted, &real, &imaginary, source))
 16232:         {
 16233:             return false;
 16234:         }
 16235:         real = operation == C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS ? c_ir_emit_unary_value(builder, real, element, IR_UNARY_FLOAT_NEGATE, source) : real;
 16236:         imaginary = c_ir_emit_unary_value(builder, imaginary, element, IR_UNARY_FLOAT_NEGATE, source);
 16237:         IrValueId negated = c_ir_complex_compose(builder, result_type, real, imaginary, source);
 16238:         if (negated.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 16239:         {
 16240:             return false;
 16241:         }
 16242:         *value_count = first;
 16243:         values[(*value_count)++] = negated;
 16244:         return true;
 16245:     }
 16246:     // Both operands are read before anything is emitted for the operation, so
 16247:     // the two splits below cannot interleave with each other's field loads.
 16248:     IrValueId left_real = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16249:     IrValueId left_imaginary = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16250:     IrValueId right_real = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16251:     IrValueId right_imaginary = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16252:     if (left_complex)
 16253:     {
 16254:         IrValueId converted = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, values[first], result_type, source);
 16255:         if (converted.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_complex_split(builder, converted, &left_real, &left_imaginary, source))
 16256:         {
 16257:             return false;
 16258:         }
 16259:     }
 16260:     else
 16261:     {
 16262:         left_real = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, values[first], element, source);
 16263:     }
 16264:     if (right_complex)
 16265:     {
 16266:         IrValueId converted = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, values[first + 1], result_type, source);
 16267:         if (converted.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_complex_split(builder, converted, &right_real, &right_imaginary, source))
 16268:         {
 16269:             return false;
 16270:         }
 16271:     }
 16272:     else
 16273:     {
 16274:         right_real = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, values[first + 1], element, source);
 16275:     }
 16276:     if (left_real.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || right_real.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 16277:     {
 16278:         return false;
 16279:     }
 16280:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 16281:     switch (operation)
 16282:     {
 16283:     case C_CONDITIONAL_ADD:
 16284:     {
 16285:         real = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, left_real, right_real, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_ADD, source);
 16286:         imaginary = left_complex && right_complex
 16287:                         ? c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, left_imaginary, right_imaginary, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_ADD, source)
 16288:                         : (left_complex ? left_imaginary : right_imaginary);
 16289:         result = c_ir_complex_compose(builder, result_type, real, imaginary, source);
 16290:         break;
 16291:     }
 16292:     case C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT:
 16293:     {
 16294:         real = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, left_real, right_real, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_SUBTRACT, source);
 16295:         if (left_complex && right_complex)
 16296:         {
 16297:             imaginary = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, left_imaginary, right_imaginary, element, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_SUBTRACT, source);
 16298:         }
 16299:         else if (left_complex)
 16300:         {
 16301:             imaginary = left_imaginary;
 16302:         }
 16303:         else
 16304:         {
 16305:             imaginary = c_ir_emit_unary_value(builder, right_imaginary, element, IR_UNARY_FLOAT_NEGATE, source);
 16306:         }
 16307:         result = c_ir_complex_compose(builder, result_type, real, imaginary, source);
 16308:         break;
 16309:     }
 16310:     case C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY:
 16311:     case C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE:
 16312:     {
 16313:         bool divide = operation == C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE;
 16314:         if (left_complex && !right_complex)
 16315:         {
 16316:             // A complex scaled or divided by a real is componentwise; only a
 16317:             // complex denominator needs the recovering algorithm.
--- lines 18120-18955 ---
 18120:     u32* emission_order = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, u32, remaining ? remaining : 1);
 18121:     u32 task_count = 0;
 18122:     u32 emission_count = 0;
 18123:     for (u32 root = last_root; root != UINT32_MAX; root = builder->prepared_calls[root].previous_sibling_index)
 18124:     {
 18125:         tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
 18126:             .call_index = root,
 18127:         };
 18128:     }
 18129:     while (task_count)
 18130:     {
 18131:         CIrCallEmissionTask task = tasks[--task_count];
 18132:         CIrPreparedCall* call = builder->prepared_calls + task.call_index;
 18133:         if (task.finish)
 18134:         {
 18135:             emission_order[emission_count++] = task.call_index;
 18136:             continue;
 18137:         }
 18138:         tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
 18139:             .call_index = task.call_index,
 18140:             .finish = true,
 18141:         };
 18142:         for (u32 child = call->last_child_index; child != UINT32_MAX; child = builder->prepared_calls[child].previous_sibling_index)
 18143:         {
 18144:             tasks[task_count++] = (CIrCallEmissionTask){
 18145:                 .call_index = child,
 18146:             };
 18147:         }
 18148:     }
 18149:     BUSTER_CHECK(emission_count == remaining);
 18150:     *emission_order_out = emission_order;
 18151:     *emission_count_out = emission_count;
 18152:     return true;
 18153: }
 18154: 
 18155: // The one vector type the 512-bit vocabulary speaks in: 64 bytes of u8. Every
 18156: // builtin that returns a vector returns this, and `Simd512` in
 18157: // <buster/lib/simd.h> is declared to match, so no conversion ever appears at a
 18158: // call site. The layout matches what the `vector_size` attribute produces for
 18159: // the same spelling, so the two are the same IR type and not two that happen to
 18160: // agree.
 18161: // __builtin_popcount is one instruction where the target has POPCNT and the
 18162: // classic SWAR sequence where it does not, decided here rather than in the
 18163: // backends: an IR expansion is the same handful of ordinary instructions every
 18164: // backend already emits, and it keeps AArch64 from needing a NEON round trip
 18165: // for a scalar operation the compiler itself barely uses.
 18166: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_population_count(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId operand, IrTypeId type, CToken token, IrSourceRange source)
 18167: {
 18168:     IrType* integer = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
 18169:     if (!integer || integer->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
 18170:     {
 18171:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18172:     }
 18173:     if (target_cpu_feature_has(builder->target, TARGET_CPU_FEATURE_X86_POPCNT))
 18174:     {
 18175:         IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
 18176:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_UNARY, type);
 18177:         instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
 18178:         instruction.operands[0] = operand;
 18179:         instruction.operand_count = 1;
 18180:         instruction.unary_operation = IR_UNARY_INTEGER_POPULATION_COUNT;
 18181:         instruction.result = result;
 18182:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
 18183:         return result;
 18184:     }
 18185:     // The classic SWAR sequence: subtract the odd bits to make two-bit sums,
 18186:     // add the pairs into four-bit sums, fold to bytes, then let one multiply
 18187:     // gather every byte sum into the top byte.
 18188:     u32 width = integer->bit_width;
 18189:     u64 mask = width >= 64 ? UINT64_MAX : (((u64)1 << width) - 1);
 18190:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, type);
 18191:     IrValueId odd_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x5555555555555555) & mask, false, token, type);
 18192:     IrValueId shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, one, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
 18193:     IrValueId high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, odd_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
 18194:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, operand, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT, source);
 18195:     IrValueId two = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 2, false, token, type);
 18196:     IrValueId pair_bits = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x3333333333333333) & mask, false, token, type);
 18197:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, two, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
 18198:     high = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, shifted, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
 18199:     IrValueId low = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, pair_bits, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
 18200:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, low, high, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
 18201:     IrValueId four = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 4, false, token, type);
 18202:     IrValueId nibble_mask = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f) & mask, false, token, type);
 18203:     shifted = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, four, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
 18204:     IrValueId summed = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, shifted, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
 18205:     value = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, summed, nibble_mask, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
 18206:     IrValueId ones = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, UINT64_C(0x0101010101010101) & mask, false, token, type);
 18207:     IrValueId gathered = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, ones, type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
 18208:     IrValueId top = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width - 8, false, token, type);
 18209:     return c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, gathered, top, type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
 18210: }
 18211: 
 18212: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_simd_vector_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
 18213: {
 18214:     IrTypeId element = builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR];
 18215:     IrType* element_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element);
 18216:     if (!element_type || element_type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER || element_type->bit_width != 8)
 18217:     {
 18218:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18219:     }
 18220:     for (u32 type_index = 0; type_index < builder->program->types.count; type_index += 1)
 18221:     {
 18222:         IrType* candidate = builder->program->types.types + type_index;
 18223:         if (candidate->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && candidate->element_type.value == element.value && candidate->element_count == 64 &&
 18224:             candidate->layout.size == 64)
 18225:         {
 18226:             return candidate->id;
 18227:         }
 18228:     }
 18229:     return ir_program_add_type(builder->program, (IrType){
 18230:                                                      .name = S8("GNU vector"),
 18231:                                                      .element_type = element,
 18232:                                                      .return_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
 18233:                                                      .layout =
 18234:                                                          {
 18235:                                                              .size = 64,
 18236:                                                              .alignment = 64,
 18237:                                                              .resolved = true,
 18238:                                                          },
 18239:                                                      .kind = IR_TYPE_VECTOR,
 18240:                                                      .element_count = 64,
 18241:                                                      .bit_width = 512,
 18242:                                                  });
 18243: }
 18244: 
 18245: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_simd_result_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrSimdOperation operation)
 18246: {
 18247:     IrSimdShape shape = ir_simd_operation_shape(operation);
 18248:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18249:     if (shape.semantic_class == IR_VECTOR_SEMANTICS_EXACT_X86_512)
 18250:     {
 18251:         result = !shape.has_result ? builder->void_type : shape.predicate_result ? builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG] :
 18252:                  c_ir_simd_vector_type(builder);
 18253:     }
 18254:     return result;
 18255: }
 18256: 
 18257: // Arguments get exactly the conversions C would already have applied at a call
 18258: // with this prototype: arrays decay, integers convert. A vector argument is
 18259: // checked and never converted — a silent lane reinterpretation is the one
 18260: // thing an explicit SIMD kernel must not get.
 18261: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_simd_coerce_argument(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, CIrSimdArgument kind, IrSourceRange source)
 18262: {
 18263:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
 18264:     {
 18265:         IrTypeId type_id = builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type;
 18266:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
 18267:         if (type)
 18268:         {
 18269:             switch (kind)
 18270:             {
 18271:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_ADDRESS:
 18272:             {
 18273:                 if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR)
 18274:                 {
 18275:                     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, type->element_type);
 18276:                     value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, pointer_type, source);
 18277:                     type = value.value < builder->function->value_count ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type) : 0;
 18278:                 }
 18279:                 return type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? value : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18280:             }
 18281:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_MASK:
 18282:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
 18283:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG], source)
 18284:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18285:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_BYTE:
 18286:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
 18287:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR], source)
 18288:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18289:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_WORD:
 18290:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM
 18291:                            ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, builder->scalar_types[C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT], source)
 18292:                            : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18293:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_VECTOR:
 18294:                 return type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size == 64 ? value : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18295:             case C_IR_SIMD_ARGUMENT_IMMEDIATE:
 18296:                 break;
 18297:             }
 18298:         }
 18299:     }
 18300: 
 18301:     return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18302: }
 18303: 
 18304: // A call whose parentheses hold a lazily evaluated operand had the calls in
 18305: // that operand left unprepared (c_ir_prepare_calls_discover), so the child
 18306: // expression about to be lowered has to prepare them itself, inside whichever
 18307: // block ends up running. That only happens with preparation off; the enclosing
 18308: // pass resumes owning it when the child finishes.
 18309: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_prepared_call_suspend_preparation(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame)
 18310: {
 18311:     frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls = builder->preparing_calls;
 18312:     if (builder->prepared_calls[frame->as.prepared_call.call_index].deferred_calls)
 18313:     {
 18314:         builder->preparing_calls = false;
 18315:     }
 18316: }
 18317: 
 18318: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrPreparedCallStepResult c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,
 18319:                                                                                     CIrPreparedCallContinuation continuation, u32 start, u32 end,
 18320:                                                                                     bool va_list_operand)
 18321: {
 18322:     frame->as.prepared_call.state->continuation = (u32)continuation;
 18323:     frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
 18324:     c_ir_prepared_call_suspend_preparation(builder, frame);
 18325:     if (va_list_operand)
 18326:     {
 18327:         frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_va_list_operand = builder->va_list_builtin_operand;
 18328:         builder->va_list_builtin_operand = true;
 18329:     }
 18330:     if (!c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
 18331:                                             .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION,
 18332:                                             .as.expression =
 18333:                                                 {
 18334:                                                     .start = start,
 18335:                                                     .end = end,
 18336:                                                 },
 18337:                                         }))
 18338:     {
 18339:         if (va_list_operand)
 18340:         {
 18341:             builder->va_list_builtin_operand = frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_va_list_operand;
 18342:         }
 18343:         builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls;
 18344:         return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 18345:     }
 18346:     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_SUSPENDED;
 18347: }
 18348: 
 18349: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrPreparedCallStepResult c_ir_prepared_call_request_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,
 18350:                                                                                CIrPreparedCallContinuation continuation, u32 start, u32 end)
 18351: {
 18352:     frame->as.prepared_call.state->continuation = (u32)continuation;
 18353:     frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
 18354:     c_ir_prepared_call_suspend_preparation(builder, frame);
 18355:     if (!c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
 18356:                                             .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_PLACE,
 18357:                                             .as.place =
 18358:                                                 {
 18359:                                                     .start = start,
 18360:                                                     .end = end,
 18361:                                                 },
 18362:                                         }))
 18363:     {
 18364:         builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls;
 18365:         return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 18366:     }
 18367:     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_SUSPENDED;
 18368: }
 18369: 
 18370: // Aggregate exchanges compare the promoted object's representation. Keep the
 18371: // atomic instruction integer-typed: two pointer views name the same object,
 18372: // and private scalar storage carries values between the record and its bits.
 18373: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_atomic_aggregate_bits_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId object_type,
 18374:                                                             IrTypeId bits_type, IrSourceRange source)
 18375: {
 18376:     IrType* object = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, object_type);
 18377:     IrType* bits = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, bits_type);
 18378:     // GNU's generic forms name an ordinary object, while C11 aggregate
 18379:     // exchange/CAS name an atomic-qualified one. In both cases the integer
 18380:     // view must cover exactly the storage the caller supplied.
 18381:     bool valid = object && bits && object->layout.resolved && bits->layout.resolved &&
 18382:                  object->layout.size == bits->layout.size && bits_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 18383:     IrTypeId atomic_bits = valid ? c_ir_add_qualified_type(builder->program, bits_type, true, object->is_volatile) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18384:     IrTypeId pointer_type = valid ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, atomic_bits) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18385:     IrValueId address = valid ? c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, object_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18386:     IrValueId cast = address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, pointer_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18387:     IrValueId result = cast.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, cast, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18388:     return result;
 18389: }
 18390: 
 18391: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_atomic_aggregate_bits_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId record_type,
 18392:                                                             IrTypeId bits_type, bool to_bits, IrSourceRange source)
 18393: {
 18394:     IrType* record = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, record_type);
 18395:     IrType* bits = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, bits_type);
 18396:     bool valid = record && bits && record->layout.resolved && bits->layout.resolved && record->layout.size <= bits->layout.size &&
 18397:                  value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 18398:     IrValueId slot = valid ? c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, bits_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18399:     IrTypeId pointer_type = valid ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, record_type) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18400:     IrValueId address = valid ? c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, slot, bits_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18401:     IrValueId cast = address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, pointer_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18402:     IrValueId record_place = cast.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, cast, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18403:     valid = valid && record_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 18404:     if (valid && to_bits)
 18405:     {
 18406:         // A three-byte record uses a four-byte atomic object. Initialize the
 18407:         // promoted tail before writing the record, matching aggregate stores.
 18408:         IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0}, bits_type);
 18409:         valid = zero.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, slot, bits_type, zero, source) &&
 18410:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, record_place, record_type, value, source);
 18411:     }
 18412:     else if (valid)
 18413:     {
 18414:         valid = c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, slot, bits_type, value, source);
 18415:     }
 18416:     IrValueId result = valid ? c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, to_bits ? slot : record_place, to_bits ? bits_type : record_type, source)
 18417:                             : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18418:     return result;
 18419: }
 18420: 
 18421: // Builtins consume a pointer to the existing target-specific list object.
 18422: // Check this at the frontend boundary instead of publishing malformed VA IR.
 18423: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_va_list_operand_valid(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value)
 18424: {
 18425:     IrType* pointer = value.value < builder->function->value_count
 18426:                           ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type) : 0;
 18427:     IrType* list = pointer && pointer->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pointer->element_type) : 0;
 18428:     return list && list->kind == IR_TYPE_VA_LIST;
 18429: }
 18430: 
 18431: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrPreparedCallStepResult c_ir_emit_va_list_call_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,
 18432:                                                                         CIrPreparedCallContinuation continuation, bool child_success,
 18433:                                                                         IrValueId child_value)
 18434: {
 18435:     CIrPreparedCall* selected = builder->prepared_calls + frame->as.prepared_call.call_index;
 18436:     CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[selected->token_index];
 18437:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 18438:     u32 starts[2] = {0};
 18439:     u32 ends[2] = {0};
 18440:     u32 count = 0;
 18441:     bool valid = c_ir_call_arguments(builder, selected, starts, ends, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(starts), &count) &&
 18442:                  count == (selected->builtin_va_end ? 1u : 2u);
 18443:     CIrPreparedCallStepResult step = C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FINISHED;
 18444:     IrValueId source_list = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18445:     IrTypeId destination_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18446:     if (valid && selected->builtin_va_start)
 18447:     {
 18448:         IrType* function_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->canonical_type);
 18449:         valid = function_type && function_type->is_variadic;
 18450:     }
 18451:     if (valid && selected->builtin_va_end)
 18452:     {
 18453:         if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_END)
 18454:         {
 18455:             source_list = child_value;
 18456:             valid = child_success && c_ir_va_list_operand_valid(builder, source_list);
 18457:         }
 18458:         else
 18459:         {
 18460:             step = c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_END, starts[0], ends[0], true);
 18461:         }
 18462:     }
 18463:     else if (valid)
 18464:     {
 18465:         if (continuation != C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_DESTINATION && continuation != C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_COPY)
 18466:         {
 18467:             // MSVC's header passes the address to __va_start; recover the
 18468:             // same destination expression without re-evaluating its effects.
 18469:             if (selected->builtin_va_start && string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("__va_start")) &&
 18470:                 starts[0] < ends[0] && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[starts[0]], C_PUNCTUATOR_AMPERSAND))
 18471:             {
 18472:                 starts[0] += 1;
 18473:             }
 18474:             step = c_ir_prepared_call_request_place(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_DESTINATION, starts[0], ends[0]);
 18475:         }
 18476:         else
 18477:         {
 18478:             // Keep the lowered place across the copy-source continuation.
 18479:             // Calls, indexing and increments in the destination run once.
 18480:             if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_DESTINATION)
 18481:             {
 18482:                 frame->as.prepared_call.state->place = child_value;
 18483:             }
 18484:             IrValueId place = frame->as.prepared_call.state->place;
 18485:             IrValue* destination = place.value < builder->function->value_count ? builder->function->values + place.value : 0;
 18486:             IrType* type = destination ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, destination->canonical_type) : 0;
 18487:             valid = child_success && destination && destination->category == IR_VALUE_PLACE && !destination->is_read_only &&
 18488:                     type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_VA_LIST && !type->is_atomic;
 18489:             if (valid)
 18490:             {
 18491:                 destination_type = type->is_volatile ? type->unqualified_type : destination->canonical_type;
 18492:                 if (selected->builtin_va_copy && continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_DESTINATION)
 18493:                 {
 18494:                     step = c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_COPY, starts[1], ends[1], true);
 18495:                 }
 18496:                 else if (selected->builtin_va_copy)
 18497:                 {
 18498:                     source_list = child_value;
 18499:                     valid = c_ir_va_list_operand_valid(builder, source_list);
 18500:                 }
 18501:             }
 18502:         }
 18503:     }
 18504:     if (valid && step == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FINISHED)
 18505:     {
 18506:         IrTypeId result_type = selected->builtin_va_end ? builder->void_type : destination_type;
 18507:         IrValueId result = selected->builtin_va_end ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_add_result(builder, result_type);
 18508:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(selected->builtin_va_start ? IR_OPCODE_VA_START :
 18509:                                                                selected->builtin_va_copy ? IR_OPCODE_VA_COPY : IR_OPCODE_VA_END, result_type);
 18510:         if (!selected->builtin_va_start)
 18511:         {
 18512:             instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
 18513:             instruction.operands[0] = source_list;
 18514:             instruction.operand_count = 1;
 18515:         }
 18516:         instruction.result = result;
 18517:         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
 18518:         if (!selected->builtin_va_end)
 18519:         {
 18520:             builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
 18521:             IrValueId place = frame->as.prepared_call.state->place;
 18522:             valid = c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, place, builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type, result, source);
 18523:         }
 18524:     }
 18525:     if (!valid)
 18526:     {
 18527:         if (!builder->failure_message.length)
 18528:         {
 18529:             builder->failure_message = selected->builtin_va_end ? S8("va_end requires a va_list operand") :
 18530:                 S8("va_start/va_copy requires a modifiable va_list destination and valid arguments");
 18531:             builder->failure_token_index = selected->token_index;
 18532:         }
 18533:         step = C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 18534:     }
 18535:     return step;
 18536: }
 18537: 
 18538: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrPreparedCallStepResult c_ir_emit_prepared_call_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame)
 18539: {
 18540:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 18541:     u32 call_index = frame->as.prepared_call.call_index;
 18542:     bool child_success = frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD && machine->child_result.success;
 18543:     IrValueId child_value = machine->child_result.value;
 18544:     CIrPreparedCallContinuation continuation = (CIrPreparedCallContinuation)frame->as.prepared_call.state->continuation;
 18545:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD &&
 18546:         (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_END || continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_COPY ||
 18547:          continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_ARG))
 18548:     {
 18549:         builder->va_list_builtin_operand = frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_va_list_operand;
 18550:     }
 18551:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD)
 18552:     {
 18553:         builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepared_call.state->previous_preparing_calls;
 18554:     }
 18555:     u32 remaining = 1;
 18556:     do
 18557:     {
 18558:         CIrPreparedCall* selected = builder->prepared_calls + call_index;
 18559:         CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[selected->token_index];
 18560:         if (selected->builtin_constant_p || selected->builtin_choose_expr || selected->builtin_types_compatible_p || selected->builtin_object_size ||
 18561:             selected->builtin_assume_aligned)
 18562:         {
 18563:             u32 starts[4] = {0};
 18564:             u32 ends[4] = {0};
 18565:             u32 argument_count = 0;
 18566:             if (!c_ir_call_arguments(builder, selected, starts, ends, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(starts), &argument_count))
 18567:             {
 18568:                 return false;
 18569:             }
 18570:             if (selected->builtin_constant_p)
 18571:             {
 18572:                 CIrConstantValue value = {0};
 18573:                 bool constant = argument_count == 1 && c_ir_constant_evaluate(builder, starts[0], ends[0], &value) &&
 18574:                                 c_ir_constant_normalize(builder, &value) && value.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_INVALID && value.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN &&
 18575:                                 value.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE;
 18576:                 selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, constant ? 1 : 0, false, token, builder->s32_type);
 18577:             }
 18578:             else if (selected->builtin_choose_expr)
 18579:             {
 18580:                 u64 condition = 0;
 18581:                 if (argument_count != 3 || !c_ir_constant_condition_evaluate(builder, starts[0], ends[0], &condition))
 18582:                 {
 18583:                     return false;
 18584:                 }
 18585:                 u32 branch = condition ? 1 : 2;
 18586:                 if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_CHOOSE)
 18587:                 {
 18588:                     if (!child_success)
 18589:                     {
 18590:                         return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 18591:                     }
 18592:                     selected->result = child_value;
 18593:                 }
 18594:                 else
 18595:                 {
 18596:                     return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_CHOOSE, starts[branch], ends[branch], false);
 18597:                 }
 18598:             }
 18599:             else if (selected->builtin_types_compatible_p)
 18600:             {
 18601:                 IrTypeId left = argument_count == 2 ? c_ir_type_name(builder, starts[0], ends[0]) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18602:                 IrTypeId right = argument_count == 2 ? c_ir_type_name(builder, starts[1], ends[1]) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18603:                 if (left.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || right.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 18604:                 {
 18605:                     return false;
 18606:                 }
 18607:                 bool compatible = c_ir_types_compatible(builder, left, right);
 18608:                 selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, compatible ? 1 : 0, false, token, builder->s32_type);
 18609:             }
 18610:             else if (selected->builtin_object_size)
 18611:             {
 18612:                 if (argument_count != 2)
 18613:                 {
 18614:                     return false;
 18615:                 }
 18616:                 u64 mode = 0;
 18617:                 if (!c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(builder->temporary_arena, builder, starts[1], ends[1], &mode) || mode > 3)
 18618:                 {
 18619:                     return false;
 18620:                 }
 18621:                 u64 size = mode >= 2 ? 0 : UINT64_MAX;
 18622:                 u32 object_start = starts[0];
 18623:                 u32 object_end = ends[0];
 18624:                 while (object_start < object_end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[object_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
 18625:                        c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, object_start, object_end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) ==
 18626:                            object_end - 1)
 18627:                 {
 18628:                     object_start += 1;
 18629:                     object_end -= 1;
 18630:                 }
 18631:                 if (object_start < object_end && builder->preprocess.tokens[object_start].kind == C_TOKEN_STRING_LITERAL &&
 18632:                     c_ir_tokens_are_string_literals(builder->preprocess, object_start, object_end))
 18633:                 {
 18634:                     CIrDecodedString decoded = {0};
 18635:                     if (!c_ir_decode_string_literal_range_for_target(builder->arena, builder->preprocess, builder->target, object_start, object_end, &decoded) ||
 18636:                         decoded.element_count == UINT64_MAX || decoded.element_count + 1 > UINT64_MAX / decoded.element_width)
 18637:                     {
 18638:                         return false;
 18639:                     }
 18640:                     size = (decoded.element_count + 1) * decoded.element_width;
 18641:                 }
 18642:                 else if (object_start + 1 == object_end && builder->preprocess.tokens[object_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 18643:                 {
 18644:                     CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, object_start);
 18645:                     IrTypeId object_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18646:                     CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
 18647:                     if (local)
 18648:                     {
 18649:                         object_type = local->type;
 18650:                     }
 18651:                     else if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count && builder->parse.entities[entity.value].type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
 18652:                     {
 18653:                         object_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[builder->parse.entities[entity.value].type.value];
 18654:                     }
 18655:                     IrType* object = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, object_type);
 18656:                     if (object && object->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY && object->layout.resolved)
 18657:                     {
 18658:                         size = object->layout.size;
 18659:                     }
 18660:                 }
 18661:                 selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, size, false, token, builder->size_type);
 18662:             }
 18663:             else
 18664:             {
 18665:                 u64 alignment = 0;
 18666:                 u64 offset = 0;
 18667:                 if ((argument_count != 2 && argument_count != 3) ||
 18668:                     !c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(builder->temporary_arena, builder, starts[1], ends[1], &alignment) || !alignment ||
 18669:                     (argument_count == 3 && !c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(builder->temporary_arena, builder, starts[2], ends[2], &offset)))
 18670:                 {
 18671:                     return false;
 18672:                 }
 18673:                 if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ASSUME_ALIGNED)
 18674:                 {
 18675:                     if (!child_success)
 18676:                     {
 18677:                         return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 18678:                     }
 18679:                     selected->result = child_value;
 18680:                 }
 18681:                 else
 18682:                 {
 18683:                     return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ASSUME_ALIGNED, starts[0], ends[0], false);
 18684:                 }
 18685:                 if (selected->result.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 18686:                 {
 18687:                     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 18688:                 }
 18689:                 IrType* aligned_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[selected->result.value].canonical_type);
 18690:                 if (aligned_type && aligned_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
 18691:                 {
 18692:                     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, aligned_type->element_type);
 18693:                     selected->result = c_ir_decay_array(builder, selected->result, pointer_type, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token));
 18694:                     aligned_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pointer_type);
 18695:                 }
 18696:                 if (!aligned_type || aligned_type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 18697:                 {
 18698:                     return false;
 18699:                 }
 18700:             }
 18701:             if (selected->result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 18702:             {
 18703:                 return false;
 18704:             }
 18705:             selected->argument_count = argument_count;
 18706:             selected->emitted = true;
 18707:             remaining -= 1;
 18708:             continue;
 18709:         }
 18710:         if (selected->builtin_generic)
 18711:         {
 18712:             u32 association_start = 0;
 18713:             u32 association_end = 0;
 18714:             IrTypeId association_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18715:             bool selection_valid =
 18716:                 c_ir_generic_selection(builder, selected->token_index, selected->close_index + 1, &association_start, &association_end, &association_type);
 18717:             if (!selection_valid)
 18718:             {
 18719:                 return false;
 18720:             }
 18721:             if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_GENERIC)
 18722:             {
 18723:                 if (!child_success)
 18724:                 {
 18725:                     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 18726:                 }
 18727:                 selected->result = child_value;
 18728:             }
 18729:             else
 18730:             {
 18731:                 // The selected association is the only one lowered, and
 18732:                 // discovery never looked inside _Generic, so its calls are
 18733:                 // prepared by the child expression itself.
 18734:                 return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_GENERIC, association_start,
 18735:                                                              association_end, false);
 18736:             }
 18737:             (void)association_type;
 18738:             selected->argument_count = 1;
 18739:             selected->emitted = true;
 18740:             remaining -= 1;
 18741:             continue;
 18742:         }
 18743:         if (selected->builtin_atomic != C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_COUNT)
 18744:         {
 18745:             u32 starts[6] = {0};
 18746:             u32 ends[6] = {0};
 18747:             u32 argument_count = 0;
 18748:             u32 expected_count = selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_LOAD   ? 2
 18749:                                  : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_INIT ? 2
 18750:                                  : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_COMPARE_EXCHANGE_STRONG ||
 18751:                                          selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_COMPARE_EXCHANGE_WEAK
 18752:                                      ? 5
 18753:                                  : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_THREAD_FENCE ||
 18754:                                          selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_SIGNAL_FENCE ||
 18755:                                          selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_IS_LOCK_FREE
 18756:                                      ? 1
 18757:                                  : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_SYNC_SYNCHRONIZE ? 0
 18758:                                                                                                      : 3;
 18759:             // GNU's `_n`, generic pointer, and legacy `__sync_*` families
 18760:             // share operations but not argument shapes.
 18761:             if (selected->builtin_atomic_generic)
 18762:             {
 18763:                 expected_count = selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_LOAD ? 3
 18764:                                  : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_EXCHANGE ? 4
 18765:                                  : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_COMPARE_EXCHANGE_STRONG ? 6
 18766:                                                                                                             : 3;
 18767:             }
 18768:             else if (selected->builtin_atomic_sequential)
 18769:             {
 18770:                 expected_count = 2;
 18771:             }
 18772:             else if (selected->builtin_atomic_gnu)
 18773:             {
 18774:                 expected_count = selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_COMPARE_EXCHANGE_STRONG   ? 6
 18775:                                  : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_IS_LOCK_FREE            ? 2
 18776:                                  : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_TEST_AND_SET ||
 18777:                                          selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_CLEAR
 18778:                                      ? 2
 18779:                                      : expected_count;
 18780:             }
 18781:             IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 18782:             // `__sync_synchronize()` is the one atomic builtin with an empty
 18783:             // argument list, which the argument scan reports as malformed.
 18784:             bool empty_arguments = selected->open_index + 1 == selected->close_index;
 18785:             if (empty_arguments ? expected_count != 0
 18786:                                 : (!c_ir_call_arguments(builder, selected, starts, ends, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(starts), &argument_count) ||
 18787:                                    argument_count != expected_count))
 18788:             {
 18789:                 return false;
 18790:             }
 18791:             if (selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_THREAD_FENCE || selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_SIGNAL_FENCE ||
 18792:                 selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_SYNC_SYNCHRONIZE)
 18793:             {
 18794:                 // `__sync_synchronize()` carries its ordering in its name.
 18795:                 IrMemoryOrder order = IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL;
 18796:                 if (selected->builtin_atomic != C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_SYNC_SYNCHRONIZE && !c_ir_atomic_memory_order(builder, starts[0], ends[0], &order))
 18797:                 {
 18798:                     return false;
 18799:                 }
 18800:                 IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
 18801:                 IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_FENCE, builder->void_type);
 18802:                 instruction.memory_order = (u8)order;
 18803:                 instruction.atomic_signal_fence = selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_SIGNAL_FENCE;
 18804:                 c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
 18805:                 selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token);
 18806:                 selected->argument_count = argument_count;
 18807:                 selected->emitted = true;
 18808:                 remaining -= 1;
 18809:                 continue;
 18810:             }
 18811:             if (selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_IS_LOCK_FREE)
 18812:             {
 18813:                 // The GNU spelling takes the object's address after its size,
 18814:                 // for a target where alignment decides the answer. Every width
 18815:                 // this backend reports lock-free is naturally aligned by the
 18816:                 // ABI, so the address adds nothing and is not lowered: it is
 18817:                 // documented to be usable as a null pointer constant, which is
 18818:                 // what most callers pass.
 18819:                 u64 size = 0;
 18820:                 if (!c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(builder->temporary_arena, builder, starts[0], ends[0], &size))
 18821:                 {
 18822:                     return false;
 18823:                 }
 18824:                 bool lock_free = size == 1 || size == 2 || size == 4 || size == 8;
 18825:                 selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, lock_free ? 1 : 0, false, token);
 18826:                 selected->argument_count = argument_count;
 18827:                 selected->emitted = true;
 18828:                 remaining -= 1;
 18829:                 continue;
 18830:             }
 18831:             IrValueId place = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18832:             if (continuation >= C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ATOMIC_PLACE &&
 18833:                 continuation <= C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ATOMIC_RESULT_PLACE)
 18834:             {
 18835:                 place = frame->as.prepared_call.state->place;
 18836:             }
 18837:             else
 18838:             {
 18839:                 return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ATOMIC_PLACE, starts[0], ends[0], false);
 18840:             }
 18841:             if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ATOMIC_PLACE)
 18842:             {
 18843:                 if (!child_success)
 18844:                 {
 18845:                     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 18846:                 }
 18847:                 IrValueId pointer = child_value;
 18848:                 if (selected->builtin_atomic_gnu && !selected->builtin_atomic_generic &&
 18849:                     pointer.value < builder->function->value_count)
 18850:                 {
 18851:                     IrType* pointer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[pointer.value].canonical_type);
 18852:                     IrType* object = pointer_type && pointer_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER
 18853:                                          ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pointer_type->element_type) : 0;
 18854:                     bool scalar = object && (object->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || object->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN ||
 18855:                                              object->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM || object->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER);
 18856:                     if (scalar && !object->is_atomic)
 18857:                     {
 18858:                         // GNU builtins accept ordinary scalar pointers, but
 18859:                         // canonical atomic instructions require an atomic
 18860:                         // place. Cast the pointer view, not the underlying
 18861:                         // object's type; plain accesses retain their semantics.
 18862:                         IrTypeId value_type = object->is_volatile ? object->unqualified_type : object->id;
 18863:                         IrTypeId view_type = c_ir_add_qualified_type(builder->program, value_type, true, object->is_volatile);
 18864:                         IrTypeId view_pointer = view_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 18865:                                                     ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, view_type) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18866:                         pointer = view_pointer.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 18867:                                       ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, pointer, view_pointer, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18868:                     }
 18869:                 }
 18870:                 place = c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, pointer, source);
 18871:                 frame->as.prepared_call.state->place = place;
 18872:             }
 18873:             IrTypeId atomic_type = place.value < builder->function->value_count ? builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18874:             IrType* atomic = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, atomic_type);
 18875:             // The C11 spelling requires a pointer to an `_Atomic` object and
 18876:             // reads the value type out of it; the GNU one takes an ordinary
 18877:             // pointer, so the object's own type *is* the value type. A GNU call
 18878:             // on an `_Atomic` object is still accepted, and still strips.
 18879:             if (selected->builtin_atomic_gnu && !selected->builtin_atomic_generic &&
 18880:                 atomic && !atomic->is_atomic)
 18881:             {
 18882:                 // Canonical atomic operations carry an atomic place even for
 18883:                 // GNU's ordinary-pointer builtins.  Reinterpret the caller's
 18884:                 // pointer through the qualified view of the same object;
 18885:                 // keeping the original place would make an otherwise valid
 18886:                 // GNU store/load fail the IR atomic-place contract.
 18887:                 IrTypeId unqualified_type = atomic->is_volatile ? atomic->unqualified_type : atomic_type;
 18888:                 IrTypeId qualified_type = c_ir_add_atomic_access_type(builder->program, unqualified_type, atomic->is_volatile);
 18889:                 IrTypeId pointer_type = qualified_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 18890:                                             ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, qualified_type)
 18891:                                             : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18892:                 IrValueId address = pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 18893:                                         ? c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, atomic_type, source)
 18894:                                         : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18895:                 IrValueId cast = address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 18896:                                      ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, pointer_type, source)
 18897:                                      : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18898:                 place = cast.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, cast, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 18899:                 if (place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 18900:                 {
 18901:                     frame->as.prepared_call.state->place = place;
 18902:                     atomic_type = qualified_type;
 18903:                     atomic = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, atomic_type);
 18904:                 }
 18905:                 else
 18906:                 {
 18907:                     atomic_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18908:                     atomic = 0;
 18909:                 }
 18910:             }
 18911:             IrTypeId value_type_id = atomic && atomic->is_atomic ? atomic->unqualified_type : atomic_type;
 18912:             IrType* unqualified = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type_id);
 18913:             if (!atomic || (!atomic->is_atomic && !selected->builtin_atomic_gnu) || !unqualified)
 18914:             {
 18915:                 return false;
 18916:             }
 18917:             bool aggregate_value = unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION;
 18918:             bool pointer_value = unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER;
 18919:             bool representation_value = aggregate_value || selected->builtin_atomic_generic;
 18920:             u64 atomic_width = selected->builtin_atomic_generic
 18921:                                    ? (unqualified->layout.resolved ? unqualified->layout.size : 0)
 18922:                                    : (atomic->layout.resolved ? atomic->layout.size : 0);
 18923:             IrTypeId generic_bits_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18924:             if (selected->builtin_atomic_generic)
 18925:             {
 18926:                 if (atomic_width != 1 && atomic_width != 2 && atomic_width != 4 && atomic_width != 8)
 18927:                 {
 18928:                     builder->failure_token_index = selected->token_index;
 18929:                     builder->failure_message =
 18930:                         S8("GNU generic atomic builtins require an object whose size is 1, 2, 4, or 8 bytes");
 18931:                     return false;
 18932:                 }
 18933:                 generic_bits_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, atomic_width);
 18934:                 if (generic_bits_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 18935:                 {
 18936:                     return false;
 18937:                 }
 18938:             }
 18939:             bool wide_atomic_runtime = builder->target.cpu_arch == CPU_ARCH_X86_64 && atomic_width == 16 &&
 18940:                                        !target_cpu_feature_has(builder->target, TARGET_CPU_FEATURE_X86_CX16);
 18941:             IrTypeId wide_atomic_runtime_type = wide_atomic_runtime
 18942:                                                     ? c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128)
 18943:                                                     : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 18944:             IrTypeId wide_atomic_runtime_pointer_type = wide_atomic_runtime_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 18945:                                                             ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, wide_atomic_runtime_type)
 18946:                                                             : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
