 19455:                         {
 19456:                             return false;
 19457:                         }
 19458:                     }
 19459:                     if (wide_atomic_runtime && !aggregate_value)
 19460:                     {
 19461:                         operation_type = wide_atomic_runtime_type;
 19462:                         operation_value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, operation_type, source);
 19463:                         if (operation_value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19464:                         {
 19465:                             return false;
 19466:                         }
 19467:                     }
 19468:                     IrValueId previous = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 19469:                     if (wide_atomic_runtime)
 19470:                     {
 19471:                         String8 runtime_name = operation == IR_ATOMIC_ADD          ? S8("__atomic_fetch_add_16")
 19472:                                                : operation == IR_ATOMIC_SUBTRACT ? S8("__atomic_fetch_sub_16")
 19473:                                                : operation == IR_ATOMIC_BITWISE_AND ? S8("__atomic_fetch_and_16")
 19474:                                                : operation == IR_ATOMIC_BITWISE_OR  ? S8("__atomic_fetch_or_16")
 19475:                                                : operation == IR_ATOMIC_BITWISE_XOR ? S8("__atomic_fetch_xor_16")
 19476:                                                : operation == IR_ATOMIC_BITWISE_NAND ? S8("__atomic_fetch_nand_16")
 19477:                                                                                       : S8("__atomic_exchange_16");
 19478:                         IrTypeId runtime_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 19479:                         IrTypeId runtime_pointer_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 19480:                         IrValueId address = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 19481:                         bool runtime_arguments = c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_arguments(builder, place, atomic_type, source,
 19482:                                                                                      &runtime_type, &runtime_pointer_type, &address);
 19483:                         IrValueId order_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, (u64)order, false, token, builder->s32_type);
 19484:                         IrTypeId parameter_types[3] = {runtime_pointer_type, runtime_type, builder->s32_type};
 19485:                         IrValueId arguments[3] = {address, operation_value, order_value};
 19486:                         if (!runtime_arguments || runtime_type.value != operation_type.value ||
 19487:                             runtime_pointer_type.value != wide_atomic_runtime_pointer_type.value ||
 19488:                             address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || order_value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
 19489:                             !c_ir_emit_runtime_call(builder, token, runtime_name, runtime_type,
 19490:                                                     parameter_types, arguments, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(arguments), &previous))
 19491:                         {
 19492:                             return false;
 19493:                         }
 19494:                     }
 19495:                     else
 19496:                     {
 19497:                         previous = c_ir_add_result(builder, operation_type);
 19498:                         IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
 19499:                         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_READ_MODIFY_WRITE, operation_type);
 19500:                         instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 2);
 19501:                         instruction.operands[0] = operation_place;
 19502:                         instruction.operands[1] = operation_value;
 19503:                         instruction.operand_count = 2;
 19504:                         instruction.memory_order = (u8)order;
 19505:                         instruction.atomic_operation = (u8)operation;
 19506:                         instruction.result = previous;
 19507:                         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
 19508:                         builder->function->values[previous.value].definition = id;
 19509:                     }
 19510:                     selected->result = representation_value
 19511:                                            ? c_ir_atomic_aggregate_bits_value(builder, previous, value_type_id, operation_type, false, source)
 19512:                                            : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, previous, value_type_id, source);
 19513:                     if (selected->result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19514:                     {
 19515:                         return false;
 19516:                     }
 19517:                     if (selected->builtin_atomic_generic)
 19518:                     {
 19519:                         if (!c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, generic_exchange_result_place, value_type_id,
 19520:                                                    selected->result, source))
 19521:                         {
 19522:                             return false;
 19523:                         }
 19524:                         selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token);
 19525:                     }
 19526:                     if (selected->builtin_atomic_new_value)
 19527:                     {
 19528:                         // `__atomic_add_fetch` and its four siblings answer the
 19529:                         // updated value. The instruction answers the previous
 19530:                         // one, so the operation is applied again to it -- which
 19531:                         // is what the reference compilers emit too, and is
 19532:                         // correct without a second atomic access because the
 19533:                         // operation is a pure function of the two operands.
 19534:                         IrTypeId recompute_type = pointer_value ? builder->ptrdiff_type : value_type_id;
 19535:                         IrValueId recompute_values[2] = {
 19536:                             pointer_value ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, previous, recompute_type, source) : previous,
 19537:                             pointer_value ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, operand_value, recompute_type, source) : operand_value,
 19538:                         };
 19539:                         if (recompute_values[0].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
 19540:                             recompute_values[1].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19541:                         {
 19542:                             return false;
 19543:                         }
 19544:                         if (selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_FETCH_NAND)
 19545:                         {
 19546:                             IrValueId combined = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, recompute_values[0], recompute_values[1],
 19547:                                                                         recompute_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
 19548:                             IrValueId inverted = combined.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 19549:                                                      ? c_ir_add_result(builder, recompute_type)
 19550:                                                      : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 19551:                             if (inverted.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19552:                             {
 19553:                                 return false;
 19554:                             }
 19555:                             IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_UNARY, recompute_type);
 19556:                             instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
 19557:                             instruction.operands[0] = combined;
 19558:                             instruction.operand_count = 1;
 19559:                             instruction.unary_operation = IR_UNARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_NOT;
 19560:                             instruction.result = inverted;
 19561:                             IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
 19562:                             builder->function->values[inverted.value].definition = id;
 19563:                             recompute_values[0] = inverted;
 19564:                         }
 19565:                         else
 19566:                         {
 19567:                             CConditionalOperator recompute =
 19568:                                 selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_FETCH_ADD        ? C_CONDITIONAL_ADD
 19569:                                 : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_FETCH_SUBTRACT ? C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT
 19570:                                 : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_FETCH_AND      ? C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_AND
 19571:                                 : selected->builtin_atomic == C_IR_ATOMIC_BUILTIN_FETCH_OR       ? C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_OR
 19572:                                                                                                   : C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_XOR;
 19573:                             u32 recompute_count = 2;
 19574:                             if (!c_ir_apply_operation(builder, recompute, recompute_values, &recompute_count,
 19575:                                                       source, recompute_type) ||
 19576:                                 recompute_count != 1)
 19577:                             {
 19578:                                 return false;
 19579:                             }
 19580:                         }
 19581:                         selected->result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, recompute_values[0], value_type_id, source);
 19582:                         if (selected->result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19583:                         {
 19584:                             return false;
 19585:                         }
 19586:                     }
 19587:                 }
 19588:             }
 19589:             selected->argument_count = argument_count;
 19590:             selected->emitted = true;
 19591:             remaining -= 1;
 19592:             continue;
 19593:         }
 19594:         if (selected->builtin_simd != C_IR_SIMD_BUILTIN_NONE)
 19595:         {
 19596:             CIrSimdBuiltin entry = c_ir_simd_builtins[selected->builtin_simd];
 19597:             IrSimdShape shape = ir_simd_operation_shape((IrSimdOperation)entry.operation);
 19598:             u32 starts[4] = {0};
 19599:             u32 ends[4] = {0};
 19600:             u32 argument_count = 0;
 19601:             builder->failure_token_index = selected->open_index;
 19602:             if (!c_ir_call_arguments(builder, selected, starts, ends, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(starts), &argument_count) ||
 19603:                 argument_count != (u32)shape.operand_count + shape.immediate_count)
 19604:             {
 19605:                 builder->failure_message = string_format(builder->arena, S8("{S8} takes {u32} arguments"), entry.name,
 19606:                                                          (u32)shape.operand_count + shape.immediate_count);
 19607:                 return false;
 19608:             }
 19609:             if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_SIMD_ARGUMENT)
 19610:             {
 19611:                 if (!child_success)
 19612:                 {
 19613:                     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 19614:                 }
 19615:                 u32 argument_index = frame->as.prepared_call.state->argument_count;
 19616:                 IrSourceRange argument_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, builder->preprocess.tokens[starts[argument_index]]);
 19617:                 IrValueId value = c_ir_simd_coerce_argument(builder, child_value, (CIrSimdArgument)entry.arguments[argument_index], argument_source);
 19618:                 if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19619:                 {
 19620:                     builder->failure_token_index = starts[argument_index];
 19621:                     builder->failure_message = string_format(builder->arena, S8("argument {u32} of {S8} has the wrong type"), argument_index + 1, entry.name);
 19622:                     return false;
 19623:                 }
 19624:                 selected->arguments[argument_index] = value;
 19625:                 frame->as.prepared_call.state->argument_count = argument_index + 1;
 19626:             }
 19627:             else
 19628:             {
 19629:                 selected->arguments = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(starts));
 19630:                 frame->as.prepared_call.state->argument_count = 0;
 19631:             }
 19632:             // The operands are ordinary expressions and are lowered one at a
 19633:             // time through the machine; a trailing immediate never becomes a
 19634:             // value and is folded straight out of its tokens below.
 19635:             u32 next = frame->as.prepared_call.state->argument_count;
 19636:             if (next < shape.operand_count)
 19637:             {
 19638:                 return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_SIMD_ARGUMENT, starts[next], ends[next], false);
 19639:             }
 19640:             u64 immediate = 0;
 19641:             if (shape.immediate_count &&
 19642:                 (!c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(builder->temporary_arena, builder, starts[shape.operand_count], ends[shape.operand_count], &immediate) ||
 19643:                  immediate >= entry.immediate_limit))
 19644:             {
 19645:                 builder->failure_token_index = starts[shape.operand_count];
 19646:                 builder->failure_message =
 19647:                     string_format(builder->arena, S8("the last argument of {S8} must be a constant below {u32}"), entry.name, entry.immediate_limit);
 19648:                 return false;
 19649:             }
 19650:             IrTypeId result_type = c_ir_simd_result_type(builder, (IrSimdOperation)entry.operation);
 19651:             if (result_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19652:             {
 19653:                 builder->failure_message = S8("this target has no 512-bit SIMD type");
 19654:                 return false;
 19655:             }
 19656:             IrSourceRange instruction_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 19657:             IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_SIMD, result_type);
 19658:             instruction.operands = selected->arguments;
 19659:             instruction.operand_count = shape.operand_count;
 19660:             instruction.simd_operation = entry.operation;
 19661:             if (shape.immediate_count)
 19662:             {
 19663:                 instruction.immediates = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, 1);
 19664:                 instruction.immediates[0] = immediate;
 19665:                 instruction.immediate_count = 1;
 19666:             }
 19667:             if (shape.has_result)
 19668:             {
 19669:                 instruction.result = c_ir_add_result(builder, result_type);
 19670:             }
 19671:             IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
 19672:             if (shape.has_result)
 19673:             {
 19674:                 builder->function->values[instruction.result.value].definition = id;
 19675:                 selected->result = instruction.result;
 19676:             }
 19677:             else
 19678:             {
 19679:                 // A void builtin still has to hand a value back to whatever
 19680:                 // expression contained it, the same way the other statement-like
 19681:                 // builtins do.
 19682:                 selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token);
 19683:             }
 19684:             selected->argument_count = argument_count;
 19685:             selected->emitted = true;
 19686:             remaining -= 1;
 19687:             continue;
 19688:         }
 19689:         if (selected->builtin_unary != IR_UNARY_COUNT)
 19690:         {
 19691:             u32 argument_start = selected->open_index + 1;
 19692:             u32 argument_end = selected->close_index;
 19693:             IrValueId operand = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 19694:             if (argument_start >= argument_end)
 19695:             {
 19696:                 return false;
 19697:             }
 19698:             if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_UNARY)
 19699:             {
 19700:                 if (!child_success)
 19701:                 {
 19702:                     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 19703:                 }
 19704:                 operand = child_value;
 19705:             }
 19706:             else
 19707:             {
 19708:                 return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_UNARY, argument_start, argument_end, false);
 19709:             }
 19710:             if (operand.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 19711:             {
 19712:                 return false;
 19713:             }
 19714:             IrTypeId type = builder->function->values[operand.value].canonical_type;
 19715:             IrType* type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
 19716:             if (!type_value || type_value->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
 19717:             {
 19718:                 return false;
 19719:             }
 19720:             IrSourceRange instruction_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 19721:             IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 19722:             if (selected->builtin_unary == IR_UNARY_INTEGER_POPULATION_COUNT)
 19723:             {
 19724:                 result = c_ir_emit_population_count(builder, operand, type, token, instruction_source);
 19725:                 if (result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19726:                 {
 19727:                     return false;
 19728:                 }
 19729:             }
 19730:             else
 19731:             {
 19732:                 result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
 19733:                 IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_UNARY, type);
 19734:                 instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
 19735:                 instruction.operands[0] = operand;
 19736:                 instruction.operand_count = 1;
 19737:                 instruction.unary_operation = (u8)selected->builtin_unary;
 19738:                 instruction.result = result;
 19739:                 IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
 19740:                 builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
 19741:             }
 19742:             selected->result = result;
 19743:             selected->argument_count = 1;
 19744:             selected->emitted = true;
 19745:             remaining -= 1;
 19746:             continue;
 19747:         }
 19748:         if (selected->builtin_strlen)
 19749:         {
 19750:             u32 argument_start = selected->open_index + 1;
 19751:             u32 argument_end = selected->close_index;
 19752:             while (argument_start < argument_end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[argument_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
 19753:                    c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, argument_start, argument_end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) ==
 19754:                        argument_end - 1)
 19755:             {
 19756:                 argument_start += 1;
 19757:                 argument_end -= 1;
 19758:             }
 19759:             u64 length = 0;
 19760:             bool valid = false;
 19761:             if (argument_start < argument_end && builder->preprocess.tokens[argument_start].kind == C_TOKEN_STRING_LITERAL)
 19762:             {
 19763:                 CIrDecodedString decoded = {0};
 19764:                 valid =
 19765:                     c_ir_tokens_are_string_literals(builder->preprocess, argument_start, argument_end) &&
 19766:                     c_ir_decode_string_literal_range_for_target(builder->arena, builder->preprocess, builder->target, argument_start, argument_end, &decoded) &&
 19767:                     decoded.element_width == 1;
 19768:                 length = decoded.element_count;
 19769:             }
 19770:             else if (argument_end == argument_start + 1 && builder->preprocess.tokens[argument_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
 19771:                      (string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[argument_start]), S8("__func__")) ||
 19772:                       string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[argument_start]), S8("__FUNCTION__")) ||
 19773:                       string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[argument_start]), S8("__PRETTY_FUNCTION__"))))
 19774:             {
 19775:                 length = builder->function->name.length;
 19776:                 valid = true;
 19777:             }
 19778:             if (!valid)
 19779:             {
 19780:                 IrValueId argument = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 19781:                 u32 declaration_index = c_ir_find_function(builder, S8("strlen"));
 19782:                 if (argument_start >= argument_end)
 19783:                 {
 19784:                     return false;
 19785:                 }
 19786:                 if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_STRLEN)
 19787:                 {
 19788:                     if (!child_success)
 19789:                     {
 19790:                         return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 19791:                     }
 19792:                     argument = child_value;
 19793:                 }
 19794:                 else
 19795:                 {
 19796:                     return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_STRLEN, argument_start, argument_end, false);
 19797:                 }
 19798:                 selected->result = c_ir_emit_call_values(builder, token, declaration_index, &argument, 1);
 19799:                 if (selected->result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19800:                 {
 19801:                     return false;
 19802:                 }
 19803:                 selected->argument_count = 1;
 19804:                 selected->emitted = true;
 19805:                 remaining -= 1;
 19806:                 continue;
 19807:             }
 19808:             selected->result = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, length, false, token, builder->size_type);
 19809:             selected->argument_count = 1;
 19810:             selected->emitted = true;
 19811:             remaining -= 1;
 19812:             continue;
 19813:         }
 19814:         // `__builtin_alloca(n)` is the same stack allocation a variable-length
 19815:         // array makes, minus the array: the storage lives until the function
 19816:         // returns, so nothing releases it at the end of the enclosing block.
 19817:         if (selected->builtin_alloca)
 19818:         {
 19819:             u32 size_start = selected->open_index + 1;
 19820:             u32 size_end = selected->close_index;
 19821:             IrValueId size = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 19822:             if (size_start >= size_end)
 19823:             {
 19824:                 return false;
 19825:             }
 19826:             if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ALLOCA)
 19827:             {
 19828:                 if (!child_success)
 19829:                 {
 19830:                     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 19831:                 }
 19832:                 size = child_value;
 19833:             }
 19834:             else
 19835:             {
 19836:                 return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ALLOCA, size_start, size_end, false);
 19837:             }
 19838:             size = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, size, builder->size_type, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token));
 19839:             IrTypeId storage_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, builder->void_type);
 19840:             IrValueId storage = storage_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_add_result(builder, storage_type) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 19841:             if (size.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || storage.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19842:             {
 19843:                 return false;
 19844:             }
 19845:             IrSourceRange allocation_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 19846:             IrInstruction allocation = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_STACK_ALLOCATE, storage_type);
 19847:             allocation.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
 19848:             allocation.operands[0] = size;
 19849:             allocation.operand_count = 1;
 19850:             allocation.immediates = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, 1);
 19851:             // GNU promises alloca storage suitably aligned for any object.
 19852:             allocation.immediates[0] = 16;
 19853:             allocation.immediate_count = 1;
 19854:             allocation.result = storage;
 19855:             builder->function->values[storage.value].definition = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, allocation, allocation_source);
 19856:             selected->result = storage;
 19857:             selected->argument_count = 1;
 19858:             selected->emitted = true;
 19859:             remaining -= 1;
 19860:             continue;
 19861:         }
 19862:         // `__builtin_complex(re, im)` composes a complex value out of two
 19863:         // real parts. Both arguments have to be lowered before the value can
 19864:         // be built, so the real half is stashed on the frame across the second
 19865:         // request the way __builtin___clear_cache stashes its address.
 19866:         if (selected->builtin_complex)
 19867:         {
 19868:             u32 starts[2] = {0};
 19869:             u32 ends[2] = {0};
 19870:             u32 argument_count = 0;
 19871:             if (!c_ir_call_arguments(builder, selected, starts, ends, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(starts), &argument_count) || argument_count != 2)
 19872:             {
 19873:                 builder->failure_message = S8("__builtin_complex takes two real floating-point arguments");
 19874:                 builder->failure_token_index = selected->token_index;
 19875:                 return false;
 19876:             }
 19877:             IrValueId real_part = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 19878:             IrValueId imaginary_part = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 19879:             if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_COMPLEX_IMAGINARY)
 19880:             {
 19881:                 if (!child_success)
 19882:                 {
 19883:                     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 19884:                 }
 19885:                 real_part = frame->as.prepared_call.state->first;
 19886:                 imaginary_part = child_value;
 19887:             }
 19888:             else if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_COMPLEX_REAL)
 19889:             {
 19890:                 if (!child_success)
 19891:                 {
 19892:                     return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 19893:                 }
 19894:                 frame->as.prepared_call.state->first = child_value;
 19895:                 return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_COMPLEX_IMAGINARY, starts[1], ends[1], false);
 19896:             }
 19897:             else
 19898:             {
 19899:                 return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_COMPLEX_REAL, starts[0], ends[0], false);
 19900:             }
 19901:             if (real_part.value >= builder->function->value_count || imaginary_part.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 19902:             {
 19903:                 return false;
 19904:             }
 19905:             IrSourceRange complex_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 19906:             IrTypeId element = c_ir_usual_arithmetic_type(builder, builder->function->values[real_part.value].canonical_type,
 19907:                                                           builder->function->values[imaginary_part.value].canonical_type);
 19908:             IrType* element_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element);
 19909:             IrTypeId complex_type = element_type && element_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT ? c_ir_complex_type_for_element(builder, element) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 19910:             if (complex_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19911:             {
 19912:                 builder->failure_message = S8("__builtin_complex takes two real floating-point arguments");
 19913:                 builder->failure_token_index = selected->token_index;
 19914:                 return false;
 19915:             }
 19916:             real_part = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, real_part, element, complex_source);
 19917:             imaginary_part = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, imaginary_part, element, complex_source);
 19918:             if (real_part.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || imaginary_part.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19919:             {
 19920:                 return false;
 19921:             }
 19922:             selected->result = c_ir_complex_compose(builder, complex_type, real_part, imaginary_part, complex_source);
 19923:             if (selected->result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19924:             {
 19925:                 return false;
 19926:             }
 19927:             selected->argument_count = argument_count;
 19928:             selected->emitted = true;
 19929:             remaining -= 1;
 19930:             continue;
 19931:         }
 19932:         // `__builtin_frame_address(0)` answers the current frame's stack
 19933:         // pointer. That is an address inside the frame rather than the frame
 19934:         // base GCC documents, which is what its callers actually use it for:
 19935:         // QuickJS compares one against another to measure recursion depth.
 19936:         // A non-zero level asks for a caller's frame, which needs a frame
 19937:         // pointer chain this backend does not promise, so it is refused
 19938:         // instead of answered approximately.
 19939:         if (selected->builtin_frame_address)
 19940:         {
 19941:             CIrConstantValue frame_level = {0};
 19942:             if (selected->close_index <= selected->open_index + 1 ||
 19943:                 !c_ir_constant_evaluate(builder, selected->open_index + 1, selected->close_index, &frame_level) || frame_level.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER)
 19944:             {
 19945:                 builder->failure_message = S8("__builtin_frame_address requires an integer constant level");

 19947:                 return false;
 19948:             }

 19950:             {

 19952:                 builder->failure_token_index = selected->token_index;
 19953:                 return false;
 19954:             }
 19955:             IrValueId frame_address = c_ir_emit_stack_save(builder, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token));
 19956:             if (frame_address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 19957:             {
 19958:                 return false;
 19959:             }
 19960:             selected->result = frame_address;
 19961:             selected->argument_count = 1;
 19962:             selected->emitted = true;
 19963:             remaining -= 1;
 19964:             continue;
 19965:         }
 19966:         if (selected->builtin_debugtrap)
 19967:         {
 19968:             if (selected->close_index != selected->open_index + 1)
 19969:             {
 19970:                 return false;
 19971:             }
 19972:             IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);

 19977:             selected->emitted = true;
 19978:             remaining -= 1;
 19979:             continue;
 19980:         }

 19982:         {

 19996:             {

 19998:             }

 20002:             selected->emitted = true;
 20003:             remaining -= 1;
 20004:             continue;
 20005:         }
 20006:         if (selected->builtin_clear_cache)
 20007:         {
 20008:             u32 argument_start = selected->open_index + 1;

 20013:                 CToken current = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];

 20016:                     parentheses += 1;

 20080:         }
 20081:         if (selected->builtin_prefetch)

 20089:                 if (c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 20090:                 {
 20091:                     parentheses += 1;
 20092:                 }

 20098:                 {

 20128:         }

 20143:         }
 20144:         if (selected->builtin_va_start || selected->builtin_va_copy || selected->builtin_va_end)

 20147:             if (step != C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FINISHED)
 20148:             {

 20150:             }

 20152:             selected->emitted = true;
 20153:             remaining -= 1;
 20154:             continue;
 20155:         }
 20156:         if (selected->builtin_va_arg)
 20157:         {
 20158:             u32 argument_start = selected->open_index + 1;
 20159:             u32 separator = c_ir_va_arg_type_separator(builder, argument_start, selected->close_index);
 20160:             IrValueId list = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 20161:             IrTypeId result_type = separator < selected->close_index ? c_ir_type_name(builder, separator + 1, selected->close_index) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 20162:             if (separator == argument_start || separator >= selected->close_index || result_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 20163:             {
 20164:                 return false;
 20165:             }
 20166:             // Reading a wide value back is the mirror of passing one, and it
 20167:             // admits the same two shapes for the same reason.  System V
 20168:             // classifies an X87/X87_UP pair into memory, so the caller left
 20169:             // the value in a sixteen-aligned overflow slot and never in the

 20171:             // no x87 class at all is copied by the ordinary eightbyte path.
 20172:             // That second arm stops at the two eightbytes the emitter's
 20173:             // va_arg copies -- `long double _Complex` is the shape past it --
 20174:             // so a wide value it cannot read back is named here rather than
 20175:             // reaching code generation.  Every other wide-float shape still

 20177:             IrType* wide_result_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, result_type);
 20178:             bool wide_va_arg_supported =
 20179:                 c_ir_type_is_f80_x87_shape(builder->program, builder->wide_float_cache, result_type, builder->target) ||
 20180:                 (c_ir_type_is_f80_opaque_aggregate(builder->program, builder->wide_float_cache, result_type, builder->target) &&
 20181:                  wide_result_type && wide_result_type->layout.resolved && wide_result_type->layout.size <= 16);
 20182:             if (!wide_va_arg_supported && c_ir_type_contains_wide_float(builder->program, builder->wide_float_cache, result_type))
 20183:             {
 20184:                 builder->failure_message = S8("C IR lowering does not yet support wide floating-point va_arg");
 20185:                 builder->failure_token_index = selected->token_index;
 20186:                 return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 20187:             }
 20188:             if (continuation == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_ARG)
 20189:             {
 20190:                 if (!child_success)
 20191:                 {

 20193:                 }
 20194:                 list = child_value;
 20195:             }
 20196:             else
 20197:             {
 20198:                 return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_VA_ARG, argument_start, separator, true);
 20199:             }
 20200:             if (!c_ir_va_list_operand_valid(builder, list))
 20201:             {
 20202:                 builder->failure_message = S8("va_arg requires a va_list operand");
 20203:                 builder->failure_token_index = selected->token_index;
 20204:                 return C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FAILED;
 20205:             }
 20206:             selected->result = c_ir_add_result(builder, result_type);
 20207:             IrSourceRange instruction_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 20208:             IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_VA_ARG, result_type);
 20209:             instruction.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
 20210:             instruction.operands[0] = list;
 20211:             instruction.operand_count = 1;
 20212:             instruction.result = selected->result;
 20213:             IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
 20214:             builder->function->values[selected->result.value].definition = id;
 20215:             selected->argument_count = 2;
 20216:             selected->emitted = true;
 20217:             remaining -= 1;
 20218:             continue;
 20219:         }
 20220:         if (selected->builtin_identity)
 20221:         {
 20222:             u32 argument_start = selected->open_index + 1;
 20223:             u32 first_end = selected->close_index;
 20224:             u32 parentheses = 0;
 20225:             u32 brackets = 0;
 20226:             u32 braces = 0;
 20227:             for (u32 index = argument_start; index < selected->close_index; index += 1)
 20228:             {
 20229:                 CToken current = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];
 20230:                 if (c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 20231:                 {
 20232:                     parentheses += 1;
 20233:                 }
 20234:                 else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) && parentheses)
 20235:                 {
 20236:                     parentheses -= 1;
 20237:                 }
 20238:                 else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 20239:                 {
 20240:                     brackets += 1;
 20241:                 }
 20242:                 else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET) && brackets)
 20243:                 {
 20244:                     brackets -= 1;
 20245:                 }
 20246:                 else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
 20247:                 {
 20248:                     braces += 1;
 20249:                 }
 20250:                 else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE) && braces)
 20251:                 {
 20252:                     braces -= 1;
 20253:                 }
 20254:                 else if (!parentheses && !brackets && !braces && c_token_is_punctuator(&current, C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA))
 20255:                 {

 20257:                     break;
 20258:                 }
 20259:             }
 20260:             if (first_end == argument_start || first_end == selected->close_index)
 20261:             {

 20263:             }

 20275:             }
 20276:             selected->argument_count = 1;
 20277:             selected->emitted = true;
 20278:             remaining -= 1;
 20279:             continue;
 20280:         }
 20281:         // The library-shaped builtins — the math intrinsics and the block-memory

 20787:                 separator += 1;
 20788:             }
 20789:             if (separator == index)
 20790:             {
 20791:                 builder->failure_token_index = separator < argument_end ? separator : selected->open_index;
 20792:                 return false;
 20793:             }
 20794:             // One argument past what the callee declares. A prototype makes
 20795:             // that a constraint violation to name; a pre-C23 `()` declares no
 20796:             // parameter list, so the call names its own and there is nothing
 20797:             // to exceed.
 20798:             if (!signature.is_variadic && !signature.is_unprototyped && argument_count >= signature.parameter_count)
 20799:             {
 20800:                 builder->failure_token_index = separator < argument_end ? separator : selected->open_index;
 20801:                 builder->failure_message = c_ir_call_arity_message(

 20803:                     argument_count + 1);
 20804:                 return false;
 20805:             }
 20806:             frame->as.prepared_call.state->argument_count = argument_count;
 20807:             frame->as.prepared_call.state->argument_index = index;
 20808:             frame->as.prepared_call.state->separator = separator;
 20809:             return c_ir_prepared_call_request_expression(builder, frame, C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_CONTINUATION_ARGUMENT, index, separator, false);
 20810:         }
 20811:         // Too few arguments for the parameters the callee does declare. The
 20812:         // direct call reports this from its name resolution, which never
 20813:         // reaches an indirect callee: without this the shortfall used to
 20814:         // travel to IR validation and be reported as a code generation
 20815:         // failure naming an opcode.
 20816:         if (argument_count < signature.parameter_count)
 20817:         {
 20818:             builder->failure_token_index = selected->open_index;
 20819:             builder->failure_message =
 20820:                 c_ir_call_arity_message(builder, selected->indirect ? (String8){0} : c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token),
 20821:                                         signature, argument_count);
 20822:             return false;
 20823:         }
 20824:         selected->argument_count = argument_count;
 20825:         if (selected->indirect)
 20826:         {
 20827:             for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
 20828:             {
 20829:                 if (c_ir_value_contains_label_provenance(builder, selected->arguments[argument_index]))
 20830:                 {
 20831:                     builder->failure_message = S8("a label address may not escape through a function call");
 20832:                     return false;
 20833:                 }
 20834:             }
 20835:             // The call's source range is taken before the callee, because the
 20836:             // retyping below is emitted against it too.
 20837:             IrSourceRange call_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 20838:             // Through a pre-C23 `()` pointer the call names its own
 20839:             // parameters, so the pointer takes the call's signature; see
 20840:             // c_ir_unprototyped_call_type.
 20841:             if (signature.is_unprototyped && argument_count > signature.parameter_count)
 20842:             {
 20843:                 IrTypeId callee_type =
 20844:                     c_ir_unprototyped_call_type(builder, signature.return_type, selected->arguments, argument_count);
 20845:                 IrTypeId callee_pointer_type = callee_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 20846:                                                    ? c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, callee_type)
 20847:                                                    : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;

 20849:                                       ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, indirect_callee, callee_pointer_type, call_source)

 20852:                 {
 20853:                     return false;
 20854:                 }
 20855:             }
 20856:             bool terminates = signature.is_noreturn && !c_ir_lowering_resumes_after_call(builder);
 20857:             IrValueId result = signature.returns_void ? (terminates ? c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID)
 20858:                                                       : c_ir_add_result(builder, signature.return_type);
 20859:             IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, argument_count + 1);

 20861:             for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
 20862:             {
 20863:                 operands[argument_index + 1] = selected->arguments[argument_index];
 20864:             }
 20865:             IrInstruction call = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CALL, signature.return_type);
 20866:             call.operands = operands;
 20867:             call.operand_count = argument_count + 1;
 20868:             call.result = signature.returns_void ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : result;
 20869:             IrInstructionId call_id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, call, call_source);
 20870:             if (!signature.returns_void)
 20871:             {
 20872:                 builder->function->values[result.value].definition = call_id;
 20873:                 selected->result = result;
 20874:             }
 20875:             else
 20876:             {
 20877:                 selected->result = terminates ? result : c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token);
 20878:             }
 20879:             c_ir_end_control_flow_after_call(builder, signature.is_noreturn, call_source);
 20880:         }
 20881:         else
 20882:         {
 20883:             selected->result = c_ir_emit_call_values(builder, token, declaration_index, selected->arguments, argument_count);
 20884:         }
 20885:         if (selected->result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 20886:         {
 20887:             return false;
 20888:         }
 20889:         selected->emitted = true;
 20890:         remaining -= 1;
 20891:     } while (false);
 20892:     BUSTER_CHECK(!remaining);
 20893:     return true;
 20894: }

 20896: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_prepare_calls_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame)
 20897: {
 20898:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 20899:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_BEGIN)
 20900:     {
 20901:         frame->as.prepare_calls.previous_preparing_calls = builder->preparing_calls;
 20902:         if (builder->preparing_calls)
 20903:         {
 20904:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, true, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 20905:             return;
 20906:         }
 20907:         builder->preparing_calls = true;
 20908:         if (!c_ir_prepare_calls_discover(builder, frame->as.prepare_calls.start, frame->as.prepare_calls.end,
 20909:                                          &frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_order, &frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_count))
 20910:         {
 20911:             builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepare_calls.previous_preparing_calls;
 20912:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 20913:             return;
 20914:         }
 20915:         frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_index = 0;
 20916:         frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
 20917:     }
 20918:     else if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD)
 20919:     {
 20920:         if (!machine->child_result.success)
 20921:         {
 20922:             builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepare_calls.previous_preparing_calls;
 20923:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 20924:             return;
 20925:         }
 20926:         frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_index += 1;
 20927:     }
 20928:     if (frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_index >= frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_count)
 20929:     {
 20930:         builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepare_calls.previous_preparing_calls;
 20931:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, true, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 20932:         return;
 20933:     }
 20934:     u32 call_index = frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_order[frame->as.prepare_calls.emission_index];
 20935:     CIrPreparedCallState* state = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, CIrPreparedCallState, 1);
 20936:     *state = (CIrPreparedCallState){0};
 20937:     frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
 20938:     if (!c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
 20939:                                             .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_PREPARED_CALL,
 20940:                                             .as.prepared_call =
 20941:                                                 {
 20942:                                                     .state = state,
 20943:                                                     .call_index = call_index,
 20944:                                                 },
 20945:                                         }))
 20946:     {
 20947:         builder->preparing_calls = frame->as.prepare_calls.previous_preparing_calls;
 20948:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 20949:     }
 20950: }

 20952: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_operation(CConditionalOperator operation, IrUnaryOperation* unary, IrBinaryOperation* binary)
 20953: {
 20954:     *unary = IR_UNARY_COUNT;
 20955:     *binary = IR_BINARY_COUNT;
 20956:     switch (operation)
 20957:     {
 20958:     case C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_PLUS:
 20959:         return true;
 20960:     case C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS:
 20961:         *unary = IR_UNARY_INTEGER_NEGATE;
 20962:         return true;
 20963:     case C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT:
 20964:         *unary = IR_UNARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_NOT;
 20965:         return true;
 20966:     case C_CONDITIONAL_ADDRESS_OF:
 20967:     case C_CONDITIONAL_DEREFERENCE:
 20968:     case C_CONDITIONAL_CAST:
 20969:     case C_CONDITIONAL_REAL_PART:
 20970:     case C_CONDITIONAL_IMAGINARY_PART:
 20971:         return true;
 20972:     case C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY:
 20973:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY;
 20974:         return true;
 20975:     case C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE:
 20976:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SIGNED_DIVIDE;
 20977:         return true;
 20978:     case C_CONDITIONAL_REMAINDER:
 20979:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SIGNED_REMAINDER;
 20980:         return true;
 20981:     case C_CONDITIONAL_ADD:
 20982:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD;
 20983:         return true;
 20984:     case C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT:
 20985:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT;
 20986:         return true;
 20987:     case C_CONDITIONAL_SHIFT_LEFT:
 20988:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT;
 20989:         return true;
 20990:     case C_CONDITIONAL_SHIFT_RIGHT:
 20991:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT;
 20992:         return true;
 20993:     case C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_AND:
 20994:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND;
 20995:         return true;
 20996:     case C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_XOR:
 20997:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_XOR;
 20998:         return true;
 20999:     case C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_OR:
 21000:         *binary = IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR;
 21001:         return true;
 21002:     case C_CONDITIONAL_LESS:
 21003:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SIGNED_LESS;
 21004:         return true;
 21005:     case C_CONDITIONAL_LESS_EQUAL:
 21006:         *binary = IR_BINARY_SIGNED_LESS_EQUAL;
 21007:         return true;
--- lines 21096-21296 ---
 21096: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_vector_splat(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrTypeId vector_type, IrSourceRange source)
 21097: {
 21098:     IrType* vector = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, vector_type);
 21099:     if (!vector || vector->kind != IR_TYPE_VECTOR || !vector->element_count || vector->element_count > UINT32_MAX)
 21100:     {
 21101:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 21102:     }
 21103:     value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, vector->element_type, source);
 21104:     if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 21105:     {
 21106:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 21107:     }
 21108:     u32 count = (u32)vector->element_count;
 21109:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, count);
 21110:     for (u32 index = 0; index < count; index += 1)
 21111:     {
 21112:         operands[index] = value;
 21113:     }
 21114:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, vector_type);
 21115:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
 21116:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ARRAY, vector_type);
 21117:     instruction.operands = operands;
 21118:     instruction.operand_count = count;
 21119:     instruction.result = result;
 21120:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
 21121:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
 21122:     return result;
 21123: }
 21124: 
 21125: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_scalarize_binary16_vector_operation(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrUnaryOperation unary, IrBinaryOperation binary,
 21126:                                                                       IrValueId* operands, u32 operand_count, IrTypeId vector_type,
 21127:                                                                       IrTypeId result_type, bool comparison, IrSourceRange source)
 21128: {
 21129:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 21130:     IrType* vector = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, vector_type);
 21131:     IrType* result_vector = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, result_type);
 21132:     bool valid = vector && result_vector && vector->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && result_vector->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR &&
 21133:                  vector->element_count == result_vector->element_count && vector->element_count && vector->element_count <= UINT32_MAX &&
 21134:                  operand_count && operand_count <= 2;
 21135:     IrBinaryOperation scalar_binary = IR_BINARY_COUNT;
 21136:     if (valid && binary != IR_BINARY_COUNT)
 21137:     {
 21138:         scalar_binary = binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_ADD             ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_ADD
 21139:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_SUBTRACT       ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_SUBTRACT
 21140:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_MULTIPLY       ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_MULTIPLY
 21141:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_DIVIDE         ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_DIVIDE
 21142:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_EQUAL          ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_EQUAL
 21143:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL      ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL
 21144:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_LESS           ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS
 21145:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_LESS_EQUAL     ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS_EQUAL
 21146:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_GREATER        ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER
 21147:                         : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL  ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL
 21148:                                                                            : IR_BINARY_COUNT;
 21149:         valid = scalar_binary != IR_BINARY_COUNT;
 21150:     }
 21151:     if (valid && unary != IR_UNARY_COUNT)
 21152:     {
 21153:         valid = unary == IR_UNARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_NEGATE;
 21154:     }
 21155:     IrValueId* slots = valid ? arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, operand_count) : 0;
 21156:     for (u32 operand_index = 0; valid && operand_index < operand_count; operand_index += 1)
 21157:     {
 21158:         slots[operand_index] = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, vector_type, source);
 21159:         valid = slots[operand_index].value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 21160:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, slots[operand_index], vector_type, operands[operand_index], source);
 21161:     }
 21162:     u32 lane_count = valid ? (u32)vector->element_count : 0;
 21163:     IrValueId* lanes = valid ? arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, lane_count) : 0;
 21164:     for (u32 lane_index = 0; valid && lane_index < lane_count; lane_index += 1)
 21165:     {
 21166:         IrValueId lane_number = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, lane_index, false, (CToken){0}, builder->s32_type);
 21167:         IrValueId lane_values[2] = {IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID};
 21168:         valid = lane_number.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 21169:         for (u32 operand_index = 0; valid && operand_index < operand_count; operand_index += 1)
 21170:         {
 21171:             IrValueId lane_place = c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, slots[operand_index], lane_number, source);
 21172:             lane_values[operand_index] = lane_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 21173:                                              ? c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, lane_place, vector->element_type, source)
 21174:                                              : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 21175:             valid = lane_values[operand_index].value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 21176:         }
 21177:         IrValueId lane_result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 21178:         if (valid && unary != IR_UNARY_COUNT)
 21179:         {
 21180:             lane_result = c_ir_emit_unary_value(builder, lane_values[0], vector->element_type, IR_UNARY_FLOAT_NEGATE, source);
 21181:         }
 21182:         else if (valid)
 21183:         {
 21184:             lane_result = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, lane_values[0], lane_values[1],
 21185:                                                  comparison ? builder->bool_type : vector->element_type, scalar_binary, source);
 21186:         }
 21187:         if (valid && comparison && lane_result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 21188:         {
 21189:             IrValueId as_integer = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, lane_result, builder->s32_type, source);
 21190:             IrValueId all_bits = as_integer.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 21191:                                      ? c_ir_emit_unary_value(builder, as_integer, builder->s32_type, IR_UNARY_INTEGER_NEGATE, source)
 21192:                                      : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 21193:             lane_result = all_bits.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
 21194:                               ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, all_bits, result_vector->element_type, source)
 21195:                               : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 21196:         }
 21197:         valid = lane_result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 21198:         if (valid)
 21199:         {
 21200:             lanes[lane_index] = lane_result;
 21201:         }
 21202:     }
 21203:     if (valid)
 21204:     {
 21205:         result = c_ir_add_result(builder, result_type);
 21206:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ARRAY, result_type);
 21207:         instruction.operands = lanes;
 21208:         instruction.operand_count = lane_count;
 21209:         instruction.result = result;
 21210:         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
 21211:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
 21212:     }
 21213:     return result;
 21214: }

 21216: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_apply_vector_operation(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrUnaryOperation unary, IrBinaryOperation binary, IrValueId* values,
 21217:                                                      u32* value_count, u32 first, u32 operand_count, IrTypeId vector_type, IrSourceRange source)
 21218: {
 21219:     IrType* vector = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, vector_type);
 21220:     IrType* element = vector ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, vector->element_type) : 0;
 21221:     if (!vector || vector->kind != IR_TYPE_VECTOR || !element || (element->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER && element->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT))
 21222:     {
 21223:         return false;
 21224:     }
 21225:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, operand_count);
 21226:     for (u32 index = 0; index < operand_count; index += 1)
 21227:     {
 21228:         IrValueId operand = values[first + index];
 21229:         IrTypeId operand_type = builder->function->values[operand.value].canonical_type;
 21230:         if (operand_type.value == vector_type.value)
 21231:         {
 21232:             operands[index] = operand;
 21233:         }
 21234:         else
 21235:         {
 21236:             operands[index] = c_ir_vector_splat(builder, operand, vector_type, source);
 21237:         }
 21238:         if (operands[index].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 21239:         {
 21240:             return false;
 21241:         }
 21242:     }
 21243:     if (unary != IR_UNARY_COUNT)
 21244:     {
 21245:         if (unary == IR_UNARY_INTEGER_NEGATE)
 21246:         {
 21247:             unary = element->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT ? IR_UNARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_NEGATE : IR_UNARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_NEGATE;
 21248:         }
 21249:         else if (unary == IR_UNARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_NOT && element->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
 21250:         {
 21251:             unary = IR_UNARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_NOT;
 21252:         }
 21253:         else
 21254:         {
 21255:             return false;
 21256:         }
 21257:     }
 21258:     bool comparison = false;
 21259:     if (binary != IR_BINARY_COUNT)
 21260:     {
 21261:         switch (binary)
 21262:         {
 21263:         case IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD:
 21264:             binary = element->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT ? IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_ADD : IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_ADD;
 21265:             break;
 21266:         case IR_BINARY_INTEGER_SUBTRACT:
 21267:             binary = element->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT ? IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_SUBTRACT : IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_SUBTRACT;
 21268:             break;
 21269:         case IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY:
 21270:             binary = element->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT ? IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_MULTIPLY : IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_MULTIPLY;
 21271:             break;
 21272:         case IR_BINARY_SIGNED_DIVIDE:
 21273:             binary = element->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT ? IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_DIVIDE
 21274:                      : element->is_signed           ? IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_DIVIDE
 21275:                                                     : IR_BINARY_VECTOR_UNSIGNED_DIVIDE;
 21276:             break;
 21277:         case IR_BINARY_SIGNED_REMAINDER:
 21278:             if (element->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
 21279:             {
 21280:                 return false;
 21281:             }
 21282:             binary = element->is_signed ? IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_REMAINDER : IR_BINARY_VECTOR_UNSIGNED_REMAINDER;
 21283:             break;
 21284:         case IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT:
 21285:             if (element->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
 21286:             {
 21287:                 return false;
 21288:             }
 21289:             binary = IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SHIFT_LEFT;
 21290:             break;
 21291:         case IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT:
 21292:             if (element->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
 21293:             {
 21294:                 return false;
 21295:             }
 21296:             binary = element->is_signed ? IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT : IR_BINARY_VECTOR_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT;
--- lines 21831-22031 ---
 21831:         return false;
 21832:     }
 21833:     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_PLUS)
 21834:     {
 21835:         bool valid = *value_count != 0;
 21836:         if (valid)
 21837:         {
 21838:             IrValueId value = values[*value_count - 1];
 21839:             values[*value_count - 1] = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, c_ir_integer_promoted_value_type(builder, value), source);
 21840:             valid = values[*value_count - 1].value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 21841:         }
 21842:         return valid;
 21843:     }
 21844:     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_REAL_PART || operation == C_CONDITIONAL_IMAGINARY_PART)
 21845:     {
 21846:         if (!*value_count)
 21847:         {
 21848:             return false;
 21849:         }
 21850:         u32 first_operand = *value_count - 1;
 21851:         IrValueId result = c_ir_emit_complex_part_operator(builder, values[first_operand], operation == C_CONDITIONAL_IMAGINARY_PART, source);
 21852:         if (result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 21853:         {
 21854:             return false;
 21855:         }
 21856:         *value_count = first_operand;
 21857:         values[(*value_count)++] = result;
 21858:         return true;
 21859:     }
 21860:     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_NOT)
 21861:     {
 21862:         if (!*value_count)
 21863:         {
 21864:             return false;
 21865:         }
 21866:         u32 first = *value_count - 1;
 21867:         IrValueId operand = c_ir_truth_value(builder, values[first], source);
 21868:         if (operand.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 21869:         {

 21871:         }

 21873:         operands[0] = operand;

 21879:         instruction.unary_operation = IR_UNARY_BOOLEAN_NOT;
 21880:         instruction.result = result;
 21881:         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
 21882:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
 21883:         result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, result, builder->s32_type, source);
 21884:         if (result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 21885:         {
 21886:             return false;
 21887:         }
 21888:         *value_count = first;
 21889:         values[(*value_count)++] = result;
 21890:         return true;
 21891:     }
 21892:     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_CAST)
 21893:     {
 21894:         if (!*value_count || cast_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 21895:         {
 21896:             return false;
 21897:         }
 21898:         u32 first = *value_count - 1;
 21899:         IrType* source_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[values[first].value].canonical_type);
 21900:         IrType* destination_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, cast_type);
 21901:         IrValueId result = destination_type && destination_type->kind == IR_TYPE_VOID ? c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0})
 21902:                            : source_type && source_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY && destination_type && destination_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER
 21903:                                ? c_ir_decay_array(builder, values[first], cast_type, source)
 21904:                                : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, values[first], cast_type, source);
 21905:         if (result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 21906:         {
 21907:             return false;
 21908:         }
 21909:         // An explicit cast produces an ordinary value even when no machine
 21910:         // conversion is needed. It must not retain the operand's bit-field.
 21911:         if (result.value < builder->unsigned_bit_field_value_capacity)
 21912:         {
 21913:             builder->unsigned_bit_field_values[result.value] = 0;
 21914:         }
 21915:         // Canonical scalar pointers flatten pointer-to-VLA types. An explicit
 21916:         // cast such as (char *)&rows[i] must discard both row stride and the
 21917:         // array-lvalue witness even when that canonical cast is an identity.
 21918:         CIrVlaValue cast_shape = c_ir_vla_value(builder, result);
 21919:         if (cast_shape.counts)
 21920:         {
 21921:             IrType* result_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[result.value].canonical_type);
 21922:             IrTypeId element = result_type->element_type;
 21923:             IrValueId place = c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, result, source);
 21924:             result = place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, element, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 21925:             if (result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 21926:             {
 21927:                 return false;
 21928:             }
 21929:         }
 21930:         *value_count = first;
 21931:         values[(*value_count)++] = result;
 21932:         return true;
 21933:     }
 21934:     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_COMMA)
 21935:     {
 21936:         if (*value_count < 2)
 21937:         {
 21938:             return false;
 21939:         }
 21940:         values[*value_count - 2] = c_ir_vla_pointer_rvalue(builder, values[*value_count - 1], source);
 21941:         *value_count -= 1;
 21942:         return true;
 21943:     }
 21944:     bool pointer_operator = operation == C_CONDITIONAL_ADDRESS_OF || operation == C_CONDITIONAL_DEREFERENCE;
 21945:     u32 operand_count = unary != IR_UNARY_COUNT || pointer_operator ? 1 : 2;
 21946:     if (*value_count < operand_count)
 21947:     {
 21948:         return false;
 21949:     }
 21950:     u32 first = *value_count - operand_count;
 21951:     if (builder->vla_value_count)
 21952:     {
 21953:         for (u32 operand_index = first; operand_index < *value_count; operand_index += 1)
 21954:         {
 21955:             values[operand_index] = c_ir_vla_flat_pointer(builder, values[operand_index], source);
 21956:             if (values[operand_index].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 21957:             {
 21958:                 return false;
 21959:             }
 21960:         }
 21961:     }
 21962:     if (pointer_operator)
 21963:     {
