 22750: 
 22751: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_compound_assignment(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, CConditionalOperator operation,
 22752:                                                        IrValueId right, IrSourceRange source, IrValueId* previous_out, IrValueId* result_out)
 22753: {
 22754:     IrType* place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
 22755:     bool atomic = place_type && place_type->is_atomic;
 22756:     // The operation consumes an unqualified value even when the destination
 22757:     // place is volatile. Loads and stores retain that place's access flags.
 22758:     IrTypeId value_type = place_type && (atomic || place_type->is_volatile) ? place_type->unqualified_type : type;
 22759:     IrType* unqualified = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
 22760:     bool pointer_arithmetic = unqualified && unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_ADD || operation == C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT);
 22761:     IrValueId previous = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 22762:     IrValueId operation_right = right;
 22763:     if (pointer_arithmetic && atomic)
 22764:     {
 22765:         IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, unqualified->element_type);
 22766:         right = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, right, builder->ptrdiff_type, source);
 22767:         if (!element || !element->layout.resolved || !element->layout.size || right.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 22768:         {
 22769:             return false;
 22770:         }
 22771:         IrValueId scale = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, element->layout.size, false, (CToken){0}, builder->ptrdiff_type);
 22772:         right = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, right, scale, builder->ptrdiff_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, source);
 22773:     }
 22774:     else if (!pointer_arithmetic && !c_ir_unsigned_bit_field_promotes_to_int(builder, c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place)))
 22775:     {
 22776:         right = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, right, value_type, source);
 22777:         operation_right = right;
 22778:     }
 22779:     if (right.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 22780:     {
 22781:         return false;
 22782:     }
 22783:     if (atomic && unqualified && unqualified->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 22784:     {
 22785:         // No hardware has a floating-point atomic read-modify-write, so this
 22786:         // one is a compare-exchange loop over the object's bit pattern rather
 22787:         // than a single instruction.
 22788:         return c_ir_emit_atomic_float_update(builder, place, type, value_type, operation, operation_right, source, previous_out, result_out);
 22789:     }
 22790:     if (atomic)
 22791:     {
 22792:         IrAtomicOperation atomic_operation = IR_ATOMIC_OPERATION_COUNT;
 22793:         if (!unqualified || (unqualified->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER && !pointer_arithmetic) || !c_ir_atomic_operation(operation, &atomic_operation))
 22794:         {
 22795:             return false;
 22796:         }
 22797:         previous = c_ir_add_result(builder, value_type);
 22798:         IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 2);
 22799:         operands[0] = place;
 22800:         operands[1] = right;
 22801:         IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
 22802:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_READ_MODIFY_WRITE, value_type);
 22803:         instruction.operands = operands;
 22804:         instruction.operand_count = 2;
 22805:         instruction.memory_order = IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL;
 22806:         instruction.atomic_operation = (u8)atomic_operation;
 22807:         instruction.result = previous;
 22808:         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
 22809:         builder->function->values[previous.value].definition = id;
 22810:     }
 22811:     else
 22812:     {
 22813:         previous = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, place, type, source);
 22814:     }
 22815:     IrValueId values[2] = {
 22816:         previous,
 22817:         operation_right,
 22818:     };
 22819:     u32 value_count = 2;
 22820:     if (previous.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_apply_operation(builder, operation, values, &value_count, source, value_type) || value_count != 1 ||
 22821:         (!atomic && !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, place, type, values[0], source)))
 22822:     {
 22823:         return false;
 22824:     }
 22825:     if (previous_out)
 22826:     {
 22827:         *previous_out = previous;
 22828:     }
 22829:     if (result_out)
 22830:     {
 22831:         // The value of `E op= x` is what E holds afterwards, in E's own type.
 22832:         // The operation runs in the promoted type, so a narrower object's
 22833:         // result comes back down here -- `(data[i] += 2) == 0` has to see the
 22834:         // stored byte, not the 256 the addition produced.
 22835:         if (!atomic && values[0].value < builder->function->value_count &&
 22836:             builder->function->values[values[0].value].canonical_type.value != value_type.value)
 22837:         {
 22838:             values[0] = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, values[0], value_type, source);
 22839:             if (values[0].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 22840:             {
 22841:                 return false;
 22842:             }
 22843:         }
 22844:         *result_out = c_ir_bit_field_assignment_value(builder, place, values[0], source);
 22845:     }
 22846:     return true;
 22847: }
 22848: 
 22849: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_compound_assignment_operator(CToken token, CConditionalOperator* operation)
 22850: {
 22851:     if (token.kind != C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR)
 22852:     {
 22853:         return false;
 22854:     }
 22855:     switch (token.punctuator)
 22856:     {
 22857:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR_ASSIGN:
 22858:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY;
 22859:         return true;
 22860:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_SLASH_ASSIGN:
 22861:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE;
 22862:         return true;
 22863:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_PERCENT_ASSIGN:
 22864:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_REMAINDER;
 22865:         return true;
 22866:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_ASSIGN:
 22867:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_ADD;
 22868:         return true;
 22869:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_ASSIGN:
 22870:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT;
 22871:         return true;
 22872:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_SHIFT_LEFT_ASSIGN:
 22873:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_SHIFT_LEFT;
 22874:         return true;
 22875:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_SHIFT_RIGHT_ASSIGN:
 22876:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_SHIFT_RIGHT;
 22877:         return true;
 22878:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_AMPERSAND_ASSIGN:
 22879:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_AND;
 22880:         return true;
 22881:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_CARET_ASSIGN:
 22882:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_XOR;
 22883:         return true;
 22884:     case C_PUNCTUATOR_PIPE_ASSIGN:
 22885:         *operation = C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_OR;
 22886:         return true;
 22887:     default:
 22888:         return false;
 22889:     }
 22890: }
 22891: 
 22892: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_assignment_operator(CToken token)
 22893: {
 22894:     CConditionalOperator operation = C_CONDITIONAL_OPERATOR_COUNT;
 22895:     return c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ASSIGN) || c_ir_compound_assignment_operator(token, &operation);
 22896: }
 22897: 
 22898: // Type-only queries also serve GNU `typeof` operands.  Keep the declaration
 22899: // near the type-name parser because stb_ds (and other GNU headers) use
 22900: // `__typeof__((object)->field)`, whose operand is a full expression rather
 22901: // than the identifier-only chain handled by the fast path below.
--- lines 23689-24172 ---
 23689:         }
 23690:         if (selected == UINT64_MAX)
 23691:         {
 23692:             return false;
 23693:         }
 23694:         next_index = selected + 1;
 23695:         count = BUSTER_MAX(count, next_index);
 23696:         item_start = index + 1;
 23697:     }
 23698:     *count_out = count;
 23699:     return count != 0;
 23700: }
 23701: 
 23702: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_compound_literal_type_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 type_start, u32 type_end, u32 initializer_open,
 23703:                                                                  u32 initializer_close)
 23704: {
 23705:     IrTypeId type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 23706:     bool resolved = c_ir_query_type_name(builder, type_start, type_end, true, &type);
 23707:     if (!resolved && builder->queries->has_request)
 23708:     {
 23709:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 23710:     }
 23711:     if (type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 23712:     {
 23713:         return type;
 23714:     }
 23715:     if (type_end < type_start + 2 || !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[type_end - 2], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) ||
 23716:         !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[type_end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET))
 23717:     {
 23718:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 23719:     }
 23720:     IrTypeId element = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 23721:     resolved = c_ir_query_type_name(builder, type_start, type_end - 2, true, &element);
 23722:     if (!resolved && builder->queries->has_request)
 23723:     {
 23724:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 23725:     }
 23726:     u64 element_count = 0;
 23727:     IrTypeId result;
 23728:     if (element.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_query_compound_element_count(builder, initializer_open, initializer_close, &element_count))
 23729:     {
 23730:         result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 23731:     }
 23732:     else
 23733:     {
 23734:         result = c_ir_add_array_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, element, element_count);
 23735:     }
 23736: 
 23737:     return result;
 23738: }
 23739: 
 23740: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_compound_literal_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 type_start, u32 type_end, u32 initializer_open, u32 initializer_close)
 23741: {
 23742:     CIrQueryFrame result = {0};
 23743:     CIrQueryFrame root = {
 23744:         .start = type_start,
 23745:         .end = type_end,
 23746:         .third = initializer_open,
 23747:         .fourth = initializer_close,
 23748:         .kind = C_IR_QUERY_FRAME_COMPOUND_TYPE,
 23749:     };
 23750:     if (!c_ir_query_execute(builder, root, &result) || !result.success)
 23751:     {
 23752:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 23753:     }
 23754:     return result.result_type;
 23755: }
 23756: 
 23757: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_increment(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrValueId previous, CToken token, bool prefix)
 23758: {
 23759:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 1, false, token);
 23760:     IrType* place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
 23761:     if (place_type && place_type->is_atomic)
 23762:     {
 23763:         IrValueId atomic_previous = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 23764:         IrValueId atomic_result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 23765:         if (!c_ir_emit_compound_assignment(builder, place, type,
 23766:                                            c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ? C_CONDITIONAL_ADD : C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT, one,
 23767:                                            c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token), &atomic_previous, &atomic_result))
 23768:         {
 23769:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 23770:         }
 23771:         return prefix ? atomic_result : atomic_previous;
 23772:     }
 23773:     IrValueId values[2] = {
 23774:         previous,
 23775:         one,
 23776:     };
 23777:     u32 value_count = 2;
 23778:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 23779:     if (!c_ir_apply_operation(builder, c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ? C_CONDITIONAL_ADD : C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT, values, &value_count,
 23780:                               source, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID) ||
 23781:         value_count != 1 || !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, place, type, values[0], source))
 23782:     {
 23783:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 23784:     }
 23785:     if (prefix && values[0].value < builder->function->value_count && builder->function->values[values[0].value].canonical_type.value != type.value)
 23786:     {
 23787:         // `++E` has the value E holds after the store, which is the value in
 23788:         // E's own type: the addition ran in the promoted type, so a narrower
 23789:         // object's result has to come back down before anything reads it.
 23790:         // SQLite carries its page-header cell count into the high byte with
 23791:         // `if( (++data[hdr+4])==0 ) data[hdr+3]++;`, and that carry is lost
 23792:         // when the comparison sees 256 instead of 0.
 23793:         values[0] = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, values[0], type, source);
 23794:     }
 23795:     return prefix ? c_ir_bit_field_assignment_value(builder, place, values[0], source) : c_ir_vla_pointer_rvalue(builder, previous, source);
 23796: }
 23797: 
 23798: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_postfix_update_at(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 index, u32 end)
 23799: {
 23800:     return index + 1 < end && (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ||
 23801:                                c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS));
 23802: }
 23803: 
 23804: // Aggregate operands are captured values, while volatile qualifiers belong to
 23805: // their destination places. If a conversion retained the unqualified value,
 23806: // initialize explicit storage through the ordinary qualified STORE contract.
 23807: // Keep exact constructor typing and evaluate each initializer only once.
 23808: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_initializer_capture(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type_id, IrValueId* operands,
 23809:                                                         u64* fields, u32 count, IrSourceRange source)
 23810: {
 23811:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
 23812:     bool array = type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR;
 23813:     bool storage = false;
 23814:     for (u32 index = 0; index < count && !storage; index += 1)
 23815:     {
 23816:         IrTypeId field_type = array ? type->element_type : type->fields[fields[index]].type;
 23817:         IrTypeId operand_type = builder->function->values[operands[index].value].canonical_type;
 23818:         storage = operand_type.value != field_type.value &&
 23819:                   ir_types_differ_only_in_volatile(&builder->program->types, operand_type, field_type);
 23820:     }
 23821:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 23822:     if (storage)
 23823:     {
 23824:         IrValueId place = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, type_id, source);
 23825:         bool valid = place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 23826:         for (u32 index = 0; index < count && valid; index += 1)
 23827:         {
 23828:             IrValueId field;
 23829:             if (array)
 23830:             {
 23831:                 IrValueId offset = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, index, false, (CToken){0}, builder->size_type);
 23832:                 field = offset.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, place, offset, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 23833:             }
 23834:             else
 23835:             {
 23836:                 field = c_ir_emit_field_index_place(builder, place, (u32)fields[index], source);
 23837:             }
 23838:             IrTypeId field_type = array ? type->element_type : type->fields[fields[index]].type;
 23839:             valid = field.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, field, field_type, operands[index], source);
 23840:         }
 23841:         if (valid)
 23842:         {
 23843:             result = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, place, type_id, source);
 23844:         }
 23845:     }
 23846:     else
 23847:     {
 23848:         result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type_id);
 23849:         if (result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 23850:         {
 23851:             IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(array ? IR_OPCODE_ARRAY : IR_OPCODE_AGGREGATE, type_id);
 23852:             instruction.operands = operands;
 23853:             instruction.operand_count = count;
 23854:             instruction.immediates = fields;
 23855:             instruction.immediate_count = array ? 0 : (u16)count;
 23856:             instruction.result = result;
 23857:             IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, source);
 23858:             builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
 23859:         }
 23860:     }
 23861:     return result;
 23862: }
 23863: 
 23864: #define C_IR_BOUNDED_ZERO_STORAGE_MIN_BYTES 4096u
 23865: 
 23866: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_zero_storage_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId root)
 23867: {
 23868:     IrType* root_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, root);
 23869:     bool compatible = root_type && root_type->layout.resolved && root_type->layout.size >= C_IR_BOUNDED_ZERO_STORAGE_MIN_BYTES &&
 23870:                       (root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || root_type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION);
 23871:     if (compatible)
 23872:     {
 23873:         u32 capacity = builder->program->types.count;
 23874:         IrTypeId* pending = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, IrTypeId, capacity);
 23875:         u8* seen = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, u8, capacity);
 23876:         memset(seen, 0, capacity);
 23877:         u32 count = 1;
 23878:         pending[0] = root;
 23879:         seen[root.value] = 1;
 23880:         for (u32 index = 0; compatible && index < count; index += 1)
 23881:         {
 23882:             IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pending[index]);
 23883:             compatible = type && type->layout.resolved && !type->is_atomic && !type->is_volatile;
 23884:             if (compatible)
 23885:             {
 23886:                 bool array = type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR;
 23887:                 bool record = type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION;
 23888:                 compatible = array || record || type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN ||
 23889:                              type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT;
 23890:                 u32 children = array ? 1 : record ? type->field_count : 0;
 23891:                 for (u32 child = 0; compatible && child < children; child += 1)
 23892:                 {
 23893:                     IrTypeId id = array ? type->element_type : type->fields[child].type;
 23894:                     compatible = id.value < capacity;
 23895:                     if (compatible && !seen[id.value])
 23896:                     {
 23897:                         seen[id.value] = 1;
 23898:                         pending[count++] = id;
 23899:                     }
 23900:                 }
 23901:             }
 23902:         }
 23903:     }
 23904:     return compatible;
 23905: }
 23906: 
 23907: // Large aggregate zero initialization must not expand into one canonical
 23908: // value and spill slot per byte. Windows ARM64 unwind records cannot describe
 23909: // the multi-megabyte functions that expansion produces. Check representations
 23910: // and qualifiers before using a byte loop; this introduces no libc dependency.
 23911: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_zero_storage(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type_id,
 23912:                                              u64 count, CToken token)
 23913: {
 23914:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 23915:     IrTypeId element_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR);
 23916:     IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, element_type);
 23917:     IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type_id, source);
 23918:     IrValueId array = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, pointer_type, source);
 23919:     IrValueId cursor = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, builder->size_type, source);
 23920:     IrValueId initial = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, builder->size_type);
 23921:     IrValueId limit = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, count, false, token, builder->size_type);
 23922:     IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, builder->size_type);
 23923:     IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, element_type);
 23924:     IrBlockId body = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 23925:     IrBlockId done = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 23926:     bool valid = array.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && cursor.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 23927:                  initial.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && limit.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 23928:                  one.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && zero.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 23929:                  body.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && done.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 23930:     valid = valid && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, initial, source) &&
 23931:             c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &body, 1, source) && c_ir_switch_block(builder, body);
 23932:     if (valid)
 23933:     {
 23934:         IrValueId index = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, source);
 23935:         IrValueId element = c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, array, index, source);
 23936:         IrValueId next = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, index, one, builder->size_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_ADD, source);
 23937:         IrValueId finished = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, next, limit, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_EQUAL, source);
 23938:         IrBlockId targets[2] = {done, body};
 23939:         valid = index.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && element.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 23940:                 next.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && finished.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 23941:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, element, element_type, zero, source) &&
 23942:                 c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, cursor, builder->size_type, next, source) &&
 23943:                 c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &finished, 1, targets, 2, source) &&
 23944:                 c_ir_switch_block(builder, done);
 23945:     }
 23946:     return valid;
 23947: }
 23948: 
 23949: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_zero_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId root_type, CToken token)
 23950: {
 23951:     typedef enum CIrZeroTaskKind
 23952:     {
 23953:         C_IR_ZERO_TASK_VALUE,
 23954:         C_IR_ZERO_TASK_COMPLETE,
 23955:     } CIrZeroTaskKind;
 23956:     typedef struct CIrZeroTask CIrZeroTask;
 23957:     struct CIrZeroTask
 23958:     {
 23959:         IrValueId* output;
 23960:         IrValueId* operands;
 23961:         u64* fields;
 23962:         IrTypeId type;
 23963:         u32 operand_count;
 23964:         CIrZeroTaskKind kind;
 23965:     };
 23966:     IrType* root = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, root_type);
 23967:     if (!root || !root->layout.resolved || root->layout.size > (UINT32_MAX - 64) / 8)
 23968:     {
 23969:         builder->failure_message = !root                    ? S8("cannot zero-initialize an unresolved IR type")
 23970:                                    : !root->layout.resolved ? S8("cannot zero-initialize an aggregate with unresolved layout")
 23971:                                                             : S8("aggregate is too large to zero-initialize");
 23972:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 23973:     }
 23974:     u32 capacity = (u32)(root->layout.size * 8 + 64);
 23975:     CIrZeroTask* tasks = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, CIrZeroTask, capacity);
 23976:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 23977:     u32 task_count = 1;
 23978:     tasks[0] = (CIrZeroTask){
 23979:         .output = &result,
 23980:         .type = root_type,
 23981:     };
 23982:     while (task_count)
 23983:     {
 23984:         CIrZeroTask task = tasks[--task_count];
 23985:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, task.type);
 23986:         if (!type)
 23987:         {
 23988:             builder->failure_message = string_format(builder->arena, S8("cannot zero-initialize unresolved IR type {u32}"), task.type.value);
 23989:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 23990:         }
 23991:         if (task.kind == C_IR_ZERO_TASK_COMPLETE)
 23992:         {
 23993:             if (type->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY && type->kind != IR_TYPE_VECTOR && task.operand_count > UINT16_MAX)
 23994:             {
 23995:                 builder->failure_message = string_format(builder->arena, S8("aggregate has too many fields to lower ({u32})"), task.operand_count);
 23996:                 return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 23997:             }
 23998:             IrSourceRange instruction_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
 23999:             IrValueId aggregate = c_ir_emit_initializer_capture(builder, task.type, task.operands, task.fields, task.operand_count, instruction_source);
 24000:             if (aggregate.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 24001:             {
 24002:                 return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 24003:             }
 24004:             *task.output = aggregate;
 24005:             continue;
 24006:         }
 24007:         bool aggregate = type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR || type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION;
 24008:         if (!aggregate)
 24009:         {
 24010:             IrValueId zero = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 24011:             if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 24012:             {
 24013:                 if (type->bit_width == 80)
 24014:                 {
 24015:                     // The f80 constant carries the semantic ten bytes as two
 24016:                     // integer immediates; do not route synthetic zero through
 24017:                     // a host f64 literal or a generic floating conversion.
 24018:                     zero = c_ir_emit_f80_constant_bits(builder, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token), S8("0.0L"), 0, 0);
 24019:                 }
 24020:                 else
 24021:                 {
 24022:                     CToken zero_token = {
 24023:                         .offset = C_SPELLING_FLOAT_ZERO,
 24024:                         .length = type->bit_width == 32 ? 4u : 3u,
 24025:                         .kind = C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER,
 24026:                     };
 24027:                     zero = c_ir_emit_float(builder, zero_token);
 24028:                     zero = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, zero, task.type, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token));
 24029:                 }
 24030:             }
 24031:             else if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
 24032:             {
 24033:                 zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, task.type);
 24034:             }
 24035:             else if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 24036:             {
 24037:                 zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token);
 24038:                 zero = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, zero, task.type, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token));
 24039:             }
 24040:             else if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN)
 24041:             {
 24042:                 zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, token);
 24043:                 zero = c_ir_truth_value(builder, zero, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token));
 24044:             }
 24045:             if (zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 24046:             {
 24047:                 builder->failure_message = string_format(builder->arena, S8("cannot zero-initialize IR type kind {u32}"), (u32)type->kind);
 24048:                 return zero;
 24049:             }
 24050:             *task.output = zero;
 24051:             continue;
 24052:         }
 24053:         u64 child_count_u64 = (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR) ? type->element_count
 24054:                               : type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION                                 ? (type->field_count ? 1 : 0)
 24055:                                                                                             : type->field_count;
 24056:         if (child_count_u64 > UINT32_MAX || child_count_u64 > capacity - task_count - 1)
 24057:         {
 24058:             builder->failure_message =
 24059:                 string_format(builder->arena, S8("aggregate zero-initializer exceeds its task capacity ({u64} children)"), child_count_u64);
 24060:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 24061:         }
 24062:         u32 child_count = (u32)child_count_u64;
 24063:         IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, child_count);
 24064:         u64* fields = (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR) ? 0 : arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, child_count);
 24065:         tasks[task_count++] = (CIrZeroTask){
 24066:             .output = task.output,
 24067:             .operands = operands,
 24068:             .fields = fields,
 24069:             .type = task.type,
 24070:             .operand_count = child_count,
 24071:             .kind = C_IR_ZERO_TASK_COMPLETE,
 24072:         };
 24073:         for (u32 child_index = child_count; child_index; child_index -= 1)
 24074:         {
 24075:             u32 index = child_index - 1;
 24076:             IrTypeId child_type = (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR) ? type->element_type : type->fields[index].type;
 24077:             if (fields)
 24078:             {
 24079:                 fields[index] = index;
 24080:             }
 24081:             tasks[task_count++] = (CIrZeroTask){
 24082:                 .output = &operands[index],
 24083:                 .type = child_type,
 24084:             };
 24085:         }
 24086:     }
 24087:     return result;
 24088: }

 24090: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(Arena* arena, CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, u64* value_out);
 24091: 
 24092: // A designator is a chain, not one step: C11 6.7.9p6 lets `.member`, `[index]`
 24093: // and any mix of them follow one another before the `=`. musl's mutex,
 24094: // barrier and rlimit initializers all write one -- `._m_type` is
 24095: // `__u.__i[0]` after the header's macros -- so the walk below accepts both
 24096: // step kinds and stops at the first token that is neither. It returns the
 24097: // index of the token after the last step, which the caller checks is the `=`.
 24098: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_designator_chain_end(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end)
 24099: {
 24100:     u32 index = start;
 24101:     while (index < end)
 24102:     {
 24103:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) && index + 1 < end &&
 24104:             builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 24105:         {
 24106:             index += 2;
 24107:             continue;
 24108:         }
 24109:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 24110:         {
 24111:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET);
 24112:             if (close >= end || close == index + 1)
 24113:             {
 24114:                 break;
 24115:             }
 24116:             index = close + 1;
 24117:             continue;
 24118:         }
 24119:         break;
 24120:     }
 24121: 
 24122:     return index;
 24123: }
 24124: 
 24125: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_array_designator_has_range(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 close)
 24126: {
 24127:     for (u32 index = start + 1; index < close; index += 1)
 24128:     {
 24129:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_ELLIPSIS))
 24130:         {
 24131:             return true;
 24132:         }
 24133:     }
 24134:     return false;
 24135: }
 24136: 
 24137: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_string_array_element_compatible(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId element_type, CIrDecodedString decoded);
 24138: 
 24139: // Unnamed bit-fields are padding, while anonymous structs/unions still consume
 24140: // an initializer. Keep the cursor in field indices so each padding field is
 24141: // skipped once as a positional initializer advances.
 24142: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_initializer_next_field_index(IrType* type, u32 index)
 24143: {
 24144:     while (index < type->field_count && type->fields[index].is_bit_field && !type->fields[index].name.length)
 24145:     {
 24146:         index += 1;
 24147:     }
 24148:     return index;
 24149: }

 24152: {
 24153:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;

 24155:     {

 24607: 
 24608: // C11 6.7.9p9: unnamed members of a structure object take no part in
 24609: // initialization, so a positional item skips an anonymous bit-field and lands
 24610: // on the next member that has a name. The constant path spells the same rule
 24611: // in c_ir_constant_initializer_field_at, and the two must agree or a local and
 24612: // a static built from the same brace list read back differently. A named
 24613: // member's own index is returned unchanged, so designators -- which resolve
 24614: // their field by name before this runs -- are unaffected.
 24615: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_compound_literal_positional_field(IrType* type, u32 field_index)
 24616: {
 24617:     u32 result = field_index;
 24618:     if (type && (type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION))
 24619:     {
 24620:         while (result < type->field_count && type->fields[result].is_bit_field && !type->fields[result].name.length)
 24621:         {
 24622:             result += 1;
 24623:         }
 24624:     }
 24625:     return result;
 24626: }

 25227: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_static_postfix_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId* type, u32 start, u32 end)
 25228: {
 25229:     u32 index = start;
 25230:     while (type->value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && index < end)
 25231:     {
 25232:         IrType* value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, *type);
 25233:         if (!value)
 25234:         {
 25235:             return false;
 25236:         }
 25237:         CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];
 25238:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 25239:         {
 25240:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET);
 25241:             if (close >= end || (value->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY && value->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER))
 25242:             {
 25243:                 return false;
 25244:             }
 25245:             *type = value->element_type;
 25246:             index = close + 1;
 25247:             continue;
 25248:         }
 25249:         bool arrow = c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW);
 25250:         if (!arrow && !c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT))
 25251:         {
 25252:             return false;
 25253:         }
 25254:         if (arrow)
 25255:         {
 25256:             if (value->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 25257:             {
 25258:                 return false;
 25259:             }
 25260:             *type = value->element_type;
 25261:             value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, *type);
 25262:         }
 25263:         if (!value || (value->kind != IR_TYPE_STRUCT && value->kind != IR_TYPE_UNION) || index + 1 >= end ||
 25264:             builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 25265:         {
 25266:             return false;
 25267:         }
 25268:         IrTypeId member_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 25269:         if (!c_ir_promoted_member_type(builder, *type, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1]), &member_type))
 25270:         {
 25271:             return false;
 25272:         }
 25273:         *type = member_type;
 25274:         index += 2;
 25275:     }
 25276:     return index == end && type->value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 25277: }

 25285: {

 25289:     {

 25300: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_sizeof_operand_postfix_chain_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId* type, u32 index, u32 end, bool promote_bit_fields)
 25301: {
 25302:     while (index < end)
 25303:     {
 25304:         IrType* value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, *type);
 25305:         if (!value)
 25306:         {
 25307:             return false;
 25308:         }
 25309:         CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];
 25310:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 25311:         {
 25312:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET);
 25313:             if (close >= end)
 25314:             {
 25315:                 return false;
 25316:             }
 25317:             // `E1[E2]` may be written with the subscripted operand on either
 25318:             // side (C11 6.5.2.1p2), so an integer on the left names the
 25319:             // element of whatever the brackets hold -- `sizeof 0[letters]` is
 25320:             // one char, not one int.
 25321:             if (value->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || value->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN)
 25322:             {
 25323:                 IrTypeId subscripted = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 25324:                 if (!c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt(builder, index + 1, close, &subscripted))
 25325:                 {
 25326:                     return false;
 25327:                 }
 25328:                 IrType* subscripted_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, subscripted);
 25329:                 if (!subscripted_value || (subscripted_value->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY && subscripted_value->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER))
 25330:                 {
 25331:                     return false;
 25332:                 }
 25333:                 *type = subscripted_value->element_type;
 25334:                 index = close + 1;
 25335:                 continue;
 25336:             }
 25337:             if (value->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY && value->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 25338:             {
 25339:                 return false;
 25340:             }
 25341:             *type = value->element_type;
 25342:             index = close + 1;
 25343:             continue;
 25344:         }
 25345:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 25346:         {
 25347:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 25348:             if (close >= end)
 25349:             {
 25350:                 return false;
 25351:             }
 25352:             if (value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 25353:             {
 25354:                 *type = value->element_type;
 25355:                 value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, *type);
 25356:             }
 25357:             if (!value || value->kind != IR_TYPE_FUNCTION)
 25358:             {
 25359:                 return false;
 25360:             }
 25361:             *type = value->return_type;
 25362:             index = close + 1;
 25363:             continue;
 25364:         }
 25365:         if ((c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS)) && index + 1 == end)
 25366:         {
 25367:             // Postfix increment keeps the operand type.
 25368:             return true;
 25369:         }
 25370:         bool arrow = c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW);
 25371:         if (!arrow && !c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT))
 25372:         {
 25373:             return false;
 25374:         }
 25375:         if (arrow)
 25376:         {
 25377:             if (value->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 25378:             {
 25379:                 return false;
 25380:             }
 25381:             *type = value->element_type;
 25382:             value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, *type);
 25383:         }
 25384:         if (!value || (value->kind != IR_TYPE_STRUCT && value->kind != IR_TYPE_UNION) || index + 1 >= end ||
 25385:             builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 25386:         {
 25387:             return false;
 25388:         }
 25389:         CIrPromotedMemberPath member = {0};
 25390:         if (!c_ir_promoted_member_path(builder, *type, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1]), &member))
 25391:         {
 25392:             // A resolved aggregate that lacks the name is a constraint
 25393:             // violation, not a shape this resolver cannot read; record it so
 25394:             // the prediction fallback refuses instead of guessing int.
 25395:             if (value->layout.resolved && !builder->sizeof_operand_constraint.length)
 25396:             {
 25397:                 builder->sizeof_operand_constraint =
 25398:                     string_format(builder->arena, S8("type '{S8}' has no member named '{S8}' ({u32} fields available)"), value->name,
 25399:                                   c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1]), value->field_count);
 25400:             }
 25401:             return false;
 25402:         }
 25403:         *type = member.type;
 25404:         bool final_member = index + 2 == end ||
 25405:                             (index + 3 == end && (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 2], C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ||
 25406:                                                  c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 2], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS)));
 25407:         if (promote_bit_fields && final_member && c_ir_unsigned_bit_field_promotes_to_int(builder, member.field))
 25408:         {
 25409:             *type = builder->s32_type;
 25410:         }
 25411:         index += 2;
 25412:     }
 25413:     return type->value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 25414: }
 25415: 
 25416: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_sizeof_operand_identifier_type_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, IrTypeId* type_out, bool promote_bit_fields)
 25417: {
 25418:     CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[start];
 25419:     String8 name = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token);
 25420:     u32 chain_start = start + 1;
 25421: 
 25422:     // Builtin math names are parser symbols rather than ordinary declarations,
 25423:     // so they have no CEntity/signature for the strict type walk to query.
 25424:     // Resolve their result type directly and consume the call suffix.  This
 25425:     // matters for hosted headers where NAN/INFINITY expand to a conditional
 25426:     // expression containing __builtin_nanf/__builtin_inff: treating the
 25427:     // builtin as an unknown identifier poisons the conditional's type merge
 25428:     // even though lowering already knows the intrinsic's scalar result.
 25429:     String8 math_link_name = c_ir_math_builtin_link_name(name);
 25430:     if (math_link_name.length)
 25431:     {
 25432:         if (chain_start >= end || !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[chain_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 25433:         {
 25434:             return false;
 25435:         }
 25436:         u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, chain_start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 25437:         if (close >= end)
 25438:         {
 25439:             return false;
 25440:         }
 25441:         bool predicate = string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isnan")) || string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isnanf")) ||
 25442:                          string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isinf")) || string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isinff")) ||
 25443:                          string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isinf_sign")) || string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isfinite"));
 25444:         bool single = math_link_name.length && math_link_name.pointer[math_link_name.length - 1] == 'f';
 25445:         *type_out = predicate ? builder->s32_type : single ? builder->f32_type : builder->f64_type;
 25446:         return c_ir_sizeof_operand_postfix_chain_attempt(builder, type_out, close + 1, end, promote_bit_fields);
 25447:     }
 25448: 
 25449:     CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity_or_lookup(builder, start);
 25450:     CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
 25451:     IrTypeId type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 25452:     if (local)
 25453:     {
 25454:         if (local->is_variable_length_array)
 25455:         {
 25456:             return false;
 25457:         }
 25458:         type = local->type;
 25459:     }
 25460:     else if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count && builder->parse.entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR)
 25461:     {
 25462:         type = builder->s32_type;
 25463:     }
 25464:     else if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count && builder->parse.entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_OBJECT)
 25465:     {
 25466:         CTypeId c_type = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].type;
 25467:         if (c_type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
 25468:         {
 25469:             type = builder->c_type_ir_map[c_type.value];
 25470:         }
 25471:     }
 25472:     if (type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && chain_start < end &&
 25473:         c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[chain_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 25474:     {
 25475:         // A direct call through a function name resolves to the declared return type.
 25476:         CIrPreparedCall* prepared_call = c_ir_prepared_call_find(builder, start);
 25477:         u32 close = UINT32_MAX;
 25478:         if (prepared_call && builder->function && prepared_call->emitted && prepared_call->result.value < builder->function->value_count)
 25479:         {
 25480:             type = builder->function->values[prepared_call->result.value].canonical_type;
 25481:             close = prepared_call->close_index;
 25482:         }
 25483:         else
 25484:         {
 25485:             u32 declaration_index = c_ir_find_function(builder, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token));
 25486:             if (declaration_index != UINT32_MAX && builder->signatures)
 25487:             {
 25488:                 type = builder->signatures[declaration_index].return_type;
 25489:                 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, chain_start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 25490:             }
 25491:             else if (declaration_index != UINT32_MAX && declaration_index < builder->parse.declaration_count)
 25492:             {
 25493:                 // No signatures exist while the type-mapping fixed point
 25494:                 // evaluates array bounds, and a bound like
 25495:                 // `char buffer[sizeof(helper())]` that fails here classifies
 25496:                 // the local as a VLA — which a static local then rejects.
 25497:                 // Resolve the declared return type through the parse
 25498:                 // declaration instead; an unmapped return type still fails,
 25499:                 // deferring the bound to a later mapping round rather than
 25500:                 // guessing.
 25501:                 CDeclaration* function_declaration = &builder->parse.declarations[declaration_index];
 25502:                 if (function_declaration->type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
 25503:                 {
 25504:                     CType* function_type = &builder->parse.types[function_declaration->type.value];
 25505:                     if (function_type->kind == C_TYPE_FUNCTION && function_type->return_type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
 25506:                     {
 25507:                         type = builder->c_type_ir_map[function_type->return_type.value];
 25508:                     }
 25509:                 }
 25510:                 if (type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 25511:                 {
 25512:                     close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, chain_start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 25513:                 }
 25514:             }
 25515:         }
 25516:         if (close >= end)
 25517:         {
 25518:             return false;
 25519:         }
 25520:         chain_start = close + 1;
 25521:     }
 25522:     else if (type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 25523:     {
 25524:         // A bare function name resolves to its function type so a call applied
 25525:         // through parentheses, e.g. `(name)(...)`, still reaches the return type.
 25526:         u32 declaration_index = c_ir_find_function(builder, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token));
 25527:         if (declaration_index != UINT32_MAX && builder->declaration_functions && builder->declaration_functions[declaration_index])
 25528:         {
 25529:             type = builder->declaration_functions[declaration_index]->canonical_type;
 25530:         }
 25531:     }
 25532:     if (type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 25533:     {
 25534:         return false;
 25535:     }
 25536:     *type_out = type;
 25537:     return c_ir_sizeof_operand_postfix_chain_attempt(builder, type_out, chain_start, end, promote_bit_fields);
 25538: }
 25539: 
 25540: /* Resolves the C result type of a sizeof/alignof expression operand strictly: every
 25541:    sub-operand must resolve through a mapped entity, literal, cast, or call before any
 25542:    type is combined, and binary operators apply the usual arithmetic conversions (so
 25543:    narrow operands promote to int and mixed widths take the wider side). Returning
 25544:    false defers to the older per-shape paths and ultimately the caller's fallback; a
 25545:    guessed type must never come out of this function, because the guessed size folds
 25546:    silently into the program (the 2026-08-08 array-bound incident, and the same
 25547:    defect shape in function bodies). */
 25548: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt_depth(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, IrTypeId* type_out, u32 remaining_depth, bool promote_bit_fields)
 25549: {
 25550:     // This resolver is a speculative type query: false lets the caller use
 25551:     // the ordinary expression paths.  Bound its recursive precedence walk so
 25552:     // adversarially deep, otherwise-valid expressions cannot exhaust the host
 25553:     // stack in sanitizer/fuzz configurations, whose instrumented frames are
 25554:     // substantially larger than Release frames.
 25555:     if (!remaining_depth)
 25556:     {
 25557:         return false;
 25558:     }
 25559:     remaining_depth -= 1;
 25560:     // GNU __extension__ is a diagnostic-only marker on the expression that
 25561:     // follows it; it contributes no value and no type of its own, so strip it
 25562:     // the same way a redundant parenthesis is stripped, and keep stripping
 25563:     // both until neither applies.  musl's <complex.h> spells `I` as
 25564:     // `(__extension__ (0.0f+1.0fi))` under __GNUC__, and leaving the marker in
 25565:     // this walk made the whole group resolve as the leading `0.0f` -- so
 25566:     // `0*I` was a float, `2.0+0*I` was a double, and every <tgmath.h> macro
 25567:     // reached through a complex argument selected the real function.
 25568:     bool trimmed = true;
 25569:     while (trimmed)
 25570:     {
 25571:         trimmed = false;
 25572:         while (start < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
 25573:                c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) == end - 1)
 25574:         {
 25575:             start += 1;
 25576:             end -= 1;
 25577:             trimmed = true;
 25578:         }
 25579:         while (start < end && builder->preprocess.tokens[start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
 25580:                string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[start]), S8("__extension__")))
 25581:         {
 25582:             start += 1;
 25583:             trimmed = true;
 25584:         }
 25585:     }
 25586:     if (start >= end)
 25587:     {
 25588:         return false;
 25589:     }
 25590:     // One top-level scan records the loosest-binding operator of every precedence tier.
 25591:     // Left-associative tiers split at their last top-level operator, the right-associative
 25592:     // assignment at its first; a `?` only counts at ternary depth zero so operators inside
 25593:     // conditional arms never split the outer expression.
 25594:     u32 last_comma = UINT32_MAX;
 25595:     u32 first_assign = UINT32_MAX;
 25596:     u32 first_question = UINT32_MAX;
 25597:     u32 first_colon = UINT32_MAX;
 25598:     u32 logical_index = UINT32_MAX;
 25599:     u32 bit_or_index = UINT32_MAX;
 25600:     u32 bit_xor_index = UINT32_MAX;
 25601:     u32 bit_and_index = UINT32_MAX;
 25602:     u32 comparison_index = UINT32_MAX;
 25603:     u32 shift_index = UINT32_MAX;
 25604:     u32 additive_index = UINT32_MAX;
 25605:     u32 multiplicative_index = UINT32_MAX;
 25606:     u32 ternary_depth = 0;
 25607:     bool previous_is_operand = false;
 25608:     for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
 25609:     {
 25610:         CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];
 25611:         u32 group_open = index;
 25612:         CIrGroupScan scan = c_ir_scan_delimiter_group(builder, &index, end);
 25613:         if (scan == C_IR_GROUP_SCAN_SKIPPED)
 25614:         {
 25615:             previous_is_operand = true;
 25616:             // A parenthesized group is an operand -- unless it is a cast, in
 25617:             // which case the `*`, `&`, `+` or `-` after it is a prefix
 25618:             // operator over the cast's operand, not a binary one.  ctypes'
 25619:             // SET macro writes `(signed char)*(signed char*)ptr & 3`, where
 25620:             // reading the star as multiplication combined the mask against
 25621:             // the pointer and predicted the whole conditional arm as one.
 25622:             // The type-name test runs only when the next token is
 25623:             // sign-ambiguous, so ordinary grouped operands pay one compare.
 25624:             if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) && index + 1 < end)
 25625:             {
 25626:                 u32 following = builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1].punctuator;
 25627:                 if ((following == C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR || following == C_PUNCTUATOR_AMPERSAND || following == C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS ||
 25628:                      following == C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS) &&
 25629:                     group_open + 1 < index && c_ir_group_type_name(builder, group_open, index).value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 25630:                 {
 25631:                     previous_is_operand = false;
 25632:                 }
 25633:             }
 25634:             continue;
 25635:         }
 25636:         if (scan == C_IR_GROUP_SCAN_UNCLOSED)
 25637:         {
 25638:             return false;
 25639:         }
 25640:         u32 punctuator = token.punctuator;
 25641:         if (punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE)
 25642:         {
 25643:             // The sizeof/alignof words are prefix operators, so a `*` after one
 25644:             // dereferences rather than multiplies.
 25645:             previous_is_operand =
 25646:                 token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER || (!string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("sizeof")) && !c_parse_alignof_word(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token)));
 25647:             continue;
 25648:         }
 25649:         if (punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_QUESTION)
 25650:         {
 25651:             if (!ternary_depth && first_question == UINT32_MAX)
 25652:             {
 25653:                 first_question = index;
 25654:             }
 25655:             ternary_depth += 1;
 25656:             previous_is_operand = false;
 25657:             continue;
 25658:         }
