 26114: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, IrTypeId* type_out)
 26115: {
 26116:     return c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt_depth(builder, start, end, type_out, 64, false);
 26117: }
 26118: 
 26119: // Walks the call, subscript, member and postfix-increment suffixes that may
 26120: // follow a postfix expression's primary, and answers where they stop.
 26121: // UINT32_MAX means the chain is malformed — an unclosed delimiter or a `.`
 26122: // with no member name — which every caller reports as "not an expression"
 26123: // rather than as a shorter one. Shared by c_ir_unary_expression_end and the
 26124: // sizeof compound-literal operand extent, which must agree on where an
 26125: // operand ends.
 26126: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_postfix_suffix_end(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 index, u32 end)
 26127: {
 26128:     while (index < end)
 26129:     {
 26130:         CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];
 26131:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 26132:         {
 26133:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 26134:             if (close >= end)
 26135:             {
 26136:                 return UINT32_MAX;
 26137:             }
 26138:             index = close + 1;
 26139:             continue;
 26140:         }
 26141:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 26142:         {
 26143:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET);
 26144:             if (close >= end)
 26145:             {
 26146:                 return UINT32_MAX;
 26147:             }
 26148:             index = close + 1;
 26149:             continue;
 26150:         }
 26151:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW))
 26152:         {
 26153:             if (index + 1 >= end || builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 26154:             {
 26155:                 return UINT32_MAX;
 26156:             }
 26157:             index += 2;
 26158:             continue;
 26159:         }
 26160:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS))
 26161:         {
 26162:             index += 1;
 26163:         }
 26164:         break;
 26165:     }
 26166:     return index;
 26167: }
 26168: 
 26169: // `sizeof (T){...}` is sizeof applied to a compound literal, not `sizeof (T)`
 26170: // followed by a stray brace: the C grammar is ambiguous there and both the
 26171: // standard and clang resolve it toward the literal, so `sizeof (int[3]){1, 2,
--- lines 27255-27961 ---
 27255:                     nested -= 1;
 27256:                 }
 27257:                 else if (!nested && c_token_is_punctuator(&item, C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA))
 27258:                 {
 27259:                     comma = scan;
 27260:                     break;
 27261:                 }
 27262:             }
 27263:             IrTypeId type = comma < close ? c_ir_type_name(builder, index + 2, comma) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 27264:             u64 offset = 0;
 27265:             u32 designator = comma + 1;
 27266:             bool valid = close < end && designator < close && type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 27267:             while (valid && designator < close)
 27268:             {
 27269:                 CToken member = builder->preprocess.tokens[designator];
 27270:                 IrType* aggregate = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
 27271:                 if (!aggregate || member.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER || (aggregate->kind != IR_TYPE_STRUCT && aggregate->kind != IR_TYPE_UNION))
 27272:                 {
 27273:                     valid = false;
 27274:                     break;
 27275:                 }
 27276:                 IrField* field = 0;
 27277:                 for (u32 field_index = 0; field_index < aggregate->field_count; field_index += 1)
 27278:                 {
 27279:                     if (string_equal(aggregate->fields[field_index].name, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, member)))
 27280:                     {
 27281:                         field = aggregate->fields + field_index;
 27282:                         break;
 27283:                     }
 27284:                 }
 27285:                 if (!field || field->is_bit_field)
 27286:                 {
 27287:                     valid = false;
 27288:                     break;
 27289:                 }
 27290:                 offset += field->offset;
 27291:                 type = field->type;
 27292:                 designator += 1;
 27293:                 while (valid && designator < close && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[designator], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 27294:                 {
 27295:                     u32 bracket_close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, designator, close, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET);
 27296:                     IrType* array = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
 27297:                     u64 element_index = 0;
 27298:                     IrType* element = array && array->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, array->element_type) : 0;
 27299:                     if (bracket_close >= close || !element || !element->layout.resolved ||
 27300:                         !c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(builder->arena, builder, designator + 1, bracket_close, &element_index))
 27301:                     {
 27302:                         valid = false;
 27303:                         break;
 27304:                     }
 27305:                     offset += element->layout.size * element_index;
 27306:                     type = array->element_type;
 27307:                     designator = bracket_close + 1;
 27308:                 }
 27309:                 if (designator < close)
 27310:                 {
 27311:                     if (!c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[designator], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) || designator + 1 >= close)
 27312:                     {
 27313:                         valid = false;
 27314:                         break;
 27315:                     }
 27316:                     designator += 1;
 27317:                 }
 27318:             }
 27319:             if (!valid)
 27320:             {
 27321:                 builder->failure_message = S8("invalid __builtin_offsetof type or member designator");
 27322:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27323:                 return;
 27324:             }
 27325:             values[value_count++] = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, offset, false, token, builder->size_type);
 27326:             expect_operand = false;
 27327:             index = close;
 27328:             continue;
 27329:         }
 27330:         if (expect_operand && token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && (string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("sizeof")) || c_parse_alignof_word(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token))) &&
 27331:             index + 1 < end)
 27332:         {
 27333:             bool is_sizeof = string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("sizeof"));
 27334:             bool parenthesized = c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS);
 27335:             // A `{` past the closing parenthesis makes the operand a compound
 27336:             // literal rather than a parenthesized type name, so the operand
 27337:             // starts at that `(` and runs to the initializer's `}`. The
 27338:             // widened range no longer begins with an identifier, so the
 27339:             // type-name shortcut below skips itself and the sizeof query
 27340:             // resolves it through its compound-literal shape.
 27341:             u32 literal_end = parenthesized ? c_ir_sizeof_compound_literal_operand_end(builder, index + 1, end) : UINT32_MAX;
 27342:             parenthesized = parenthesized && literal_end == UINT32_MAX;
 27343:             if (!is_sizeof && !parenthesized && literal_end == UINT32_MAX)
 27344:             {
 27345:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27346:                 return;
 27347:             }
 27348:             u32 operand_start = index + (parenthesized ? 2 : 1);
 27349:             u32 operand_end = literal_end != UINT32_MAX ? literal_end
 27350:                               : parenthesized
 27351:                                   ? c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index + 1, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS)
 27352:                                   : c_ir_unary_expression_end(builder, operand_start, end);
 27353:             if (operand_end > end || operand_start >= operand_end)
 27354:             {
 27355:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27356:                 return;
 27357:             }
 27358:             // Parentheses after sizeof are ambiguous: `(T)` is a type name,
 27359:             // while `(expression)->field` (and `(expression)[index]`) is a
 27360:             // parenthesized value with postfix operators.  The old shortcut
 27361:             // stopped at the inner `)` for the latter and left `->field` in
 27362:             // the enclosing expression, which then failed in the logical-core
 27363:             // lowerer.  Probe the type-name shape and, when it is not one,
 27364:             // let the normal unary walker consume the complete postfix chain.
 27365:             bool has_postfix_after_parenthesized = operand_end + 1 < end &&
 27366:                                                    (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[operand_end + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) ||
 27367:                                                     c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[operand_end + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW) ||
 27368:                                                     c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[operand_end + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) ||
 27369:                                                     c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[operand_end + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS));
 27370:             if (is_sizeof && parenthesized && literal_end == UINT32_MAX && has_postfix_after_parenthesized &&
 27371:                 c_ir_group_type_name(builder, index + 1, operand_end).value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 27372:             {
 27373:                 parenthesized = false;
 27374:                 operand_start = index + 1;
 27375:                 operand_end = c_ir_unary_expression_end(builder, operand_start, end);
 27376:                 if (operand_end > end || operand_start >= operand_end)
 27377:                 {
 27378:                     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27379:                     return;
 27380:                 }
 27381:             }
 27382:             u32 consumed_index = parenthesized ? operand_end : operand_end - 1;
 27383:             // A dereference of a pointer-to-VLA names the same array object
 27384:             // as subscript zero. Use its saved size, including through groups,
 27385:             // without reading the object or reevaluating declaration bounds.
 27386:             u32 size_start = operand_start;
 27387:             u32 size_end = operand_end;
 27388:             u32 size_dereferences = 0;
 27389:             bool size_prefix = is_sizeof;
 27390:             while (size_prefix && size_start < size_end)
 27391:             {
 27392:                 if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[size_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
 27393:                     c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, size_start, size_end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) == size_end - 1)
 27394:                 {
 27395:                     size_start += 1;
 27396:                     size_end -= 1;
 27397:                 }
 27398:                 else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[size_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR))
 27399:                 {
 27400:                     size_dereferences += 1;
 27401:                     size_start += 1;
 27402:                 }
 27403:                 else
 27404:                 {
 27405:                     size_prefix = false;
 27406:                 }
 27407:             }
 27408:             if (is_sizeof && size_start < size_end && builder->preprocess.tokens[size_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 27409:             {
 27410:                 CEntityId size_entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, size_start);
 27411:                 CIntegerIrLocal* size_local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, size_entity);
 27412:                 if (size_local && size_local->is_variable_length_array)
 27413:                 {
 27414:                     u32 suffix_index = size_dereferences;
 27415:                     u32 suffix_token = size_start + 1;
 27416:                     while (suffix_token < size_end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[suffix_token], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 27417:                     {
 27418:                         u32 suffix_close =
 27419:                             c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, suffix_token, size_end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET);
 27420:                         if (suffix_close >= size_end)
 27421:                         {
 27422:                             break;
 27423:                         }
 27424:                         suffix_index += 1;
 27425:                         suffix_token = suffix_close + 1;
 27426:                     }
 27427:                     IrValueId runtime_size = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 27428:                     if (suffix_token == size_end && suffix_index <= size_local->vla_dimension_count && (suffix_index || !size_local->is_vla_parameter))
 27429:                     {
 27430:                         runtime_size = size_local->vla_suffix_sizes[suffix_index];
 27431:                     }
 27432:                     if (runtime_size.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 27433:                     {
 27434:                         values[value_count++] = runtime_size;
 27435:                         expect_operand = false;
 27436:                         index = consumed_index;
 27437:                         continue;
 27438:                     }
 27439:                 }
 27440:             }
 27441:             builder->sizeof_operand_constraint = (String8){0};
 27442:             builder->sizeof_operand_constraint_token = UINT32_MAX;
 27443:             IrTypeId operand_type = builder->preprocess.tokens[operand_start].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER ? IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID
 27444:                                     : parenthesized ? c_ir_group_type_name(builder, index + 1, operand_end)
 27445:                                                     : c_ir_type_name(builder, operand_start, operand_end);
 27446:             IrType* operand = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, operand_type);
 27447:             u64 value = 0;
 27448:             u32 literal_alignment = 0;
 27449:             if (operand && operand->layout.resolved)
 27450:             {
 27451:                 value = is_sizeof ? c_ir_sizeof_operand_size(operand) : c_ir_sizeof_operand_alignment(operand);
 27452:             }
 27453:             else if (!is_sizeof && !builder->sizeof_operand_constraint.length &&
 27454:                      c_ir_sizeof_expression(builder, operand_start, operand_end, &value, &literal_alignment))
 27455:             {
 27456:                 // `_Alignof` takes a type name, but GNU's `__alignof__` also
 27457:                 // takes an expression -- libc-test's tls_align_dso.c fills its
 27458:                 // table with `__alignof__(x)` over four objects -- and so does
 27459:                 // the compound literal the extent scan above claimed for both
 27460:                 // words. The alignment of the operand's own type is the
 27461:                 // answer in each case, so the sizeof resolver settles it and
 27462:                 // only its second answer is read.
 27463:                 value = literal_alignment;
 27464:             }
 27465:             else if (is_sizeof && !builder->sizeof_operand_constraint.length &&
 27466:                      c_ir_sizeof_expression(builder, operand_start, operand_end, &value, 0))
 27467:             {
 27468:             }
 27469:             else
 27470:             {
 27471:                 // Both words take an expression operand: `sizeof v` writes one
 27472:                 // without parentheses, and GNU's `__alignof__ (v)` is a second
 27473:                 // spelling of `_Alignof` that accepts one where the standard
 27474:                 // word takes only a type name -- libc-test's tls_align_dso.c
 27475:                 // fills its table with `__alignof__(x)` over four objects, and
 27476:                 // the alignment of an object's *type* is what GCC answers for
 27477:                 // one whose declaration asked for no more.
 27478:                 //
 27479:                 // The prediction guesses int for an operand it cannot type; an
 27480:                 // unmapped array object is such an operand, and a guess for one
 27481:                 // silently misfolds the answer, so it fails here instead.  A
 27482:                 // member chain the resolver proved wrong -- a
 27483:                 // resolved aggregate with no member of that name -- is not a
 27484:                 // shape to guess either: it is the diagnostic the walkers
 27485:                 // recorded, and predicting int for it is what made every
 27486:                 // autoconf AC_CHECK_MEMBER fallback probe answer yes.
 27487:                 if (builder->sizeof_operand_constraint.length)
 27488:                 {
 27489:                     builder->failure_message = builder->sizeof_operand_constraint;
 27490:                     builder->failure_token_index = builder->sizeof_operand_constraint_token != UINT32_MAX
 27491:                                                        ? builder->sizeof_operand_constraint_token : operand_start;
 27492:                     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27493:                     return;
 27494:                 }
 27495:                 if (c_ir_sizeof_operand_is_parenthesized_type_name(builder, operand_start, operand_end))
 27496:                 {
 27497:                     builder->failure_message = S8("a parenthesized type name is not an expression; the type form takes exactly one pair of parentheses");
 27498:                     builder->failure_token_index = operand_start;
 27499:                     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27500:                     return;
 27501:                 }
 27502:                 IrTypeId expression_type = c_ir_sizeof_operand_is_unmapped_array_object(builder, operand_start, operand_end)
 27503:                                                ? IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID
 27504:                                                : c_ir_predict_expression_type(builder, operand_start, operand_end);
 27505:                 IrType* expression = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, expression_type);
 27506:                 if (!expression || !expression->layout.resolved)
 27507:                 {
 27508:                     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27509:                     return;
 27510:                 }
 27511:                 value = is_sizeof ? expression->layout.size : c_ir_sizeof_operand_alignment(expression);
 27512:             }
 27513:             values[value_count++] = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, value, false, token, builder->size_type);
 27514:             expect_operand = false;
 27515:             index = consumed_index;
 27516:             continue;
 27517:         }
 27518:         if (expect_operand && (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS)) &&
 27519:             index + 1 < end &&
 27520:             (builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER ||
 27521:              (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR) && index + 2 < end &&
 27522:               builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 2].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)))
 27523:         {
 27524:             bool dereference = c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR);
 27525:             u32 operand_index = index + (dereference ? 2 : 1);
 27526:             CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, operand_index);
 27527:             CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
 27528:             IrValueId place = local ? local->place : c_ir_emit_global_place(builder, entity, source);
 27529:             if (dereference && place.value < builder->function->value_count)
 27530:             {
 27531:                 IrTypeId pointer_type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
 27532:                 IrValueId pointer = c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, place, pointer_type, source);
 27533:                 place = c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, pointer, source);
 27534:             }
 27535:             if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 27536:             {
 27537:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27538:                 return;
 27539:             }
 27540:             IrTypeId type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
 27541:             IrType* place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
 27542:             IrValueId previous = place_type && place_type->is_atomic ? place : c_ir_emit_load_place(builder, place, type, source);
 27543:             IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_increment(builder, place, type, previous, token, true);
 27544:             if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 27545:             {
 27546:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27547:                 return;
 27548:             }
 27549:             values[value_count++] = value;
 27550:             expect_operand = false;
 27551:             index = operand_index;
 27552:             continue;
 27553:         }
 27554:         // glibc's assert macro prefixes its GNU statement expression with
 27555:         // `__extension__`.  This marker suppresses pedantic diagnostics but
 27556:         // contributes no expression value, so leave operand state unchanged
 27557:         // and let the following statement-expression wrapper lower normally.
 27558:         if (expect_operand && token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
 27559:             string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("__extension__")))
 27560:         {
 27561:             continue;
 27562:         }
 27563:         CIrPreparedCall* prepared_call = c_ir_prepared_call_find(builder, index);
 27564:         // A call keys on the first token of its callee, so the call this
 27565:         // range is the callee of is found here as well -- its argument list
 27566:         // closes past the end of the range.  That call is not an operand of
 27567:         // its own callee; the place machine draws the same line for a call
 27568:         // that is the base of a postfix chain.
 27569:         if (prepared_call && prepared_call->close_index >= end)
 27570:         {
 27571:             prepared_call = 0;
 27572:         }
 27573:         // Consuming only the inner call of a chain would strand the walk at
 27574:         // the outer argument list, so hop to the outermost chained call this
 27575:         // range still contains and consume its result instead.
 27576:         if (prepared_call)
 27577:         {
 27578:             prepared_call = c_ir_prepared_call_chained(builder, prepared_call, end);
 27579:         }
 27580:         if (prepared_call)
 27581:         {
 27582:             if (!expect_operand)
 27583:             {
 27584:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27585:                 return;
 27586:             }
 27587:             builder->failure_token_index = prepared_call->open_index;
 27588:             IrValueId value = prepared_call->emitted ? prepared_call->result : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 27589:             if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 27590:             {
 27591:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27592:                 return;
 27593:             }
 27594:             values[value_count++] = value;
 27595:             expect_operand = false;
 27596:             index = prepared_call->close_index;
 27597:             continue;
 27598:         }
 27599:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
 27600:         {
 27601:             if (!expect_operand)
 27602:             {
 27603:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27604:                 return;
 27605:             }
 27606:             IrValueId value = c_number_is_float(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token)) ? c_ir_emit_float(builder, token) : c_ir_emit_integer(builder, token);
 27607:             if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 27608:             {
 27609:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27610:                 return;
 27611:             }
 27612:             values[value_count++] = value;
 27613:             expect_operand = false;
 27614:             continue;
 27615:         }
 27616:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_CHARACTER_LITERAL || token.kind == C_TOKEN_STRING_LITERAL)
 27617:         {
 27618:             if (!expect_operand)
 27619:             {
 27620:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27621:                 return;
 27622:             }
 27623:             u32 literal_end = index + 1;
 27624:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_STRING_LITERAL)
 27625:             {
 27626:                 while (literal_end < end && builder->preprocess.tokens[literal_end].kind == C_TOKEN_STRING_LITERAL)
 27627:                 {
 27628:                     literal_end += 1;
 27629:                 }
 27630:             }
 27631:             IrValueId value = token.kind == C_TOKEN_CHARACTER_LITERAL ? c_ir_emit_character(builder, token)
 27632:                                                                       : c_ir_emit_string_range_typed(builder, index, literal_end, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID);
 27633:             if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 27634:             {
 27635:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27636:                 return;
 27637:             }
 27638:             values[value_count++] = value;
 27639:             expect_operand = false;
 27640:             index = literal_end - 1;
 27641:             continue;
 27642:         }
 27643:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 27644:         {
 27645:             if (!expect_operand)
 27646:             {
 27647:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27648:                 return;
 27649:             }
 27650:             // The arms below advance `index` past what they consumed -- a
 27651:             // failed call leaves it on the closing parenthesis -- so the
 27652:             // failure report keeps the identifier's own token index.
 27653:             u32 identifier_index = index;
 27654:             IrValueId value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 27655:             IrValueId value_place = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 27656:             if (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(builder->preprocess.dialect) &&
 27657:                 (string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("true")) || string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("false"))))
 27658:             {
 27659:                 value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("true")), false, token, builder->bool_type);
 27660:             }
 27661:             else if (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(builder->preprocess.dialect) && string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("nullptr")))
 27662:             {
 27663:                 value = c_ir_emit_nullptr(builder, token);
 27664:             }
 27665:             else if (string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("__func__")) || string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("__FUNCTION__")) ||
 27666:                      string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("__PRETTY_FUNCTION__")))
 27667:             {
 27668:                 value = c_ir_emit_function_name(builder, token);
 27669:             }
 27670:             else if (index + 1 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 27671:             {
 27672:                 u32 close = index + 2;
 27673:                 u32 depth = 1;
 27674:                 while (close < end && depth)
 27675:                 {
 27676:                     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[close], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 27677:                     {
 27678:                         depth += 1;
 27679:                     }
 27680:                     else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[close], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
 27681:                     {
 27682:                         depth -= 1;
 27683:                     }
 27684:                     close += 1;
 27685:                 }
 27686:                 if (depth)
 27687:                 {
 27688:                     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27689:                     return;
 27690:                 }
 27691:                 CIrPreparedCall* chained_call = c_ir_prepared_call_find(builder, index);
 27692:                 if (chained_call && chained_call->close_index < end)
 27693:                 {
 27694:                     chained_call = c_ir_prepared_call_chained(builder, chained_call, end);
 27695:                 }
 27696:                 value = chained_call && chained_call->emitted ? chained_call->result : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 27697:                 index = chained_call && chained_call->emitted ? chained_call->close_index : close - 1;
 27698:             }
 27699:             else
 27700:             {
 27701:                 CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, index);
 27702:                 CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
 27703:                 if (!local && entity.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 27704:                 {
 27705:                     local = c_ir_find_local_by_name(builder, token);
 27706:                 }
 27707:                 u32 place_end = index + 1;
 27708:                 if (local && local->is_variable_length_array)
 27709:                 {
 27710:                     u32 dimension = 0;
 27711:                     while (dimension < local->vla_dimension_count && place_end < end &&
 27712:                            c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[place_end], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 27713:                     {
 27714:                         u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, place_end, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET);
 27715:                         if (close >= end)
 27716:                         {
 27717:                             break;
 27718:                         }
 27719:                         place_end = close + 1;
 27720:                         dimension += 1;
 27721:                     }
 27722:                 }
 27723:                 while (place_end + 1 < end &&
 27724:                        (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[place_end], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) ||
 27725:                         c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[place_end], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW)) &&
 27726:                        builder->preprocess.tokens[place_end + 1].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 27727:                 {
 27728:                     place_end += 2;
 27729:                 }
 27730:                 if (place_end > index + 1)
 27731:                 {
 27732:                     c_ir_expression_core_save(frame, values, operations, operation_sources, operation_cast_types, value_count,
 27733:                                               operation_count, place_end, expect_operand);
 27734:                     state->pending_start = index;
 27735:                     state->pending_end = place_end;
 27736:                     frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_CORE_IDENTIFIER_PLACE;
 27737:                     // Run the place now, off the dispatch loop (the resume
 27738:                     // arm above, inlined); a suspension resumes through the
 27739:                     // loop unchanged.
 27740:                     u32 place_mark = machine->frame_count;
 27741:                     if (!c_ir_lower_place_frame_push(builder, index, place_end))
 27742:                     {
 27743:                         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27744:                         return;
 27745:                     }
 27746:                     c_ir_lower_place_step(builder, machine->frames + machine->frame_count - 1);
 27747:                     if (machine->frame_count != place_mark || machine->failed)
 27748:                     {
 27749:                         return;
 27750:                     }
 27751:                     if (!machine->child_result.success)
 27752:                     {
 27753:                         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27754:                         return;
 27755:                     }
 27756:                     if (!c_ir_lower_expression_core_consume_place(builder, frame, state, values, &value_count, &index))
 27757:                     {
 27758:                         return;
 27759:                     }
 27760:                     expect_operand = false;
 27761:                     frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
 27762:                     goto c_ir_expression_core_loop;
 27763:                 }
 27764:                 else if (local)
 27765:                 {
 27766:                     if (index + 2 < end &&
 27767:                         (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) ||
 27768:                          c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW)) &&
 27769:                         builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 2].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 27770:                     {
 27771:                         IrValueId place = c_ir_emit_field_place(builder, local, builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 2]);
 27772:                         if (place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 27773:                         {
 27774:                             value_place = place;
 27775:                             IrTypeId field_type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
 27776:                             IrType* field = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, field_type);

 27793:                         {

 27797:                 }
 27798:                 else if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count &&

 27803:                     if (place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && index + 2 < end &&
 27804:                         (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) ||
 27805:                          c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW)) &&
 27806:                         builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 2].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 27807:                     {
 27808:                         IrValueId operand = place;
 27809:                         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW))
 27810:                         {

 27812:                             operand = c_ir_emit_arrow_operand_from_place(builder, place, place_type, source);
 27813:                         }

 27816:                         index += 2;
 27817:                     }
 27818:                     if (place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 27819:                     {

 27822:                         IrType* type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
 27823:                         value = type_value && (type_value->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || (type_value->is_atomic && c_ir_postfix_update_at(builder, index, end)))
 27824:                                     ? place
 27825:                                     : c_ir_emit_expression_place_value(builder, place, type, source);
 27826:                     }
 27827:                 }
 27828:                 else if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count && builder->parse.entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR)
 27829:                 {
 27830:                     CEntity* enumerator = &builder->parse.entities[entity.value];

 27832:                 }
 27833:                 else if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count && builder->parse.entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_FUNCTION)
 27834:                 {

 27836:                 }
 27837:             }
 27838:             if (value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && value_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && index + 1 < end &&

 27845:             }

 27847:             {

 27852:                     // records no binding for it, and reporting the name as

 27857:                     bool called = identifier_index + 1 < end &&
 27858:                                   c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[identifier_index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS);
 27859:                     String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token);
 27860:                     builder->failure_message =
 27861:                         failed_entity.value >= builder->parse.entity_count

 27863:                         : called ? string_format(builder->arena, S8("could not lower call to '{S8}' bound to C entity {u32} of kind {u32}"), spelling,
 27864:                                                  failed_entity.value, (u32)builder->parse.entities[failed_entity.value].kind)
 27865:                                  : string_format(builder->arena, S8("could not lower identifier '{S8}' bound to C entity {u32} of kind {u32}"), spelling,
 27866:                                                  failed_entity.value, (u32)builder->parse.entities[failed_entity.value].kind);
 27867:                 }

 27869:                 return;
 27870:             }
 27871:             values[value_count++] = value;
 27872:             expect_operand = false;
 27873:             continue;
 27874:         }
 27875:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) && index + 2 < end &&
 27876:             c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
 27877:         {
 27878:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 27879:             if (close < end && close > index + 2 && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[close - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE) &&
 27880:                 c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index + 1, close, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE) == close - 1)
 27881:             {
 27882:                 c_ir_expression_core_save(frame, values, operations, operation_sources, operation_cast_types, value_count, operation_count,
 27883:                                           close + 1, expect_operand);
 27884:                 frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_CORE_STATEMENT;
 27885:                 if (!c_ir_lower_statement_expression_frame_push(builder, index + 1, close - 1))
 27886:                 {
 27887:                     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27888:                 }
 27889:                 return;
 27890:             }
 27891:         }
 27892:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 27893:         {
 27894:             if (!expect_operand)
 27895:             {
 27896:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27897:                 return;
 27898:             }
 27899:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 27900:             IrTypeId cast_type = close < end ? c_ir_group_type_name(builder, index, close) : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 27901:             u32 initializer_close = UINT32_MAX;
 27902:             bool compound_literal = close + 1 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[close + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE);
 27903:             if (compound_literal)

 27906:                 if (initializer_close >= end)
 27907:                 {
 27908:                     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 27909:                     return;
 27910:                 }

 27912:                                                                         : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;

 27920:                 {

 27923:                     {
 27924:                         cast_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[c_type.value];

 27926:                         {

 27929:                                 builder->parse.types[c_type_value->element_type.value].kind == C_TYPE_VOID)
 27930:                             {

 28274:     {
 28275:         return false;
 28276:     }
 28277:     block = &builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value];
 28278:     block->terminated = true;
 28279:     return true;
 28280: }
 28281: 
 28282: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_truth_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value, IrSourceRange source)
 28283: {
 28284:     IrTypeId type_id = builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type;
 28285:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
 28286:     if (!type)
 28287:     {
 28288:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 28289:     }
 28290:     // Array expressions decay to pointers in every value context, including
 28291:     // the truth conversion of an assertion's `condition && "message"`
 28292:     // operand.  Keep the declared array type for sizeof/type-only queries,
 28293:     // but materialize its address before forming the pointer comparison here.
 28294:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
 28295:     {
 28296:         IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, type->element_type);
 28297:         value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, pointer_type, source);
 28298:         if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 28299:         {
 28300:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 28301:         }
 28302:         type_id = pointer_type;
 28303:         type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
 28304:         if (!type)
 28305:         {
 28306:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 28307:         }
 28308:     }
 28309:     if (c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, type_id))
 28310:     {
 28311:         IrValueId widened = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__extendhfsf2"), builder->f32_type, value, type_id, source);
 28312:         return widened.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_truth_value(builder, widened, source);
 28313:     }
 28314:     // Truth conversion is a comparison against a zero of the same type, so it
 28315:     // needs the x87 comparison the canonical backend provides only for f80.
 28316:     // A wide long double on any other target still has none.
 28317:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && type->bit_width > 64 && !c_ir_target_supports_f80(builder->target))
 28318:     {
 28319:         builder->failure_message = S8("C IR lowering does not yet support wide floating-point truth conversion");
 28320:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 28321:     }
 28322:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN)
 28323:     {
 28324:         return value;
 28325:     }
 28326:     // A complex value is false only when both halves are zero (C11 6.3.1.2
 28327:     // applied to G.4.1's model), so the conversion is `re != 0 || im != 0`.
 28328:     if (type->is_complex)
 28329:     {
 28330:         IrTypeId element = type->element_type;
 28331:         IrValueId real = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 28332:         IrValueId imaginary = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 28333:         IrValueId zero = c_ir_complex_zero(builder, element, source);
 28334:         if (zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_complex_split(builder, value, &real, &imaginary, source))
 28335:         {
 28336:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 28337:         }
 28338:         IrValueId real_nonzero = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, real, zero, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL, source);
 28339:         IrValueId imaginary_nonzero = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, imaginary, zero, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL, source);
 28340:         return c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, real_nonzero, imaginary_nonzero, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_BOOLEAN_OR, source);
 28341:     }
 28342:     if (type->is_nullptr)
 28343:     {
 28344:         return c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0}, builder->bool_type);
 28345:     }
 28346:     // A pointer's zero is built at pointer width for the reason
 28347:     // c_ir_emit_nullptr gives: it saves the widening cast on the hottest
 28348:     // conversion in the language.
 28349:     IrTypeId zero_type = type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? builder->size_type : builder->s32_type;
 28350:     IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0}, zero_type);
 28351:     if (zero.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && type_id.value != zero_type.value)
 28352:     {
 28353:         IrType* integer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->s32_type);
 28354:         IrConversionOperation conversion = IR_CONVERSION_COUNT;
 28355:         if (integer_type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
 28356:         {
 28357:             conversion = integer_type->bit_width < type->bit_width
 28358:                              ? (integer_type->is_signed ? IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_SIGN_EXTEND : IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_ZERO_EXTEND)
 28359:                          : integer_type->bit_width > type->bit_width ? IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_TRUNCATE
 28360:                                                                     : IR_CONVERSION_INTEGER_REINTERPRET;
 28361:         }
 28362:         else if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 28363:         {
 28364:             conversion = IR_CONVERSION_SIGNED_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT;
 28365:         }
 28366:         if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 28367:         {
 28368:             zero = c_ir_emit_integer_to_pointer(builder, zero, type_id, source);
 28369:         }
 28370:         else
 28371:         {
 28372:             zero = conversion == IR_CONVERSION_COUNT ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID
 28373:                                                      : c_ir_emit_cast_instruction(builder, zero, type_id, conversion, source);
 28374:         }
 28375:     }
 28376:     if (zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 28377:     {
 28378:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 28379:     }
 28380:     IrBinaryOperation operation = type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER   ? IR_BINARY_INTEGER_NOT_EQUAL
 28381:                                   : type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT   ? IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL
 28382:                                   : type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER ? IR_BINARY_POINTER_NOT_EQUAL
 28383:                                                                   : IR_BINARY_COUNT;
 28384:     if (operation == IR_BINARY_COUNT)
 28385:     {
 28386:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 28387:     }
 28388:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, builder->bool_type);
 28389:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 2);
 28390:     operands[0] = value;
 28391:     operands[1] = zero;
 28392:     IrSourceRange comparison_source = source;
 28393:     IrInstruction comparison = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_BINARY, builder->bool_type);
 28394:     comparison.operands = operands;
 28395:     comparison.operand_count = 2;
 28396:     comparison.binary_operation = (u8)operation;
 28397:     comparison.result = result;
 28398:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, comparison, comparison_source);
 28399:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
 28400:     return result;
 28401: }

 28403: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_matching_delimiter(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 open, u32 end, CPunctuator opening, CPunctuator closing);
 28404: 
 28405: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_root_conditional(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, u32* expression_start, u32* question, u32* colon,
 28406:                                                u32* expression_end);
 28407:

 28417: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_condition_leaf_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
 28418: {
 28419:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 28420:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
 28421:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = &machine->frames[machine->frame_count - 1];
 28422:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_CONDITION_LEAF);
 28423:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CONDITION_LEAF_PLACE)
 28424:     {
 28425:         IrValueId place = machine->child_result.value;
 28426:         if (!machine->child_result.success || place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 28427:         {
 28428:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 28429:             return;
 28430:         }
 28431:         frame->as.condition_leaf.place = place;
 28432:         frame->as.condition_leaf.type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
 28433:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CONDITION_LEAF_ASSIGNMENT;
 28434:         if (!c_ir_lower_expression_core_frame_push(builder, frame->as.condition_leaf.start, frame->as.condition_leaf.end))
 28435:         {
 28436:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 28437:         }
 28438:         return;
 28439:     }
 28440:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CONDITION_LEAF_CORE)
 28441:     {
 28442:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, machine->child_result.success, machine->child_result.value);
 28443:         return;
 28444:     }
 28445:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CONDITION_LEAF_ASSIGNMENT)
 28446:     {
 28447:         IrValueId value = machine->child_result.value;
 28448:         IrValueId place = frame->as.condition_leaf.place;
 28449:         IrTypeId type = frame->as.condition_leaf.type;
 28450:         IrSourceRange source = frame->as.condition_leaf.source;
 28451:         if (!machine->child_result.success || place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 28452:         {
 28453:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 28454:             return;
 28455:         }
 28456:         if (!frame->as.condition_leaf.simple)
 28457:         {
 28458:             bool success = c_ir_emit_compound_assignment(builder, place, type, frame->as.condition_leaf.operation, value, source, 0, &value);
 28459:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, success, value);
 28460:             return;
 28461:         }
 28462:         value = c_ir_decay_array(builder, value, type, source);
 28463:         value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, type, source);
 28464:         bool success = value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, place, type, value, source);
 28465:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, success, value);
 28466:         return;
 28467:     }
 28468:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_BEGIN);
 28469:     u32 start = frame->as.condition_leaf.start;
 28470:     u32 end = frame->as.condition_leaf.end;
 28471:     u32 assignment = end;
 28472:     u32 parentheses = 0;
 28473:     u32 brackets = 0;
 28474:     u32 braces = 0;
 28475:     u32 conditional_depth = 0;
 28476:     bool top_level_comma = false;
 28477:     CConditionalOperator operation = C_CONDITIONAL_OPERATOR_COUNT;
 28478:     for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
 28479:     {
 28480:         CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];

 29029:         {

 29062:         memset(result->dimension_counts, 0xff, sizeof(*result->dimension_counts) * result->dimension_count);

 29067:     }

 29084:         {

 29086:             return;
 29087:         }

 29100:             state->dimension += 1;
 29101:             continue;
 29102:         }
 29103:         if (!bound.token_count || bound.is_star)
 29104:         {
 29105:             if (state->parameter && dimension == 0)
 29106:             {
 29107:                 state->dimension += 1;
 29108:                 continue;
 29109:             }
 29110:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 29111:             return;
 29112:         }
 29113:         state->temporary_mark = builder->temporary_arena->position;
 29114:         frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
 29115:         c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
 29116:                                            .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION,
 29117:                                            .as.expression =
 29118:                                                {
 29119:                                                    .start = bound.token_start,
 29120:                                                    .end = bound.token_start + bound.token_count,
 29121:                                                },
 29122:                                        });
 29123:         return;
 29124:     }
 29125:     IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, result->element_type);
 29126:     result->suffix_sizes[result->dimension_count] =
 29127:         c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, element->layout.size, false, state->token, builder->size_type);
 29128:     // suffix_sizes[0] is the whole object's size, and a parameter never has
 29129:     // one: an array parameter is a pointer, so the only reader of
 29130:     // CIrVlaLayout::runtime_size that wants suffix 0 is the ALLOCATE in
 29131:     // c_ir_lower_automatic_declaration_step, which is the declaration path and
 29132:     // not this one, and c_ir_lower_expression_core_step's sizeof arm refuses
 29133:     // suffix 0 for an is_vla_parameter local on purpose, because `sizeof a` is
 29134:     // the pointer's. Stopping the walk one dimension short therefore drops the
 29135:     // outermost MULTIPLY — for a one-dimensional `u8 a[n]` that is the whole
 29136:     // product, and unlike the constant bound `u8 slots[2]` the operands are not
 29137:     // both known, so it cost emitted code rather than compile time. Every inner
 29138:     // suffix is still built: `sizeof a[0]` on `u8 a[n][m]` reads
 29139:     // suffix_sizes[1]. suffix_sizes[0] stays INVALID from the 0xff fill above,
 29140:     // which is what an absent bound already left there and what the
 29141:     // c_ir_lower_frame_finish below already accepts for a parameter.
 29142:     u32 outermost_dimension = state->parameter ? 1 : 0;
 29143:     for (u32 dimension = result->dimension_count; dimension != outermost_dimension; dimension -= 1)
 29144:     {
 29145:         u32 index = dimension - 1;
 29146:         IrValueId count = result->dimension_counts[index];

 29148:         if (count.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && suffix.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 29149:         {
 29150:             result->suffix_sizes[index] =
 29151:                 c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, count, suffix, builder->size_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_MULTIPLY, state->source);
 29152:         }
 29153:     }
 29154:     result->runtime_size = result->suffix_sizes[0];
 29155:     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, state->parameter || result->runtime_size.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID, result->runtime_size);
 29156: }

 29158: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_automatic_declaration_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder);
 29159: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_declaration_or_assignment_list_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder);

 29163: // The request helpers run the pushed child now, off the dispatch loop, and
 29164: // return true when it completed: the advance loop in
 29165: // c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_step then re-enters the CHILD arm as a
 29166: // self-loop instead of a dispatch round trip. A suspension returns false and
 29167: // resumes through the loop unchanged.
 29168: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_expression(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,
 29169:                                                                               CIrLowerAssignmentStatementState* state,
 29170:                                                                               CIrLowerAssignmentStatementContinuation continuation, u32 start,
 29171:                                                                               u32 end)
 29172: {
 29173:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 29174:     state->continuation = continuation;
 29175:     state->temporary_mark = builder->temporary_arena->position;
 29176:     frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
 29177:     u32 request_mark = machine->frame_count;
 29178:     bool completed = false;
 29179:     if (c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, (CIrLowerFrame){
 29180:                                            .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION,
 29181:                                            .as.expression =
 29182:                                                {
 29183:                                                    .start = start,
 29184:                                                    .end = end,
 29185:                                                },
 29186:                                        }))
 29187:     {
 29188:         c_ir_lower_expression_step(builder);
 29189:         completed = machine->frame_count == request_mark && !machine->failed;
 29190:     }
 29191:     return completed;
 29192: }
 29193: 
 29194: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame,
 29195:                                                                          CIrLowerAssignmentStatementState* state, u32 start, u32 end)
 29196: {
 29197:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 29198:     state->continuation = C_IR_LOWER_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT_GENERAL_LEFT;
 29199:     state->temporary_mark = builder->temporary_arena->position;
 29200:     frame->stage = C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
 29201:     u32 request_mark = machine->frame_count;
 29202:     bool completed = false;
 29203:     if (c_ir_lower_place_frame_push(builder, start, end))
 29204:     {
 29205:         c_ir_lower_place_step(builder, machine->frames + machine->frame_count - 1);
 29206:         completed = machine->frame_count == request_mark && !machine->failed;
 29207:     }
 29208:     return completed;
 29209: }

 29211: // Recover the addressable place behind a just-emitted load. Both ordinary
 29212: // assignment statements and nested parenthesized assignment expressions use
 29213: // this when their left operand was lowered as a value first (for example an
 29214: // address-of/member chain in Lua's setnilvalue macro).
 29215: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_recover_memory_place_from_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId value)
 29216: {
 29217:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 29218:     if (value.value < builder->function->value_count)
 29219:     {
 29220:         IrValue* value_definition = builder->function->values + value.value;
 29221:         if (value_definition->category == IR_VALUE_PLACE)
 29222:         {
 29223:             result = value;
 29224:         }
 29225:         else if (value_definition->definition.value < builder->function->instruction_count)
 29226:         {
 29227:             IrInstructionId definition_id = value_definition->definition;
 29228:             IrInstruction* definition = builder->function->instructions + definition_id.value;
 29229:             CIrDirectSsa* ssa = builder->direct_ssa;
 29230:             bool has_later_event = ssa && ssa->event_count && ssa->events[ssa->event_count - 1].after.value == definition_id.value;
 29231:             bool recover = !has_later_event && (definition->opcode == IR_OPCODE_LOAD || definition->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD) &&
 29232:                            definition->operand_count == 1 && definition_id.value + 1 == builder->function->instruction_count &&
 29233:                            value.value + 1 == builder->function->value_count &&
 29234:                            builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value].last_instruction.value == definition_id.value &&
 29235:                            builder->last_instruction.value == definition_id.value;
 29236:             IrInstructionId previous = IR_INSTRUCTION_ID_INVALID;
 29237:             if (recover)
 29238:             {
 29239:                 if (builder->previous_instruction_known)
 29240:                 {
 29241:                     previous = builder->previous_instruction;
 29242:                 }
 29243:                 else
 29244:                 {
 29245:                     IrInstructionId cursor = builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value].first_instruction;
 29246:                     while (cursor.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && cursor.value != definition_id.value)
 29247:                     {
 29248:                         IR_CONSTRUCTION_RECORD(PLACE_REPAIR_STEPS, 1);
 29249:                         previous = cursor;
 29250:                         cursor = builder->function->instructions[cursor.value].next;
 29251:                     }
 29252:                     recover = cursor.value == definition_id.value;
 29253:                 }
 29254:             }
 29255:             if (recover)
 29256:             {
 29257:                 if (previous.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
--- lines 29587-29814 ---
 29587:                 base = local_type && local_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY ? local->place : c_ir_emit_load(builder, local, first);
 29588:             }
 29589:             if (base.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 29590:             {
 29591:                 state->base = base;
 29592:                 state->assignment = close + 1;
 29593:                 state->close = close;
 29594:                 state->operation = operation;
 29595:                 state->simple = simple;
 29596:                 return c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_expression(builder, frame, state, C_IR_LOWER_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT_INDEX_SUBSCRIPT, start + 2, close);
 29597:             }
 29598:         }
 29599:         // A postfix update or another full expression follows the subscript;
 29600:         // leave it to the expression machine below rather than treating the
 29601:         // update token as a malformed assignment operator.
 29602:     }
 29603:     if (first.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && start + 4 < end &&
 29604:         (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) ||
 29605:          c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW)) &&
 29606:         builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 2].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_ir_assignment_operator(builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 3]))
 29607:     {
 29608:         CToken assignment = builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 3];
 29609:         CConditionalOperator operation = C_CONDITIONAL_OPERATOR_COUNT;
 29610:         bool simple = c_token_is_punctuator(&assignment, C_PUNCTUATOR_ASSIGN);
 29611:         c_ir_compound_assignment_operator(assignment, &operation);
 29612:         CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, start);
 29613:         CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
 29614:         IrValueId place = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 29615:         if (local)
 29616:         {
 29617:             place = c_ir_emit_field_place(builder, local, builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1], builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 2]);
 29618:         }
 29619:         else
 29620:         {
 29621:             IrSourceRange field_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, first);
 29622:             IrValueId base = c_ir_emit_global_place(builder, entity, field_source);
 29623:             if (base.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW))
 29624:             {
 29625:                 IrTypeId base_type = builder->function->values[base.value].canonical_type;
 29626:                 base = c_ir_emit_arrow_operand_from_place(builder, base, base_type, field_source);
 29627:             }
 29628:             place = c_ir_emit_field_place_from_value(builder, base, builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1], builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 2]);
 29629:         }
 29630:         if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 29631:         {
 29632:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 29633:             return false;
 29634:         }
 29635:         state->place = place;
 29636:         state->type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
 29637:         state->assignment = start + 3;
 29638:         state->operation = operation;
 29639:         state->simple = simple;
 29640:         return c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_expression(builder, frame, state, C_IR_LOWER_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT_FIELD_RIGHT, start + 4, end);
 29641:     }
 29642:     if (first.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && start + 2 == end &&
 29643:         (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ||
 29644:          c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS)))
 29645:     {
 29646:         CToken update = builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1];
 29647:         CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, start));
 29648:         if (!local)
 29649:         {
 29650:             // Global objects use the general expression-core update path,
 29651:             // which resolves their identifier to a global place before
 29652:             // applying the increment.  Keep this local fast path narrow so
 29653:             // a direct statement such as `listing++` is not rejected merely

 29655:             return c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_expression(builder, frame, state, C_IR_LOWER_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT_EXPRESSION, start, end);
 29656:         }
 29657:         IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 1, false, update);
 29658:         bool success = c_ir_emit_compound_assignment(builder, local->place, local->type,
 29659:                                                       c_token_is_punctuator(&update, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ? C_CONDITIONAL_ADD : C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT, one,
 29660:                                                       c_ir_token_source_range(builder, update), 0, 0);
 29661:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, success, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 29662:         return false;
 29663:     }
 29664:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS))
 29665:     {
 29666:         if (start + 2 != end || builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 29667:         {
 29668:             // Prefix updates over a dereference (for example ++(*input)) are
 29669:             // full expressions rather than the identifier fast path below.
 29670:             // Let the expression machine form the dereferenced place and
 29671:             // apply the same increment semantics used by return/condition
 29672:             // expressions.
 29673:             return c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_expression(builder, frame, state, C_IR_LOWER_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT_EXPRESSION, start, end);
 29674:         }
 29675:         CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, start + 1));
 29676:         if (!local)
 29677:         {
 29678:             // See the postfix case above: the expression core already knows
 29679:             // how to form a place for a global identifier, so let it handle
 29680:             // prefix updates instead of treating a missing local as an
 29681:             // unsupported statement.
 29682:             return c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_expression(builder, frame, state, C_IR_LOWER_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT_EXPRESSION, start, end);
 29683:         }
 29684:         IrValueId one = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 1, false, first);
 29685:         bool success = c_ir_emit_compound_assignment(builder, local->place, local->type,
 29686:                                                       c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ? C_CONDITIONAL_ADD : C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT, one,
 29687:                                                       c_ir_token_source_range(builder, first), 0, 0);
 29688:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, success, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 29689:         return false;
 29690:     }
 29691:     if (first.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && start + 2 < end)
 29692:     {
 29693:         CToken assignment = builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1];
 29694:         CConditionalOperator operation = C_CONDITIONAL_OPERATOR_COUNT;
 29695:         bool simple = c_token_is_punctuator(&assignment, C_PUNCTUATOR_ASSIGN);
 29696:         bool compound = c_ir_compound_assignment_operator(assignment, &operation);
 29697:         if (simple || compound)
 29698:         {
 29699:             CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, start);
 29700:             CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);

 29702:             IrValueId place = local ? local->place : c_ir_emit_global_place(builder, entity, source);
 29703:             if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 29704:             {
 29705:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 29706:                 return false;
 29707:             }
 29708:             state->place = place;
 29709:             state->type = local ? local->type : builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;
 29710:             state->assignment = start + 1;
 29711:             state->operation = operation;
 29712:             state->simple = simple;
 29713:             return c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_expression(builder, frame, state, C_IR_LOWER_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT_IDENTIFIER_RIGHT, start + 2, end);
 29714:         }
 29715:     }
 29716:     return c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_expression(builder, frame, state, C_IR_LOWER_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT_EXPRESSION, start, end);
 29717: }
 29718: 
 29719: // Each advance runs the stage machine to a child request or the finish; the
 29720: // request helpers run the child off the dispatch loop and report whether it
 29721: // completed, so a completed child re-enters the CHILD arm here as a
 29722: // self-loop instead of resuming through a dispatch round trip.
 29723: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
 29724: {
 29725:     bool stepping = true;
 29726:     while (stepping)
 29727:     {
 29728:         stepping = c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_advance(builder);
 29729:     }
 29730: }

 30028:         return;

 30041: 
 30042: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_root_conditional(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, u32* expression_start, u32* question, u32* colon,
 30043:                                                u32* expression_end)
 30044: {
 30045:     while (start < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
 30046:            !c_ir_group_is_statement_expression(builder, start, end))
 30047:     {
 30048:         u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 30049:         if (close != end - 1)
 30050:         {
 30051:             break;
 30052:         }
 30053:         start += 1;
 30054:         end -= 1;
 30055:     }
 30056:     u32 found_question = UINT32_MAX;
 30057:     u32 nested_questions = 0;
 30058:     bool root_assignment = false;
 30059:     for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
 30060:     {
 30061:         u32 punctuator = builder->preprocess.tokens[index].punctuator;
 30062:         CIrGroupScan scan = c_ir_scan_delimiter_group(builder, &index, end);
 30063:         if (scan == C_IR_GROUP_SCAN_SKIPPED)
 30064:         {
 30065:             continue;
 30066:         }
 30067:         if (scan == C_IR_GROUP_SCAN_UNCLOSED)
 30068:         {
 30069:             return false;
 30070:         }
 30071:         if (punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS || punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET || punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE)
 30072:         {
 30073:             return false;
 30074:         }
 30075:         if (punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_QUESTION)
 30076:         {
 30077:             // `lhs = condition ? true_value : false_value` has a
 30078:             // conditional operator in the assignment's right operand, not
 30079:             // at the root of the expression.  Treating it as a root
 30080:             // conditional loses the assignment completion (the Lua
 30081:             // luaV_fastgeti macro relies on this exact precedence).
 30082:             if (root_assignment)
 30083:             {
 30084:                 return false;
 30085:             }
 30086:             if (found_question == UINT32_MAX)
 30087:             {
 30088:                 found_question = index;
 30089:             }
 30090:             else
 30091:             {
 30092:                 nested_questions += 1;
 30093:             }
 30094:         }
 30095:         else if (found_question != UINT32_MAX && punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_COLON)
 30096:         {
 30097:             if (nested_questions)
 30098:             {
 30099:                 nested_questions -= 1;
 30100:             }
 30101:             else
 30102:             {
 30103:                 if (found_question == start || found_question + 1 == index || index + 1 == end)
 30104:                 {
 30105:                     return false;
 30106:                 }
 30107:                 *expression_start = start;
 30108:                 *question = found_question;
 30109:                 *colon = index;
 30110:                 *expression_end = end;
 30111:                 return true;
 30112:             }
 30113:         }
 30114:         else if (found_question == UINT32_MAX && c_ir_assignment_operator(builder->preprocess.tokens[index]))
 30115:         {
 30116:             root_assignment = true;
 30117:         }
 30118:     }
 30119:     return false;
 30120: }

 30122: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_expression_core_range(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32* start_in_out, u32* end_in_out)
 30123: {
 30124:     u32 start = *start_in_out;
 30125:     u32 end = *end_in_out;
 30126:     bool narrowed = true;
 30127:     while (narrowed)
 30128:     {
 30129:         narrowed = false;
 30130:         while (start < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
 30131:                !c_ir_group_is_statement_expression(builder, start, end) &&
 30132:                c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) == end - 1)
 30133:         {
 30134:             start += 1;
 30135:             end -= 1;
 30136:             narrowed = true;
 30137:         }
 30138:         u32 last_comma = UINT32_MAX;
 30139:         u32 conditional_depth = 0;
 30140:         for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
 30141:         {
 30142:             u32 punctuator = builder->preprocess.tokens[index].punctuator;
 30143:             CIrGroupScan scan = c_ir_scan_delimiter_group(builder, &index, end);
 30144:             if (scan == C_IR_GROUP_SCAN_SKIPPED)
 30145:             {
 30146:                 continue;
 30147:             }
 30148:             if (scan == C_IR_GROUP_SCAN_UNCLOSED)
 30149:             {
 30150:                 break;
 30151:             }
 30152:             if (punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_QUESTION)
 30153:             {
 30154:                 conditional_depth += 1;
 30155:             }
 30156:             else if (punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_COLON && conditional_depth)
 30157:             {
 30158:                 conditional_depth -= 1;
 30159:             }
 30160:             else if (punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA && !conditional_depth)

 30240:     }
 30241: 
 30242:     return result;
 30243: }
