 30245: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_predict_nonconditional_expression_type_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end)
 30246: {
 30247:     // A GNU statement expression has the type of the trailing expression
 30248:     // statement in its body, and void when it has no such statement --
 30249:     // glibc's assert expansion, which Lua's `LUA_USER_H="ltests.h"` build
 30250:     // reaches, ends in a call to noreturn `__assert_fail`, and letting the
 30251:     // generic identifier fallback see that name predicts an integer and makes
 30252:     // a valid `(void)0 : assert(...)` conditional appear incompatible. Reading
 30253:     // the trailing `;` alone as void was the cheaper approximation of the same
 30254:     // rule, and it made `({ 11; })` void as well, so a conditional with a
 30255:     // statement expression in one arm merged two voids and produced nothing.
 30256:     // Keep this shape check ahead of the strict operand query, which is
 30257:     // intentionally type-only and cannot see a body at all.
 30258:     u32 statement_start = start;
 30259:     if (statement_start < end && builder->preprocess.tokens[statement_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
 30260:         string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[statement_start]), S8("__extension__")))
 30261:     {
 30262:         statement_start += 1;
 30263:     }
 30264:     if (statement_start + 3 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[statement_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
 30265:         c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[statement_start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE) &&
 30266:         c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) &&
 30267:         c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, statement_start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) == end - 1 &&
 30268:         c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, statement_start + 1, end - 1, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE) == end - 2)
 30269:     {
 30270:         u32 tail_start = 0;
 30271:         u32 tail_end = 0;
 30272:         IrTypeId tail_type = builder->void_type;
 30273:         if (c_ir_statement_expression_tail(builder, statement_start + 1, end - 2, &tail_start, &tail_end))
 30274:         {
 30275:             if (!c_ir_query_prediction(builder, tail_start, tail_end, &tail_type) && builder->queries->has_request)
 30276:             {
 30277:                 return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30278:             }
 30279:             tail_type = tail_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? builder->void_type : tail_type;
 30280:         }
 30281:         return tail_type;
 30282:     }
 30283:     if (start + 3 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 30284:     {
 30285:         u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 30286:         if (close < end && close + 1 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[close + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
 30287:         {
 30288:             u32 initializer_close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, close + 1, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE);
 30289:             IrTypeId compound_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30290:             if (initializer_close < end)
 30291:             {
 30292:                 c_ir_query_compound_type(builder, start + 1, close, close + 1, initializer_close, &compound_type);
 30293:                 if (builder->queries->has_request)
 30294:                 {
 30295:                     return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30296:                 }
 30297:             }
 30298:             if (compound_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 30299:             {
 30300:                 return compound_type;
 30301:             }
 30302:         }
 30303:     }
 30304:     c_ir_expression_core_range(builder, &start, &end);
 30305:     // Resolve complete arithmetic/cast expressions before the legacy
 30306:     // identifier scan below.  That scan is intentionally a cheap fallback,
 30307:     // but for `((int)(pointer_difference)) + index` it retained the last
 30308:     // member's pointer type and made a surrounding conditional appear to
 30309:     // merge `int` with `pointer`.  The strict operand resolver already knows
 30310:     // the usual arithmetic conversions and pointer arithmetic, so use its
 30311:     // result whenever the full range is unambiguous.
 30312:     IrTypeId strict_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30313:     if (c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt(builder, start, end, &strict_type))
 30314:     {
 30315:         // The strict operand walk deliberately preserves an array's declared
 30316:         // type so callers such as sizeof can distinguish an array from its
 30317:         // element pointer.  An ordinary expression value, however, applies
 30318:         // the C array-to-pointer conversion before a conditional compares
 30319:         // the branch types (for example `array : 0`).
 30320:         IrType* strict_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, strict_type);
 30321:         if (strict_value && strict_value->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION)
 30322:         {
 30323:             // Function designators decay to pointers in value contexts.  The
 30324:             // strict operand query intentionally retains the declared
 30325:             // function type for sizeof/type-only callers, so perform the
 30326:             // value-context conversion here (not in the query itself).  This
 30327:             // matters for `lax ? iter_auxlax : iter_auxstrict` passed to
 30328:             // lua_pushcfunction.
 30329:             return c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, strict_type);
 30330:         }
 30331:         return c_ir_sizeof_operand_decay(builder, strict_type);
 30332:     }
 30333:     if (builder->queries->has_request)
 30334:     {
 30335:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30336:     }
 30337:     // Parenthesized function designators are still calls: `(gzgetc)(g)` is
 30338:     // common in zlib's gzgetc macro and must predict the declared return type
 30339:     // rather than the function-pointer type of the designator.  The strict
 30340:     // operand resolver already handles the parenthesized postfix call chain.
 30341:     if (start < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 30342:     {
 30343:         u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 30344:         if (close + 1 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[close + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 30345:         {
 30346:             IrTypeId call_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30347:             bool call_ready = c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt(builder, start, end, &call_type);
 30348:             if (builder->queries->has_request)
 30349:             {
 30350:                 return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30351:             }
 30352:             if (call_ready && call_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 30353:             {
 30354:                 return call_type;
 30355:             }
 30356:         }
 30357:     }
 30358:     // An assignment expression has the unpromoted type of its left operand.
 30359:     // The broad identifier scan below is intentionally only a fallback for
 30360:     // incomplete expressions; for `(p)->field = value` it would otherwise
 30361:     // retain `p`'s pointer type and make a surrounding conditional appear to
 30362:     // produce a pointer.  That misprediction is observable when the
 30363:     // conditional assignment is immediately compared (as in cJSON's boolean
 30364:     // setter macro).
 30365:     if (c_ir_has_root_assignment(builder, start, end))
 30366:     {
 30367:         IrTypeId assignment_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30368:         bool assignment_type_ready = c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt(builder, start, end, &assignment_type);
 30369:         if (builder->queries->has_request)
 30370:         {
 30371:             return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30372:         }
 30373:         if (assignment_type_ready && assignment_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 30374:         {
 30375:             return assignment_type;
 30376:         }
 30377:     }
 30378:     // Unary integer operators keep the promoted operand type. In particular,
 30379:     // a cast under `~` must not fall through to the s32 literal fallback.
 30380:     if (start < end && (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_TILDE) ||
 30381:                         c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS) ||
 30382:                         c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS)))
 30383:     {
 30384:         IrTypeId operand_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30385:         if (!c_ir_query_prediction(builder, start + 1, end, &operand_type) && builder->queries->has_request)
 30386:         {
 30387:             return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30388:         }
 30389:         IrTypeId predicted = c_ir_usual_arithmetic_type(builder, operand_type, operand_type);
 30390:         IrType* predicted_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, predicted);
 30391:         if (predicted_value && predicted_value->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
 30392:         {
 30393:             return predicted;
 30394:         }
 30395:     }
 30396:     // Unary dereference changes the operand's pointer/array type to its
 30397:     // element type.  Keep this in the prediction path as well as the lowering
 30398:     // path; otherwise a conditional such as `*p++ ? ... : int_call()` is
 30399:     // predicted as a pointer and the later comparison rejects an ordinary
 30400:     // promoted character result against a nonzero integer.
 30401:     if (start < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR))
 30402:     {
 30403:         IrTypeId dereferenced_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30404:         if (c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt(builder, start, end, &dereferenced_type))
 30405:         {
 30406:             return dereferenced_type;
 30407:         }
 30408:     }
 30409:     if (start + 1 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_AMPERSAND_AMPERSAND) &&
 30410:         builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 30411:     {
 30412:         CIrLabel* label = c_ir_label_find(builder->labels, builder->label_count, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1]));
 30413:         if (label && start + 2 == end)
 30414:         {
 30415:             return c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, builder->void_type);
 30416:         }
 30417:     }
 30418:     {
 30419:         for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
 30420:         {
 30421:             CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];

 30423:             if (scan == C_IR_GROUP_SCAN_SKIPPED)
 30424:             {
 30425:                 continue;
 30426:             }
 30427:             if (scan == C_IR_GROUP_SCAN_UNCLOSED)
 30428:             {
 30429:                 break;
 30430:             }
 30431:             if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_EQUAL) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_NOT_EQUAL) ||
 30432:                 c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LESS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LESS_EQUAL) ||
 30433:                 c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_GREATER) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_GREATER_EQUAL) ||

 30824:     }
 30825:     return result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? builder->s32_type : result;
 30826: }
 30827: 
 30828: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_usual_arithmetic_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId left_type, IrTypeId right_type)
 30829: {
 30830:     IrType* left = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left_type);
 30831:     IrType* right = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right_type);
 30832:     if (!left || !right)
 30833:     {
 30834:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30835:     }
 30836:     // One complex operand makes the result complex, over the usual arithmetic
 30837:     // type of the two corresponding real types (C11 6.3.1.8p1).
 30838:     if (left->is_complex || right->is_complex)
 30839:     {
 30840:         return c_ir_complex_result_type(builder, left_type, right_type);
 30841:     }
 30842:     if (left->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || left->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM || (left->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && left->bit_width < 32))
 30843:     {
 30844:         left_type = builder->s32_type;
 30845:         left = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left_type);
 30846:     }
 30847:     if (right->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || right->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM || (right->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && right->bit_width < 32))
 30848:     {
 30849:         right_type = builder->s32_type;
 30850:         right = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right_type);
 30851:     }
 30852:     bool left_arithmetic = left && (left->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || left->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT);
 30853:     bool right_arithmetic = right && (right->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || right->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT);
 30854:     if (!left_arithmetic || !right_arithmetic)
 30855:     {
 30856:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30857:     }
 30858:     if (left->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT || right->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 30859:     {
 30860:         if (left->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 30861:         {
 30862:             return right_type;
 30863:         }
 30864:         if (right->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 30865:         {
 30866:             return left_type;
 30867:         }
 30868:         return c_ir_float_conversion_rank(right) > c_ir_float_conversion_rank(left) ? right_type : left_type;
 30869:     }
 30870:     if (left_type.value == right_type.value)
 30871:     {
 30872:         return left_type;
 30873:     }
 30874:     if (left->is_signed == right->is_signed)
 30875:     {
 30876:         return right->bit_width > left->bit_width ? right_type : left_type;
 30877:     }
 30878:     IrTypeId signed_type = left->is_signed ? left_type : right_type;
 30879:     IrTypeId unsigned_type = left->is_signed ? right_type : left_type;
 30880:     IrType* signed_value = left->is_signed ? left : right;
 30881:     IrType* unsigned_value = left->is_signed ? right : left;
 30882:     IrTypeId result;
 30883:     if (unsigned_value->bit_width >= signed_value->bit_width)
 30884:     {
 30885:         result = unsigned_type;
 30886:     }
 30887:     else
 30888:     {
 30889:         result = signed_type;
 30890:     }
 30891: 
 30892:     return result;
 30893: }
 30894: 
 30895: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_type_is_integer_domain(IrType* type)
 30896: {
 30897:     return type && (type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM);
 30898: }
 30899: 
 30900: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_range_is_null_pointer_constant_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type_id, u32 start, u32 end)
 30901: {
 30902:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
 30903:     // C11 6.3.2.3p3 gives a null pointer constant two spellings: an integer
 30904:     // constant expression with the value 0, *or* such an expression cast to
 30905:     // `void *`.  The second is not a rewording of the first -- it is the only
 30906:     // one that survives being written as a conditional operand, and musl's
 30907:     // <tgmath.h> is built out of exactly that: `0 ? (t*)0 : (void*)!(c)`
 30908:     // selects `t` or `void` purely on whether the `void *` arm is a null
 30909:     // pointer constant.
 30910:     bool void_pointer = type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && !type->is_nullptr;
 30911:     if (void_pointer)
 30912:     {
 30913:         IrType* pointee = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type->element_type);
 30914:         void_pointer = pointee && pointee->kind == IR_TYPE_VOID;
 30915:     }
 30916:     if (!c_ir_type_is_integer_domain(type) && !void_pointer)
 30917:     {
 30918:         return false;
 30919:     }
 30920:     CIrConstantValue value = {0};
 30921:     if (!c_ir_query_constant(builder, start, end, &value))
 30922:     {
 30923:         return false;
 30924:     }
 30925:     // A `void *` operand folds through the cast rule in c_ir_constant_cast,
 30926:     // which turns a zero integer into a symbol-less pointer constant and
 30927:     // fails outright on any other value -- so `(void *)1` never arrives here
 30928:     // as a constant at all.
 30929:     if (void_pointer)
 30930:     {
 30931:         return value.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER && value.symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && !value.addend && !value.integer;
 30932:     }
 30933:     return value.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER && !value.integer;
 30934: }
 30935: 
 30936: // Pointer selection shares one semantic merge between expression typing and
 30937: // constant folding. The caller supplies whether each operand is a null pointer
 30938: // constant; that fact depends on the expression, not merely its pointer type.
 30939: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_conditional_pointer_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId true_type, IrTypeId false_type,
 30940:                                                           bool true_null_constant, bool false_null_constant)
 30941: {
 30942:     IrType* true_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, true_type);
 30943:     IrType* false_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, false_type);
 30944:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 30945:     if (true_value && false_value)
 30946:     {
 30947:         if (true_value->is_nullptr && false_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && !false_value->is_nullptr)
 30948:         {
 30949:             result = false_type;
 30950:         }
 30951:         else if (false_value->is_nullptr && true_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && !true_value->is_nullptr)
 30952:         {
 30953:             result = true_type;
 30954:         }
 30955:         else if (true_value->is_nullptr && false_null_constant)
 30956:         {
 30957:             result = true_type;
 30958:         }
 30959:         else if (false_value->is_nullptr && true_null_constant)
 30960:         {
 30961:             result = false_type;
 30962:         }
 30963:         else if (true_value->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && c_ir_type_is_integer_domain(false_value) && false_null_constant)
 30964:         {
 30965:             result = true_type;
 30966:         }
--- lines 31004-31204 ---
 31004:             result = true_value->kind == false_value->kind ? true_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31005:         }
 31006:     }
 31007:     return result;
 31008: }
 31009: 
 31010: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_conditional_result_type_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId true_type, IrTypeId false_type, u32 true_start,
 31011:                                                                   u32 true_end, u32 false_start, u32 false_end)
 31012: {
 31013:     // Conditional arithmetic promotes bit-fields before finding a common
 31014:     // type, including two arms whose declared unsigned types are identical.
 31015:     IrType* first = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, true_type);
 31016:     IrType* second = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, false_type);
 31017:     bool promote_true = first && first->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && first->bit_width == 32 && !first->is_signed;
 31018:     bool promote_false = second && second->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && second->bit_width == 32 && !second->is_signed;
 31019:     if (promote_true)
 31020:     {
 31021:         IrTypeId promoted = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31022:         if (c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt_depth(builder, true_start, true_end, &promoted, 64, true))
 31023:         {
 31024:             true_type = promoted;
 31025:         }
 31026:     }
 31027:     if (promote_false && !builder->queries->has_request)
 31028:     {
 31029:         IrTypeId promoted = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31030:         if (c_ir_sizeof_operand_type_attempt_depth(builder, false_start, false_end, &promoted, 64, true))
 31031:         {
 31032:             false_type = promoted;
 31033:         }
 31034:     }
 31035:     if (builder->queries->has_request)
 31036:     {
 31037:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31038:     }
 31039:     if (true_type.value == false_type.value)
 31040:     {
 31041:         return true_type;
 31042:     }
 31043:     IrType* true_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, true_type);
 31044:     IrType* false_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, false_type);
 31045:     if (!true_value || !false_value)
 31046:     {
 31047:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31048:     }
 31049:     // C11 6.5.15p6: the second and third operands go through the usual
 31050:     // conversions, and an operand of array type becomes a pointer to its
 31051:     // first element. musl's select, pselect, ppoll and utime all write
 31052:     // `x ? (T[2]){...} : 0`, whose branches are an array and a null pointer
 31053:     // constant; without the decay the two kinds never met. Two array
 31054:     // branches of one type keep the fast path above, so only a mismatch
 31055:     // decays here.
 31056:     if (true_value->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY && false_value->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
 31057:     {
 31058:         true_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, true_value->element_type);
 31059:         true_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, true_type);
 31060:     }
 31061:     else if (false_value->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY && true_value->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
 31062:     {
 31063:         false_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, false_value->element_type);
 31064:         false_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, false_type);
 31065:     }
 31066:     if (!true_value || !false_value)
 31067:     {
 31068:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31069:     }
 31070:     if (true_type.value == false_type.value)
 31071:     {
 31072:         return true_type;
 31073:     }
 31074:     IrTypeId arithmetic_type = c_ir_usual_arithmetic_type(builder, true_type, false_type);
 31075:     if (arithmetic_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 31076:     {
 31077:         return arithmetic_type;
 31078:     }
 31079:     bool true_null_constant = false;
 31080:     bool false_null_constant = false;
 31081:     IrTypeId result;
 31082:     if (!c_ir_query_null_pointer_constant(builder, true_type, true_start, true_end, &true_null_constant) && builder->queries->has_request)
 31083:     {
 31084:         result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31085:     }
 31086:     else if (!c_ir_query_null_pointer_constant(builder, false_type, false_start, false_end, &false_null_constant) && builder->queries->has_request)
 31087:     {
 31088:         result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31089:     }
 31090:     else
 31091:     {
 31092:         result = c_ir_conditional_pointer_type(builder, true_type, false_type, true_null_constant, false_null_constant);
 31093:     }
 31094: 
 31095:     return result;
 31096: }

 31098: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_conditional_result_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId true_type, IrTypeId false_type, u32 true_start, u32 true_end,
 31099:                                                           u32 false_start, u32 false_end)

 31104:         .start = true_start,
 31105:         .end = true_end,
 31106:         .third = false_start,
 31107:         .fourth = false_end,
 31108:         .kind = C_IR_QUERY_FRAME_CONDITIONAL_TYPE,
 31109:     };
 31110:     CIrQueryFrame result = {0};
 31111:     if (!c_ir_query_execute(builder, root, &result) || !result.success)
 31112:     {
 31113:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31114:     }
 31115:     return result.result_type;

 31118: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_predict_expression_type_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end)
 31119: {
 31120:     if (start >= end)
 31121:     {
 31122:         return builder->s32_type;
 31123:     }
 31124:     c_ir_expression_core_range(builder, &start, &end);
 31125:     u32 expression_start = 0;
 31126:     u32 question = 0;
 31127:     u32 colon = 0;
 31128:     u32 expression_end = 0;
 31129:     if (!c_ir_root_conditional(builder, start, end, &expression_start, &question, &colon, &expression_end))
 31130:     {
 31131:         return c_ir_predict_nonconditional_expression_type_attempt(builder, start, end);
 31132:     }
 31133:     (void)expression_start;
 31134:     IrTypeId true_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31135:     IrTypeId false_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31136:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31137:     if (!c_ir_query_prediction(builder, question + 1, colon, &true_type) && builder->queries->has_request)
 31138:     {
 31139:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31140:     }
 31141:     if (!c_ir_query_prediction(builder, colon + 1, expression_end, &false_type) && builder->queries->has_request)
 31142:     {
 31143:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31144:     }
 31145:     if (!c_ir_query_conditional_type(builder, true_type, false_type, question + 1, colon, colon + 1, expression_end, &result) &&
 31146:         builder->queries->has_request)
 31147:     {
 31148:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 31149:     }
 31150:     return result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? builder->s32_type : result;
 31151: }

 31163: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_conditional_value_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
 31164: {
 31165:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 31166:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
 31167:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = &machine->frames[machine->frame_count - 1];
 31168:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_CONDITIONAL_VALUE);
 31169:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_ROOT)
 31170:     {
 31171:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, machine->child_result.success, machine->child_result.value);
 31172:         return;
 31173:     }
 31174:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_TASK)
 31175:     {
 31176:         IrValueId value = machine->child_result.value;
 31177:         IrType* task_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, frame->as.conditional.type);
 31178:         if (!machine->child_result.success || !task_type ||
 31179:             (task_type->kind != IR_TYPE_VOID && value.value >= builder->function->value_count))
 31180:         {
 31181:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31182:             return;
 31183:         }
 31184:         // A conditional whose branches are void is itself a void expression.
 31185:         // There is no result place to materialize or store: the branch effects
 31186:         // only need to complete before jumping to the merge.  The final frame
 31187:         // returns an integer zero placeholder so discarded void expressions
 31188:         // can still travel through the value machinery.
 31189:         if (task_type->kind == IR_TYPE_VOID)
 31190:         {

 31192:                                  frame->as.conditional.source))

 31194:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);

 31196:             }

 31198:             return;
 31199:         }

 31415: 
 31416: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_expression_task_push(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame, CIrLowerFrame task, u32 token_index)
 31417: {
 31418:     if (!frame->as.expression.tasks)
 31419:     {
 31420:         frame->as.expression.task_capacity = frame->as.expression.end - frame->as.expression.start + 1;
 31421:         frame->as.expression.tasks = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, CIrLowerFrame, frame->as.expression.task_capacity);
 31422:     }
 31423:     if (frame->as.expression.task_count >= frame->as.expression.task_capacity)
 31424:     {
 31425:         builder->failure_message = S8("C expression nesting exceeds the lowering frame capacity");
 31426:         builder->failure_token_index = token_index;
 31427:         return false;
 31428:     }
 31429:     frame->as.expression.tasks[frame->as.expression.task_count++] = task;
 31430:     return true;
 31431: }
 31432: 
 31433: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_expression_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
 31434: {
 31435:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 31436:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
 31437:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = &machine->frames[machine->frame_count - 1];
 31438:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION);
 31439:     bool unwind = false;
 31440:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_BEGIN)
 31441:     {
 31442:         if (frame->as.expression.start >= frame->as.expression.end || frame->as.expression.end > builder->preprocess.token_count)
 31443:         {
 31444:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31445:             return;
 31446:         }
 31447:         frame->as.expression.value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 31448:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
 31449:     }
 31450:     else if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_VALUE)
 31451:     {
 31452:         if (!machine->child_result.success)
 31453:         {
 31454:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31455:             return;
 31456:         }
 31457:         frame->as.expression.value = machine->child_result.value;
 31458:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
 31459:         unwind = true;
 31460:     }
 31461:     else if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_VOID_ASSIGNMENT)
 31462:     {
 31463:         // A cast to void still evaluates an assignment for its side effect.
 31464:         // Lower the assignment through the statement machine and provide the
 31465:         // discarded value expected by the surrounding comma/expression walk.
 31466:         if (!machine->child_result.success)
 31467:         {
 31468:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31469:             return;
 31470:         }
 31471:         frame->as.expression.value = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0});
 31472:         if (frame->as.expression.value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 31473:         {
 31474:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31475:             return;
 31476:         }
 31477:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
 31478:         unwind = true;
 31479:     }
 31480:     else if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_PLACE)
 31481:     {
 31482:         IrValueId place = machine->child_result.value;
 31483:         u32 assignment = frame->as.expression.pending_assignment;
 31484:         if (!machine->child_result.success || place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 31485:         {
 31486:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31487:             return;
 31488:         }
 31489:         // A parenthesized place may contain an address-of/dereference chain,
 31490:         // as in Lua's setnilvalue macro: `((&(p->val))->tt_ = value)`.
 31491:         // The expression child materializes that field as a load, while the
 31492:         // assignment still needs its underlying place.  Recover the final
 31493:         // load's operand exactly as the general assignment statement path
 31494:         // does, removing the now-redundant load from the current block.
 31495:         place = c_ir_recover_place_from_value(builder, place);
 31496:         if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count || builder->function->values[place.value].category != IR_VALUE_PLACE)
 31497:         {
 31498:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31499:             return;
 31500:         }
 31501:         CToken operator_token = builder->preprocess.tokens[assignment];
 31502:         CIrLowerFrame task = {
 31503:             .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_ASSIGNMENT_COMPLETION,
 31504:             .as.assignment =
 31505:                 {
 31506:                     .place = place,
 31507:                     .type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type,
 31508:                     .source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, operator_token),
 31509:                     .operation = frame->as.expression.pending_operation,
 31510:                     .simple = c_token_is_punctuator(&operator_token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ASSIGN),
 31511:                 },
 31512:         };
 31513:         if (!c_ir_expression_task_push(builder, frame, task, assignment))
 31514:         {
 31515:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31516:             return;
 31517:         }
 31518:         frame->as.expression.start = assignment + 1;
 31519:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
 31520:     }
 31521:     else
 31522:     {
 31523:         BUSTER_CHECK(frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_CONDITION);
 31524:         if (!machine->child_result.success || !frame->as.expression.task_count)
 31525:         {
 31526:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31527:             return;
 31528:         }
 31529:         CIrLowerFrame* task = &frame->as.expression.tasks[frame->as.expression.task_count - 1];
 31530:         BUSTER_CHECK(task->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_ARITHMETIC_CONDITIONAL_LEFT);
 31531:         if (!c_ir_switch_block(builder, frame->as.expression.pending_true_block))
 31532:         {
 31533:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31534:             return;
 31535:         }
 31536:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
 31537:     }
 31538:     while (true)
 31539:     {
 31540:         while (unwind)
 31541:         {
 31542:             if (!frame->as.expression.task_count)
 31543:             {
 31544:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, true, frame->as.expression.value);
 31545:                 return;
 31546:             }
 31547:             CIrLowerFrame task = frame->as.expression.tasks[--frame->as.expression.task_count];
 31548:             IrValueId value = frame->as.expression.value;
 31549:             if (task.kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_ARITHMETIC_CONDITIONAL_LEFT)
 31550:             {
 31551:                 task.kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_ARITHMETIC_CONDITIONAL_COMPLETION;
 31552:                 task.as.arithmetic_conditional.left = value;
 31553:                 if (!c_ir_expression_task_push(builder, frame, task, task.as.arithmetic_conditional.nested_start))
 31554:                 {
 31555:                     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31556:                     return;
 31557:                 }
 31558:                 frame->as.expression.start = task.as.arithmetic_conditional.nested_start;
 31559:                 frame->as.expression.end = task.as.arithmetic_conditional.nested_end;
 31560:                 frame->as.expression.value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 31561:                 unwind = false;
 31562:                 break;
 31563:             }
 31564:             if (task.kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_ARITHMETIC_CONDITIONAL_COMPLETION)
 31565:             {
 31566:                 IrValueId operands[2] = {task.as.arithmetic_conditional.left, value};
 31567:                 u32 operand_count = 2;
 31568:                 bool added = c_ir_apply_operation(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_ADD, operands, &operand_count,
 31569:                                                    task.as.arithmetic_conditional.operation_source, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID) && operand_count == 1;
 31570:                 if (added)
 31571:                 {
 31572:                     c_ir_vla_conditional_shape(builder, task.as.arithmetic_conditional.place, operands[0]);
 31573:                 }
 31574:                 if (!added || !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, task.as.arithmetic_conditional.place, task.as.arithmetic_conditional.type, operands[0],
 31575:                                            task.as.arithmetic_conditional.source) ||
 31576:                     !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &task.as.arithmetic_conditional.merge_block, 1,
 31577:                                     task.as.arithmetic_conditional.source) ||
 31578:                     !c_ir_switch_block(builder, task.as.arithmetic_conditional.false_block))
 31579:                 {
 31580:                     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31581:                     return;
 31582:                 }
 31583:                 task.kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_ARITHMETIC_CONDITIONAL_FALSE_COMPLETION;
 31584:                 if (!c_ir_expression_task_push(builder, frame, task, task.as.arithmetic_conditional.false_start))
 31585:                 {
 31586:                     c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 31587:                     return;
 31588:                 }
 31589:                 frame->as.expression.start = task.as.arithmetic_conditional.false_start;
 31590:                 frame->as.expression.end = task.as.arithmetic_conditional.false_end;
 31591:                 frame->as.expression.value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 31592:                 unwind = false;
 31593:                 break;
 31594:             }
 31595:             if (task.kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_ARITHMETIC_CONDITIONAL_FALSE_COMPLETION)
 31596:             {
 31597:                 c_ir_vla_conditional_shape(builder, task.as.arithmetic_conditional.place, value);
 31598:                 if (!c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, task.as.arithmetic_conditional.place, task.as.arithmetic_conditional.type, value,
 31599:                                            task.as.arithmetic_conditional.source) ||
 31600:                     !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &task.as.arithmetic_conditional.merge_block, 1,
 31601:                                     task.as.arithmetic_conditional.source) ||
--- lines 32423-32860 ---
 32423:             *scope_out = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root, task.start);
 32424:             return true;
 32425:         }
 32426:         if (task.continuation.value != block.value && task.block.value != block.value)
 32427:         {
 32428:             continue;
 32429:         }
 32430:         *token_out = task.end;
 32431:         *scope_out = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root, task.end);
 32432:         return true;
 32433:     }
 32434:     *scope_out = C_SCOPE_ID_INVALID;
 32435:     *token_out = UINT32_MAX;
 32436:     return false;
 32437: }
 32438: 
 32439: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_body_task_set_loop_cleanup_targets(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrBodyTask* task, u32 break_token, u32 continue_token)
 32440: {
 32441:     CScopeId root = builder->declaration_index < builder->parse.declaration_count ? builder->parse.declarations[builder->declaration_index].scope
 32442:                                                                                      : C_SCOPE_ID_INVALID;
 32443:     task->break_scope = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root, break_token);
 32444:     task->continue_scope = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root, continue_token);
 32445:     task->break_token = break_token;
 32446:     task->continue_token = continue_token;
 32447: }
 32448: 
 32449: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_cleanup_target_for_task(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrBodyTask task, CIrBodyTask* tasks, u32 task_count,
 32450:                                                        IrBlockId block, CScopeId* scope_out, u32* token_out)
 32451: {
 32452:     if (block.value == task.break_block.value && task.break_block.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32453:     {
 32454:         *scope_out = task.break_scope;
 32455:         *token_out = task.break_token;
 32456:         return true;
 32457:     }
 32458:     if (block.value == task.continue_block.value && task.continue_block.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32459:     {
 32460:         *scope_out = task.continue_scope;
 32461:         *token_out = task.continue_token;
 32462:         return true;
 32463:     }
 32464:     if (block.value == task.continuation.value && task.continuation.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32465:     {
 32466:         CScopeId root = builder->declaration_index < builder->parse.declaration_count ? builder->parse.declarations[builder->declaration_index].scope
 32467:                                                                                           : C_SCOPE_ID_INVALID;
 32468:         *token_out = task.end;
 32469:         *scope_out = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root, task.end);
 32470:         return true;
 32471:     }
 32472:     return c_ir_cleanup_target_for_block(builder, tasks, task_count, block, scope_out, token_out);
 32473: }
 32474: 
 32475: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_activate_cleanup(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CEntityId entity_id, IrSourceRange source)
 32476: {
 32477:     if (entity_id.value >= builder->parse.entity_count || !builder->cleanup_flags || !builder->cleanup_entity_entries ||
 32478:         !builder->parse.entities[entity_id.value].has_cleanup)
 32479:     {
 32480:         return true;
 32481:     }
 32482:     u32 cleanup_entry = builder->cleanup_entity_entries[entity_id.value];
 32483:     if (cleanup_entry < builder->cleanup_flag_base || cleanup_entry - builder->cleanup_flag_base >= builder->cleanup_flag_count)
 32484:     {
 32485:         return true;
 32486:     }
 32487:     IrValueId flag = builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_entry - builder->cleanup_flag_base];
 32488:     if (flag.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32489:     {
 32490:         return false;
 32491:     }
 32492:     CToken token = c_ir_space_name_token(builder, builder->parse.entities[entity_id.value].name);
 32493:     IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 1, false, token, builder->bool_type);
 32494:     return value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, flag, builder->bool_type, value, source);
 32495: }
 32496: 
 32497: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_has_cleanup_state(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
 32498: {
 32499:     return builder->cleanup_flag_count != 0;
 32500: }
 32501: 
 32502: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_cleanup_target_has_calls(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CScopeId target_scope, u32 target_token)
 32503: {
 32504:     if (builder->cleanup_entities && builder->cleanup_flags)
 32505:     {
 32506:         for (u32 cleanup_index = builder->cleanup_flag_count; cleanup_index != 0; cleanup_index -= 1)
 32507:         {
 32508:             u32 entry_index = builder->cleanup_flag_base + cleanup_index - 1;
 32509:             CEntityId entity_id = builder->cleanup_entities[entry_index];
 32510:             CEntity* entity = entity_id.value < builder->parse.entity_count ? &builder->parse.entities[entity_id.value] : 0;
 32511:             if (entity && entity->has_cleanup && builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_index - 1].value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
 32512:                 c_ir_cleanup_is_outside_target(&builder->parse, entity, target_scope, target_token) && c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity_id))
 32513:             {
 32514:                 return true;
 32515:             }
 32516:         }
 32517:     }
 32518: 
 32519:     return false;
 32520: }
 32521: 
 32522: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_cleanup_calls(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrBodyTask* tasks, u32 task_count, CScopeId target_scope,
 32523:                                                   u32 target_token, IrSourceRange source)
 32524: {
 32525:     for (u32 cleanup_index = builder->cleanup_flag_count; cleanup_index != 0; cleanup_index -= 1)
 32526:     {
 32527:         u32 entry_index = builder->cleanup_flag_base + cleanup_index - 1;
 32528:         CEntityId entity_id = builder->cleanup_entities[entry_index];
 32529:         CEntity* entity = entity_id.value < builder->parse.entity_count ? &builder->parse.entities[entity_id.value] : 0;
 32530:         if (!entity || !entity->has_cleanup || builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_index - 1].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
 32531:             !c_ir_cleanup_is_outside_target(&builder->parse, entity, target_scope, target_token))
 32532:         {
 32533:             continue;
 32534:         }
 32535:         CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity_id);
 32536:         if (!local)
 32537:         {
 32538:             continue;
 32539:         }
 32540:         IrFunction* callback_function = 0;
 32541:         CIrSignature callback_signature = {0};
 32542:         bool callback_resolved = c_ir_cleanup_function_target(builder, entity->cleanup_function, &callback_function, &callback_signature);
 32543:         IrTypeId variable_type = entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count ? builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value] : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 32544:         if (!callback_resolved || variable_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || callback_signature.parameter_count != 1)
 32545:         {
 32546:             return false;
 32547:         }
 32548:         CToken callback_token = c_ir_space_name_token(builder, entity->name);
 32549:         IrValueId flag = builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_index - 1];
 32550:         IrValueId active = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, flag, builder->bool_type, source);
 32551:         active = active.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_truth_value(builder, active, source);
 32552:         IrBlockId call_block = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 32553:         IrBlockId next_block = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 32554:         if (active.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || call_block.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || next_block.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32555:         {
 32556:             return false;
 32557:         }
 32558:         IrBlockId targets[2] = {call_block, next_block};
 32559:         if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &active, 1, targets, 2, source) || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, call_block))
 32560:         {
 32561:             return false;
 32562:         }
 32563:         IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, local->place, variable_type, source);
 32564:         IrValueId arguments[1] = {address};
 32565:         arguments[0] = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, arguments[0], callback_signature.parameter_types[0], source);
 32566:         if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || arguments[0].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
 32567:             c_ir_emit_call_target(builder, callback_token, callback_function, callback_signature, arguments, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(arguments)).value ==
 32568:                 IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32569:         {
 32570:             return false;
 32571:         }
 32572:         IrValueId inactive = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, callback_token, builder->bool_type);
 32573:         if (inactive.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, flag, builder->bool_type, inactive, source) ||
 32574:             !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &next_block, 1, source) || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, next_block))
 32575:         {
 32576:             return false;
 32577:         }
 32578:     }
 32579:     BUSTER_UNUSED(tasks);
 32580:     BUSTER_UNUSED(task_count);
 32581:     return true;
 32582: }
 32583: 
 32584: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_computed_goto_cleanup_dispatch(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId target, IrBlockId* targets, u32 target_count,
 32585:                                                                   CIrLabel* labels, u32 label_count, CScopeId root_scope, IrSourceRange source)
 32586: {
 32587:     if (!target_count || (!c_ir_is_computed_goto_target(builder, target) && !c_ir_is_computed_goto_storage_target(builder, target)))
 32588:     {
 32589:         if (!builder->failure_message.length)
 32590:         {
 32591:             builder->failure_message = S8("computed goto requires a function-local void pointer label value");
 32592:         }
 32593:         return false;
 32594:     }
 32595:     IrType* target_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[target.value].canonical_type);
 32596:     IrBlockId* cleanup_blocks = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrBlockId, target_count);
 32597:     bool needs_dispatch = ir_value_label_metadata(builder->function, target).has_non_label_provenance || !c_ir_is_computed_goto_target(builder, target);
 32598:     for (u32 target_index = 0; target_index < target_count; target_index += 1)
 32599:     {
 32600:         CIrLabel* label = 0;
 32601:         for (u32 label_index = 0; label_index < label_count; label_index += 1)
 32602:         {
 32603:             if (labels[label_index].block.value == targets[target_index].value)
 32604:             {
 32605:                 label = labels + label_index;
 32606:                 break;
 32607:             }
 32608:         }
 32609:         if (!label)
 32610:         {
 32611:             builder->failure_message = S8("computed goto target does not belong to this function");
 32612:             return false;
 32613:         }
 32614:         CScopeId target_scope = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root_scope, label->token_index);
 32615:         if (c_ir_cleanup_target_has_calls(builder, target_scope, label->token_index))
 32616:         {
 32617:             cleanup_blocks[target_index] = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 32618:             if (cleanup_blocks[target_index].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32619:             {
 32620:                 return false;
 32621:             }
 32622:             needs_dispatch = true;
 32623:         }
 32624:         else
 32625:         {
 32626:             cleanup_blocks[target_index] = IR_BLOCK_ID_INVALID;
 32627:         }
 32628:     }
 32629:     if (!needs_dispatch)
 32630:     {
 32631:         return c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_INDIRECT_BRANCH, &target, 1, targets, target_count, source);
 32632:     }
 32633:     if (!target_type || target_type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 32634:     {
 32635:         builder->failure_message = S8("computed goto target must retain its function-local pointer type");
 32636:         return false;
 32637:     }
 32638:     IrBlockId invalid = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 32639:     if (invalid.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32640:     {
 32641:         return false;
 32642:     }
 32643:     for (u32 target_index = 0; target_index < target_count; target_index += 1)
 32644:     {
 32645:         IrValueId label_value = c_ir_emit_label_address(builder, targets[target_index], source);
 32646:         IrType* label_type = label_value.value < builder->function->value_count
 32647:                                  ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[label_value.value].canonical_type)
 32648:                                  : 0;
 32649:         if (label_value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !label_type || label_type->id.value != target_type->id.value)
 32650:         {
 32651:             builder->failure_message = S8("computed goto target must retain its original void pointer type");
 32652:             return false;
 32653:         }
 32654:         IrValueId equal = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, target, label_value, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_POINTER_EQUAL, source);
 32655:         IrBlockId match = cleanup_blocks[target_index].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? targets[target_index] : cleanup_blocks[target_index];
 32656:         if (equal.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32657:         {
 32658:             return false;
 32659:         }
 32660:         if (target_index + 1 < target_count)
 32661:         {
 32662:             IrBlockId next = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 32663:             IrBlockId branch_targets[2] = {match, next};
 32664:             if (next.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &equal, 1, branch_targets, 2, source) ||
 32665:                 !c_ir_switch_block(builder, next))
 32666:             {
 32667:                 return false;
 32668:             }
 32669:         }
 32670:         else
 32671:         {
 32672:             IrBlockId branch_targets[2] = {match, invalid};
 32673:             if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &equal, 1, branch_targets, 2, source) || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, invalid))
 32674:             {
 32675:                 return false;
 32676:             }
 32677:             IrSourceRange unreachable_source = source;
 32678:             IrInstruction unreachable = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_UNREACHABLE, builder->void_type);
 32679:             if (c_ir_append_instruction(builder, unreachable, unreachable_source).value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32680:             {
 32681:                 return false;
 32682:             }
 32683:             builder->function->blocks[invalid.value].terminated = true;
 32684:         }
 32685:     }
 32686:     for (u32 target_index = 0; target_index < target_count; target_index += 1)
 32687:     {
 32688:         if (cleanup_blocks[target_index].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32689:         {
 32690:             continue;
 32691:         }
 32692:         CIrLabel* label = 0;
 32693:         for (u32 label_index = 0; label_index < label_count; label_index += 1)
 32694:         {
 32695:             if (labels[label_index].block.value == targets[target_index].value)
 32696:             {
 32697:                 label = labels + label_index;
 32698:                 break;
 32699:             }
 32700:         }
 32701:         if (!label || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, cleanup_blocks[target_index]))
 32702:         {
 32703:             return false;
 32704:         }
 32705:         CScopeId target_scope = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root_scope, label->token_index);
 32706:         if (!c_ir_emit_cleanup_calls(builder, 0, 0, target_scope, label->token_index, source) ||
 32707:             !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &label->block, 1, source))
 32708:         {
 32709:             return false;
 32710:         }
 32711:     }
 32712:     return true;
 32713: }
 32714: 
 32715: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_initialize_cleanup_flags(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CDeclaration declaration)
 32716: {
 32717:     if (builder->cleanup_flag_count)
 32718:     {
 32719:         CToken token = c_ir_space_name_token(builder, declaration.name);
 32720:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_source_range(declaration.location, declaration.name.length);
 32721:         for (u32 cleanup_index = 0; cleanup_index < builder->cleanup_flag_count; cleanup_index += 1)
 32722:         {
 32723:             u32 entry_index = builder->cleanup_flag_base + cleanup_index;
 32724:             CEntityId entity_id = builder->cleanup_entities[entry_index];
 32725:             if (entity_id.value >= builder->parse.entity_count)
 32726:             {
 32727:                 return false;
 32728:             }
 32729:             IrValueId flag = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, builder->bool_type, source);
 32730:             IrValueId inactive = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, token, builder->bool_type);
 32731:             if (flag.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || inactive.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
 32732:                 !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, flag, builder->bool_type, inactive, source))
 32733:             {
 32734:                 return false;
 32735:             }
 32736:             builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_index] = flag;
 32737:         }
 32738:     }
 32739: 
 32740:     return true;
 32741: }
 32742: 
 32743: typedef struct CIrSwitchCase CIrSwitchCase;
 32744: struct CIrSwitchCase
 32745: {
 32746:     u32 label_start;
 32747:     u32 content_start;
 32748:     u32 content_end;
 32749:     CIrConstantValue low_constant;
 32750:     CIrConstantValue high_constant;
 32751:     u64 value;
 32752:     u64 high_value;
 32753:     IrBlockId block;
 32754:     bool is_default;
 32755:     bool is_range;
 32756:     // Set when the label prefixes a control statement's substatement rather
 32757:     // than opening a new statement of the switch body — `if (c) case 1: ...`.
 32758:     // Such a case still dispatches to a block of its own, but the block is
 32759:     // reached by falling into it from the statement stream that contains it,
 32760:     // so it owns no token range and gets no task.
 32761:     bool in_substatement;
 32762:     u8 reserved[1];
 32763: };
 32764: 
 32765: // One case label whose block the statement stream has to branch into when it
 32766: // reaches the label, keyed by the label's token index. Nested switches reuse
 32767: // the switch-case scratch array, so this registry lives for the whole body.
 32768: // A declaration between a switch's `{` and its first case label declares
 32769: // objects the cases go on to use, but no statement stream ever reaches it:
 32770: // the dispatch jumps straight to a label.  SQLite's lemon-generated parser
 32771: // declares `YYMINORTYPE yylhsminor;` exactly there and half of its reduce
 32772: // actions read it.  Give those objects their frame slots before the dispatch,
 32773: // where they dominate every case block, and leave any initializer unrun --
 32774: // which is what C says jumping past an initializer does.
 32775: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_switch_prefix_locals(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 body_start, u32 prefix_end)
 32776: {
 32777:     CScopeId root = builder->declaration_index < builder->parse.declaration_count ? builder->parse.declarations[builder->declaration_index].scope
 32778:                                                                                   : C_SCOPE_ID_INVALID;
 32779:     CScopeId scope = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root, body_start);
 32780:     if (scope.value >= builder->parse.scope_count)
 32781:     {
 32782:         return true;
 32783:     }
 32784:     for (CEntityId entity = builder->parse.scopes[scope.value].first_entity; entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count;
 32785:          entity = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].next_in_scope)
 32786:     {
 32787:         CEntity* value = builder->parse.entities + entity.value;
 32788:         u32 declaration_token = value->declaration_token_plus_one ? value->declaration_token_plus_one - 1 : UINT32_MAX;
 32789:         if (value->kind != C_ENTITY_LOCAL || value->is_static_storage || value->is_thread_local || declaration_token < body_start ||
 32790:             declaration_token >= prefix_end || value->type.value >= builder->parse.type_count || c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity))
 32791:         {
 32792:             continue;
 32793:         }
 32794:         IrTypeId local_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[value->type.value];
 32795:         IrType* local_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, local_type);
 32796:         u32 alignment = local_type_value ? local_type_value->layout.alignment : 0;
 32797:         String8 rejection = {0};
 32798:         if (!local_type_value || !local_type_value->layout.resolved ||
 32799:             c_ir_alignment_evaluate(builder, value->alignment_start, value->alignment_count, alignment, &alignment, 0, &rejection) != C_IR_ALIGNMENT_RESOLVED ||
 32800:             c_ir_emit_local(builder, builder->preprocess.tokens[declaration_token], local_type, entity, alignment).value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 32801:         {
 32802:             builder->failure_message =
 32803:                 rejection.length ? rejection
 32804:                                  : string_format(builder->arena, S8("could not declare local '{S8}', which precedes the first case label of a switch"), value->name);
 32805:             builder->failure_kind_plus_one = rejection.length ? C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_ALIGNMENT + 1 : 0;
 32806:             builder->failure_token_index = declaration_token;
 32807:             return false;
 32808:         }
 32809:     }
 32810:     return true;
 32811: }
 32812: 
 32813: typedef struct CIrSubstatementCase CIrSubstatementCase;
 32814: struct CIrSubstatementCase
 32815: {
 32816:     u32 label_start;
 32817:     u32 content_start;
 32818:     IrBlockId block;
 32819: };
 32820: 
 32821: typedef struct CIrLabel CIrLabel;
 32822: 
 32823: // The registry is keyed by token index, which is unique across the body, so a
 32824: // nested switch's labels can never be mistaken for an outer switch's. Bodies
 32825: // carry a handful of these at most, so a linear scan is the whole lookup.
 32826: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrSubstatementCase* c_ir_substatement_case_find(CIrLowerBodyState* state, u32 label_start)
 32827: {
 32828:     CIrSubstatementCase* result = 0;
 32829:     for (u32 index = 0; index < state->substatement_case_count && !result; index += 1)
 32830:     {
 32831:         if (state->substatement_cases[index].label_start == label_start)
 32832:         {
 32833:             result = state->substatement_cases + index;
 32834:         }
 32835:     }
 32836: 
 32837:     return result;
 32838: }
 32839: 
 32840: // A colon only introduces a labeled statement when it is itself a label,
 32841: // case, or default colon; a conditional's colon can directly precede an
 32842: // `identifier :` pair (`b ? b ? c : s : l`), where `s` is not a label. Pair
 32843: // nested `? :` groups backward to the statement boundary: an unmatched `?`
 32844: // claims the colon for a conditional expression.
 32845: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL BUSTER_COLD BUSTER_PRESERVE_MOST bool c_ir_label_colon_at(CToken* tokens, u32 body_start, u32 colon_index)
 32846: {
 32847:     u32 parentheses = 0;
 32848:     u32 brackets = 0;
 32849:     u32 braces = 0;
 32850:     u32 pending_colons = 0;
 32851:     u32 scan = colon_index;
 32852:     while (scan > body_start)
 32853:     {
 32854:         scan -= 1;
 32855:         CToken token = tokens[scan];
 32856:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
 32857:         {
 32858:             parentheses += 1;
 32859:         }
 32860:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
--- lines 33511-33738 ---
 33511:     instruction.immediates = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, value_count);
 33512:     u32 value_index = 0;
 33513:     for (u32 index = 0; index < case_count; index += 1)
 33514:     {
 33515:         if (!cases[index].is_default)
 33516:         {
 33517:             instruction.targets[value_index] = cases[index].block;
 33518:             instruction.immediates[value_index] = cases[index].value;
 33519:             value_index += 1;
 33520:         }
 33521:     }
 33522:     instruction.targets[value_count] = default_block;
 33523:     instruction.target_count = (u16)(value_count + 1);
 33524:     instruction.immediate_count = (u16)value_count;
 33525:     if (c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source).value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 33526:     {
 33527:         return false;
 33528:     }
 33529:     builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value].terminated = true;
 33530:     return true;
 33531: }

 33533: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_switch_promoted_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type_id)
 33534: {
 33535:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
 33536:     IrTypeId result;
 33537:     if (!type || type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM || (type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->bit_width < 32))
 33538:     {
 33539:         result = builder->s32_type;
 33540:     }
 33541:     else
 33542:     {
 33543:         result = type_id;
 33544:     }
 33545: 
 33546:     return result;
 33547: }

 33549: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_switch_integer_less_equal(IrType* type, u64 left, u64 right)
 33550: {
 33551:     return type->is_signed ? c_ir_integer_signed_value(left, type) <= c_ir_integer_signed_value(right, type) : left <= right;
 33552: }
