 33554: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_terminate_switch_ranges(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId switched, CIrSwitchCase* cases, u32 case_count,
 33555:                                                       IrBlockId default_block, IrSourceRange source)
 33556: {
 33557:     (void)source;
 33558:     IrBlockId dispatch = builder->current_block;
 33559:     for (u32 case_index = 0; case_index < case_count; case_index += 1)
 33560:     {
 33561:         CIrSwitchCase* current = cases + case_index;
 33562:         if (current->is_default)
 33563:         {
 33564:             continue;
 33565:         }
 33566:         IrBlockId miss = default_block;
 33567:         for (u32 next = case_index + 1; next < case_count; next += 1)
 33568:         {
 33569:             if (!cases[next].is_default)
 33570:             {
 33571:                 miss = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 33572:                 break;
 33573:             }
 33574:         }
 33575:         if (miss.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, dispatch))
 33576:         {
 33577:             return false;
 33578:         }
 33579:         CToken label = builder->preprocess.tokens[current->label_start];
 33580:         IrSourceRange label_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, label);
 33581:         IrValueId lower = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, current->value, false, label, builder->function->values[switched.value].canonical_type);
 33582:         if (lower.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 33583:         {
 33584:             return false;
 33585:         }
 33586:         IrValueId condition = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 33587:         IrValueId operands[2] = {switched, lower};
 33588:         u32 operand_count = 2;
 33589:         if (current->is_range)
 33590:         {
 33591:             IrBlockId upper_check = c_ir_block_create(builder);
 33592:             if (upper_check.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
 33593:                 !c_ir_apply_operation(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_GREATER_EQUAL, operands, &operand_count, label_source, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID) ||
 33594:                 operand_count != 1)
 33595:             {
 33596:                 return false;
 33597:             }
 33598:             condition = c_ir_truth_value(builder, operands[0], label_source);
 33599:             if (condition.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 33600:             {
 33601:                 return false;
 33602:             }
 33603:             IrBlockId lower_targets[2] = {upper_check, miss};
 33604:             if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &condition, 1, lower_targets, 2, label_source) || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, upper_check))
 33605:             {
 33606:                 return false;
 33607:             }
 33608:             IrValueId upper = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, current->high_value, false, label,
 33609:                                                              builder->function->values[switched.value].canonical_type);
 33610:             if (upper.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 33611:             {
 33612:                 return false;
 33613:             }
 33614:             operands[0] = switched;
 33615:             operands[1] = upper;
 33616:             operand_count = 2;
 33617:             if (!c_ir_apply_operation(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_LESS_EQUAL, operands, &operand_count, label_source, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID) ||
 33618:                 operand_count != 1)
 33619:             {
 33620:                 return false;
 33621:             }
 33622:             condition = c_ir_truth_value(builder, operands[0], label_source);
 33623:             if (condition.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 33624:             {
 33625:                 return false;
 33626:             }
 33627:         }
 33628:         else
 33629:         {
 33630:             operands[0] = switched;
 33631:             operands[1] = lower;
 33632:             operand_count = 2;
 33633:             if (!c_ir_apply_operation(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_EQUAL, operands, &operand_count, label_source, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID) || operand_count != 1)
 33634:             {
 33635:                 return false;
 33636:             }
 33637:             condition = c_ir_truth_value(builder, operands[0], label_source);
 33638:             if (condition.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 33639:             {
 33640:                 return false;
 33641:             }
 33642:         }
 33643:         IrBlockId targets[2] = {current->block, miss};
 33644:         if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &condition, 1, targets, 2, label_source))
 33645:         {
 33646:             return false;
 33647:         }
 33648:         dispatch = miss;
 33649:     }
 33650:     return true;
 33651: }
 33652: 
 33653: // The storage a variable-length array declaration allocates, and the local
 33654: // that names it. A VLA local is a pointer variable: the ALLOCATE moves the
 33655: // stack pointer by the runtime size and the pointer it produces is stored into
 33656: // the local's frame slot, which is what every later index and sizeof reads
 33657: // through. Both declaration paths emit it -- the single declarator in
 33658: // c_ir_lower_body_advance and a declarator split out of a list in
 33659: // c_ir_prepare_automatic_declaration -- so it lives here rather than in either.
 33660: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_vla_storage(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrVlaLayout* layout, IrTypeId pointer_type_id, IrTypeId element_type,
 33661:                                              CEntityId entity, CToken name, u32 alignment)
 33662: {
 33663:     IrValueId storage = c_ir_add_result(builder, pointer_type_id);
 33664:     bool emitted = layout->runtime_size.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && storage.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 33665:     IrSourceRange source = c_ir_source_range(c_ir_token_location(builder, name), name.length);
 33666:     if (emitted)
 33667:     {
 33668:         IrInstruction allocation = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_STACK_ALLOCATE, pointer_type_id);
 33669:         allocation.operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
 33670:         allocation.operands[0] = layout->runtime_size;
 33671:         allocation.operand_count = 1;
 33672:         allocation.immediates = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u64, 1);
 33673:         allocation.immediates[0] = alignment;
 33674:         allocation.immediate_count = 1;
 33675:         allocation.result = storage;
 33676:         builder->function->values[storage.value].definition = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, allocation, source);
 33677:         IrType* pointer_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, pointer_type_id);
 33678:         IrValueId place = c_ir_emit_local(builder, name, pointer_type_id, entity, pointer_type ? pointer_type->layout.alignment : alignment);
 33679:         CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
 33680:         emitted = place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && local;
 33681:         if (emitted)
 33682:         {
 33683:             local->runtime_size = layout->runtime_size;
 33684:             local->vla_element_type = element_type;
 33685:             local->vla_dimension_counts = layout->dimension_counts;
 33686:             local->vla_suffix_sizes = layout->suffix_sizes;
 33687:             local->vla_dimension_count = layout->dimension_count;
 33688:             local->is_variable_length_array = true;
 33689:             c_ir_vla_local_shape(builder, local);
 33690:             emitted = c_ir_emit_store(builder, local, storage, source);
 33691:         }
 33692:         if (emitted)
 33693:         {
 33694:             c_ir_mark_local_read_only(builder, local);
 33695:             emitted = c_ir_activate_cleanup(builder, entity, source);
 33696:         }
 33697:     }
 33698: 
 33699:     return emitted;
 33700: }
 33701: 
 33702: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_prepare_automatic_declaration(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerAutomaticDeclarationState* state,
 33703:                                                              u32* expression_start_out, u32* expression_end_out, bool* expression_pending_out)
 33704: {
 33705:     u32 start = state->start;
 33706:     u32 end = state->end;
 33707:     *expression_pending_out = false;
 33708:     CEntityId entity = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
 33709:     u32 name_index = end;
 33710:     for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
 33711:     {
 33712:         if (builder->preprocess.tokens[index].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 33713:         {
 33714:             continue;
 33715:         }
 33716:         CEntityId candidate = c_ir_local_entity_at(builder, index);
 33717:         if (candidate.value < builder->parse.entity_count && builder->parse.entities[candidate.value].kind == C_ENTITY_LOCAL)
 33718:         {
 33719:             entity = candidate;
 33720:             name_index = index;
 33721:             break;
 33722:         }
 33723:     }
 33724:     if (name_index >= end || entity.value >= builder->parse.entity_count)
 33725:     {
 33726:         builder->failure_message = S8("could not resolve the automatic local declaration");
 33727:         return false;
 33728:     }
 33729:     CEntity* local_entity = &builder->parse.entities[entity.value];
 33730:     if (local_entity->type.value >= builder->parse.type_count)
 33731:     {
 33732:         builder->failure_message = S8("automatic local declaration has an invalid C type");
 33733:         return false;
 33734:     }
 33735:     IrTypeId local_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[local_entity->type.value];
 33736:     CType* local_c_type = &builder->parse.types[local_entity->type.value];
 33737:     // An array C type reaches c_type_ir_map only when every bound folded, so an
 33738:     // unmapped one is a variable-length array. The single-declarator path in
--- lines 38293-38493 ---
 38293:                                           .as.assignment_statement = statement_state,
 38294:                                       });
 38295:                 state->task_count = task_count;
 38296:                 return false;
 38297:             }
 38298:         }
 38299:         if (split)
 38300:         {
 38301:             continue;
 38302:         }
 38303:         IrBlock* block = &builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value];
 38304:         if (block->terminated)
 38305:         {
 38306:             continue;
 38307:         }
 38308:         CScopeId cleanup_scope = C_SCOPE_ID_INVALID;
 38309:         u32 cleanup_token = UINT32_MAX;
 38310:         bool cleanup_state = c_ir_has_cleanup_state(builder);
 38311:         if (cleanup_state && task.continuation.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 38312:         {
 38313:             if (!c_ir_cleanup_target_for_task(builder, task, tasks, task_count, task.continuation, &cleanup_scope, &cleanup_token))
 38314:             {
 38315:                 return false;
 38316:             }
 38317:         }
 38318:         else if (cleanup_state && statement_expression_mode)
 38319:         {
 38320:             CScopeId root = builder->declaration_index < builder->parse.declaration_count ? builder->parse.declarations[builder->declaration_index].scope
 38321:                                                                                             : C_SCOPE_ID_INVALID;
 38322:             cleanup_token = task.end;
 38323:             cleanup_scope = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root, cleanup_token);
 38324:         }
 38325:         if (cleanup_state && !c_ir_emit_cleanup_calls(builder, tasks, task_count, cleanup_scope, cleanup_token, declaration_source))
 38326:         {
 38327:             return false;
 38328:         }
 38329:         block = &builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value];
 38330:         if (task.restore_before_continuation && task.has_stack_checkpoint && !c_ir_emit_stack_restore(builder, task.stack_checkpoint, declaration_source))
 38331:         {
 38332:             return false;
 38333:         }
 38334:         if (task.continuation.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 38335:         {
 38336:             if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &task.continuation, 1, declaration_source))
 38337:             {
 38338:                 return false;
 38339:             }
 38340:         }
 38341:         else if (statement_expression_mode)
 38342:         {
 38343:             // This is the end of the nested GNU statement expression, not
 38344:             // the end of its enclosing function.  The enclosing function's
 38345:             // return type is irrelevant here: glibc assert expands to a
 38346:             // statement expression, and in a void function successful
 38347:             // assertions must continue with the following statement.
 38348:             return true;
 38349:         }
 38350:         else if (builder->returns_void)
 38351:         {
 38352:             if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_RETURN, 0, 0, 0, 0, declaration_source))
 38353:             {
 38354:                 return false;
 38355:             }
 38356:         }
 38357:         else if (builder->returns_zero_at_end)
 38358:         {
 38359:             // C 5.1.2.2.3 gives `main` alone a defined fall-off: reaching the
 38360:             // closing brace returns 0. It is one function per program, so the
 38361:             // flag is decided once with the signature rather than by matching
 38362:             // a name here.
 38363:             IrValueId zero = c_ir_emit_integer_value_at(builder, 0, false, declaration_source, builder->return_type);
 38364:             if (zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_RETURN, &zero, 1, 0, 0, declaration_source))
 38365:             {
 38366:                 return false;
 38367:             }
 38368:         }
 38369:         else
 38370:         {
 38371:             // Only the root body task has no continuation, so this is the end
 38372:             // of a non-void function's body. Reaching the closing brace is
 38373:             // undefined only if the caller uses the value (C 6.9.1p12), so
 38374:             // this is not a refusal: terminate with unreachable, which is what
 38375:             // Clang and GCC emit. sbase's dc ends `regname` with a call to its
 38376:             // own non-noreturn error(), and the bc its tests drive is
 38377:             // yacc-generated with the same shape.
 38378:             IrSourceRange unreachable_source = declaration_source;
 38379:             IrInstruction unreachable = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_UNREACHABLE, builder->void_type);
 38380:             c_ir_append_instruction(builder, unreachable, unreachable_source);
 38381:             block->terminated = true;
 38382:         }
 38383:     }
 38384:     return true;
 38385: }
 38386: 
 38387: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_body_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
 38388: {
 38389:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 38390:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
 38391:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = machine->frames + machine->frame_count - 1;
 38392:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_BODY && frame->as.body.state);
 38393:     CIrLowerBodyState* state = frame->as.body.state;
 38394:     bool stepping = true;
 38395:     while (stepping)
 38396:     {
 38397:         bool success = c_ir_lower_body_advance(builder, state);
 38398:         if (!state->yielded)
 38399:         {
 38400:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, success, state->result);
 38401:             stepping = false;
 38402:         }
 38403:         else if (machine->failed)
 38404:         {
 38405:             stepping = false;
 38406:         }
 38407:         else
 38408:         {
 38409:             // Run the yielded child now, off the dispatch loop, when its kind
 38410:             // is in the acyclic direct-run set; a completion loops the
 38411:             // statement walk here without a dispatch round trip, and a
 38412:             // suspension resumes through the loop unchanged.
 38413:             u32 yield_mark = machine->frame_count - 1;
 38414:             switch (machine->frames[yield_mark].kind)
 38415:             {
 38416:                 case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION:
 38417:                     c_ir_lower_expression_step(builder);
 38418:                     break;
 38419:                 case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_BODY_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT:
 38420:                     c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_step(builder);
 38421:                     break;
 38422:                 case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_CONDITION:
 38423:                     c_ir_lower_condition_step(builder);
 38424:                     break;
 38425:                 case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_COMPOUND_LITERAL:
 38426:                     c_ir_lower_compound_literal_step(builder, machine->frames + yield_mark);
 38427:                     break;
 38428:                 default:
 38429:                     break;
 38430:             }
 38431:             stepping = machine->frame_count == yield_mark && !machine->failed;
 38432:         }
 38433:     }
 38434: }

 38436: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_lower_body(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CDeclaration declaration, bool statement_expression_mode,
 38437:                                          IrValueId* statement_expression_result)
 38438: {
 38439:     TemporalArena temporary = arena_begin_temporal(builder->temporary_arena);
 38440:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 38441:     bool outermost = machine->run_depth == 0;
 38442:     if (outermost)
 38443:     {
 38444:         machine->root_frame_mark = machine->frame_count;
 38445:         machine->scratch_mark = builder->scratch_arena->position;
 38446:         machine->child_result = (CIrLowerFrameResult){
 38447:             .value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID,
 38448:         };
 38449:         machine->failed = false;
 38450:     }
 38451:     u32 request_mark = machine->frame_count;
 38452:     bool pushed = c_ir_lower_body_frame_push(builder, declaration, statement_expression_mode);
 38453:     CIrLowerFrameResult lowered = {0};
 38454:     if (pushed)
 38455:     {
 38456:         lowered = c_ir_lower_dispatch_run(builder, request_mark, outermost);
 38457:     }
 38458:     else if (outermost)
 38459:     {
 38460:         c_ir_lower_machine_unwind(builder);
 38461:     }
 38462:     scratch_end(temporary);
 38463:     if (statement_expression_result)
 38464:     {
 38465:         *statement_expression_result = lowered.value;
 38466:     }
 38467:     return lowered.success;
 38468: }

 41650: 
 41651: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_bytes(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, IrTypeId root_type, u8* bytes, u64 byte_count,
 41652:                                                          IrGlobalRelocation* relocations, u32* relocation_count, u32 relocation_capacity);
 41653: 
 41654: // The scalar leaves of an aggregate initializer, classified before they are
 41655: // folded.  Almost every leaf of a large table is one number -- the generated
 41656: // instruction metadata is arrays of small integer records -- and the general
 41657: // folder (c_ir_constant_initializer_bytes_legacy) prices each at a task
 41658: // array, a compound-literal probe, a query frame, the shunting-yard
 41659: // evaluator, a cast and a byte loop.  A leaf whose tokens are exactly a
 41660: // number, a signed number, a character constant or an identifier naming an
 41661: // integer constant, landing in an integer, boolean, enum or float member
 41662: // that is not a bit-field, is folded here
 41663: // instead: the same literal routines and typing rules the evaluator uses
 41664: // (c_ir_integer_literal_type, c_ir_float_literal_value,
 41665: // c_ir_decode_character_value), the evaluator's unary `+`/`-`
 41666: // (c_ir_constant_apply_unary) and its cast (c_ir_constant_cast), then one
 41667: // little-endian store of the member's size.  The class is one byte decided
 41668: // from the token kinds and the member's kind alone; an arm that cannot
 41669: // reproduce the evaluator's answer -- a literal no type holds, a 128-bit
 41670: // operand, an imaginary suffix -- declines, and the leaf takes the general
 41671: // folder, so every refusal and its message stay exactly what they were.
 41672: // A big-endian target keeps the byte loop: only the little-endian store is
 41673: // written here.
 41674: typedef enum CIrInitializerLeafClass
 41675: {
 41676:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_OTHER,
 41677:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_INTEGER,
 41678:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT,
 41679:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_FLOAT_TO_FLOAT,
 41680:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_CHARACTER_TO_INTEGER,
 41681:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_IDENTIFIER_TO_INTEGER,
 41682: } CIrInitializerLeafClass;
 41683: 
 41684: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_identifier(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 token_index, CIrConstantValue* result);
 41685: 
 41686: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u8 c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_class(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end)
 41687: {
 41688:     u8 leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_OTHER;
 41689:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
 41690:     u32 count = end - start;
 41691:     bool signed_prefix =
 41692:         count == 2 && (c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS));
 41693:     if ((count == 1 || signed_prefix) && builder->program->data_layout.endianness == TARGET_ENDIAN_LITTLE)
 41694:     {
 41695:         CToken literal = tokens[end - 1];
 41696:         u64 size = child->layout.size;
 41697:         // The sizes one u64 of bits fills: a wider member takes the general
 41698:         // evaluator and the two-limb byte writer.
 41699:         bool integer_child = (child->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || child->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || child->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM) &&
 41700:                              (size == 1 || size == 2 || size == 4 || size == 8);
 41701:         // binary16, f32 and f64: the x87 element has its own folder ahead of
 41702:         // the general one, and any other width is stored through the general
 41703:         // folder's own conversion.
 41704:         bool float_child = child->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && ((child->bit_width == 16 && size == 2) || (child->bit_width == 32 && size == 4) ||
 41705:                                                             (child->bit_width == 64 && size == 8));
 41706:         if (literal.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
 41707:         {
 41708:             bool floating = c_number_is_float(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, literal));
 41709:             if (integer_child && !floating)
 41710:             {
 41711:                 leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_INTEGER;
 41712:             }
 41713:             else if (float_child)
 41714:             {
 41715:                 leaf_class = floating ? C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_FLOAT_TO_FLOAT : C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT;
 41716:             }
 41717:         }
 41718:         else if (literal.kind == C_TOKEN_CHARACTER_LITERAL && integer_child)
 41719:         {
 41720:             leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_CHARACTER_TO_INTEGER;
 41721:         }
 41722:         else if (literal.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && integer_child)
 41723:         {
 41724:             leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_IDENTIFIER_TO_INTEGER;
 41725:         }
 41726:     }
 41727:     return leaf_class;
 41728: }
 41729: 
 41730: // `size` bytes of `bits`, least significant first: what
 41731: // c_ir_constant_store_unit_bits writes for a little-endian target and a
 41732: // member no wider than the bits.  Spelled per size so the stores merge.
 41733: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_store_little_endian(u8* bytes, u64 size, u64 bits)
 41734: {
 41735:     switch (size)
 41736:     {
 41737:     case 1:
 41738:         bytes[0] = (u8)bits;
 41739:         break;
 41740:     case 2:
 41741:         bytes[0] = (u8)bits;
 41742:         bytes[1] = (u8)(bits >> 8);
 41743:         break;
 41744:     case 4:
 41745:         bytes[0] = (u8)bits;
 41746:         bytes[1] = (u8)(bits >> 8);
 41747:         bytes[2] = (u8)(bits >> 16);
 41748:         bytes[3] = (u8)(bits >> 24);
 41749:         break;
 41750:     case 8:
 41751:         bytes[0] = (u8)bits;
 41752:         bytes[1] = (u8)(bits >> 8);
 41753:         bytes[2] = (u8)(bits >> 16);
 41754:         bytes[3] = (u8)(bits >> 24);
 41755:         bytes[4] = (u8)(bits >> 32);
 41756:         bytes[5] = (u8)(bits >> 40);
 41757:         bytes[6] = (u8)(bits >> 48);
 41758:         bytes[7] = (u8)(bits >> 56);
 41759:         break;
 41760:     default:
 41761:         BUSTER_TODO();
 41762:     }
 41763: }
 41764: 
 41765: // The evaluator's unary `+`/`-` on an integer constant of `*type`
 41766: // (c_ir_constant_apply_unary): a boolean or narrow operand is promoted to
 41767: // int first -- no literal type is that narrow, but the rule is kept so the
 41768: // arm and the evaluator cannot disagree -- and the result is masked to the
 41769: // operand's width.  False for the 128-bit operand, whose wide negate stays
 41770: // with the evaluator.
 41771: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_unary(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType** type, u64* integer, bool negative)
 41772: {
 41773:     IrType* operand = *type;
 41774:     if (operand->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || (operand->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && operand->bit_width < 32))
 41775:     {
 41776:         operand = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->s32_type);
 41777:     }
 41778:     bool applied = operand && !(operand->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && operand->bit_width == 128);
 41779:     if (applied)
 41780:     {
 41781:         u64 value = negative ? 0 - *integer : *integer;
 41782:         *integer = value & c_ir_integer_type_mask(operand);
 41783:         *type = operand;
 41784:     }
 41785:     return applied;
 41786: }
 41787: 
 41788: // An integer constant of `literal_type` stored into the integer member
 41789: // `child`: c_ir_constant_cast replays a signed source's sign bit before the
 41790: // target mask. A boolean tests nonzero before that narrowing.
 41791: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_initializer_store_integer_leaf(IrType* child, IrType* literal_type, u64 integer, u8* bytes)
 41792: {
 41793:     u64 value = literal_type->is_signed ? (u64)c_ir_integer_signed_value(integer, literal_type) : integer;
 41794:     u64 converted = child->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN ? value != 0 : value & c_ir_integer_type_mask(child);
 41795:     c_ir_constant_store_little_endian(bytes, child->layout.size, converted);
 41796: }
 41797: 
 41798: // A floating value stored into the binary16, f32 or f64 member `child`: the
 41799: // cast rounds at the member's own precision (c_ir_constant_cast), and the
 41800: // folder writes that value's bits.
 41801: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_initializer_store_float_leaf(IrType* child, f64 floating, u8* bytes)
 41802: {
 41803:     u64 bits = 0;
 41804:     if (child->bit_width == 16)
 41805:     {
 41806:         bits = child->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 ? c_ir_bfloat16_bits_from_f64(floating) : c_ir_float16_bits_from_f64(floating);
 41807:     }
 41808:     else if (child->bit_width == 32)
 41809:     {
 41810:         f32 narrowed = (f32)(f64)(f32)floating;
 41811:         u32 narrowed_bits = 0;
 41812:         memcpy(&narrowed_bits, &narrowed, sizeof(narrowed_bits));
 41813:         bits = narrowed_bits;
 41814:     }
 41815:     else
 41816:     {
 41817:         memcpy(&bits, &floating, sizeof(bits));
 41818:     }
 41819:     c_ir_constant_store_little_endian(bytes, child->layout.size, bits);
 41820: }
 41821: 
 41822: // The INTEGER_TO_INTEGER and INTEGER_TO_FLOAT arms: an integer literal,
 41823: // typed by c_ir_integer_literal_type exactly as the evaluator types it.
 41824: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_fold_integer_leaf(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u8 leaf_class, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end,
 41825:                                                                     u8* bytes)
 41826: {
 41827:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
 41828:     bool signed_prefix = end - start == 2;
 41829:     bool negative = signed_prefix && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
 41830:     String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, tokens[end - 1]);
 41831:     u64 integer = 0;
 41832:     bool folded = c_conditional_number(spelling, &integer);
 41833:     IrType* literal_type = folded ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, c_ir_integer_literal_type(builder, spelling, integer)) : 0;
 41834:     folded = literal_type != 0;
 41835:     if (folded && signed_prefix)
 41836:     {
 41837:         folded = c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_unary(builder, &literal_type, &integer, negative);
 41838:     }
 41839:     if (folded)
 41840:     {
 41841:         if (leaf_class == C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_INTEGER)
 41842:         {
 41843:             c_ir_constant_initializer_store_integer_leaf(child, literal_type, integer, bytes);
 41844:         }
 41845:         else
 41846:         {
 41847:             CIrConstantValue source = {.integer = integer, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER};
 41848:             u32 precision = child->bit_width == 16   ? (child->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 ? 8u : 11u)
 41849:                             : child->bit_width == 32 ? 24u
 41850:                                                      : 53u;
 41851:             f64 floating = c_ir_constant_integer_to_float(&source, literal_type, precision);
 41852:             c_ir_constant_initializer_store_float_leaf(child, floating, bytes);
 41853:         }
 41854:     }
 41855:     return folded;
 41856: }
 41857: 
 41858: // The FLOAT_TO_FLOAT arm.  An imaginary literal is left to the evaluator,
 41859: // which refuses it rather than folding its magnitude.
 41860: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_fold_float_leaf(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end, u8* bytes)
 41861: {
 41862:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
 41863:     bool negative = end - start == 2 && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
 41864:     String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, tokens[end - 1]);
 41865:     String8 ignored_real_spelling = {0};
 41866:     f64 floating = 0.0;
 41867:     char8 suffix = 0;
 41868:     c_ir_float_suffix(spelling, &suffix);
 41869:     bool wide_source = (suffix == 'l' || suffix == 'L') && target_data_layout(builder->target).long_double_type.bit_width > 64;
 41870:     bool folded = !c_ir_number_imaginary_spelling(builder->arena, spelling, &ignored_real_spelling);
 41871:     if (folded && wide_source)
 41872:     {
 41873:         CIrConstantValue source = {0};
 41874:         CIrConstantValue converted = {0};
 41875:         folded = c_ir_constant_float_literal(builder, spelling, &source) && c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &source, child->id, &converted);
 41876:         floating = converted.floating;
 41877:     }
 41878:     else if (folded)
 41879:     {
 41880:         folded = c_ir_float_literal_value(spelling, &floating, &suffix);
 41881:     }
 41882:     if (folded)
 41883:     {
 41884:         c_ir_constant_initializer_store_float_leaf(child, negative ? -floating : floating, bytes);
 41885:     }
 41886:     return folded;
 41887: }
 41888: 
 41889: // The CHARACTER_TO_INTEGER arm: the constant's type is the one the evaluator
 41890: // gives it, int unless the prefix says otherwise.
 41891: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_fold_character_leaf(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end, u8* bytes)
 41892: {
 41893:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
 41894:     bool signed_prefix = end - start == 2;
 41895:     bool negative = signed_prefix && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
 41896:     u64 character = 0;
 41897:     CTypeKind kind = C_TYPE_INVALID;
 41898:     bool folded = c_ir_decode_character_value(builder->arena, builder->preprocess.spelling_base, tokens[end - 1], builder->target, &character, &kind);
 41899:     IrType* literal_type = 0;
 41900:     if (folded)
 41901:     {
 41902:         IrTypeId type = builder->scalar_types[kind];
 41903:         literal_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? builder->s32_type : type);
 41904:         folded = literal_type != 0;
 41905:     }
 41906:     if (folded && signed_prefix)
 41907:     {
 41908:         folded = c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_unary(builder, &literal_type, &character, negative);
 41909:     }
 41910:     if (folded)
 41911:     {
 41912:         c_ir_constant_initializer_store_integer_leaf(child, literal_type, character, bytes);
 41913:     }
 41914:     return folded;
 41915: }
 41916: 
 41917: // The IDENTIFIER_TO_INTEGER arm: an enumerator, a constexpr object or C23's
 41918: // `true`/`false`, resolved by c_ir_constant_identifier exactly as the
 41919: // evaluator resolves a lone identifier.  A name that resolves to anything
 41920: // but an integer constant -- an object, a function, `nullptr`, an unknown --
 41921: // is declined to the general folder, which refuses or folds it as before.
 41922: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_fold_identifier_leaf(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end, u8* bytes)
 41923: {
 41924:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
 41925:     bool signed_prefix = end - start == 2;
 41926:     bool negative = signed_prefix && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
 41927:     CIrConstantValue value = {0};
 41928:     bool folded = c_ir_constant_identifier(builder, end - 1, &value) && value.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER;
 41929:     IrType* constant_type = folded ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value.type) : 0;
 41930:     u64 integer = value.integer;
 41931:     folded = constant_type != 0;
 41932:     if (folded && signed_prefix)
 41933:     {
 41934:         folded = c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_unary(builder, &constant_type, &integer, negative);
 41935:     }
 41936:     if (folded)
 41937:     {
 41938:         c_ir_constant_initializer_store_integer_leaf(child, constant_type, integer, bytes);
 41939:     }
 41940:     return folded;
 41941: }
 41942: 
 41943: #if !BUSTER_OPTIMIZE
 41944: // The differential gate: a leaf an arm folded is folded again through the
 41945: // general folder into scratch, and the two answers must be the same bytes.
 41946: // Debug builds only -- the general fold is the cost the arms exist to
 41947: // remove, and the Release tree carries the tests.
 41948: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_initializer_check_literal_leaf(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId child_type, IrType* child, u32 start,
 41949:                                                                      u32 end, u8* bytes, u64 child_offset)
 41950: {
 41951:     u8 scratch[16] = {0};
 41952:     u32 scratch_relocation_count = 0;
 41953:     BUSTER_CHECK(child->layout.size <= sizeof(scratch));
 41954:     bool legacy_folded = c_ir_constant_initializer_bytes_legacy(builder, start, end, child_type, scratch, child->layout.size, child_offset, 0,
 41955:                                                                 &scratch_relocation_count, 0);
 41956:     BUSTER_CHECK(legacy_folded && memory_compare(scratch, bytes, child->layout.size));
 41957: }
 41958: #endif

 41960: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_context_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantInitializerContext* context)
 41961: {
 41962:     CIrConstantInitializerFrame* frames = context->frames;
 41963:     CIrConstantInitializerContinuation* continuation_work = context->continuation_work;
 41964:     CIrConstantInitializerRange* range_work = context->range_work;
 41965:     u8* bytes = context->bytes;
 41966:     u64 byte_count = context->byte_count;
 41967:     IrGlobalRelocation* relocations = context->relocations;
 41968:     u32* relocation_count = context->relocation_count;
 41969:     u32 relocation_capacity = context->relocation_capacity;
 41970:     u32 capacity = context->frame_capacity;
 41971:     u32 frame_count = context->frame_count;
 41972:     u64 span = context->span;
 41973:     while (frame_count)
 41974:     {
 41975:         CIrConstantInitializerFrame* frame = frames + frame_count - 1;
 41976:         if (!c_initializer_consume_separator(builder->preprocess.tokens, frame->limit, &frame->cursor, frame->next_index))
 41977:         {
 41978:             return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("invalid initializer separator"), frame->cursor);
 41979:         }
 41980:         bool designated = frame->cursor < frame->limit && (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->cursor], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) ||
 41981:                                                            c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->cursor], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT));
 41982:         if (designated && frame->borrowed)
 41983:         {
 41984:             u32 designated_cursor = frame->cursor;
 41985:             while (frame_count && frames[frame_count - 1].borrowed)
 41986:             {
 41987:                 frame_count -= 1;
 41988:                 if (frame_count)
 41989:                 {
 41990:                     frames[frame_count - 1].cursor = designated_cursor;
 41991:                 }
 41992:             }
 41993:             if (!frame_count)
 41994:             {
 41995:                 return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("invalid aggregate designator"), frame->cursor);
 41996:             }
 41997:             frame = frames + frame_count - 1;
 41998:             if (!c_initializer_consume_separator(builder->preprocess.tokens, frame->limit, &frame->cursor, frame->next_index))
 41999:             {
 42000:                 return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("invalid initializer separator"), frame->cursor);
 42001:             }
 42002:             designated = frame->cursor < frame->limit && (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->cursor], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) ||
 42003:                                                           c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->cursor], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT));
 42004:         }
 42005:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, frame->type);
 42006:         u64 slot_count = type ? c_ir_constant_initializer_slot_count(builder, type) : 0;
 42007:         if (!type || !type->layout.resolved || frame->cursor >= frame->limit || (frame->next_index >= slot_count && !designated))
 42008:         {
 42009:             if (!type || (!frame->borrowed && frame->cursor < frame->limit && frame->next_index >= slot_count))
 42010:             {
 42011:                 return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("initializer has more elements than the aggregate can hold"), frame->cursor);
 42012:             }
 42013:             u32 cursor = frame->cursor;
 42014:             bool borrowed = frame->borrowed;
 42015:             frame_count -= 1;
 42016:             if (borrowed && frame_count) frames[frame_count - 1].cursor = cursor;
 42017:             continue;
 42018:         }
 42019:         CIrConstantInitializerDesignator designator = {0};
 42020:         if (!c_ir_constant_initializer_designator(builder, frame, continuation_work, (u32)(span + 1), range_work, (u32)(span + 1), &designator)) return false;
 42021:         u64 selected = designator.selected;
 42022:         u32 value_start = designator.value_start;
 42023:         if ((!designator.has_designator && designator.selected_end >= slot_count) ||
 42024:             (type && (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR) && designator.selected_end >= slot_count))
 42025:         {
 42026:             return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("array designator index is outside the array bounds"), frame->cursor);
 42027:         }
 42028:         IrTypeId child_type = designator.value_type;
 42029:         IrType* child = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, child_type);
 42030:         u64 child_offset = designator.value_offset;
 42031:         if (!child) return false;
 42032:         u32 value_end = c_ir_constant_initializer_value_end(builder, value_start, frame->limit);
 42033:         if (value_end <= value_start)
 42034:         {
 42035:             return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("invalid aggregate initializer element"), value_start);
 42036:         }
 42037:         if (designator.range_count)
 42038:         {
 42039:             context->pending_range.designator = designator;
 42040:             context->pending_range.value_start = value_start;
 42041:             context->pending_range.value_end = value_end;
 42042:             context->frame_count = frame_count;
 42043:             context->step = C_IR_CONSTANT_INITIALIZER_CONTEXT_PUSH_RANGE;
 42044:             return true;
 42045:         }
 42046:         bool merge_union = designator.clear_union && frame->has_last_union && designator.clear_field != UINT32_MAX &&
 42047:                            frame->last_union_offset == designator.clear_offset && frame->last_union_field == designator.clear_field;
 42048:         bool clear_whole_union = designator.clear_union && !merge_union;
 42049:         u64 clear_offset = clear_whole_union ? designator.clear_offset : child_offset;
 42050:         u64 clear_size = clear_whole_union ? designator.clear_size : child->layout.size;
 42051:         bool clear_value = designator.has_designator && (clear_whole_union || !designator.value_field || !designator.value_field->is_bit_field);
 42052:         if (clear_value &&
 42053:             !c_ir_constant_initializer_clear_subobject(builder, bytes, byte_count, clear_offset, clear_size, 0, relocations, relocation_count, &context->relocation_extent))
 42054:         {
 42055:             return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("designated initializer exceeds the target object"), value_start);
 42056:         }
 42057:         if (designator.clear_union)
 42058:         {

 42932:             if (oldest.value < builder->parse.entity_count && string_equal(builder->parse.entities[oldest.value].name, name))
 42933:             {
 42934:                 return oldest;
 42935:             }
 42936:             if (oldest.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 42937:             {
 42938:                 return oldest;
 42939:             }
 42940:         }
 42941:     }
 42942:     if (builder->parse.name_lookup_buckets && builder->parse.entity_lookup_bucket_count &&
 42943:         (!builder->parse.symbols || !symbol || token_symbol_matches_name))
 42944:     {
 42945:         // The name chain is newest-first. Keep the last exact-spelling match
 42946:         // so this remains the oldest entity, just like the old table scan, but
 42947:         // only when the bounded chain retains that canonical descending-ID
 42948:         // order. Malformed chains fall through to the ascending scan below.
 42949:         u32 bucket = (u32)c_parse_name_hash(symbol, name) & (builder->parse.entity_lookup_bucket_count - 1);
 42950:         CEntityId oldest = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
 42951:         CEntityId entity = builder->parse.name_lookup_buckets[bucket];
 42952:         u32 previous_entity = UINT32_MAX;
 42953:         u32 chain_length = 0;
 42954:         bool chain_valid = true;
 42955:         while (entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && chain_length < builder->parse.entity_count)
 42956:         {
 42957:             if (entity.value >= builder->parse.entity_count || entity.value >= previous_entity)
 42958:             {
 42959:                 chain_valid = false;
 42960:                 break;
 42961:             }
 42962:             previous_entity = entity.value;
 42963:             if (string_equal(builder->parse.entities[entity.value].name, name))
 42964:             {
 42965:                 oldest = entity;
 42966:             }
 42967:             entity = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].next_by_name;
 42968:             chain_length += 1;
 42969:         }
 42970:         if (entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 42971:         {
 42972:             chain_valid = false;
 42973:         }
 42974:         if (chain_valid && oldest.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 42975:         {
 42976:             return oldest;
 42977:         }
 42978:     }
 42979: 
 42980:     // Hand-built parse results do not carry the index. Keep the original
 42981:     // ascending scan as the compatibility path for those callers.
 42982:     for (u32 entity_index = 0; entity_index < builder->parse.entity_count; entity_index += 1)
 42983:     {
 42984:         if (string_equal(builder->parse.entities[entity_index].name, name))
 42985:         {
 42986:             return (CEntityId){.value = entity_index};
 42987:         }
 42988:     }
 42989:     return C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
 42990: }
 42991: 
 42992: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_from_global(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrSymbolId symbol, CIrConstantValue* result)
 42993: {
 42994:     if (symbol.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && builder->module)
 42995:     {
 42996:         bool is_constexpr = false;
 42997:         for (u32 entity_index = 0; entity_index < builder->parse.entity_count; entity_index += 1)
 42998:         {
 42999:             CEntity* entity = builder->parse.entities + entity_index;
 43000:             if (builder->entity_symbols[entity_index].value == symbol.value)
 43001:             {
 43002:                 is_constexpr = entity->is_constexpr && entity->has_constant_value;
 43003:                 break;
 43004:             }
 43005:         }
 43006:         for (u32 global_index = 0; global_index < builder->module->global_count; global_index += 1)
 43007:         {
 43008:             IrGlobal* global = builder->module->globals + global_index;
 43009:             if (global->symbol.value != symbol.value)
 43010:             {
 43011:                 continue;
 43012:             }
 43013:             if (!is_constexpr && !global->is_read_only)
 43014:             {
 43015:                 return false;
 43016:             }
 43017:             IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, global->type);
 43018:             if (global->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO && c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(type))
 43019:             {
 43020:                 *result = c_ir_constant_integer(global->type, 0);
 43021:                 return true;
 43022:             }
 43023:             if (global->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO && type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 43024:             {
 43025:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){
 43026:                     .type = global->type,
 43027:                     .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER,
 43028:                 };
 43029:                 return true;
 43030:             }
 43031:             if (global->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_INTEGER && c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(type))
 43032:             {
 43033:                 u64 value = global->initializer_bits;
 43034:                 if (global->initializer_is_negative)
 43035:                 {
 43036:                     value = 0 - value;
 43037:                 }
 43038:                 *result = c_ir_constant_integer(global->type, value);
 43039:                 return true;
 43040:             }
 43041:             if (global->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_BYTES && c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(type) && type->layout.size == 16 &&
 43042:                 global->bytes.pointer && global->bytes.length == 16)
 43043:             {
 43044:                 *result = c_ir_constant_integer(global->type, 0);
 43045:                 if (builder->program->data_layout.endianness == TARGET_ENDIAN_LITTLE)
 43046:                 {
 43047:                     memcpy(&result->integer, global->bytes.pointer, 8);
 43048:                     memcpy(&result->integer_high, global->bytes.pointer + 8, 8);
 43049:                 }
 43050:                 else
 43051:                 {
 43052:                     memcpy(&result->integer_high, global->bytes.pointer, 8);
 43053:                     memcpy(&result->integer, global->bytes.pointer + 8, 8);
 43054:                 }
 43055:                 return true;
 43056:             }
 43057:             if (type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && global->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO)
 43058:             {
 43059:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){.type = global->type, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT};
 43060:                 return true;
 43061:             }
 43062:             if (type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && (type->bit_width == 80 || type->bit_width == 128) &&
 43063:                 global->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_BYTES && global->bytes.pointer && global->bytes.length == type->layout.size)
 43064:             {
 43065:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){.type = global->type, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT};
 43066:                 u32 payload_size = type->bit_width / 8;
 43067:                 for (u32 byte = 0; byte < payload_size; byte += 1)
 43068:                 {
 43069:                     u32 offset = builder->program->data_layout.endianness == TARGET_ENDIAN_LITTLE ? byte : payload_size - byte - 1;
 43070:                     if (byte < 8) result->integer |= (u64)global->bytes.pointer[offset] << (byte * 8);
 43071:                     else result->integer_high |= (u64)global->bytes.pointer[offset] << ((byte - 8) * 8);
 43072:                 }
 43073:                 return true;
 43074:             }
 43075:             if (global->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_FLOAT && type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && type->bit_width <= 64)
 43076:             {
 43077:                 f64 value = 0.0;
 43078:                 if (type->bit_width == 16)
 43079:                 {
 43080:                     value = type->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 ? c_ir_bfloat16_to_f64(global->initializer_bits)
 43081:                                                                          : c_ir_float16_to_f64(global->initializer_bits);
 43082:                 }
 43083:                 else if (type->bit_width == 32)
 43084:                 {
 43085:                     f32 narrowed = 0.0f;
 43086:                     u32 bits = (u32)global->initializer_bits;
 43087:                     memcpy(&narrowed, &bits, sizeof(narrowed));
 43088:                     value = (f64)narrowed;
 43089:                 }
 43090:                 else
 43091:                 {
 43092:                     memcpy(&value, &global->initializer_bits, sizeof(value));
 43093:                 }
 43094:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){.type = global->type, .floating = value, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT};
 43095:                 return true;
 43096:             }
 43097:             if (global->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_SYMBOL_ADDRESS && type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 43098:             {
 43099:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){
 43100:                     .type = global->type,
 43101:                     .symbol = global->initializer_symbol,
 43102:                     .addend = global->initializer_addend,
 43103:                     .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER,
 43104:                 };
 43105:                 return true;
 43106:             }
 43107:             return false;
 43108:         }
 43109:     }
 43110: 
 43111:     return false;
 43112: }
 43113: 
 43114: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_identifier(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 token_index, CIrConstantValue* result)
 43115: {
 43116:     CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[token_index];
 43117:     if (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(builder->preprocess.dialect) && (string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("true")) || string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("false"))))
 43118:     {
 43119:         *result = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->bool_type, string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("true")));
 43120:         return true;
 43121:     }
 43122:     if (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(builder->preprocess.dialect) && string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("nullptr")))
 43123:     {
 43124:         *result = (CIrConstantValue){.type = builder->nullptr_type, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER};
 43125:         return true;
 43126:     }
 43127:     CEntityId entity_id = c_ir_constant_entity_at(builder, token_index);
 43128:     if (entity_id.value < builder->parse.entity_count)
 43129:     {
 43130:         CEntity* entity = builder->parse.entities + entity_id.value;
 43131:         if (entity->kind == C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR || (entity->is_constexpr && entity->has_constant_value))
 43132:         {
 43133:             IrTypeId type = entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count ? builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value] : builder->s32_type;
 43134:             u64 value = entity->constant_value;
 43135:             if (entity->constant_is_negative)
 43136:             {
 43137:                 value = 0 - value;
 43138:             }
 43139:             *result = c_ir_constant_integer(type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? builder->s32_type : type, value);
 43140:             return true;
 43141:         }
 43142:         // A function-local static is C_ENTITY_LOCAL with a symbol -- the
 43143:         // clinic macros write `.kwtuple = (&_kwtuple.ob_base.ob_base)` where
 43144:         // _kwtuple is exactly that -- and it folds like any file-scope
 43145:         // object.  An automatic local has no symbol and stays refused.
 43146:         bool static_local = entity->kind == C_ENTITY_LOCAL && builder->entity_symbols[entity_id.value].value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 43147:         if ((entity->kind == C_ENTITY_OBJECT || static_local) && entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
 43148:         {
 43149:             IrSymbolId symbol = builder->entity_symbols[entity_id.value];
 43150:             IrTypeId type = builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value];
 43151:             IrType* type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
 43152:             if (type_value && type_value->layout.resolved)
 43153:             {
 43154:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){
 43155:                     .type = type,
 43156:                     .symbol = symbol,
 43157:                     .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE,
 43158:                 };
 43159:                 return true;
 43160:             }
 43161:         }
 43162:         if (entity->kind == C_ENTITY_FUNCTION && entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
 43163:         {
 43164:             IrTypeId function_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value];
 43165:             IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, function_type);
 43166:             if (pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 43167:             {
 43168:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){
 43169:                     .type = pointer_type,
 43170:                     .symbol = builder->entity_symbols[entity_id.value],
 43171:                     .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER,
 43172:                 };
 43173:                 return result->symbol.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 43174:             }
 43175:         }
 43176:     }
 43177: 
 43178:     return false;
 43179: }
 43180: 
 43181: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_lvalue_field(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantValue* value, String8 name)
 43182: {
 43183:     if (value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
 43184:     {
 43185:         return true;
 43186:     }
 43187:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
 43188:     if (type && (type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION))
 43189:     {
 43190:         for (u32 field_index = 0; field_index < type->field_count; field_index += 1)
 43191:         {
 43192:             IrField* field = type->fields + field_index;
 43193:             if (!string_equal(field->name, name))
 43194:             {
 43195:                 continue;
 43196:             }
 43197:             if (field->offset > INT64_MAX || value->addend > INT64_MAX - (s64)field->offset)
 43198:             {
 43199:                 return false;
 43200:             }
 43201:             value->type = field->type;
 43202:             value->addend += (s64)field->offset;
 43203:             value->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE;
 43204:             return true;
 43205:         }
 43206:     }
 43207: 
 43208:     return false;
 43209: }
 43210: 
 43211: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_index(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantValue* value, u64 index)
 43212: {
 43213:     if (value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
 43214:     {
 43215:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
 43216:         if (!type || (value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE && value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER) ||
 43217:             (type->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY && type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER))
 43218:         {
 43219:             return false;
 43220:         }
 43221:         IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type->element_type);
 43222:         if (!element || !element->layout.resolved || element->layout.size > INT64_MAX || index > (u64)INT64_MAX / BUSTER_MAX((u64)1, element->layout.size))
 43223:         {
 43224:             return false;
 43225:         }
 43226:         s64 offset = (s64)(index * element->layout.size);
 43227:         if (value->addend > INT64_MAX - offset)
 43228:         {
 43229:             return false;
 43230:         }
 43231:         value->type = type->element_type;
 43232:         value->addend += offset;
 43233:         value->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE;
 43234:     }
 43235: 
 43236:     return true;
 43237: }
 43238: 
 43239: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_normalize(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantValue* value)
 43240: {
 43241:     if (value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
 43242:     {
 43243:         if (value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE)
 43244:         {
 43245:             return value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_INVALID;
 43246:         }
 43247:         if (!c_ir_constant_from_global(builder, value->symbol, value))
 43248:         {
 43249:             value->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN;
 43250:         }
 43251:     }
 43252: 
 43253:     return true;
 43254: }
 43255: 
 43256: // IEEE-754 binary16 -- the representation of `_Float16` -- as bits and back.
 43257: // There is no host half type to convert through: this compiler builds under
 43258: // four C compilers and cross-compiles, so the format is encoded arithmetically
 43259: // with round-to-nearest-even, and the subnormal, overflow and NaN cases are
 43260: // spelled out rather than inherited from a host conversion.
 43261: //
 43262: // The f64 carrier every folded constant travels in is exact over the whole
 43263: // binary16 range -- the largest finite value is 65504 and the smallest
 43264: // subnormal 2^-24, both exact in binary64 -- so this pair is the only place a
--- lines 44137-44446 ---
 44137:                     *result = (CIrConstantValue){.type = target_type, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN};
 44138:                     success = true;
 44139:                 }
 44140:                 else if (target->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN)
 44141:                 {
 44142:                     // C 6.3.1.2: compare to zero before any truncation. This
 44143:                     // includes floating fractions, NaNs, pointers and i128's
 44144:                     // high limb; a one-bit integer mask cannot implement it.
 44145:                     success = source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER || source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT ||
 44146:                               (source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER && c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(source_type));
 44147:                     if (success)
 44148:                         *result = c_ir_constant_integer(target_type, c_ir_constant_truth(builder, &source));
 44149:                 }
 44150:                 else if (target->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 44151:                 {
 44152:                     success = source_type && (source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT ||
 44153:                               (source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER && c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(source_type)));
 44154:                     bool wide = target->bit_width > 64 || (source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT && source_type && source_type->bit_width > 64);
 44155:                     if (success && wide)
 44156:                     {
 44157:                         success = c_ir_constant_wide_float_cast(&source, source_type, target, result);
 44158:                     }
 44159:                     else if (success)
 44160:                     {
 44161:                         u32 precision = target->bit_width == 16   ? (target->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 ? 8u : 11u)
 44162:                                         : target->bit_width == 32 ? 24u
 44163:                                                                   : 53u;
 44164:                         f64 floating = source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT ? source.floating
 44165:                                                                          : c_ir_constant_integer_to_float(&source, source_type, precision);
 44166:                         // A floating source still rounds at the destination's
 44167:                         // precision; the integer path has already rounded once.
 44168:                         // binary16 rounds from the binary64 carrier in both
 44169:                         // cases: every value it can hold is exact there, so the
 44170:                         // integer path's own rounding cannot have moved a
 44171:                         // result across a half-precision boundary first.
 44172:                         if (target->bit_width == 16)
 44173:                             floating = target->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 ? c_ir_bfloat16_round(floating)
 44174:                                                                                         : c_ir_float16_round(floating);
 44175:                         else if (target->bit_width == 32)
 44176:                             floating = (f64)(f32)floating;
 44177:                         *result = (CIrConstantValue){.type = target_type, .floating = floating, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT};
 44178:                     }
 44179:                 }
 44180:                 else if (c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(target))
 44181:                 {
 44182:                     if (source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT)
 44183:                     {
 44184:                         CIrWideInteger integer = {0};
 44185:                         success = source_type && source_type->bit_width > 64
 44186:                                       ? c_ir_constant_wide_float_to_integer(&source, source_type, target, &integer)
 44187:                                       : c_ir_constant_float_to_integer(source.floating, target, &integer);
 44188:                         if (success)
 44189:                         {
 44190:                             *result = c_ir_constant_integer(target_type, integer.low & c_ir_integer_type_mask(target));
 44191:                             result->integer_high = target->bit_width == 128 ? integer.high : 0;
 44192:                         }
 44193:                     }
 44194:                     else
 44195:                     {
 44196:                         success = source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER ||
 44197:                                   (source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER && source.symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && source.addend == 0);
 44198:                         if (success)
 44199:                         {
 44200:                             u64 integer = source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER ? source.integer : 0;
 44201:                             IrType* source_integer_type = source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER ? source_type : 0;
 44202:                             // Replay a negative narrow source's sign before the
 44203:                             // target mask. Narrowing still discards the high bits.
 44204:                             if (source_integer_type && source_integer_type->is_signed)
 44205:                                 integer = (u64)c_ir_integer_signed_value(integer, source_integer_type);
 44206:                             *result = c_ir_constant_integer(target_type, integer & c_ir_integer_type_mask(target));
 44207:                             if (target->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && target->bit_width == 128 && source.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER)
 44208:                             {
 44209:                                 result->integer_high = source.integer_high;
 44210:                                 if (source_integer_type && source_integer_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && source_integer_type->bit_width < 128 &&
 44211:                                     source_integer_type->is_signed && source_integer_type->bit_width &&
 44212:                                     (source.integer & ((u64)1 << (source_integer_type->bit_width - 1))))
 44213:                                     result->integer_high = UINT64_MAX;
 44214:                             }
 44215:                         }
 44216:                     }
 44217:                 }
 44218:             }
 44219:         }
 44220:     }
 44221:     return success;
 44222: }
 44223: 
 44224: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_constant_common_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId left, IrTypeId right)
 44225: {
 44226:     IrType* left_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left);
 44227:     IrType* right_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right);
 44228:     if (left_value && right_value && (left_value->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT || right_value->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT ||
 44229:                                       c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(left_value) || c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(right_value)))
 44230:     {
 44231:         return c_ir_usual_arithmetic_type(builder, left, right);
 44232:     }
 44233:     return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 44234: }
 44235: 
 44236: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_apply_unary(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CConditionalOperator operation, IrTypeId cast_type,
 44237:                                                     CIrConstantValue* value)
 44238: {
 44239:     bool success = false;
 44240:     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_CAST)
 44241:     {
 44242:         CIrConstantValue cast = {0};
 44243:         success = c_ir_constant_cast(builder, value, cast_type, &cast);
 44244:         if (success)
 44245:             *value = cast;
 44246:     }
 44247:     else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_ADDRESS_OF)
 44248:     {
 44249:         if (value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE)
 44250:         {
 44251:             IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, value->type);
 44252:             success = pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 44253:             if (success)
 44254:             {
 44255:                 value->type = pointer_type;
 44256:                 value->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER;
 44257:             }
 44258:         }
 44259:     }
 44260:     else if (value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
 44261:     {
 44262:         success = true;
 44263:     }
 44264:     else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_DEREFERENCE)
 44265:     {
 44266:         IrType* pointer = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
 44267:         success = value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER && pointer && pointer->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER;
 44268:         if (success)
 44269:         {
 44270:             value->type = pointer->element_type;
 44271:             value->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE;
 44272:         }
 44273:     }
 44274:     else if (c_ir_constant_normalize(builder, value))
 44275:     {
 44276:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
 44277:         if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_NOT)
 44278:         {
 44279:             *value = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->s32_type, !c_ir_constant_truth(builder, value));
 44280:             success = true;
 44281:         }
 44282:         else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_PLUS || operation == C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS || operation == C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT)
 44283:         {
 44284:             if (value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT && operation != C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT)
 44285:             {
 44286:                 if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS)
 44287:                 {
 44288:                     if (type->bit_width > 64) value->integer_high ^= type->bit_width == 80 ? UINT64_C(0x8000) : UINT64_C(0x8000000000000000);
 44289:                     else value->floating = -value->floating;
 44290:                 }
 44291:                 success = true;
 44292:             }
 44293:             else if (c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(type))
 44294:             {
 44295:                 // All three unary integer operators promote. Cast the value,
 44296:                 // not just its type, so signed char/short retain their sign.
 44297:                 IrTypeId promoted = c_ir_constant_common_type(builder, value->type, value->type);
 44298:                 success = c_ir_constant_cast(builder, value, promoted, value);
 44299:                 if (success)
 44300:                 {
 44301:                     type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
 44302:                     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS)
 44303:                     {
 44304:                         if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->bit_width == 128)
 44305:                         {
 44306:                             CIrWideInteger negated = c_ir_wide_negate((CIrWideInteger){.low = value->integer, .high = value->integer_high});
 44307:                             value->integer = negated.low;
 44308:                             value->integer_high = negated.high;
 44309:                         }
 44310:                         else
 44311:                             value->integer = 0 - value->integer;
 44312:                     }
 44313:                     else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_BITWISE_NOT)
 44314:                     {
 44315:                         value->integer = ~value->integer;
 44316:                         if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->bit_width == 128)
 44317:                             value->integer_high = ~value->integer_high;
 44318:                     }
 44319:                     value->integer &= c_ir_integer_type_mask(type);
 44320:                 }
 44321:             }
 44322:         }
 44323:     }
 44324:     return success;
 44325: }
 44326: 
 44327: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_apply_binary(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CConditionalOperator operation, const CIrConstantValue* left_input,
 44328:                                                      const CIrConstantValue* right_input, CIrConstantValue* result)
 44329: {
 44330:     CIrConstantValue left = *left_input;
 44331:     CIrConstantValue right = *right_input;
 44332:     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_COMMA)
 44333:     {
 44334:         // A known right value does not make the evaluated left operand
 44335:         // constant. In particular, a call must not disappear from a probe.
 44336:         if (!c_ir_constant_normalize(builder, &left)) return false;
 44337:         *result = left.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN ? (CIrConstantValue){.type = right.type, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN} : right;
 44338:         return true;
 44339:     }
 44340:     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_AND || operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_OR)
 44341:     {
 44342:         if (left.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN && !c_ir_constant_normalize(builder, &left))
 44343:         {
 44344:             return false;
 44345:         }
 44346:         if (right.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN && !c_ir_constant_normalize(builder, &right))
 44347:         {
 44348:             return false;
 44349:         }
 44350:         bool left_known = left.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN;
 44351:         bool right_known = right.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN;
 44352:         if (left_known && right_known)
 44353:         {
 44354:             bool value = operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_AND ? c_ir_constant_truth(builder, &left) && c_ir_constant_truth(builder, &right)
 44355:                                                                 : c_ir_constant_truth(builder, &left) || c_ir_constant_truth(builder, &right);
 44356:             *result = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->s32_type, value);
 44357:             return true;
 44358:         }
 44359:         if (left_known)
 44360:         {
 44361:             bool left_truth = c_ir_constant_truth(builder, &left);
 44362:             if ((operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_AND && !left_truth) || (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_OR && left_truth))
 44363:             {
 44364:                 *result = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->s32_type, operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_OR);
 44365:                 return true;
 44366:             }
 44367:         }
 44368:         if (right_known)
 44369:         {
 44370:             bool right_truth = c_ir_constant_truth(builder, &right);
 44371:             if ((operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_AND && !right_truth) || (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_OR && right_truth))
 44372:             {
 44373:                 *result = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->s32_type, operation == C_CONDITIONAL_LOGICAL_OR);
 44374:                 return true;
 44375:             }
 44376:         }
 44377:         *result = (CIrConstantValue){.type = builder->s32_type, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN};
 44378:         return true;
 44379:     }
 44380:     if (left.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN || right.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
 44381:     {
 44382:         *result = (CIrConstantValue){.type = left.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN ? left.type : right.type, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN};
 44383:         return true;
 44384:     }
 44385:     IrType* left_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left.type);
 44386:     IrType* right_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right.type);
 44387:     bool left_pointer = left.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER;
 44388:     bool right_pointer = right.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER;
 44389:     if (left.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE)
 44390:     {
 44391:         left_pointer = false;
 44392:     }
 44393:     if (right.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE)
 44394:     {
 44395:         right_pointer = false;
 44396:     }
 44397:     // An array lvalue decays to a pointer to its first element before any
 44398:     // arithmetic (C 6.3.2.1p3). sbase's dc writes `static Num one = {.buf =
 44399:     // onestr, .wp = onestr + 1};`, and without the decay `onestr + 1` reaches
 44400:     // the integer path below with an array operand: the addend was dropped and
 44401:     // the initializer silently pointed at element zero.
 44402:     if (left.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE && left_type && left_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
 44403:     {
 44404:         left.type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, left_type->element_type);
 44405:         left.kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER;
 44406:         left_pointer = true;
 44407:     }
 44408:     if (right.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE && right_type && right_type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
 44409:     {
 44410:         right.type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, right_type->element_type);
 44411:         right.kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER;
 44412:         right_pointer = true;
 44413:     }
 44414:     // Adding a type may have grown the table, so re-resolve both operands.
 44415:     left_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left.type);
 44416:     right_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right.type);
 44417:     if ((left_pointer || (left_type && left_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)) || (right_pointer || (right_type && right_type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)))
 44418:     {
 44419:         if (!left_pointer && left.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER && left.integer == 0 && left.integer_high == 0)
 44420:         {
 44421:             left_pointer = true;
 44422:             left.type = right.type;
 44423:             left.symbol = IR_SYMBOL_ID_INVALID;
 44424:             left.addend = 0;
 44425:         }
 44426:         if (!right_pointer && right.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER && right.integer == 0 && right.integer_high == 0)
 44427:         {

 44867: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_complex_initializer_unary(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CConditionalOperator operation,
 44868:                                                                 const CIrConstantComplexInitializerValue* source,
 44869:                                                                 CIrConstantComplexInitializerValue* result)
 44870: {
 44871:     if (operation != C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_PLUS && operation != C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS)
 44872:     {
 44873:         return false;
 44874:     }
 44875:     *result = *source;
 44876:     if (!c_ir_constant_apply_unary(builder, operation, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID, &result->real))
 44877:     {
 44878:         return false;
 44879:     }
 44880:     return !source->is_complex || c_ir_constant_apply_unary(builder, operation, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID, &result->imaginary);
 44881: }
