 44883: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_complex_initializer_binary(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CConditionalOperator operation,
 44884:                                                                  const CIrConstantComplexInitializerValue* left,
 44885:                                                                  const CIrConstantComplexInitializerValue* right,
 44886:                                                                  CIrConstantComplexInitializerValue* result)
 44887: {
 44888:     if (!left->is_complex && !right->is_complex)
 44889:     {
 44890:         CIrConstantValue scalar = {0};
 44891:         if (!c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, operation, &left->real, &right->real, &scalar))
 44892:         {
 44893:             return false;
 44894:         }
 44895:         *result = (CIrConstantComplexInitializerValue){.real = scalar, .type = scalar.type};
 44896:         return true;
 44897:     }
 44898:     if (operation != C_CONDITIONAL_ADD && operation != C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT &&
 44899:         operation != C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY && operation != C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE)
 44900:     {
 44901:         return false;
 44902:     }
 44903:     IrTypeId left_element = left->is_complex ? left->element_type : left->type;
 44904:     IrTypeId right_element = right->is_complex ? right->element_type : right->type;
 44905:     IrTypeId element = c_ir_usual_arithmetic_type(builder, left_element, right_element);
 44906:     IrType* element_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, element);
 44907:     if (!element_type || element_type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 44908:     {
 44909:         return false;
 44910:     }
 44911:     IrTypeId result_type = c_ir_complex_type_for_element(builder, element);
 44912:     CIrConstantValue left_real = {0};
 44913:     CIrConstantValue right_real = {0};
 44914:     CIrConstantValue left_imaginary = {.type = element, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT};
 44915:     CIrConstantValue right_imaginary = {.type = element, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT};
 44916:     if (!c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &left->real, element, &left_real) ||
 44917:         !c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &right->real, element, &right_real) ||
 44918:         (left->is_complex && !c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &left->imaginary, element, &left_imaginary)) ||
 44919:         (right->is_complex && !c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &right->imaginary, element, &right_imaginary)))
 44920:     {
 44921:         return false;
 44922:     }
 44923:     CIrConstantValue real = {0};
 44924:     CIrConstantValue imaginary = {0};
 44925:     if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_ADD || operation == C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT)
 44926:     {
 44927:         if (!c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, operation, &left_real, &right_real, &real))
 44928:         {
 44929:             return false;
 44930:         }
 44931:         if (left->is_complex && right->is_complex)
 44932:         {
 44933:             if (!c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, operation, &left_imaginary, &right_imaginary, &imaginary))
 44934:             {
 44935:                 return false;
 44936:             }
 44937:         }
 44938:         else if (left->is_complex)
 44939:         {
 44940:             imaginary = left_imaginary;
 44941:         }
 44942:         else
 44943:         {
 44944:             imaginary = right_imaginary;
 44945:             if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT &&
 44946:                 !c_ir_constant_apply_unary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_UNARY_MINUS, IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID, &imaginary))
 44947:             {
 44948:                 return false;
 44949:             }
 44950:         }
 44951:     }
 44952:     else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY && left->is_complex && right->is_complex)
 44953:     {
 44954:         CIrConstantValue ac = {0};
 44955:         CIrConstantValue bd = {0};
 44956:         CIrConstantValue ad = {0};
 44957:         CIrConstantValue bc = {0};
 44958:         if (!c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, &left_real, &right_real, &ac) ||
 44959:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, &left_imaginary, &right_imaginary, &bd) ||
 44960:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, &left_real, &right_imaginary, &ad) ||
 44961:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, &left_imaginary, &right_real, &bc) ||
 44962:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT, &ac, &bd, &real) ||
 44963:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_ADD, &ad, &bc, &imaginary))
 44964:         {
 44965:             return false;
 44966:         }
 44967:     }
 44968:     else if (operation == C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY)
 44969:     {
 44970:         const CIrConstantValue* scalar = left->is_complex ? &right_real : &left_real;
 44971:         const CIrConstantValue* complex_real = left->is_complex ? &left_real : &right_real;
 44972:         const CIrConstantValue* complex_imaginary = left->is_complex ? &left_imaginary : &right_imaginary;
 44973:         if (!c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, complex_real, scalar, &real) ||
 44974:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, complex_imaginary, scalar, &imaginary))
 44975:         {
 44976:             return false;
 44977:         }
 44978:     }
 44979:     else if (!right->is_complex)
 44980:     {
 44981:         if (!c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE, &left_real, &right_real, &real) ||
 44982:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE, &left_imaginary, &right_real, &imaginary))
 44983:         {
 44984:             return false;
 44985:         }
 44986:     }
 44987:     else
 44988:     {
 44989:         CIrConstantValue cc = {0};
 44990:         CIrConstantValue dd = {0};
 44991:         CIrConstantValue denominator = {0};
 44992:         CIrConstantValue ac = {0};
 44993:         CIrConstantValue bd = {0};
 44994:         CIrConstantValue bc = {0};
 44995:         CIrConstantValue ad = {0};
 44996:         CIrConstantValue real_numerator = {0};
 44997:         CIrConstantValue imaginary_numerator = {0};
 44998:         if (!c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, &right_real, &right_real, &cc) ||
 44999:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, &right_imaginary, &right_imaginary, &dd) ||
 45000:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_ADD, &cc, &dd, &denominator) ||
 45001:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, &left_real, &right_real, &ac) ||
 45002:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, &left_imaginary, &right_imaginary, &bd) ||
 45003:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, &left_imaginary, &right_real, &bc) ||
 45004:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_MULTIPLY, &left_real, &right_imaginary, &ad) ||
 45005:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_ADD, &ac, &bd, &real_numerator) ||
 45006:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT, &bc, &ad, &imaginary_numerator) ||
 45007:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE, &real_numerator, &denominator, &real) ||
 45008:             !c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, C_CONDITIONAL_DIVIDE, &imaginary_numerator, &denominator, &imaginary))
 45009:         {
 45010:             return false;
 45011:         }
 45012:     }
 45013:     *result = (CIrConstantComplexInitializerValue){
 45014:         .real = real,
 45015:         .imaginary = imaginary,
 45016:         .type = result_type,
 45017:         .element_type = element,
 45018:         .is_complex = true,
 45019:     };
 45020:     return true;
 45021: }

 45023: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_complex_initializer_builtin(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end,
 45024:                                                                   CIrConstantComplexInitializerValue* result)
 45025: {

 45424:         index += 1;
 45425:         // C11 7.19p3 lets the member designator subscript as well as select,

 45427:         // *static* initializer -- so this constant walk, not just the value
 45428:         // path, has to follow one.  It only became reachable when __GNUC__
 45429:         // started being predefined in every dialect: <stddef.h> spells
 45430:         // offsetof as pointer arithmetic without it, and that form never

 45433:         {
 45434:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET);
 45435:             if (close >= end || !type || type->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY)
 45436:             {
 45437:                 return false;
 45438:             }
 45439:             CIrConstantValue subscript = {0};
 45440:             if (!c_ir_query_constant(builder, index + 1, close, &subscript) || subscript.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER)
 45441:             {
 45442:                 return false;
 45443:             }
 45444:             IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type->element_type);
 45445:             if (!element || !element->layout.resolved)
 45446:             {
 45447:                 return false;
 45448:             }
 45449:             if (element->layout.size && subscript.integer > UINT64_MAX / element->layout.size)
 45450:             {
 45451:                 return false;
 45452:             }
 45453:             u64 element_offset = subscript.integer * element->layout.size;
 45454:             if (offset > UINT64_MAX - element_offset)
 45455:             {
 45456:                 return false;
 45457:             }
 45458:             offset += element_offset;
 45459:             type = element;
 45460:             index = close + 1;
 45461:         }
 45462:     }
 45463:     *offset_out = offset;
 45464:     return true;
 45465: }
 45466: 
 45467: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_is_null_pointer_constant(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantValue const* value)
 45468: {
 45469:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
 45470:     bool result = value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER && !value->integer && !value->integer_high;
 45471:     if (value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER && type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 45472:     {
 45473:         IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type->element_type);
 45474:         result = (type->is_nullptr || (element && element->kind == IR_TYPE_VOID)) && value->symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && !value->addend;
 45475:     }
 45476:     return result;
 45477: }
 45478: 
 45479: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_apply_operator(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantOperator operation, CIrConstantValue* values,
 45480:                                                        u32* value_count)
 45481: {
 45482:     bool success = false;
 45483:     if (operation.operation == C_CONDITIONAL_SELECT)
 45484:     {
 45485:         if (*value_count >= 3)
 45486:         {
 45487:             CIrConstantValue false_value = values[--*value_count];
 45488:             CIrConstantValue true_value = values[--*value_count];
 45489:             CIrConstantValue condition = values[--*value_count];
 45490:             IrTypeId true_type = c_ir_sizeof_operand_decay(builder, true_value.type);
 45491:             IrTypeId false_type = c_ir_sizeof_operand_decay(builder, false_value.type);
 45492:             IrTypeId common = c_ir_usual_arithmetic_type(builder, true_type, false_type);
 45493:             if (common.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 45494:             {
 45495:                 common = true_type.value == false_type.value
 45496:                              ? true_type
 45497:                              : c_ir_conditional_pointer_type(builder, true_type, false_type,
 45498:                                                               c_ir_constant_is_null_pointer_constant(builder, &true_value),
 45499:                                                               c_ir_constant_is_null_pointer_constant(builder, &false_value));
 45500:             }
 45501:             CIrConstantValue selected = c_ir_constant_truth(builder, &condition) ? true_value : false_value;
 45502:             if (condition.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
 45503:             {
 45504:                 selected = (CIrConstantValue){.type = common, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN};
 45505:                 success = common.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 45506:             }
 45507:             else if (common.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 45508:             {
 45509:                 // ?: converts the selected value to the common type before
 45510:                 // its consumer runs, even when its condition is constant.
 45511:                 success = selected.type.value == common.value || c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &selected, common, &selected);
 45512:             }
 45513:             if (success)
 45514:             {
 45515:                 values[(*value_count)++] = selected;
 45516:             }
 45517:         }
 45518:     }
 45519:     else if (c_conditional_is_unary(operation.operation))
 45520:     {
 45521:         success = *value_count && c_ir_constant_apply_unary(builder, operation.operation, operation.cast_type, &values[*value_count - 1]);
 45522:     }
 45523:     else if (*value_count >= 2)
 45524:     {
 45525:         CIrConstantValue right = values[--*value_count];
 45526:         CIrConstantValue left = values[--*value_count];
 45527:         CIrConstantValue result = {0};
 45528:         success = c_ir_constant_apply_binary(builder, operation.operation, &left, &right, &result);
 45529:         if (success)
 45530:         {
 45531:             values[(*value_count)++] = result;
 45532:         }
 45533:     }
 45534:     return success;
 45535: }
 45536: 
 45537: // Failure exit for the query call sites in c_ir_constant_evaluate_impl: a
 45538: // pending request means the frame is suspended, not failed, so record where
 45539: // to pick the scan back up once the sub-query completes.
 45540: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_evaluate_suspend(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrQueryResume* resume, u32 index, bool expect_operand, u32 value_start,
 45541:                                                         u32 operator_start, u32 value_count, u32 operator_count)
 45542: {
 45543:     if (builder->queries->has_request)
 45544:     {
 45545:         *resume = (CIrQueryResume){
 45546:             .index = index,
 45547:             .value_start = value_start,
 45548:             .operator_start = operator_start,
 45549:             .value_count = value_count,
 45550:             .operator_count = operator_count,
 45551:             .expect_operand = expect_operand,
 45552:             .valid = true,
 45553:         };
 45554:     }
 45555:     return false;
 45556: }
 45557: 
 45558: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_evaluate_impl(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, CIrConstantValue* result_out, u32 value_start,
 45559:                                                      u32 operator_start, CIrQueryResume* resume)
 45560: {
 45561:     if (start >= end || end > builder->preprocess.token_count || !builder->queries)
 45562:     {
 45563:         return false;
 45564:     }
 45565:     u32 capacity = end - start + 8;
 45566:     if (value_start > builder->queries->value_capacity || capacity > builder->queries->value_capacity - value_start ||
 45567:         operator_start > builder->queries->operator_capacity || capacity > builder->queries->operator_capacity - operator_start)
 45568:     {
 45569:         builder->failure_message = S8("C constant-expression nesting exceeds the query buffer capacity");
 45570:         builder->failure_token_index = start;
 45571:         return false;
 45572:     }
 45573:     CIrConstantValue* values = builder->queries->values + value_start;
 45574:     CIrConstantOperator* operators = builder->queries->operators + operator_start;
 45575:     u32 value_count = 0;
 45576:     u32 operator_count = 0;
 45577:     bool expect_operand = true;
 45578:     u32 scan_start = start;
 45579:     if (resume->valid)
 45580:     {
 45581:         scan_start = resume->index;
 45582:         value_count = resume->value_count;
 45583:         operator_count = resume->operator_count;
 45584:         expect_operand = resume->expect_operand;
 45585:         resume->valid = false;
 45586:     }
 45587:     for (u32 index = scan_start; index < end; index += 1)
 45588:     {
 45589:         CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];
 45590:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_INVALID)
 45591:         {
 45592:             continue;
 45593:         }
 45594:         if (expect_operand)
 45595:         {
 45596:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
 45597:             {
 45598:                 CIrConstantValue value = {0};
 45599:                 if (c_number_is_float(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token)))
 45600:                 {
 45601:                     // This evaluator has no complex value, and folding an
 45602:                     // imaginary literal as its magnitude would answer
 45603:                     // `1.0i == 1.0` with true. Refuse instead.
 45604:                     String8 ignored_real_spelling = {0};
 45605:                     if (c_ir_number_imaginary_spelling(builder->arena, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token),
 45606:                                                        &ignored_real_spelling))
 45607:                     {
 45608:                         return false;
 45609:                     }
 45610:                     if (!c_ir_constant_float_literal(builder, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), &value)) return false;
 45611:                 }
 45612:                 else
 45613:                 {
 45614:                     u64 integer = 0;
 45615:                     if (!c_conditional_number(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), &integer)) return false;
 45616:                     value = c_ir_constant_integer(c_ir_integer_literal_type(builder, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), integer), integer);
 45617:                     if (value.type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID) return false;
 45618:                 }
 45619:                 if (value_count >= capacity) return false;
 45620:                 values[value_count++] = value;
 45621:                 expect_operand = false;
 45622:                 continue;
 45623:             }
 45624:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_CHARACTER_LITERAL)
 45625:             {
 45626:                 u64 character = 0;
 45627:                 CTypeKind kind = C_TYPE_INVALID;
 45628:                 if (!c_ir_decode_character_value(builder->arena, builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token, builder->target, &character, &kind)) return false;
 45629:                 IrTypeId type = builder->scalar_types[kind];
 45630:                 if (type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID) type = builder->s32_type;
 45631:                 values[value_count++] = c_ir_constant_integer(type, character);
 45632:                 expect_operand = false;
 45633:                 continue;
 45634:             }
 45635:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && (string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("sizeof")) || c_parse_alignof_word(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token))) && index + 1 < end &&
 45636:                 c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 45637:             {
 45638:                 u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index + 1, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 45639:                 if (close >= end) return false;
 45640:                 // `sizeof (T){...}` sizes the compound literal, so the operand
 45641:                 // is the whole postfix expression and not the type name the
 45642:                 // parenthesis closes.
 45643:                 u32 literal_end = c_ir_sizeof_compound_literal_operand_end(builder, index + 1, end);
 45644:                 bool literal = literal_end != UINT32_MAX;
 45645:                 u32 operand_start = literal ? index + 1 : index + 2;
 45646:                 u32 operand_end = literal ? literal_end : close;
 45647:                 u32 consumed_index = literal ? literal_end - 1 : close;
 45648:                 builder->queries->value_count = value_start + value_count;
 45649:                 builder->queries->operator_count = operator_start + operator_count;
 45650:                 IrTypeId type_id = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 45651:                 // A compound literal is an expression, so it never names a type
 45652:                 // here; it resolves through the sizeof query below.
 45653:                 bool type_resolved = !literal && c_ir_query_type_name(builder, operand_start, operand_end, true, &type_id);
 45654:                 if (!literal && !type_resolved && builder->queries->has_request)
 45655:                 {
 45656:                     return c_ir_constant_evaluate_suspend(builder, resume, index, expect_operand, value_start, operator_start, value_count, operator_count);
 45657:                 }
 45658:                 u64 size = 0;
 45659:                 u32 alignment = 0;
 45660:                 if (type_id.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 45661:                 {
 45662:                     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
 45663:                     if (!type || !type->layout.resolved) return false;
 45664:                     size = c_ir_sizeof_operand_size(type);
 45665:                     alignment = c_ir_sizeof_operand_alignment(type);
 45666:                 }
 45667:                 else if (!c_ir_query_sizeof(builder, operand_start, operand_end, &size, &alignment))
 45668:                 {
 45669:                     return c_ir_constant_evaluate_suspend(builder, resume, index, expect_operand, value_start, operator_start, value_count, operator_count);
 45670:                 }
 45671:                 values[value_count++] = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->size_type, c_parse_alignof_word(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token)) ? alignment : size);
 45672:                 expect_operand = false;
 45673:                 index = consumed_index;
 45674:                 continue;
 45675:             }
 45676:             // `sizeof` over an expression takes no parentheses of its own: the
 45677:             // operand is the unary expression that follows. musl's `__tz.c`
 45678:             // writes `static size_t old_tz_size = sizeof old_tz_buf;` and
 45679:             // `c_locale.c` writes `.map_size = sizeof empty_mo`, both of which
 45680:             // are static initializers and so reach this evaluator.
 45681:             // `_Alignof` is not spelled this way -- C11 6.5.3.4 gives it a
 45682:             // parenthesized type name only -- so only `sizeof` is taken here.
 45683:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("sizeof")) && index + 1 < end &&
 45684:                 !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 45685:             {
 45686:                 u32 operand_end = c_ir_unary_expression_end(builder, index + 1, end);
 45687:                 if (operand_end <= index + 1)
 45688:                 {
 45689:                     return false;
 45690:                 }
 45691:                 u64 size = 0;
 45692:                 u32 alignment = 0;
 45693:                 builder->queries->value_count = value_start + value_count;
 45694:                 builder->queries->operator_count = operator_start + operator_count;
 45695:                 if (!c_ir_query_sizeof(builder, index + 1, operand_end, &size, &alignment))
 45696:                 {
 45697:                     return c_ir_constant_evaluate_suspend(builder, resume, index, expect_operand, value_start, operator_start, value_count, operator_count);
 45698:                 }
 45699:                 values[value_count++] = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->size_type, size);
 45700:                 expect_operand = false;
 45701:                 index = operand_end - 1;
 45702:                 continue;
 45703:             }
 45704:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && (string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("__builtin_offsetof")) || string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("offsetof"))) &&
 45705:                 index + 1 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 45706:             {
 45707:                 u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index + 1, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 45708:                 u64 offset = 0;
 45709:                 builder->queries->value_count = value_start + value_count;
 45710:                 builder->queries->operator_count = operator_start + operator_count;
 45711:                 if (close >= end || !c_ir_query_offsetof(builder, index + 2, close, &offset))
 45712:                 {
 45713:                     return c_ir_constant_evaluate_suspend(builder, resume, index, expect_operand, value_start, operator_start, value_count, operator_count);
 45714:                 }
 45715:                 values[value_count++] = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->size_type, offset);
 45716:                 expect_operand = false;
 45717:                 index = close;
 45718:                 continue;
 45719:             }
 45720:             // A generic selection has the type and value of its selected
 45721:             // association. Resolve the selector through the shared type matcher,
 45722:             // then schedule only that association on the explicit constant-query
 45723:             // stack. Unselected expressions remain semantically checked by the
 45724:             // ordinary generic-selection walk but are never evaluated here.
 45725:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && index + 1 < end &&
 45726:                 string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("_Generic")) &&
 45727:                 c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 45728:             {
 45729:                 u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index + 1, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS,
 45730:                                                            C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 45731:                 u32 selected_start = 0;
 45732:                 u32 selected_end = 0;
 45733:                 IrTypeId selected_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 45734:                 CIrConstantValue selected = {0};
 45735:                 builder->queries->value_count = value_start + value_count;
 45736:                 builder->queries->operator_count = operator_start + operator_count;
 45737:                 if (close >= end ||
 45738:                     !c_ir_generic_selection(builder, index, close + 1, &selected_start, &selected_end, &selected_type) ||
 45739:                     !c_ir_query_constant(builder, selected_start, selected_end, &selected))
 45740:                 {
 45741:                     return c_ir_constant_evaluate_suspend(builder, resume, index, expect_operand, value_start, operator_start,
 45742:                                                           value_count, operator_count);
 45743:                 }
 45744:                 (void)selected_type;
 45745:                 if (value_count >= capacity)
 45746:                 {
--- lines 45869-46069 ---
 45869:                         // The destination's own is the one the callers already
 45870:                         // apply to whatever this evaluator hands back.
 45871:                         CIrConstantValue converted_literal = {0};
 45872:                         if (value_count >= capacity || !c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &body, literal_type, &converted_literal))
 45873:                         {
 45874:                             return false;
 45875:                         }
 45876:                         values[value_count++] = converted_literal;
 45877:                         expect_operand = false;
 45878:                         index = literal_close;
 45879:                         continue;
 45880:                     }
 45881:                 }
 45882:                 IrTypeId cast_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
 45883:                 if (close < end)
 45884:                 {
 45885:                     c_ir_query_type_name(builder, index + 1, close, true, &cast_type);
 45886:                     if (builder->queries->has_request)
 45887:                     {
 45888:                         return c_ir_constant_evaluate_suspend(builder, resume, index, expect_operand, value_start, operator_start, value_count, operator_count);
 45889:                     }
 45890:                 }
 45891:                 if (cast_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 45892:                 {
 45893:                     if (operator_count >= capacity) return false;
 45894:                     operators[operator_count++] = (CIrConstantOperator){.operation = C_CONDITIONAL_CAST, .cast_type = cast_type};
 45895:                     index = close;
 45896:                     expect_operand = true;
 45897:                     continue;
 45898:                 }
 45899:                 if (operator_count >= capacity) return false;
 45900:                 operators[operator_count++] = (CIrConstantOperator){.operation = C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN};
 45901:                 continue;
 45902:             }
 45903:             CConditionalOperator operation = C_CONDITIONAL_OPERATOR_COUNT;
 45904:             if (c_conditional_operator(token, true, &operation))
 45905:             {
 45906:                 if (operator_count >= capacity) return false;
 45907:                 operators[operator_count++] = (CIrConstantOperator){.operation = operation};
 45908:                 continue;
 45909:             }
 45910:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && index + 1 < end &&
 45911:                 c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 45912:             {
 45913:                 CEntityId entity_id = c_ir_constant_entity_at(builder, index);
 45914:                 u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index + 1, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
 45915:                 if (entity_id.value >= builder->parse.entity_count || builder->parse.entities[entity_id.value].kind != C_ENTITY_FUNCTION || close >= end)
 45916:                 {
 45917:                     return false;
 45918:                 }
 45919:                 IrTypeId return_type = builder->s32_type;
 45920:                 CEntity* entity = builder->parse.entities + entity_id.value;
 45921:                 if (entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
 45922:                 {
 45923:                     IrTypeId function_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value];
 45924:                     IrType* function = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, function_type);
 45925:                     if (function && function->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION && function->return_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 45926:                     {
 45927:                         return_type = function->return_type;
 45928:                     }
 45929:                 }
 45930:                 if (value_count >= capacity) return false;
 45931:                 values[value_count++] = (CIrConstantValue){.type = return_type, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN};
 45932:                 index = close;
 45933:                 expect_operand = false;
 45934:                 continue;
 45935:             }
 45936:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 45937:             {
 45938:                 CIrConstantValue value = {0};
 45939:                 if (!c_ir_constant_identifier(builder, index, &value)) return false;
 45940:                 while (index + 2 < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) &&
 45941:                        builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 2].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 45942:                 {
 45943:                     if (!c_ir_constant_lvalue_field(builder, &value, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 2]))) return false;
 45944:                     index += 2;
 45945:                 }
 45946:                 if (value_count >= capacity) return false;
 45947:                 values[value_count++] = value;
 45948:                 expect_operand = false;
 45949:                 continue;
 45950:             }
 45951:             return false;
 45952:         }
 45953:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 45954:         {
 45955:             return false;
 45956:         }
 45957:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW))
 45958:         {
 45959:             if (index + 1 >= end || builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER || !value_count) return false;
 45960:             // `p->m` is `(*p).m`, so a constant pointer becomes the lvalue it
 45961:             // points at before the member is selected. That is the portable
 45962:             // `offsetof` musl's <stddef.h> falls back to when the compiler
 45963:             // does not claim GCC 4 --
 45964:             // `((size_t)((char *)&(((type *)0)->member) - (char *)0))` -- and
 45965:             // it stands in static storage in `strerror`'s message index and
 45966:             // in `dynlink`'s MIN_TLS_ALIGN.
 45967:             if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ARROW))
 45968:             {
 45969:                 CIrConstantValue* target = values + value_count - 1;
 45970:                 IrType* pointer = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, target->type);
 45971:                 if (target->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER && pointer && pointer->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 45972:                 {
 45973:                     target->type = pointer->element_type;
 45974:                     target->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE;
 45975:                 }
 45976:             }
 45977:             if (!c_ir_constant_lvalue_field(builder, &values[value_count - 1], c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, builder->preprocess.tokens[index + 1]))) return false;
 45978:             index += 1;
 45979:             continue;
 45980:         }
 45981:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
 45982:         {
 45983:             u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, index, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET);
 45984:             CIrConstantValue index_value = {0};
 45985:             builder->queries->value_count = value_start + value_count;
 45986:             builder->queries->operator_count = operator_start + operator_count;
 45987:             if (!value_count || close >= end || !c_ir_query_constant(builder, index + 1, close, &index_value) ||
 45988:                 index_value.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER || !c_ir_constant_index(builder, &values[value_count - 1], index_value.integer))
 45989:             {
 45990:                 return c_ir_constant_evaluate_suspend(builder, resume, index, expect_operand, value_start, operator_start, value_count, operator_count);
 45991:             }
 45992:             index = close;
 45993:             continue;
 45994:         }
 45995:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
 45996:         {
 45997:             while (operator_count && operators[operator_count - 1].operation != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN)
 45998:             {
 45999:                 if (!c_ir_constant_apply_operator(builder, operators[--operator_count], values, &value_count)) return false;
 46000:             }
 46001:             if (!operator_count) return false;
 46002:             operator_count -= 1;
 46003:             continue;
 46004:         }
 46005:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_QUESTION))
 46006:         {
 46007:             while (operator_count && operators[operator_count - 1].operation != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN &&
 46008:                    operators[operator_count - 1].operation != C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION && c_conditional_precedence(operators[operator_count - 1].operation) > 1)
 46009:             {
 46010:                 if (!c_ir_constant_apply_operator(builder, operators[--operator_count], values, &value_count)) return false;
 46011:             }
 46012:             operators[operator_count++] = (CIrConstantOperator){.operation = C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION};
 46013:             expect_operand = true;
 46014:             continue;
 46015:         }
 46016:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_COLON))
 46017:         {
 46018:             while (operator_count && operators[operator_count - 1].operation != C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION)
 46019:             {
 46020:                 if (operators[operator_count - 1].operation == C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN) return false;
 46021:                 if (!c_ir_constant_apply_operator(builder, operators[--operator_count], values, &value_count)) return false;
 46022:             }
 46023:             if (!operator_count) return false;
 46024:             operators[operator_count - 1].operation = C_CONDITIONAL_SELECT;
 46025:             expect_operand = true;
 46026:             continue;
 46027:         }
 46028:         CConditionalOperator operation = C_CONDITIONAL_OPERATOR_COUNT;
 46029:         if (!c_conditional_operator(token, false, &operation)) return false;
 46030:         u32 precedence = c_conditional_precedence(operation);
 46031:         bool right_associative = operation == C_CONDITIONAL_COMMA ? false : false;
 46032:         while (operator_count && operators[operator_count - 1].operation != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN &&
 46033:                operators[operator_count - 1].operation != C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION &&
 46034:                (c_conditional_precedence(operators[operator_count - 1].operation) > precedence ||
 46035:                 (!right_associative && c_conditional_precedence(operators[operator_count - 1].operation) == precedence)))
 46036:         {
 46037:             if (!c_ir_constant_apply_operator(builder, operators[--operator_count], values, &value_count)) return false;
 46038:         }
 46039:         if (operator_count >= capacity) return false;
 46040:         operators[operator_count++] = (CIrConstantOperator){.operation = operation};
 46041:         expect_operand = true;
 46042:     }
 46043:     if (expect_operand)
 46044:     {
 46045:         return false;
 46046:     }
 46047:     while (operator_count)
 46048:     {
 46049:         CIrConstantOperator operation = operators[--operator_count];
 46050:         if (operation.operation == C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN || operation.operation == C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION)
 46051:         {
 46052:             return false;
 46053:         }
 46054:         if (!c_ir_constant_apply_operator(builder, operation, values, &value_count)) return false;
 46055:     }
 46056:     if (value_count != 1)
 46057:     {
 46058:         return false;
 46059:     }
 46060:     *result_out = values[0];
 46061:     return result_out->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_INVALID && result_out->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN;
 46062: }

 46097: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_integer_constant_evaluate(Arena* arena, CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, u64* value_out)
 46098: {
 46099:     (void)arena;
 46100:     CIrConstantValue result = {0};
 46101:     if (!c_ir_constant_evaluate(builder, start, end, &result) || result.kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER)
 46102:     {
 46103:         return false;
 46104:     }
 46105:     *value_out = result.integer;
 46106:     return true;
 46107: }
 46108: 
 46109: // A bit-field's own bits, deposited into the constant bytes its storage unit
 46110: // occupies. One byte at a time rather than through a `u64` round trip, because
 46111: // a packed field with no single storage unit spans up to nine bytes and no
 46112: // integer of the host or the target is that wide. `clear` says whether the
 46113: // bytes already hold something the field replaces; an initializer building a
 46114: // zeroed object only ever adds to them.
 46115: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_deposit_bit_field(IrProgram* program, u8* bytes, u64 offset, u64 unit, u32 bit_offset, u32 bit_width, u64 value,
 46116:                                                        bool clear)
 46117: {
 46118:     if (!program || !bytes || !bit_width)
 46119:     {
 46120:         return;
 46121:     }
 46122:     u32 end = bit_offset + bit_width;
 46123:     for (u32 bit = bit_offset; bit < end;)
 46124:     {
 46125:         u64 unit_byte = bit / 8;
 46126:         u32 low = bit - (u32)unit_byte * 8;
 46127:         u32 count = BUSTER_MIN(8 - low, end - bit);
 46128:         u8 mask = (u8)((((u32)1 << count) - 1) << low);
 46129:         u8 piece = (u8)((u32)((value >> (bit - bit_offset)) & (((u64)1 << count) - 1)) << low);
 46130:         u64 target = program->data_layout.endianness == TARGET_ENDIAN_LITTLE ? unit_byte : unit - unit_byte - 1;
 46131:         if (clear)
 46132:         {
 46133:             bytes[offset + target] = (u8)(bytes[offset + target] & (u8)~mask);
 46134:         }
 46135:         bytes[offset + target] = (u8)(bytes[offset + target] | piece);
 46136:         bit += count;
 46137:     }
 46138: }
 46139: 
 46140: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_store_unit_bits(IrProgram* program, u64 size, u8* bytes, u64 offset, u64 bits, bool sign_extend)
 46141: {
 46142:     if (!program)
 46143:     {
 46144:         return;
 46145:     }
 46146:     for (u64 byte_index = 0; byte_index < size; byte_index += 1)
 46147:     {
 46148:         u64 source_index = program->data_layout.endianness == TARGET_ENDIAN_LITTLE ? byte_index : size - byte_index - 1;
 46149:         u8 byte = (u8)(source_index < sizeof(bits) ? bits >> (u32)(source_index * 8) : (sign_extend ? 0xff : 0));
 46150:         bytes[offset + byte_index] = byte;
 46151:     }
 46152: }
 46153: 
 46154: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_store_bits(IrProgram* program, IrType* type, u8* bytes, u64 offset, u64 bits, bool sign_extend)
 46155: {
 46156:     if (!type || !type->layout.resolved)
 46157:     {
 46158:         return;
 46159:     }
 46160:     c_ir_constant_store_unit_bits(program, type->layout.size, bytes, offset, bits, sign_extend);
 46161: }

 46163: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_global_constant_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CDeclaration declaration, IrType* type, u32 start, u32 end, IrGlobal* global)
 46164: {
 46165:     CIrConstantValue value = {0};
 46166:     if (c_ir_constant_evaluate(builder, start, end, &value))
 46167:     {
 46168:         if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
 46169:         {
 46170:             if (value.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER && value.integer != 0)
 46171:             {
 46172:                 return false;
 46173:             }
 46174:             CIrConstantValue converted = {0};
 46175:             if (!c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &value, global->type, &converted))
 46176:             {
 46177:                 return false;
 46178:             }
 46179:             if (c_ir_symbol_is_thread_local(builder, converted.symbol))
 46180:             {
 46181:                 return false;
 46182:             }
 46183:             if (converted.symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && converted.addend == 0)
 46184:             {
 46185:                 global->initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO;
 46186:             }
 46187:             else
 46188:             {
 46189:                 global->initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_SYMBOL_ADDRESS;
 46190:                 global->initializer_symbol = converted.symbol;
 46191:                 global->initializer_addend = converted.addend;
 46192:             }
 46193:             return true;
 46194:         }
 46195:         CIrConstantValue converted = {0};
 46196:         if (c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &value, global->type, &converted))
 46197:         {
 46198:             if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 46199:             {
 46200:                 if (type->bit_width > 64)
 46201:                 {
 46202:                     return false;
 46203:                 }
 46204:                 if (type->bit_width == 16)
 46205:                 {
 46206:                     // `converted` has already been rounded to binary16 by the
 46207:                     // cast above, so the encoding here cannot round twice.
 46208:                     global->initializer_bits = type->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 ? c_ir_bfloat16_bits_from_f64(converted.floating)
 46209:                                                                                               : c_ir_float16_bits_from_f64(converted.floating);
 46210:                 }
 46211:                 else if (type->bit_width == 32)
 46212:                 {
 46213:                     f32 narrowed = (f32)converted.floating;
 46214:                     // C23 6.7.1p6 wants a constexpr initializer exactly
 46215:                     // representable in the object's type.  The conversion
 46216:                     // above has already rounded `converted` to that type, so
 46217:                     // comparing against it would always agree; the question is
 46218:                     // asked of the same value at `f64`, the widest this
 46219:                     // evaluator carries, which is what `value` held before the
 46220:                     // destination's own conversion rounded it.
 46221:                     CIrConstantValue unrounded = {0};
 46222:                     if (declaration.is_constexpr && converted.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_FLOAT &&
 46223:                         c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &value, builder->f64_type, &unrounded) && (f64)narrowed != unrounded.floating)
 46224:                     {
 46225:                         return false;
 46226:                     }
 46227:                     u32 bits = 0;
 46228:                     memcpy(&bits, &narrowed, sizeof(bits));
 46229:                     global->initializer_bits = bits;
 46230:                 }
 46231:                 else
 46232:                 {
 46233:                     memcpy(&global->initializer_bits, &converted.floating, sizeof(converted.floating));
 46234:                 }
 46235:                 global->initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_FLOAT;
 46236:                 if (!global->is_read_only && global->initializer_bits == 0)
 46237:                 {
 46238:                     global->initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO;
 46239:                 }
 46240:                 return true;
 46241:             }
 46242:             if (c_ir_constant_type_is_integer(type))
 46243:             {
 46244:                 if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->bit_width == 128 && type->layout.size == 16)
 46245:                 {
 46246:                     u8* bytes = arena_allocate(builder->arena, u8, 16);
 46247:                     if (builder->program->data_layout.endianness == TARGET_ENDIAN_LITTLE)
 46248:                     {
 46249:                         memcpy(bytes, &converted.integer, 8);
 46250:                         memcpy(bytes + 8, &converted.integer_high, 8);
 46251:                     }
 46252:                     else
 46253:                     {
 46254:                         memcpy(bytes, &converted.integer_high, 8);
 46255:                         memcpy(bytes + 8, &converted.integer, 8);
 46256:                     }
 46257:                     global->bytes = (ByteSlice){.pointer = bytes, .length = 16};
 46258:                     global->initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_BYTES;
 46259:                     if (!global->is_read_only && converted.integer == 0 && converted.integer_high == 0)
 46260:                     {
 46261:                         global->initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO;
 46262:                     }
 46263:                     return true;
 46264:                 }

 46266:                 global->initializer_is_negative = type->is_signed && signed_value < 0;
 46267:                 global->initializer_bits = global->initializer_is_negative ? (u64)(-(signed_value + 1)) + 1 : converted.integer;
 46268:                 global->initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_INTEGER;
 46269:                 if (!global->is_read_only && global->initializer_bits == 0)
 46270:                 {
 46271:                     global->initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO;
 46272:                 }
 46273:                 return true;
 46274:             }
 46275:         }
 46276:     }
 46277: 
 46278:     return false;
 46279: }

 46978:         u8* bytes = arena_allocate(arena, u8, type->layout.size);
 46979:         u32 relocation_capacity = 0;
 46980:         if (!c_ir_constant_initializer_relocation_capacity(builder, type->layout.size, (u64)end - start, &relocation_capacity))
 46981:         {
 46982:             return false;
 46983:         }
 46984:         IrGlobalRelocation* relocations = arena_allocate(arena, IrGlobalRelocation, relocation_capacity);
 46985:         u32 relocation_count = 0;

 46987:         if (!c_ir_constant_initializer_bytes(builder, start, end, global->type, bytes, type->layout.size, relocations, &relocation_count, relocation_capacity))
 46988:         {
 46989:             return false;

 46991:         if (c_ir_global_canonicalize_zero_bytes(global, bytes, type->layout.size, relocation_count))
 46992:         {
 46993:             return true;
 46994:         }
 46995:         global->bytes = (ByteSlice){
 46996:             .pointer = bytes,
 46997:             .length = type->layout.size,
 46998:         };
 46999:         global->initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_BYTES;
 47000:         global->relocations = relocations;
 47001:         global->relocation_count = relocation_count;
 47002:         return true;
 47003:     }
 47004:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY && c_ir_tokens_are_string_literals(preprocess, start, end))
 47005:     {
 47006:         CIrDecodedString decoded = {0};

 47008:         if (!element ||

 47010:             !c_ir_string_array_element_compatible(builder, type->element_type, decoded) || decoded.bytes.length > type->layout.size)
 47011:         {
 47012:             return false;
 47013:         }
 47014:         u8* bytes = arena_allocate_zeroed(arena, u8, type->layout.size);
 47015:         if (decoded.bytes.length)
 47016:         {
 47017:             memcpy(bytes, decoded.bytes.pointer, decoded.bytes.length);
 47018:         }
 47019:         if (c_ir_global_canonicalize_zero_bytes(global, bytes, type->layout.size, 0))
 47020:         {
 47021:             return true;
 47022:         }
 47023:         global->bytes = (ByteSlice){
 47024:             .pointer = bytes,
 47025:             .length = type->layout.size,
 47026:         };
 47027:         global->initializer_kind = IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_BYTES;
 47028:         return true;
 47029:     }
 47030:     bool negative = false;
 47031:     if (end - start == 2 &&
 47032:         (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS)))
 47033:     {
 47034:         negative = c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
 47035:         start += 1;
 47036:     }
 47037:     if (end - start != 1)
 47038:     {
 47039:         return false;
 47040:     }
 47041:     CToken token = preprocess.tokens[start];
 47042:     if (token.kind != C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
 47043:     {
 47044:         return false;
 47045:     }
 47046:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
 47047:     {
 47048:         f64 value = 0.0;
 47049:         char8 suffix = 0;
 47050:         if (!c_ir_float_literal_value(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), &value, &suffix) ||
 47051:             (type->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 && (suffix == 'l' || suffix == 'L') &&
 47052:              target_data_layout(builder->target).long_double_type.bit_width > 64))
 47053:         {
 47054:             return false;
 47055:         }
 47056:         if (negative)
 47057:         {
 47058:             value = -value;
 47059:         }
 47060:         if (type->bit_width == 16)
 47061:         {
 47062:             // The `f16` suffix reports as 'h'; see c_ir_float_suffix. A
 47063:             // literal that already has the object's type has nothing left to
 47064:             // round, so C23 6.7.1p6's exactness rule does not apply to it.
 47065:             bool bfloat16 = type->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16;
 47066:             bool source_is_half = !bfloat16 && suffix == 'h';

 47205:                     operand_alignment = c_ir_sizeof_operand_alignment(value);
 47206:                     operand_resolved = true;
 47207:                 }
 47208:                 else if (type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 47209:                 {
 47210:                     // The operand is an expression, not a type name. Resolve it
 47211:                     // through the sizeof query only: the type-prediction query
 47212:                     // guesses int for anything it cannot resolve yet, and a
 47213:                     // guessed size folded into an array bound lays the global
 47214:                     // out too small (the stage-1 stray-global-write incident of
 47215:                     // 2026-08-08). Failing here re-queues the bound for a later
 47216:                     // type-mapping pass instead.
 47217:                     operand_resolved = c_ir_query_sizeof(builder, operand_start, operand_end, &operand_size, &operand_alignment);
 47218:                     if (builder->queries->has_request)
 47219:                     {
 47220:                         return false;
 47221:                     }
 47222:                 }
 47223:             }
 47224:             if (!operand_resolved)
 47225:             {
 47226:                 return false;
 47227:             }
 47228:             tokens[token_count++] = c_space_token(
 47229:                 &bound_space,
 47230:                 string_format(arena, S8("{u64}"),
 47231:                               c_parse_alignof_word(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index])) ? operand_alignment : operand_size),
 47232:                 C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER, C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE);
 47233:             index = consumed_index;
 47234:             continue;
 47235:         }
 47236:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && (string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("sizeof")) || c_parse_alignof_word(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token))) &&
 47237:             index + 1 < end && !c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
 47238:         {
 47239:             // `char tmp[sizeof h->chksum]` (sbase's tar) applies sizeof to a
 47240:             // unary expression instead of a parenthesized type name. Its
 47241:             // operand ends where the call-discovery scan says an unevaluated
 47242:             // operand ends, and the sizeof query resolves the expression's
 47243:             // type or fails outright — it never guesses one, so a bound this
 47244:             // pass cannot fold yet is re-queued rather than folded wrong.
 47245:             // Without this the bound stays unresolved and the array becomes a
 47246:             // variable-length one, which a declarator list then rejects.
 47247:             u32 operand_start = index + 1;
 47248:             u32 operand_end = c_ir_unevaluated_operand_end(builder, operand_start, end);
 47249:             u64 operand_size = 0;
 47250:             u32 operand_alignment = 0;
 47251:             if (operand_end <= operand_start || !c_ir_query_sizeof(builder, operand_start, operand_end, &operand_size, &operand_alignment) ||
 47252:                 builder->queries->has_request)
 47253:             {
 47254:                 return false;
 47255:             }
 47256:             tokens[token_count++] = c_space_token(
 47257:                 &bound_space,
 47258:                 string_format(arena, S8("{u64}"),
 47259:                               c_parse_alignof_word(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index])) ? operand_alignment : operand_size),
 47260:                 C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER, C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE);
 47261:             index = operand_end - 1;
 47262:             continue;
 47263:         }
 47264:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
 47265:         {
 47266:             CEntity* constant = c_parse_first_constant_entity_token(&parse, builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token);
 47267:             if (!constant)
 47268:             {
 47269:                 return false;
 47270:             }
 47271:             if (constant->constant_is_negative)
 47272:             {
 47273:                 tokens[token_count++] = c_space_token(&bound_space, S8("-"), C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
 47274:             }
 47275:             tokens[token_count++] = c_space_token(&bound_space, string_format(arena, S8("{u64}"), constant->constant_value),
 47276:                                                   C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER, C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE);
 47277:             continue;
 47278:         }
 47279:         tokens[token_count++] = c_space_retoken(&bound_space, preprocess.spelling_base, token);
 47280:     }
 47281:     CPreprocessResult evaluation = {
 47282:         .diagnostics = arena_allocate(arena, CDiagnostic, bound.token_count + 1),
 47283:         .target = preprocess.target,
 47284:         .dialect = preprocess.dialect,
 47285:     };
 47286:     return c_integer_expression_evaluate(arena, bound_space.base, tokens, token_count, 65536, &evaluation, count_out) && evaluation.diagnostic_count == 0;
 47287: }

 47289: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_array_bound_evaluate(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CArrayBound bound, u64* count_out)
 47290: {
 47291:     CIrQueryFrame result = {0};
 47292:     if (!c_ir_query_execute(builder, (CIrQueryFrame){.bound = bound, .kind = C_IR_QUERY_FRAME_ARRAY_BOUND}, &result) || !result.success)
 47293:     {
 47294:         return false;
 47295:     }
 47296:     *count_out = result.integer;
 47297:     return true;
 47298: }
 47299: 
 47300: // Answers the alignment the specifiers in [alignment_start, alignment_count)
 47301: // ask for: the maximum of `natural_alignment` and every request. The sizeof
 47302: // folding in c_parse_layout_alignment_specifiers walks the same records and
 47303: // must reach the same number.
 47304: //
 47305: // A GNU `aligned(N)` only ever raises, so an N the type already satisfies is
 47306: // exactly the no-op the maximum computes on its own -- a header defending
 47307: // itself with `aligned(2)` on an already 4-aligned member keeps its layout.
 47308: // `_Alignas` carries the opposite rule, since C requires a declaration's
 47309: // alignment to be at least the natural one, and Clang measures the largest
 47310: // request in the declaration rather than each one: `_Alignas(2)
 47311: // __attribute__((aligned(8))) int` is accepted, `_Alignas(2) int` is not.
 47312: //
 47313: // A rejected run still fills *alignment_out with the usable maximum, so the
 47314: // caller can finish the layout and report `*rejection_out` against the
 47315: // attribute instead of leaving a type nothing downstream can name.
 47316: //
 47317: // `requested_out`, when asked for, receives the largest alignment any of the
 47318: // records *asks* for, before it is merged with the declared type's natural
 47319: // alignment. Only the bit-field placement rule needs that raw number: GNU
 47320: // `aligned(N)` starts a bit-field at the next multiple of N bytes even when N
 47321: // is below the declared type's own alignment, while every other reader of a
 47322: // request only ever raises with it. Zero means no record resolved.
 47323: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrAlignmentStatus c_ir_alignment_evaluate(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 alignment_start, u32 alignment_count, u32 natural_alignment,
 47324:                                                              u32* alignment_out, u32* requested_out, String8* rejection_out)
 47325: {
 47326:     IrProgram* program = builder->program;
 47327:     CParseResult parse = builder->parse;
 47328:     IrTypeId* c_type_ir_map = builder->c_type_ir_map;
 47329:     u32 alignment = natural_alignment;
 47330:     u64 requested_maximum = 0;
 47331:     bool standard_below_natural = false;
 47332:     CIrAlignmentStatus status = C_IR_ALIGNMENT_RESOLVED;
 47333:     if (alignment_start > parse.alignment_count || alignment_count > parse.alignment_count - alignment_start)
 47334:     {
 47335:         return C_IR_ALIGNMENT_PENDING;
 47336:     }
 47337:     for (u32 index = 0; index < alignment_count; index += 1)
 47338:     {
 47339:         CAlignmentSpecifier specifier = parse.alignments[alignment_start + index];
 47340:         u64 requested = 0;
 47341:         if (specifier.type.value < parse.type_count)
 47342:         {
 47343:             IrTypeId type = c_type_ir_map[specifier.type.value];
 47344:             IrType* value = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, type);
 47345:             if (!value || !value->layout.resolved)
 47346:             {
 47347:                 return C_IR_ALIGNMENT_PENDING;
 47348:             }
 47349:             requested = value->layout.alignment;
 47350:         }
 47351:         else if (!c_ir_array_bound_evaluate(builder, (CArrayBound){
 47352:                                                 .token_start = specifier.token_start,
 47353:                                                 .token_count = specifier.token_count,
 47354:                                             },
 47355:                                             &requested))
 47356:         {
 47357:             return C_IR_ALIGNMENT_PENDING;
 47358:         }
 47359:         if (!requested)
 47360:         {
 47361:             continue;
 47362:         }
 47363:         if (requested > UINT32_MAX || (requested & (requested - 1)))
 47364:         {
 47365:             if (status == C_IR_ALIGNMENT_RESOLVED)
 47366:             {
 47367:                 *rejection_out = string_format(builder->arena, S8("alignment specifier requests {u64}, which is not a power of two the target can align to"), requested);
 47368:                 status = C_IR_ALIGNMENT_REJECTED;
 47369:             }
 47370:             continue;
 47371:         }
 47372:         // Only a request under the natural alignment can be the maximum that
 47373:         // violates the `_Alignas` rule, so the spelling -- a token load and a
 47374:         // compare -- is asked for only on that path.
 47375:         standard_below_natural |= requested < natural_alignment && c_alignment_specifier_is_standard(builder->preprocess, specifier);
 47376:         requested_maximum = BUSTER_MAX(requested_maximum, requested);
 47377:         alignment = BUSTER_MAX(alignment, (u32)requested);
 47378:     }
 47379:     if (requested_out)
 47380:     {
 47381:         *requested_out = requested_maximum > UINT32_MAX ? UINT32_MAX : (u32)requested_maximum;
 47382:     }
 47383:     if (status == C_IR_ALIGNMENT_RESOLVED && standard_below_natural && requested_maximum < natural_alignment)
 47384:     {
 47385:         *rejection_out = string_format(builder->arena, S8("_Alignas requests alignment {u64}, which is less than the minimum alignment of {u32} for the declared type"),
 47386:                                        requested_maximum, natural_alignment);
 47387:         status = C_IR_ALIGNMENT_REJECTED;
 47388:     }
 47389:     *alignment_out = alignment;
 47390:     return status;
 47391: }
 47392: 
 47393: // Marks every array type that some struct uses as its flexible array member.
 47394: // The answer is a property of the whole type table, so it is collected in one
 47395: // pass and read back by index; asking it per array type rescans every
 47396: // aggregate and every member, which is quadratic on a large translation unit.
 47397: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_collect_flexible_array_types(CParseResult* parse, bool* flexible)
 47398: {
 47399:     if (!parse || !flexible)
 47400:     {
 47401:         return;
 47402:     }
 47403:     memset(flexible, 0, sizeof(*flexible) * parse->type_count);
 47404:     for (u32 aggregate_index = 0; aggregate_index < parse->type_count; aggregate_index += 1)
 47405:     {
